text.en: 3A233 Mass spectrometers capable of measuring ions of 230 u or greater with a resolution better than 2/230, and ion sources therefor: N.B.: Mass spectrometers specially designed or manufactured for analyzing on-line uranium-hexafluoride samples are controlled under the Nuclear Export Control List of the People's Republic of China. a. Electron-bombardment mass spectrometers having both of the following characteristics: 1. A molecular-beam inlet system that injects a collimated beam of analyte molecules into the ion-source region where an electron beam ionizes the molecules; 2. Mass spectrometers designed for actinides or actinide fluorides and equipped with microfluorination ion sources. text.zh:
4A003 高性能“数字计算机”、电子组件及相关设备：
a．“调整后的峰值性能（APP）”大于8.0 加权每秒万亿次浮点运算（Weighted TeraFLOPS）的“数字计算机”；
b．为增强性能而专门设计或改装的“电子组件”，其采用处理器聚合方式以使“调整后的峰值性能（APP）”大于8.0 加权每秒万亿次浮点运算（Weighted TeraFLOPS）；
c．为聚合“数字计算机”性能而专门设计的外部互连设备，其单链路单向通信速率超过2.0 Gbyte/s，但不适用于内部互连设备（例如：背板、总线）、无源互连设备、网络访问控制器或通信信道控制器。
技术说明：调整后的峰值性能（APP）是指“数字计算机”在进行64 位或更多位的浮点加法和乘法运算的调整后的峰值速度。本技术说明涉及的缩写：n“数字计算机”中的处理器数量I 处理器编号（1，……，n）tᵢ 处理器时钟周期（tᵢ=1/Fᵢ）Fᵢ 处理器频率Rᵢ 峰值浮点运算速度Wᵢ
text.en: 4A003 High-performance “digital computers,” electronic assemblies, and related equipment: a. “Digital computers” with an “adjusted peak performance (APP)” exceeding 8.0 weighted tera floating-point operations per second (Weighted TeraFLOPS); b. “Electronic assemblies” specially designed or modified to enhance performance by aggregating processors to achieve an “adjusted peak performance (APP)” exceeding 8.0 Weighted TeraFLOPS; c. External interconnection equipment specially designed to aggregate the performance of “digital computers,” with a unidirectional communication rate per link exceeding 2.0 Gbyte/s; this does not apply to internal interconnection equipment (e.g., backplanes or buses), passive interconnection equipment, network access controllers, or communication channel controllers. Technical Note: Adjusted peak performance (APP) means the adjusted peak rate at which “digital computers” perform floating-point addition and multiplication operations of 64 bits or more. Abbreviations used in this Technical Note: n = number of processors in the “digital computer”; i = processor index (1, …, n); tᵢ = processor clock cycle (tᵢ = 1/Fᵢ); Fᵢ = processor frequency; Rᵢ = peak floating-point operating rate; Wᵢ =

text.zh:
体系结构调整因子APP 用加权万亿次浮点运算（Weighted TeraFLOPS （WT））表示，单位是10¹² 调整后的每秒浮点运算。APP 的计算方法如下：
1. 确定“数字计算机”中的每个处理器i 在每个时钟周期内执行的64 位或更多位的峰值浮点操作次数（FPOᵢ）。
说明：在确定FPO 时，仅包括64 位或更多位浮点加法、浮点乘法运算。所有浮点运算必须表示为每个处理器时钟周期所执行的运算次数；需要多个时钟周期完成的运算可以表示为每个时钟周期完成运算的分数值。对于不能进行64 位或更多位浮点操作数的处理器，其有效浮点运算速度R 为0。
2. 计算每个处理器的浮点运算速度R，Rᵢ= FPOᵢ/ tᵢ
3. 计算APP，APP=W₁×R₁+ W₂×R₂+…+ Wₙ×Rₙ
4. 对于“向量处理器”，Wᵢ=0.9；对于非“向量处理器”，Wᵢ=0.3说明1：对于在一个时钟周期内能够完成复合运算的处理器，例如同时进行加法和乘法运算，
text.en: architecture adjustment factor. APP is expressed in Weighted TeraFLOPS (WT), in units of 10¹² adjusted floating-point operations per second. APP is calculated as follows: 1. Determine the peak number of floating-point operations of 64 bits or more performed per clock cycle by each processor i in the “digital computer” (FPOᵢ). Note: In determining FPO, include only floating-point addition and multiplication operations of 64 bits or more. All floating-point operations must be expressed as the number performed per processor clock cycle; operations requiring multiple clock cycles may be expressed as fractions of an operation per clock cycle. For processors incapable of operating on floating-point operands of 64 bits or more, the effective floating-point operating rate R is zero. 2. Calculate each processor's floating-point operating rate R: Rᵢ = FPOᵢ/tᵢ. 3. Calculate APP: APP = W₁×R₁ + W₂×R₂ + … + Wₙ×Rₙ. 4. For “vector processors,” Wᵢ = 0.9; for non-“vector processors,” Wᵢ = 0.3. Note 1: For processors capable of compound operations in one clock cycle, such as simultaneous addition and multiplication,

text.zh:
所有运算次数都计算在内。说明2：就流水线处理器而言，有效浮点运算速度R 取流水线满时的流水线速度，或非流水线速度中的较高值。说明3：在计算APP 之前，应先对每个参与运算的处理器，按照其最大可能的理论值来计算其运算速度R。如果计算机制造商在手册或资料中声称，该计算机能够进行并发、并行、同时操作或运行，则在计算R 时，应考虑同时操作的因素。说明4：计算APP 时，不应考虑那些仅负责输出/输入和外部设备功能（例如：磁盘驱动器、通信及视频显示等）的处理器。说明5：计算APP 的值，不考虑通过“局域网”、广域网、I/O共享连接或共享设备、I/O 控制器以及任何由软件实现通讯互连的处理器组合。说明6：计算APP 的值，必须包括通过聚合、同时运算和共享内存方式专门设计用于增强系统性能的处理器组合。
技术说明：
1．聚合在同一芯片上的所有同时运行的处理器和加速器；
2．处理器组合共享内存方式，
text.en: count all operations. Note 2: For pipelined processors, the effective floating-point operating rate R is the higher of the fully loaded pipeline rate and the nonpipelined rate. Note 3: Before calculating APP, calculate the operating rate R of each participating processor at its maximum theoretical value. If the computer manufacturer states in manuals or literature that the computer can operate concurrently, in parallel, or simultaneously, simultaneous operation must be considered when calculating R. Note 4: Exclude processors dedicated solely to input/output and peripheral functions, such as disk drives, communications, and video displays, when calculating APP. Note 5: Exclude processor combinations interconnected through “local area networks,” wide area networks, shared I/O connections or devices, I/O controllers, or any software-implemented communication interconnection when calculating APP. Note 6: Include processor combinations specially designed to enhance system performance through aggregation, simultaneous operation, and shared memory when calculating APP. Technical Notes: 1. Aggregate all simultaneously operating processors and accelerators on the same chip; 2. Shared memory for a processor combination means

text.zh: 是任一处理器通过高速缓存块或存储字的硬件传输、不用任何的软件机制可以访问系统中的任一内存地址。该方式可以通过4A003.b 所管制的“电子组件”获得。说明7：“向量处理器”定义为内置向量指令的处理器，这些指令能够同时进行多重浮点向量（64 位或更多位的一维数组）运算，且处理器中至少含有2 个向量功能部件和至少8 个向量寄存器，每个向量寄存器至少包含64 个数据单元。
text.en: that any processor can access any memory address in the system by hardware transfer of cache blocks or memory words, without any software mechanism. This may be achieved through “electronic assemblies” controlled under 4A003.b. Note 7: A “vector processor” is a processor with built-in vector instructions capable of simultaneously performing multiple operations on floating-point vectors (one-dimensional arrays of 64 bits or more), with at least two vector functional units and at least eight vector registers, each containing at least 64 data elements.

text.zh:

a．具有以下任一特性，部分或全部实现了密码运算、密钥管理、随机数生成等功能的集成电路芯片（安全芯片）：
1．含有专门用于电力、税务、公安、金融等领域的64 位以上密钥长度的对称密码算法，768 位以上密钥长度的基于整数因子分解的非对称密码算法或128 位以上密钥长度基于椭圆曲线的非对称密码算法；

Equipment whose primary function is cryptographic processing (cryptographic machines or cards), having both of the following characteristics: 1. text.zh:
6A108 目标探测电子装置和部件：
a．雷达设备：
b．地形等高线绘制设备；
c．场景绘图及相关设备（包括数字和模拟设备）；
d．成像传感器设备；
e．排除传导热的电子装置和部件；
f．“抗辐射加固”的电子装置和部件；
g．能够在超过125 ℃温度下短期可靠工作的电子装置和部件；
h．具有专门设计的整体结构支承件的电子装置和部件。
说明：6A108 项不管制集成到民用飞机、通用航空器等民用航空器上的目标探测电子装置和部件。“无人驾驶航空器”及相关物项的出口管制，本清单另有规定的，依照其规定。
text.en: 6A108 Target-detection electronic devices and components: a. Radar equipment: b. Terrain-contour mapping equipment; c. Scene-mapping and related equipment, including digital and analog equipment; d. Imaging sensor equipment; e. Electronic devices and components that remove heat by conduction; f. "Radiation-hardened" electronic devices and components; g. Electronic devices and components capable of reliable short-term operation at temperatures above 125 °C; h. Electronic devices and components with specially designed integral structural supports. Note: 6A108 does not control target-detection electronic devices and components integrated into civil aircraft, including civil airplanes and general-aviation aircraft. Where this List otherwise provides for export controls on "unmanned aerial vehicles" and related items, those provisions apply.

text.zh:
6A203 高速相机和成像装置及其部件：
注意：为增强或发挥相机或成像装置的性能以符合以下特性而专门设计的软件由6D203、6D204 项实施管制。
a．以下扫描相机和为其专门设计的部件：
1．记录速度大于0.5 mm/μs 的扫描相机；
2．时间分辨率能够小于等于50 ns 的电子扫描相机；
3．6A203.a.2 项所管制的相机的扫描管；
4．为与具有模块式结构并达到6A203.a.1 或6A203.a.2 项性能指标的扫描相机结合使用而专门设计的插件；
5．为6A203.a.1 项所管制相机专门设计的同步电子部件，以及由涡轮、反射镜和轴承组成的旋转组件。
b．以下分幅相机和为其专门设计的部件：
1．记录速率大于每秒225000 帧的分幅相机；
2．帧曝光时间能够小于等于50 ns 的分幅相机；
3．为6A203.b.1 或6A203.b.2 项所管制相机专门设计，且选通（快门）时间小于等于50 ns
text.en: 6A203 High-speed cameras, imaging devices, and components: N.B.: Software specially designed to enhance or release the performance of cameras or imaging devices to meet the following characteristics is controlled under 6D203 and 6D204. a. The following streak cameras and specially designed components therefor: 1. Streak cameras with recording speeds greater than 0.5 mm/μs; 2. Electronic streak cameras capable of temporal resolution of 50 ns or less; 3. Streak tubes for cameras controlled under 6A203.a.2; 4. Plug-ins specially designed for use with modular streak cameras meeting the performance specifications of 6A203.a.1 or 6A203.a.2; 5. Synchronization electronics and rotating assemblies consisting of turbines, mirrors, and bearings, specially designed for cameras controlled under 6A203.a.1. b. The following framing cameras and specially designed components therefor: 1. Framing cameras with recording rates greater than 225000 frames per second; 2. Framing cameras capable of frame-exposure times of 50 ns or less; 3. Specially designed for cameras controlled under 6A203.b.1 or 6A203.b.2 and having gating (shutter) times of 50 ns or less:

text.zh:
的分幅管和固态成像器件；
4．为与具有模块式结构并达到6A203.b.1 或6A203.b.2 项性能指标的分幅相机结合使用而专门设计的插件；
5．为6A203.b.1 或6A203.b.2 项所管制的相机专门设计的同步电子部件，由涡轮、反射镜和轴承组成的旋转组件；
c．以下固态或电子管相机和为其专门设计的部件：
1．选通（快门）时间小于等于50 ns 的固态相机或电子管相机；
2．为6A203.c.1 项所管制的相机专门设计，且选通（快门）时间小于等于50 ns 的固态成像装置和图像增强管；
3．选通（快门）时间小于等于50 ns 的电光快门装置（克尔盒或泡克耳斯盒）；
4．为与具有模块式结构并达到6A203.c.1 项性能指标的相机结合使用而专门设计的插件；
技术说明：高速单帧相机可单独用于产生一项动态事件的单一图像，或可将若干这类相机与顺序触发系统相结合，以产生一项事件的多幅图像。
d．专门设计或认定为抗辐射，
text.en: framing tubes and solid-state imaging devices; 4. Plug-ins specially designed for use with modular framing cameras meeting the performance specifications of 6A203.b.1 or 6A203.b.2; 5. Synchronization electronics and rotating assemblies consisting of turbines, mirrors, and bearings, specially designed for cameras controlled under 6A203.b.1 or 6A203.b.2; c. The following solid-state or electron-tube cameras and specially designed components therefor: 1. Solid-state or electron-tube cameras with gating (shutter) times of 50 ns or less; 2. Solid-state imaging devices and image-intensifier tubes specially designed for cameras controlled under 6A203.c.1, with gating (shutter) times of 50 ns or less; 3. Electro-optical shutter devices (Kerr or Pockels cells) with gating (shutter) times of 50 ns or less; 4. Plug-ins specially designed for use with modular cameras meeting the performance specifications of 6A203.c.1; Technical Note: A high-speed single-frame camera may be used alone to produce a single image of a dynamic event, or several such cameras may be combined with a sequential-triggering system to produce multiple images of an event. d. Television cameras and lenses specially designed or rated as radiation-hardened,

text.zh:
可承受大于5×10⁴ Gy（硅）的总辐射剂量且不会降低使用性能的电视摄像机及其镜头。
技术说明：Gy（硅）是指某一未屏蔽的硅样品暴露于电离辐射时所吸收的能量，以J/kg 为单位。
text.en: capable of withstanding a total radiation dose greater than 5×10⁴ Gy (silicon) without degradation of operational performance. Technical Note: Gy (silicon) means the energy absorbed by an unshielded silicon sample exposed to ionizing radiation, expressed in J/kg.

title.zh: 激光器、激光放大器和振荡器：
title.en: Lasers, laser amplifiers, and oscillators:

summary.zh: 激光器、激光放大器和振荡器：
summary.en: Lasers, laser amplifiers, and oscillators:

text.zh:
6A205 激光器、激光放大器和振荡器：
a．具有以下两种特性的铜蒸气激光器：
1．工作波长500～600 nm；
2．“平均输出功率”大于等于30 W；
b．具有以下两种特性的氩离子激光器：
1．工作波长400～515 nm；
2．“平均输出功率”大于等于40 W；
c．具有以下任一特性，输出波长1000～1100 nm 的掺钕的激光器（非玻璃激光器）：
1．采用脉冲激发和Q-开关，其脉冲宽度大于等于1 ns，并具有以下任一特性：
a．单横模输出，“平均输出功率”超过40 W；
b．多横模输出，“平均输出功率”超过50 W；
2．倍频后，输出波长500～550 nm，倍频（新波长）“平均输出功率”超过40 W；
d．具有以下所有特性的可调脉冲单模染料激光振荡器：
1．工作波长300～800 nm；
2．“平均输出功率”超过1 W；
3．重复率超过1 kHz；
4．脉冲宽度小于100 ns；
text.en: 6A205 Lasers, laser amplifiers, and oscillators: a. Copper-vapor lasers having both of the following characteristics: 1. An operating wavelength of 500–600 nm; 2. “Average output power” of 30 W or greater; b. Argon-ion lasers having both of the following characteristics: 1. An operating wavelength of 400–515 nm; 2. “Average output power” of 40 W or greater; c. Neodymium-doped lasers, other than glass lasers, with an output wavelength of 1000–1100 nm and either of the following characteristics: 1. Pulse-excited and Q-switched, with a pulse duration of 1 ns or greater and either of the following characteristics: a. Single-transverse-mode output with “average output power” exceeding 40 W; b. Multiple-transverse-mode output with “average output power” exceeding 50 W; 2. After frequency doubling, an output wavelength of 500–550 nm and frequency-doubled “average output power” at the new wavelength exceeding 40 W; d. Tunable pulsed single-mode dye-laser oscillators having all of the following characteristics: 1. An operating wavelength of 300–800 nm; 2. “Average output power” exceeding 1 W; 3. A repetition rate exceeding 1 kHz; 4. A pulse duration below 100 ns;

text.zh:
e．具有以下所有特性的可调脉冲染料激光放大器和振荡器：
1．工作波长300～800 nm；
2．“平均输出功率”超过30 W；
3．重复率超过1 kHz；
4．脉冲宽度小于100 ns；
说明：6A205.e 项不管制单模振荡器。
f．具有以下所有特性的紫翠玉激光器：
1．工作波长720～800 nm；
2．带宽大于等于0.005 nm；
3．重复率超过125 Hz；
4．“平均输出功率”超过30 W；
g．具有以下所有特性的脉冲二氧化碳激光器：
1．工作波长9000～11000 nm；
2．重复率超过250 Hz；
3．“平均输出功率”超过500 W；
4．脉冲宽度小于200 ns；
说明：6A205.g 项不管制诸如切割和焊接中应用的更高功率（通常为1～5 kW）工业用二氧化碳激光器，因为这类激光器采用的是连续波，或是脉冲宽度超过200 ns 的脉冲。
h．具有以下所有特性的脉冲受激准分子激光器（氟化氙、氯化氙和氟化氪）：
text.en: e. Tunable pulsed dye-laser amplifiers and oscillators having all of the following characteristics: 1. An operating wavelength of 300–800 nm; 2. “Average output power” exceeding 30 W; 3. A repetition rate exceeding 1 kHz; 4. A pulse duration below 100 ns; Note: 6A205.e does not control single-mode oscillators. f. Alexandrite lasers having all of the following characteristics: 1. An operating wavelength of 720–800 nm; 2. A bandwidth of 0.005 nm or greater; 3. A repetition rate exceeding 125 Hz; 4. “Average output power” exceeding 30 W; g. Pulsed carbon-dioxide lasers having all of the following characteristics: 1. An operating wavelength of 9000–11000 nm; 2. A repetition rate exceeding 250 Hz; 3. “Average output power” exceeding 500 W; 4. A pulse duration below 200 ns; Note: 6A205.g does not control higher-power industrial carbon-dioxide lasers, typically 1–5 kW, used for applications such as cutting and welding, because they operate in continuous-wave mode or with pulse durations exceeding 200 ns. h. Pulsed excimer lasers (xenon fluoride, xenon chloride, and krypton fluoride) having all of the following characteristics:

text.zh:
1．工作波长240～360 nm；
2．重复率超过250 Hz；
3．“平均输出功率”超过500 W；
i．设计输出波长为16 µm、重复率超过250 Hz 的仲氢喇曼移相器；
j．具有以下所有特性的脉冲一氧化碳激光器：
1．工作波长5000～6000 nm；
2．重复率超过250 Hz；
3．“平均输出功率”超过200 W；
4．脉冲宽度小于200 ns。
说明：6A205.j 项不管制诸如切割和焊接中应用的更高功率（通常为1～5 kW）工业用一氧化碳激光器，因为这类激光器采用的是连续波，或是脉冲宽度超过200 ns 的脉冲。
text.en: 1. An operating wavelength of 240–360 nm; 2. A repetition rate exceeding 250 Hz; 3. “Average output power” exceeding 500 W; i. Parahydrogen Raman shifters designed for an output wavelength of 16 µm and a repetition rate exceeding 250 Hz; j. Pulsed carbon-monoxide lasers having all of the following characteristics: 1. An operating wavelength of 5000–6000 nm; 2. A repetition rate exceeding 250 Hz; 3. “Average output power” exceeding 200 W; 4. A pulse duration below 200 ns. Note: 6A205.j does not control higher-power industrial carbon-monoxide lasers, typically 1–5 kW, used for applications such as cutting and welding, because they operate in continuous-wave mode or with pulse durations exceeding 200 ns.

title.zh: 挖泥船：
title.en: Dredgers:

summary.zh: 挖泥船：
summary.en: Dredgers:

text.zh:
8A901 挖泥船：
a．具有以下任一特性的耙吸式挖泥船：
1．“舱容”大于等于1500 m³；
2．“挖深”大于等于15 m；
3．具有艏吹功能及装置；
b．具有以下任一特性的绞吸式挖泥船：
1．“绞刀功率”大于等于500 kW；
2．“挖深”大于等于15 m；
3．“总装机功率”大于等于2000 kW；
c．具有以下任一特性的斗式挖泥船：
1．“斗容”大于等于4 m³；
2．“挖深”大于等于15 m；
d．具有以下任一特性的吸沙船：
1．“舱容”大于等于500 m³；
2．“总装机功率”大于等于1000 kW；
e．具有以下任一特性的自航自卸式泥驳：
1．“舱容”大于等于1000 m³；
2．具有艏吹功能及自卸装置。
技术说明：就8A901 而言，“舱容”是指挖泥船泥舱的有效容积；“挖深”是指挖泥船作业时最大挖深；“绞刀功率”是指绞吸式挖泥船绞刀工作所需的输入功率；“总装机功率”是指船上所有柴油机及电池输出功率之和；
text.en: 8A901 Dredgers: a. Trailing suction hopper dredgers having any of the following characteristics: 1. A “hopper capacity” of 1500 m³ or greater; 2. A “dredging depth” of 15 m or greater; 3. Bow-discharge capability and equipment; b. Cutter-suction dredgers having any of the following characteristics: 1. “Cutter power” of 500 kW or greater; 2. A “dredging depth” of 15 m or greater; 3. “Total installed power” of 2000 kW or greater; c. Bucket dredgers having either of the following characteristics: 1. A “bucket capacity” of 4 m³ or greater; 2. A “dredging depth” of 15 m or greater; d. Sand-suction vessels having either of the following characteristics: 1. A “hopper capacity” of 500 m³ or greater; 2. “Total installed power” of 1000 kW or greater; e. Self-propelled, self-unloading hopper barges having either of the following characteristics: 1. A “hopper capacity” of 1000 m³ or greater; 2. Bow-discharge capability and self-unloading equipment. Technical Note: For 8A901, “hopper capacity” means the effective volume of the dredger's spoil hopper; “dredging depth” means the maximum dredging depth during operation; “cutter power” means the input power required to operate the cutter of a cutter-suction dredger; “total installed power” means the combined output power of all diesel engines and batteries on board;

text.zh: “斗容”是指斗式挖泥船的抓斗或链斗的总容积。
text.en: “bucket capacity” means the total volume of the grab or chain buckets of a bucket dredger.

title.zh: “无人驾驶航空器”“无人驾驶飞艇”以及相关设备和部件：
title.en: “Unmanned aerial vehicles,” “unmanned airships,” and related equipment and components:

summary.zh: “无人驾驶航空器”“无人驾驶飞艇”以及相关设备和部件：
summary.en: “Unmanned aerial vehicles,” “unmanned airships,” and related equipment and components:

text.zh:
9A012 “无人驾驶航空器”“无人驾驶飞艇”以及相关设备和部件：
a．在“操作人员”“自然视距”以外能够可控飞行并具有以下任一特性的“无人驾驶航空器”或“无人驾驶飞艇”：
1．最大“续航时间”大于等于30 分钟小于1h，以及在大于等于46.3 km/h（25 节）的阵风条件下，具有起飞能力和稳定可控飞行能力；
2．最大“续航时间”大于等于1h；
技术说明：
1．“操作人员”是指负责操控“无人驾驶航空器”或“无人驾驶飞艇”的专业人员，通过地面控制站对飞行器进行遥控或编程，以确保飞行任务的顺利完成；
2．“续航时间”指换算到国际标准大气环境条件（ISO2533：1975）下海平面零风状态的持续飞行时间；
3．“自然视距”是指在没有任何人为干扰和大气污染的理想条件下，地球表面上观察者能够清晰看到物体的最大距离。视距是指在地球表面上，由于地球曲率的限制，观察者能够清晰看到物体的最大距离。在实际应用中，通常考虑大气条件对视距的影响。
text.en: 9A012 “Unmanned aerial vehicles,” “unmanned airships,” and related equipment and components: a. “Unmanned aerial vehicles” or “unmanned airships” capable of controlled flight beyond the “operator's” “natural line of sight,” having either of the following characteristics: 1. A maximum “endurance” of 30 minutes or greater but less than 1 h, and the ability to take off and maintain stable, controlled flight in wind gusts of 46.3 km/h (25 knots) or greater; 2. A maximum “endurance” of 1 h or greater; Technical Notes: 1. “Operator” means the professional responsible for controlling an “unmanned aerial vehicle” or “unmanned airship” through remote control or programming via a ground-control station to ensure successful completion of the flight mission; 2. “Endurance” means continuous flight time converted to sea-level, zero-wind conditions under the International Standard Atmosphere (ISO 2533:1975); 3. “Natural line of sight” means the maximum distance at which an observer on the Earth's surface can clearly see an object under ideal conditions without human interference or atmospheric pollution. Line of sight means the maximum distance at which an observer on the Earth's surface can clearly see an object, as limited by the Earth's curvature. In practice, the effect of atmospheric conditions on line of sight is normally considered.

text.zh:
b．用于“无人驾驶航空器”或“无人驾驶飞艇”的发动机：
1．设计或改进后用于在15420 m（50000 英尺）以上“高空”飞行的吸气活塞式或转子式内燃发动机；
2．最大持续功率超过16 kW 的航空发动机；
c．满足一定技术指标的专门用于9A012.a 项所管制的“无人驾驶航空器”或“无人驾驶飞艇”的“载荷”，包括“红外成像设备”、“合成孔径雷达”、“目标指示激光器”、惯性测量设备：
1．具有以下两种特性的“红外成像设备”：
a．波长范围780～30000 nm；
b．“瞬时视场角”（IFOV）小于2.5 mrad；
2．作用距离大于5 km，且具有以下任一特性的“合成孔径雷达”（SAR）：
a．“条带模式”分辨率优于0.3 m；
b．“聚束模式”分辨率优于0.1 m；
3．可在高于55℃环境中稳定工作，且具有以下所有特性的“目标指示激光器”：
a．免温控型；
b．能量大于80 mJ；
c．稳定度优于15%；
text.en: b. Engines for “unmanned aerial vehicles” or “unmanned airships”: 1. Air-breathing piston or rotary internal-combustion engines designed or modified for “high-altitude” flight above 15420 m (50000 feet); 2. Aircraft engines with a maximum continuous power exceeding 16 kW; c. “Payloads” meeting specified technical criteria and dedicated to “unmanned aerial vehicles” or “unmanned airships” controlled under 9A012.a, including “infrared imaging equipment,” “synthetic aperture radar,” “target-designating lasers,” and inertial measurement equipment: 1. “Infrared imaging equipment” having both of the following characteristics: a. A wavelength range of 780–30000 nm; b. An “instantaneous field of view” (IFOV) below 2.5 mrad; 2. “Synthetic aperture radar” (SAR) with an operating range greater than 5 km and either of the following characteristics: a. “Stripmap mode” resolution better than 0.3 m; b. “Spotlight mode” resolution better than 0.1 m; 3. “Target-designating lasers” capable of stable operation at ambient temperatures above 55 °C and having all of the following characteristics: a. No temperature control required; b. Energy greater than 80 mJ; c. Stability better than 15%;

text.zh:
d．“光束发散角”小于0.3 mrad；
4．具有以下所有特性的惯性测量设备：
a．航向精度小于2°；
b．姿态精度小于0.5°；
c．分辨率小于0.1°；
说明：9A012.c.4 项不管制7A、7B 所管制的相关物项。
d．专门设计用于将有人飞行器、有人驾驶飞艇改装为9A012.a项所管制的“无人驾驶航空器”“无人驾驶飞艇”的设备或部件；
e．专门用于9A012.a 项所管制的“无人驾驶航空器”或“无人驾驶飞艇”，且具有以下任一特性的无线电通信设备：
1．“无线电视距”传输距离大于50 km；
2．一站控多机能力大于10 架。
说明：9A012.a、9A012.b.1、9A012.d 项不管制模型飞机或模型飞艇。
技术说明：就9A012 项而言：
1．“红外成像设备”是一种利用物体发射的红外辐射来形成图像的探测设备，广泛应用于夜视、热成像、搜索与救援等领域。
2．“合成孔径雷达”是一种主动式微波遥感系统，
text.en: d. “Beam divergence” below 0.3 mrad; 4. Inertial measurement equipment having all of the following characteristics: a. Heading accuracy below 2°; b. Attitude accuracy below 0.5°; c. Resolution below 0.1°; Note: 9A012.c.4 does not control related items controlled under 7A or 7B. d. Equipment or components specially designed to convert manned aircraft or manned airships into “unmanned aerial vehicles” or “unmanned airships” controlled under 9A012.a; e. Radio communication equipment dedicated to “unmanned aerial vehicles” or “unmanned airships” controlled under 9A012.a, having either of the following characteristics: 1. A “radio line-of-sight” transmission distance greater than 50 km; 2. The capability to control more than 10 aircraft from a single station. Note: 9A012.a, 9A012.b.1, and 9A012.d do not control model aircraft or model airships. Technical Notes: For 9A012: 1. “Infrared imaging equipment” means detection equipment that forms images using infrared radiation emitted by objects, widely used for night vision, thermal imaging, search and rescue, and similar applications. 2. “Synthetic aperture radar” is an active microwave remote-sensing system

text.zh:
它通过合成孔径技术获得高分辨率雷达图像，适用于地形测绘、环境监测等。
3．“目标指示激光器”是一种用于军事领域的激光设备，它能精确地指向目标并对其进行标记，以便于激光制导武器对其进行打击。
4．“瞬时视场角”是指探测器在某一瞬间所能覆盖的视场角度，它决定了探测器的空间分辨率。
5．“条带模式”是合成孔径雷达工作的一种模式，其中雷达波束沿着飞行方向连续扫描地面，形成一条宽的扫描带。
6．“聚束模式”是合成孔径雷达工作的一种模式，其中雷达波束在某一特定区域进行长时间的聚焦，以获得更高的空间分辨率。
7．“光束发散角”是指光束在传播过程中发散的程度，通常用来描述激光束或其他类型光束的聚焦性能。
8．“无线电视距”是指在没有任何障碍物的情况下，无线电波在自由空间中传播的最大距离。
text.en: that uses synthetic-aperture techniques to obtain high-resolution radar images for applications such as terrain mapping and environmental monitoring. 3. A “target-designating laser” is military laser equipment that precisely points to and marks a target so that laser-guided weapons can engage it. 4. “Instantaneous field of view” means the angular field a detector covers at a given instant; it determines the detector's spatial resolution. 5. “Stripmap mode” is a synthetic-aperture radar operating mode in which the radar beam continuously scans the ground along the flight direction, forming a wide swath. 6. “Spotlight mode” is a synthetic-aperture radar operating mode in which the radar beam remains focused on a specific area for an extended period to obtain higher spatial resolution. 7. “Beam divergence” means the extent to which a beam spreads during propagation, commonly used to describe the focusing performance of laser or other light beams. 8. “Radio line of sight” means the maximum distance radio waves propagate through free space without obstructions.

text.zh:
9A106 经设计或改进后能够在20～2000 Hz 频率范围内和加速度大于10 g₀ 均方根（RMS）的振动环境中工作的液体和悬浮推进剂控制系统，以及为此专门设计的部件：
a．“绝压”大于等于7000 kPa、流量大于等于每分钟24 L、作动器响应时间小于100 μs 的伺服阀；
b．用于液体推进剂、转速大于等于8000 转/分钟、出口压力大于等于7000 kPa 的泵。
说明：9A106 项不管制集成到民用飞机、通用航空器等民用航空器上的伺服阀和泵。
text.en: 9A106 Liquid and slurry propellant control systems designed or modified to operate in vibration environments over 20–2000 Hz and at accelerations greater than 10 g₀ RMS, and specially designed components therefor: a. Servo valves with an “absolute pressure” of 7000 kPa or greater, a flow rate of 24 L/min or greater, and an actuator response time below 100 μs; b. Pumps for liquid propellants with a rotational speed of 8000 rpm or greater and an outlet pressure of 7000 kPa or greater. Note: 9A106 does not control servo valves or pumps integrated into civil aircraft, including civil airplanes and general-aviation aircraft.

summary.zh: 非9A012 项所管制的“无人驾驶航空器”：
summary.en: “Unmanned aerial vehicles” other than those controlled under 9A012:

text.zh:
9A501 非9A012 项所管制的“无人驾驶航空器”：
a．“射/航程”大于等于300 km 的“无人驾驶航空器”；
b．具有以下任一特性，具备自主飞行控制和导航能力的“无人驾驶航空器”：
1．包含容量为20 L 以上的气雾剂布撒系统/装置；
2．经设计或改进后能够配备容量20 L 以上的气雾剂布撒系统/装置；
c．具有以下任一特性，具备操作员从视距外控制飞行能力的“无人驾驶航空器”：
1．包含容量为20 L 以上的气雾剂布撒系统/装置；
2．经设计或改进后能够配备容量20 L 以上的气雾剂布撒系统/装置。
说明：
1．9A501 项不管制为娱乐或竞赛专门设计的模型飞机。
2．对于未列入本清单的所有“无人驾驶航空器”，出口经营者明知或者应当知道出口将用于大规模杀伤性武器扩散、恐怖主义活动或者军事目的的，不得出口。违反规定的，按照《中华人民共和国出口管制法》第三十四条处罚。
text.en: 9A501 “Unmanned aerial vehicles” other than those controlled under 9A012: a. “Unmanned aerial vehicles” with a “range” of 300 km or greater; b. “Unmanned aerial vehicles” capable of autonomous flight control and navigation, having either of the following characteristics: 1. Incorporating an aerosol-dissemination system/device with a capacity of 20 L or greater; 2. Designed or modified to accommodate an aerosol-dissemination system/device with a capacity of 20 L or greater; c. “Unmanned aerial vehicles” capable of operator-controlled flight beyond visual line of sight, having either of the following characteristics: 1. Incorporating an aerosol-dissemination system/device with a capacity of 20 L or greater; 2. Designed or modified to accommodate an aerosol-dissemination system/device with a capacity of 20 L or greater. Notes: 1. 9A501 does not control model aircraft specially designed for recreation or competition. 2. For all “unmanned aerial vehicles” not included in this list, exporters shall not export if they know or should know that the export will be used for proliferation of weapons of mass destruction, terrorist activities, or military purposes. Violations shall be penalized under Article 34 of the Export Control Law of the People's Republic of China.

text.zh:
9B001 燃气涡轮发动机/燃气轮机制造相关装备：
a．用于制造燃气涡轮发动机/燃气轮机叶片、导向器等涡轮构型部件所需“高温合金”的定向晶或单晶铸造设备；
b．专门设计用于制造燃气涡轮发动机/燃气轮机叶片、导向器、机匣等涡轮构型部件的精密铸造中间产品（包括陶瓷型芯、蜡模模组、型壳），以及专门设计用于制造上述中间产品的工具、模具、夹具等工艺装备。
text.en: 9B001 Equipment related to manufacturing gas-turbine engines / gas turbines: a. Directional-solidification or single-crystal casting equipment for “superalloys” required to manufacture turbine-shaped components such as blades and vanes for gas-turbine engines / gas turbines; b. Precision-casting intermediate products specially designed for manufacturing turbine-shaped components such as blades, vanes, and casings for gas-turbine engines / gas turbines, including ceramic cores, wax-pattern assemblies, and shells, and tools, dies, fixtures, and other process equipment specially designed to manufacture those intermediate products.

title.zh: 具有以下所有特性的“高压水炮”：
title.en: “High-pressure water cannons” having all of the following characteristics:

summary.zh: 具有以下所有特性的“高压水炮”：
summary.en: “High-pressure water cannons” having all of the following characteristics:

text.zh:
0A901 具有以下所有特性的“高压水炮”：
a．“最大射程”大于等于100 m；
b．“额定流量”大于等于540 m³/h；
c．“额定压力”大于等于1.2 MPa。
技术说明：
1．“高压水炮”是一种以高压水泵对液体介质做功，形成可在空气中远距离喷射高速流体的设备。
2．“最大射程”是指水炮出口到洒落区域的最远距离。最大射程处伤害力较小，也不存在瞄准的可能。
3．“额定流量”是指在额定工况下的流量。
4．“额定压力”是指在满足设备正常工作需求下的最大压力。
text.en: 0A901 “High-pressure water cannons” having all of the following characteristics: a. A “maximum range” of 100 m or greater; b. A “rated flow rate” of 540 m³/h or greater; c. A “rated pressure” of 1.2 MPa or greater. Technical Notes: 1. A “high-pressure water cannon” is equipment that uses a high-pressure pump to transfer energy to a liquid medium, producing a high-speed fluid jet that can travel long distances through the air. 2. “Maximum range” means the greatest distance from the water-cannon outlet to the area where the water lands. At maximum range, its injuring force is relatively low and aiming is not possible. 3. “Rated flow rate” means the flow rate under rated operating conditions. 4. “Rated pressure” means the maximum pressure consistent with the equipment's normal operating requirements.

text.zh: 以 IPSec/SSL VPN 为主要功能的设备，且具有以下两种特征：1）含有 64 位以上密钥长度的对称密码算法、768 位以上密钥长度的基于整数因子分解的非对称密码算法或 128 位以上密钥长度基于椭圆曲线的非对称密码算法；2）加密通信速率 10Gbps 以上。
text.en: Equipment whose principal function is IPSec/SSL VPN and having both of the following characteristics: 1) incorporating symmetric cryptographic algorithms with key lengths of 64 bits or more, asymmetric cryptographic algorithms based on integer factorization with key lengths of 768 bits or more, or asymmetric cryptographic algorithms based on elliptic curves with key lengths of 128 bits or more; 2) Encrypted communications rates of 10 Gbps or more.

summary.zh: 为制造航空器结构件或航天器结构件而专门设计的工具、模具、夹具等工艺装备

text.zh: 为制造航空器结构件或航天器结构件而专门设计的工具、模具、夹具等工艺装备
text.en: Tools, dies, fixtures, and other process equipment specially designed for manufacturing aircraft or spacecraft structural parts

text.zh:
为制造以下任一物项而专门设计用于钛、铝及其合金 “ 超塑成形 ”/“ 扩散连接 ” 的工具 、 模具、夹具等工艺装备：
技术说明：
1．“超塑成形”是指利用超塑性金属材料在特定温度和应变速率条件下表现出的超高延伸率及不易断裂的超塑性，在模具型腔内将超塑性金属板料作为被成形坯料实现成形加工，以获得各种所需形状零件的成形工艺。
2．“扩散连接”是指相互接触的两个材料表面，在温度和压力的作用下相互靠近，局部发生塑性变形，原子间产生相互扩散，在界面接触处形成扩散层，从而实现可靠连接的成形工艺。
a．航空器结构件或航天器结构件；
text.en: Tools, dies, fixtures, and other process equipment specially designed for “superplastic forming” / “diffusion bonding” of titanium, aluminum, and their alloys to manufacture any of the following: Technical Notes: 1. “Superplastic forming” means a forming process that uses the exceptionally high elongation and resistance to fracture exhibited by superplastic metallic materials at specific temperatures and strain rates, forming superplastic metal sheet blanks within a die cavity to obtain parts of various desired shapes. 2. “Diffusion bonding” means a forming process in which two contacting material surfaces are brought closer together under temperature and pressure, undergo localized plastic deformation and atomic interdiffusion, and form a diffusion layer at the interface, thereby achieving a reliable bond. a. Aircraft or spacecraft structural parts;

text.zh:

说明：
1．1B226 项管制能够富集稳定同位素以及铀同位素的分离器。能够分离一个质量单位差的铅同位素的分离器，必然能够富集有三个质量单位差的铀同位素。
2．1B226 项管制离子源和收集器都在磁场内的分离器，以及两者都布置在磁场外的分离器。
技术说明：单一 50 mA 离子源可以从天然丰度的给料中每年分离出不到 3g 的高浓铀（HEU）。
text.en: Electromagnetic isotope separators designed for, or equipped with, one or more ion sources capable of providing a total ion-beam current of 50 mA or greater. Notes: 1. 1B226 controls separators capable of enriching stable isotopes as well as uranium isotopes. A separator capable of separating lead isotopes differing by one mass unit is inherently capable of enriching uranium isotopes differing by three mass units. 2. 1B226 controls separators with both the ion source and collector within the magnetic field, and separators with both located outside the magnetic field. Technical Note: A single 50 mA ion source can separate less than 3 g of highly enriched uranium (HEU) per year from natural-abundance feed material.

text.zh: 氢-低温蒸馏塔
text.en: Hydrogen cryogenic distillation columns

text.zh:
具有以下所有特性的氢-低温蒸馏塔：
a．工作时的内部温度小于等于-238 ℃；
b．工作时的内部压力为0.5～5 MPa（5～50 个大气压）；
c．用以下任一材料制成：
1．用含硫量低并采用ASTM 标准（或等效国家标准）晶粒级别为5 级或5 级以上的国际汽车工程师协会奥氏体300 系列不锈钢制成；
2．耐低温并与氢（H₂）相容的等效材料；
d．内径大于等于30 cm，“有效长度”大于等于4 m。
技术说明：“有效长度”是指填料塔中填充材料的有效高度或板式塔中内接触板的有效高度。
text.en: Hydrogen cryogenic distillation columns having all of the following characteristics: a. Internal operating temperatures of -238 °C or lower; b. Internal operating pressures of 0.5–5 MPa (5–50 atmospheres); c. Made of either of the following materials: 1. Low-sulfur SAE 300-series austenitic stainless steel with an ASTM (or equivalent national standard) grain-size number of 5 or higher; 2. Equivalent materials compatible with hydrogen (H₂) and cryogenic temperatures; d. An inside diameter of 30 cm or greater and an “effective length” of 4 m or greater. Technical Note: “Effective length” means the active height of packing material in a packed column or the active height of internal contactor plates in a plate column.

text.zh:
以下材料：
c．具有以下所有特性，用于制造导弹部件的的固态钨：
1．具有以下任一特性的固态钨（不含颗粒、粉末状）：
a．非 1C226、1C241 项下管制的钨及钨含量大于等于 97%（按重量）的钨合金；

2．能被机械加工成下述任一产品：
a．直径大于等于 120 mm、长度大于等于 50 mm 的圆柱体；
b．内径大于等于 65 mm、壁厚大于等于 25 mm 且长度大于等于 50 mm 的管材；
c．尺寸大于等于 120 mm×120 mm×50 mm 的块状物。
text.en: The following materials: c. Solid tungsten for manufacturing missile components, having all of the following characteristics: 1. Solid tungsten (excluding particles and powders) having any of the following characteristics: a. Tungsten and tungsten alloys containing 97% or more tungsten by weight, other than those controlled under 1C226 or 1C241; b. Copper-infiltrated tungsten containing 80% or more tungsten by weight; c. Silver-infiltrated tungsten containing 80% or more tungsten by weight (with a silver content of 2% or greater); 2. Capable of being machined into any of the following products: a. Cylinders with a diameter of 120 mm or greater and a length of 50 mm or greater; b. Tubes with an inside diameter of 65 mm or greater, a wall thickness of 25 mm or greater, and a length of 50 mm or greater; c. Blocks with dimensions of 120 mm×120 mm×50 mm or greater.

a．铬含量 17%～26.5%（按重量计）且镍含量 4.5%～7%（按重量计）；

text.en: Titanium-stabilized duplex stainless steel having all of the following characteristics: a. A chromium content of 17%–26.5% by weight and a nickel content of 4.5%–7% by weight; b. A ferritic–austenitic microstructure (also called a “duplex” microstructure), with at least 10% austenite by volume; c. In any of the following forms: 1. Ingots or bars with each dimension 100 mm or greater; 2. Sheets with a width of 600 mm or greater and a thickness of 3 mm or less; 3. Tubes with an outside diameter of 600 mm or greater and a wall thickness of 3 mm or less.

Technical Note: 1C240.b refers to metal formed by compacting and sintering materials controlled under 1C240.a, with numerous interconnected fine pores throughout its structure. a. 人及人兽共患病“病原微生物”、毒素及其亚单位、动物 “ 病原微生物”：
说明：
1．1C351 项所管制的各类“病原微生物”，包括菌、毒种及各类活培养物，以及含有此类 “ 病原微生物”的各种生物材料（例如：细胞、组织、血清、带菌动物等）或非生物材料 ； 无论这些“病原微生物”是天然的，还是经过遗传修饰的都在出口管制之列，但以“疫苗”形式存在的除外。
2．1C351 项所管制的各种“毒素”，不包括免疫用毒素，以及经国家主管部门批准的人或动物用药物产品。
3．1C351 项亦管制属于我国境内新发现或生物学特征有明显改变，可对人、动物健康造成严重损害的人及人兽共患病“病原微生物”、动物“病原微生物”。
a．病毒：
29．亨德拉病毒（也称马麻疹病毒）Hendra virus（syn.Equine morbillivirus）；
text.en: Human and zoonotic “pathogenic microorganisms,” toxins and their subunits, and animal “pathogenic microorganisms”: Notes: 1. The “pathogenic microorganisms” controlled under 1C351 include bacterial and viral strains and all types of live cultures, as well as biological materials (e.g., cells, tissues, sera, infected animals) or nonbiological materials containing such “pathogenic microorganisms”; These “pathogenic microorganisms” are subject to export controls whether naturally occurring or genetically modified, except when in the form of “vaccines.” 2. The “toxins” controlled under 1C351 exclude toxins for immunization and pharmaceutical products for human or animal use approved by the competent national authorities. 3. 1C351 also controls human and zoonotic “pathogenic microorganisms” and animal “pathogenic microorganisms” newly discovered in China or exhibiting significant changes in biological characteristics that can cause serious harm to human or animal health. a. Viruses: 29. Hendra virus (syn. equine morbillivirus);

text.zh:
人及人兽共患病“病原微生物”、毒素及其亚单位、动物 “ 病原微生物”：
说明：
1．1C351 项所管制的各类“病原微生物”，包括菌、毒种及各类活培养物，以及含有此类 “ 病原微生物”的各种生物材料（例如：细胞、组织、血清、带菌动物等）或非生物材料 ； 无论这些“病原微生物”是天然的，还是经过遗传修饰的都在出口管制之列，但以“疫苗”形式存在的除外。
2．1C351 项所管制的各种“毒素”，不包括免疫用毒素，以及经国家主管部门批准的人或动物用药物产品。
3．1C351 项亦管制属于我国境内新发现或生物学特征有明显改变，可对人、动物健康造成严重损害的人及人兽共患病“病原微生物”、动物“病原微生物”。
c．细菌：
2．牛种布鲁菌Brucella abortus；
text.en: Human and zoonotic “pathogenic microorganisms,” toxins and their subunits, and animal “pathogenic microorganisms”: Notes: 1. The “pathogenic microorganisms” controlled under 1C351 include bacterial and viral strains and all types of live cultures, as well as biological materials (e.g., cells, tissues, sera, infected animals) or nonbiological materials containing such “pathogenic microorganisms”; These “pathogenic microorganisms” are subject to export controls whether naturally occurring or genetically modified, except when in the form of “vaccines.” 2. The “toxins” controlled under 1C351 exclude toxins for immunization and pharmaceutical products for human or animal use approved by the competent national authorities. 3. 1C351 also controls human and zoonotic “pathogenic microorganisms” and animal “pathogenic microorganisms” newly discovered in China or exhibiting significant changes in biological characteristics that can cause serious harm to human or animal health. c. Bacteria: 2. Brucella abortus;

text.zh: 微生物的致病性相关的核酸序列的遗传物质
text.en: Genetic material containing nucleic acid sequences associated with the pathogenicity of microorganisms

text.zh:
遗传物质和遗传修饰生物体：
技术说明：
1．遗传物质包括染色体、基因组、质粒、转座子、载体（无论是否经过遗传修饰）。
2．与本清单所管制微生物致病性相关的核酸序列是指与清单所管制微生物有关的以下特殊序列：
a．该序列本身或通过其转录或翻译产物会给人、动植物健康带来明显危害；
b．通过插入、替换 、 整合或缺失，该序列能增强清单所管制微生物或其他任何生物体对人、动植物健康造成严重损害的能力。
3．与肠出血性大肠埃希氏菌（О157 血清型）和其它产志贺样毒素菌株致病性相关的核酸序列不受管制，编码志贺样毒素或其亚单位的核酸序列则受管制。
a．含有与本清单所管制微生物的致病性相关的核酸序列的遗传物质；
text.en: Genetic material and genetically modified organisms: Technical Notes: 1. Genetic material includes chromosomes, genomes, plasmids, transposons, and vectors, whether or not genetically modified. 2. Nucleic-acid sequences associated with the pathogenicity of microorganisms controlled by this list mean the following specific sequences associated with listed microorganisms: a. Sequences that, by themselves or through their transcription or translation products, pose a significant hazard to human, animal, or plant health; b. Through insertion, substitution, integration, or deletion, the sequence can enhance the ability of listed microorganisms or any other organism to cause serious harm to human, animal, or plant health. 3. Nucleic-acid sequences associated with the pathogenicity of enterohemorrhagic Escherichia coli (serotype O157) and other Shiga-like-toxin-producing strains are not controlled; nucleic-acid sequences encoding Shiga-like toxins or their subunits are controlled. a. Genetic material containing nucleic-acid sequences associated with the pathogenicity of microorganisms controlled by this list;

text.zh: 微生物的致病性相关的核酸序列的遗传修饰生物体
text.en: Genetically modified organisms containing nucleic acid sequences associated with the pathogenicity of microorganisms

text.zh:
遗传物质和遗传修饰生物体：
技术说明：
1．遗传物质包括染色体、基因组、质粒、转座子、载体（无论是否经过遗传修饰）。
2．与本清单所管制微生物致病性相关的核酸序列是指与清单所管制微生物有关的以下特殊序列：
a．该序列本身或通过其转录或翻译产物会给人、动植物健康带来明显危害；
b．通过插入、替换 、 整合或缺失，该序列能增强清单所管制微生物或其他任何生物体对人、动植物健康造成严重损害的能力。
3．与肠出血性大肠埃希氏菌（О157 血清型）和其它产志贺样毒素菌株致病性相关的核酸序列不受管制，编码志贺样毒素或其亚单位的核酸序列则受管制。
c．含有与清单所管制微生物的致病性相关的核酸序列的遗传修饰生物体；
text.en: Genetic material and genetically modified organisms: Technical Notes: 1. Genetic material includes chromosomes, genomes, plasmids, transposons, and vectors, whether or not genetically modified. 2. Nucleic-acid sequences associated with the pathogenicity of microorganisms controlled by this list mean the following specific sequences associated with listed microorganisms: a. Sequences that, by themselves or through their transcription or translation products, pose a significant hazard to human, animal, or plant health; b. Through insertion, substitution, integration, or deletion, the sequence can enhance the ability of listed microorganisms or any other organism to cause serious harm to human, animal, or plant health. 3. Nucleic-acid sequences associated with the pathogenicity of enterohemorrhagic Escherichia coli (serotype O157) and other Shiga-like-toxin-producing strains are not controlled; nucleic-acid sequences encoding Shiga-like toxins or their subunits are controlled. c. Genetically modified organisms containing nucleic-acid sequences associated with the pathogenicity of microorganisms controlled by this list;

text.en: Ultrahigh-molecular-weight polyethylene fibers and products thereof: b. summary.zh: 用耐液态锕系元素金属的材料制造的或作涂层的坩埚

text.zh: 用耐液态锕系元素金属的材料制造的或作涂层的坩埚
text.en: Crucibles made of or coated with materials resistant to liquid actinide metals

text.zh:
用耐液态锕系元素金属的材料制造的坩埚：
a．具有以下两种特性的坩埚：
1．容积150～8000 cm³ 或150～8000 ml；
2．用总不纯度小于等于2%（按重量计）的以下任何一种材料或以下材料组合制造的或作涂层：
a．氟化钙（CaF₂）；
b．锆酸钙（偏锆酸盐）（CaZrO₃）；
c．硫化铈（Ce₂S₃）；
d．氧化铒（Er₂O₃）；
e．氧化铪（HfO₂）；
f．氧化镁（MgO）；
g．氮化铌-钛-钨合金（约50%铌、30%钛和20%钨）；
h．氧化钇（Y₂O₃）；
i．氧化锆（ZrO₂）；
text.en: Crucibles made of materials resistant to liquid actinide metals: a. Crucibles having both of the following characteristics: 1. A volume of 150–8000 cm³ or 150–8000 ml; 2. Made of or coated with any of the following materials, or combinations thereof, with a total impurity content of 2% or less by weight: a. Calcium fluoride (CaF₂); b. Calcium zirconate (metazirconate) (CaZrO₃); c. Cerium sulfide (Ce₂S₃); d. Erbium oxide (Er₂O₃); e. Hafnium oxide (HfO₂); f. Magnesium oxide (MgO); g. Nitrided niobium–titanium–tungsten alloy (approximately 50% niobium, 30% titanium, and 20% tungsten); h. Yttrium oxide (Y₂O₃); i. Zirconium oxide (ZrO₂);

title.zh: 车床

summary.zh: 车床
summary.en: Lathes

text.zh: 车床
text.en: Lathes

text.zh:
用于切削或切割金属、陶瓷或复合材料且根据制造商的技术说明书，可以配备沿 2 个或多个轴同时进行 “ 成形控制 ”的电子装置的机床及其任何组合：注意 ： 由 2B201项附属软件控制的“数控”单元，见 2D203 项。
说明：1 ． 按照ISO230-2:1988 或等效国家标准进行测量后，根据以下“程序”得出声称的 “ 定位精度”水平，如果提供给国家有关主管部门并得到认可，可以用于每种型号机床的测试以代替对单个机床的测试。按照以下“程序”得出声称的 “ 定位精度”：
a．选择某一型号 5 台机器以供评价；b ． 按照ISO230-2:1988 或等效国家标准，测量直线坐标 “ 精度”；
c．测量每台机器每一轴线的精度值（A）。ISO230-2:1988 标准或等效国家标准中介绍了计算精度值的方法；
d．测量每一轴线的平均精度值。此平均值即可成为该型号机器每一轴线声称的 “ 定位精度 ”（Âx，Ây……）；e ． 既然2B201
text.en: Machine tools for removing or cutting metals, ceramics or composites, and any combination thereof, which, according to the manufacturer's technical specifications, can be equipped with electronic devices for simultaneous "contouring control" in two or more axes: Attention: For "numerical control" units controlled by software associated with 2B201, see 2D203. Notes: 1. Claimed “positioning accuracy” levels obtained using the following “procedure,” after measurement in accordance with ISO230-2:1988 or an equivalent national standard, may be used for testing each machine-tool model instead of individual machine tools if submitted to and accepted by the competent national authorities. Determine the claimed “positioning accuracy” using the following “procedure”: a. Select five machines of a model for evaluation; b. Measure linear-axis “accuracy” in accordance with ISO230-2:1988 or an equivalent national standard; c. Determine the accuracy value (A) for each axis of each machine. ISO 230-2:1988 or an equivalent national standard describes the method for calculating the accuracy value; d. Determine the average accuracy value for each axis. this average may become the claimed “positioning accuracy” for each axis of that machine model (Âx, Ây…); e. Since 2B201

text.zh:
项提到每个直线坐标，因此将会得出与线性轴数同样多的声称的 “ 定位精度 ”值；
f．如果不受 2B201.a 、2B201.b 或2B201.c 项管制的某一机床的任何轴线声称“定位精度”，对磨床而言小于等于 6 µm 和对铣床和车床而言为小于等于 8µm（两者均按照ISO230-2:1988 或等效国家标准测定），则应要求制造商每 18 个月重新确定一次精度水平。
2．2B201 项不管制限于加工以下部件的专用机床:
a．齿轮；
b．曲轴或凸轮轴；
c．工具或刀具；
d．挤压机螺杆。
技术说明：
1．轴应根据国际标准（ ISO841 《 数控机床 —— 轴和动作的名称》）或等效国家标准命名。
2．二次平行轴的数量成形未计入成形轴的总数量。（例如：在水平镗床上的 w轴或中心线与一次转轴平行的二次转轴）。
3．旋转轴不一定需要旋转360 度。旋转轴可由丝杆或齿轮-齿条之类线性机构驱动。
4．就 2B201项而言，可同时协调的 “
text.en: refers to each linear axis, there will be as many claimed “positioning accuracy” values as there are linear axes; f. If any axis of a machine tool not controlled by 2B201.a, 2B201.b, or 2B201.c has a claimed “positioning accuracy” of 6 µm or less for grinding machines, or 8 µm or less for milling or turning machines (both measured in accordance with ISO230-2:1988 or an equivalent national standard), the manufacturer must be required to redetermine the accuracy level every 18 months. 2. 2B201 does not control special-purpose machine tools limited to manufacturing the following parts: a. Gears; b. Crankshafts or camshafts; c. Tools or cutters; d. Extruder screws. Technical Notes: 1. Axes must be designated in accordance with the international standard ISO841, “Numerically Controlled Machines — Axis and Motion Nomenclature,” or an equivalent national standard. 2. Secondary parallel contouring axes are not counted in the total number of contouring axes. (For example, the w-axis on a horizontal boring mill or a secondary rotary axis whose centerline is parallel to the primary rotary axis.) 3. Rotary axes need not rotate through 360 degrees. A rotary axis may be driven by a linear device, such as a screw or rack and pinion. 4. For 2B201, the number of simultaneously coordinated axes for “

text.zh:
成形控制 ”的轴数是指在加工中沿这些轴或围绕这些轴可实现工件与刀具间同时且有关联的运动的轴数。这不包括任何其他的轴，沿这些轴或围绕这些轴在车床上实现其他有关运动，例如：
a．磨床的轮装置系统；
b．用来装卸其他工件的平行旋转轴；
c．用来从不同端点将同一工件装入卡盘的共线旋转轴；
5．具有车、铣、磨 3 个功能中2 个或 2 个以上功能（如车床具有铣的功能）的工具，要分别以2B201.a、2B201.b和 2B201.c 项加以评估。
6．2B201.b.3、2B201.c.3 项管制基于平行线性动力学设计，具有5 个或更多非旋转轴的机床 （ 例如：并联机床）。
a．具有以下两种特性的车床：
1．能够加工件直径大于 35 mm 的车床；
2．按照 ISO230-2:1988 或等效国家标准，“定位精度”在采取了所有补偿手段后沿任一直线坐标可达到小于6µm（总“定位精度”）；
说明：2B201.a 项不管制仅加工贯穿进给的棒料，
text.en: contouring control” means the number of axes along or about which simultaneous and interrelated motion between the workpiece and tool can occur during machining. This excludes any other axes along or about which other related movements are performed on a lathe, for example: a. Wheel-dressing systems in grinding machines; b. Parallel rotary axes for loading or unloading other workpieces; c. Collinear rotary axes for holding the same workpiece in a chuck from different ends; 5. Machine tools having two or more of the three functions of turning, milling, and grinding (e.g., a turning machine with milling capability) must be evaluated separately against 2B201.a, 2B201.b, and 2B201.c. 6. 2B201.b.3 and 2B201.c.3 control machine tools based on parallel linear kinematic designs with five or more non-rotary axes (e.g., parallel-kinematic machine tools). a. Turning machines having both of the following characteristics: 1. Turning machines capable of machining workpieces with diameters greater than 35 mm; 2. “Positioning accuracy,” with all available compensation, better than 6 µm along any linear axis (overall “positioning accuracy”), in accordance with ISO230-2:1988 or an equivalent national standard; Note: 2B201.a does not control bar turning machines limited to machining through-fed bar stock,

text.zh: 棒料最大直径小于等于 42 mm，并且无法安装卡盘能力的棒料车床。车床可对直径小于 42 mm 的加工零件进行钻、铣加工。
text.en: with a maximum bar diameter of 42 mm or less, and having no capability to fit a chuck. The machines may drill or mill parts with diameters less than 42 mm.

说明：1 ． 按照ISO230-2:1988 或等效国家标准进行测量后，根据以下“程序”得出声称的 “ 定位精度”水平，如果提供给国家有关主管部门并得到认可，可以用于每种型号机床的测试以代替对单个机床的测试。按照以下“程序”得出声称的 “ 定位精度”：
a．选择某一型号 5 台机器以供评价；b ． 按照ISO230-2:1988 或等效国家标准，测量直线坐标 “ 精度”；
c．测量每台机器每一轴线的精度值（A）。ISO230-2:1988 标准或等效国家标准中介绍了计算精度值的方法；
d．测量每一轴线的平均精度值。此平均值即可成为该型号机器每一轴线声称的 “ 定位精度 ”（Âx，Ây……）；e ． 既然2B201
text.en: Machine tools for removing or cutting metals, ceramics or composites, and any combination thereof, which, according to the manufacturer's technical specifications, can be equipped with electronic devices for simultaneous "contouring control" in two or more axes: Attention: For "numerical control" units controlled by software associated with 2B201, see 2D203. Notes: 1. Claimed “positioning accuracy” levels obtained using the following “procedure,” after measurement in accordance with ISO230-2:1988 or an equivalent national standard, may be used for testing each machine-tool model instead of individual machine tools if submitted to and accepted by the competent national authorities. Determine the claimed “positioning accuracy” using the following “procedure”: a. Select five machines of a model for evaluation; b. Measure linear-axis “accuracy” in accordance with ISO230-2:1988 or an equivalent national standard; c. Determine the accuracy value (A) for each axis of each machine. ISO 230-2:1988 or an equivalent national standard describes the method for calculating the accuracy value; d. Determine the average accuracy value for each axis. this average may become the claimed “positioning accuracy” for each axis of that machine model (Âx, Ây…); e. Since 2B201

text.zh:

f．如果不受 2B201.a 、2B201.b 或2B201.c 项管制的某一机床的任何轴线声称“定位精度”，对磨床而言小于等于 6 µm 和对铣床和车床而言为小于等于 8µm（两者均按照ISO230-2:1988 或等效国家标准测定），则应要求制造商每 18 个月重新确定一次精度水平。

3．旋转轴不一定需要旋转360 度。旋转轴可由丝杆或齿轮-齿条之类线性机构驱动。

2．有 2 个或多个成形旋转轴；

text.zh:
“ 机器人 ”“ 末端操纵装置 ” 和控制器：
说明：2B207 项不管制为诸如汽车喷漆台之类的非核工业应用而专门设计的 “ 机器人”。
技术说明：
1．在 2B207项中，“机器人”是指一种操纵机构，可以连续轨径作业或按点位作业 ， 还可能使用“传感器”并具有以下所有特性：
a．多功能；
b．通过在三维空间中的可变移动能够使材料、零件、工具或专用装置定位或定向；c ． 包含 3个或更多个可能装有步进电机的闭环或开环伺服装置；
d．通过教学、复演法或通过采用可编程序逻辑控制的电子计算机使该机有“用户可存取编程能力”，即无需机械干预。在上述定义中，“传感器”是指物理现象的探测器，其输出（在转换成一种可由控制器解释的信号之后）能够产生“程序”，或对“程序 ” 指令或数字“程序”数据进行修改。其包括具有机器显示、红外线成像、声像、触觉测量、惯性位置测量、光学或声学测距或力测量或转矩测量等能力的“传感器”。在上述定义中，
text.en: “Robots,” “end-effectors,” and controllers: Note: 2B207 does not control “robots” specially designed for non-nuclear industrial applications such as automobile paint booths. Technical Notes: 1. In 2B207, “robot” means a manipulation mechanism, capable of continuous-path or point-to-point operation, which may use “sensors” and has all of the following characteristics: a. Multifunctional; b. Capable of positioning or orienting materials, parts, tools, or special devices through variable movements in three-dimensional space; c. Incorporates three or more closed- or open-loop servo devices, which may include stepping motors; d. Has “user-accessible programmability” through teach/playback or an electronic computer with programmable logic control, without mechanical intervention. In the definition above, “sensor” means a detector of a physical phenomenon whose output, after conversion into a signal interpretable by a controller, can generate “programs” or modify “program” instructions or numerical “program” data. These include “sensors” with capabilities for machine vision, infrared imaging, acoustic imaging, tactile measurement, inertial position measurement, optical or acoustic ranging, or force or torque measurement. In the definition above,

text.zh:

a．仅采用手动控制、遥控的操纵机构；
b．固定顺序操纵机构，它们是按照机械式固定的程序运动的自动运转装置。通过固定的止动件（ 例如 ： 销或凸轮）机械地限制该“程序”。采用机械的、电子的或电气的手段不可能改变或变更运转顺序和选择轨径或角度；

text.en: “user-accessible programmability” means the facility allowing a user to insert, modify, or replace “programs” by means other than the following: a. Physical changes to wiring or interconnections; b. Setting function controls, including entering parameters. In this definition, “robots” do not include the following devices: a. Manipulation mechanisms controlled exclusively manually or by remote manual control; b. Fixed-sequence manipulation mechanisms: automatically operating devices that move according to mechanically fixed programs. Mechanically limiting the “program” by fixed stops (e.g., pins or cams). Mechanically limiting the “program” by fixed but adjustable stops (e.g., pins or cams). The sequence of operations and choice of paths or angles can be varied within a fixed “program” pattern. The “program” pattern on one or more axes of motion can be changed or modified only through mechanical operations (e.g., changing pins or exchanging cams); d. Non-servo-controlled variable-sequence manipulation mechanisms: automatically operating devices that move according to mechanically fixed programs.

text.zh:

text.en: The “program” can be changed, but the sequence proceeds only through binary signals output by mechanically fixed binary electrical devices or adjustable stops; e. Stacker cranes defined as Cartesian-coordinate manipulation systems, incorporated into warehouses with vertically arranged storage bins for accessing bin contents. 2. In 2B207, “end-effectors” include grippers, “active tooling units,” and any other tooling attached to the baseplate at the end of a “robot” manipulator arm. In this definition, an “active tooling unit” means a device that applies motive power or process energy to, or senses, a workpiece. a. “Robots” or “end-effectors” having either of the following characteristics: 1. Specially designed to comply with national safety standards for handling high explosives (e.g., meeting electrical-code ratings for high explosives); 2. Specially designed or rated as radiation-hardened to withstand radiation greater than 5×10⁴ Gy (silicon) without operational degradation; Technical Note: Gy (silicon) means the energy, in J/kg, absorbed by an unshielded silicon sample exposed to ionizing radiation.

b．如果有，压力敏感元件所需且直接接触过程介质的封装，该封装由铝、铝合金、氧化铝（矾土或蓝宝石）、镍、镍含量大于等于 60%（按重量计）的镍合金、完全氟化的烃聚合物制造或保护；
c．具有以下任一特性：
1．满量程小于 13 kPa、“精度”高于满量程±1%；
2．满量程大于等于 13 kPa、13 kPa 压力点测量“精度”高于±130 Pa。
text.en: Pressure transducers of all types having all of the following characteristics: Technical Notes: 1. Pressure transducers controlled under 2B230 are devices that convert pressure measurements into electrically usable signals. 2. "Accuracy" in 2B230 includes nonlinearity, hysteresis and repeatability at ambient temperature. a. Pressure-sensing elements made of or protected by aluminum, aluminum alloys, aluminum oxide (alumina or sapphire), nickel, nickel alloys containing 60% or more nickel by weight, or fully fluorinated hydrocarbon polymers; b. If present, the enclosure required for the pressure-sensing element and in direct contact with the process medium, made of or protected by aluminum, aluminum alloys, aluminum oxide (alumina or sapphire), nickel, nickel alloys containing 60% or more nickel by weight, or fully fluorinated hydrocarbon polymers; c. Having either of the following characteristics: 1. A full scale of less than 13 kPa and “accuracy” better than ±1% of full scale; 2. A full scale of 13 kPa or greater and measurement “accuracy” better than ±130 Pa at the 13 kPa pressure point.

text.zh: 真空泵

text.zh:

a．抽气口孔径尺寸大于等于 380 mm；
b．抽气速率大于等于 15 m³/s；

技术说明：
1．抽气速率在测量点用氮气或空气测定。
2．堵住泵抽气端，可在此抽气端测定这种极限真空度。
text.en: Vacuum pumps having all of the following characteristics: a. An inlet-port opening of 380 mm or greater; b. A pumping speed of 15 m³/s or greater; c. Capable of producing an ultimate vacuum below 13.3 mPa. Technical Notes: 1. Pumping speed is determined with nitrogen or air at the measurement point. 2. The ultimate vacuum can be measured at the pump inlet with the inlet blocked.

title.zh: 波纹管密封涡旋压缩机和波纹管密封涡旋真空泵
title.en: Bellows-sealed scroll compressors and bellows-sealed scroll vacuum pumps

summary.zh: 波纹管密封涡旋压缩机和波纹管密封涡旋真空泵
summary.en: Bellows-sealed scroll compressors and bellows-sealed scroll vacuum pumps

text.zh: 波纹管密封涡旋压缩机和波纹管密封涡旋真空泵
text.en: Bellows-sealed scroll compressors and bellows-sealed scroll vacuum pumps

text.zh:
具有以下所有特性的波纹管密封涡旋压缩机和波纹管密封涡旋真空泵：
a．入口体积流量能够达到 50 m³/h 或更大；
b．压缩比能够达到 2：1 或更大；
c．所有与工艺气体接触的表面均由以下任何材料制造：
1．铝或铝合金；
2．氧化铝；
3．不锈钢；
4．镍或镍合金；
5．磷青铜；
6．含氟聚合物。
技术说明：
1．在涡旋压缩机或涡旋真空泵中，一对或多对相互啮合的涡旋盘或涡盘中形成月牙形气室，相互啮合的涡旋盘一个运动而另外一个保持不动。运动的涡盘围绕不动的涡盘旋转摆动，而自身不旋转。随着动涡轮盘绕静涡轮盘的运动，转向机器出口端月牙形气室逐步缩小（即气体被压缩）。
2．在波纹管密封涡旋压缩机或真空泵中，工艺气体通过一个金属波纹管与泵的润滑部件和外部大气完全隔开。波纹管的一端连接到动涡盘，另一端连接到真空泵的壳体。
3．含氟聚合物包括但不限于以下材料：
a．聚四氟乙烯（PTFE）；
b．聚全氟乙丙烯（FEP）；
text.en: Bellows-sealed scroll compressors and bellows-sealed scroll vacuum pumps having all of the following characteristics: a. Capable of an inlet volumetric flow of 50 m³/h or greater; b. Capable of a compression ratio of 2:1 or greater; c. All surfaces in contact with the process gas are made of any of the following materials: 1. Aluminum or aluminum alloys; 2. Aluminum oxide; 3. Stainless steel; 4. Nickel or nickel alloys; 5. Phosphor bronze; 6. Fluoropolymers. Technical Notes: 1. In a scroll compressor or scroll vacuum pump, one or more pairs of intermeshing scrolls form crescent-shaped gas pockets, with one scroll moving and the other stationary. The moving scroll orbits the stationary scroll without rotating about its own axis. As the moving scroll orbits the stationary scroll, the crescent-shaped gas pockets progressively shrink toward the machine outlet, compressing the gas. 2. In a bellows-sealed scroll compressor or vacuum pump, a metal bellows completely isolates the process gas from the pump's lubricated parts and the outside atmosphere. One end of the bellows is attached to the moving scroll, and the other to the vacuum-pump housing. 3. Fluoropolymers include, but are not limited to, the following materials: a. Polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE); b. Fluorinated ethylene propylene (FEP);

text.zh:
c．过氟烷氧基聚合物（PFA）；
d．聚三氟氯乙烯（PCTFE）；
e．偏氟乙烯-六氟丙烯共聚物。
text.en: c. Perfluoroalkoxy polymers (PFA); d. Polychlorotrifluoroethylene (PCTFE); e. Vinylidene fluoride–hexafluoropropylene copolymers.

title.zh: 全密闭设施
title.en: Complete containment facilities

summary.zh: 全密闭设施
summary.en: Complete containment facilities

text.zh: 全密闭设施
text.en: Complete containment facilities

text.zh:
生物材料处理设备：
a．符合世界卫生组织《实验室生物安全手册》（2004 年第三版，日内瓦）所规定的生物安全水平三级（BL-3）、四级（BL-4）标准的全密闭设施；
说明：
1．“生物安全水平三级（BL-3）”是指生物医学或微生物学实验室，使用高效空气粒子过滤器（HEPA），在对外环境保持负压、人员和物品出入实行控制、废水废气废物处理，以及微生物操作规程、个人防护等方面，符合世界卫生组织《实验室生物安全手册》（2004 年第三版，日内瓦）所规定的生物安全三级标准的实验室封闭水平和生物安全处理能力。
2．“生物安全水平四级（BL-4）”是指生物医学或微生物学实验室，使用高效空气粒子过滤器（HEPA），在对外环境保持负压、人员和物品出入实行控制、废水废气废物处理，以及微生物操作规程、个人防护等方面，符合世界卫生组织《实验室生物安全手册》（2004 年第三版，日内瓦）所规定的生物安全四级标准的实验室封闭水平和生物安全处理能力。
text.en: Biological material processing equipment: a. Complete containment facilities meeting biosafety level 3 (BL-3) or level 4 (BL-4) criteria in the World Health Organization's Laboratory Biosafety Manual, third edition, Geneva, 2004; Notes: 1. “Biosafety Level 3 (BL-3)” means the laboratory containment level and biosafety handling capability of a biomedical or microbiological laboratory using high-efficiency particulate air (HEPA) filters, maintaining negative pressure relative to the outside environment, controlling entry and exit of personnel and materials, treating wastewater, exhaust gases, and waste, and meeting the Level 3 standards for microbiological practices and personal protection specified in the World Health Organization’s Laboratory Biosafety Manual (3rd edition, Geneva, 2004). 2. “Biosafety Level 4 (BL-4)” means the laboratory containment level and biosafety handling capability of a biomedical or microbiological laboratory using high-efficiency particulate air (HEPA) filters, maintaining negative pressure relative to the outside environment, controlling entry and exit of personnel and materials, treating wastewater, exhaust gases, and waste, and meeting the Level 4 standards for microbiological practices and personal protection specified in the World Health Organization’s Laboratory Biosafety Manual (3rd edition, Geneva, 2004).

text.zh: 其特点是在生物安全水平三级的基础上，通过增加气密系统、分隔通道系统，使用三级生物安全柜或正压工作服，以及专用的空气控制系统等，以达到比生物安全水平三级更严密的生物封闭和更高的生物安全处理能力。
text.en: It builds on biosafety level 3 by adding airtight systems, segregated access systems, class III biological safety cabinets or positive-pressure suits, and dedicated air-control systems to achieve tighter biological containment and greater biosafety-handling capability than level 3.

text.zh: 交叉流（切向流）过滤设备
text.en: Cross-flow (tangential-flow) filtration equipment

text.zh:
生物材料处理设备：
d．交叉流（切向流）过滤设备及其组件：
说明：2B352.d项不管制由制造商标明的反向渗透设备。
1．具有以下所有特性，不泄漏气溶胶，可用于分离 “ 病原微生物 ”“ 毒素 ”和细胞培养物的交叉流（切向流）过滤设备：
a．总过滤面积大于等于 1 m²；
b．可原位灭菌或消毒；技术说明 ：2B352.d.1.b 项所述的“灭菌”是指通过使用物理（蒸汽）或化学剂杀灭设备中所有的活微生物 ；“消毒”是指通过使用具有杀菌作用的化学剂，破坏设备中微生物的潜在感染力。“消毒”和“灭菌”不同于“卫生处理”，“卫生处理”是指用于降低设备中微生物含量而不必达到消灭所有微生物感染力或存活力的清洁过程。
text.en: Biological material processing equipment: d. Cross-flow (tangential-flow) filtration equipment and components: Note: 2B352.d does not control equipment identified by its manufacturer as reverse-osmosis equipment. 1. Cross-flow (tangential-flow) filtration equipment that does not release aerosols, usable for separating “pathogenic microorganisms,” “toxins,” and cell cultures, having all of the following characteristics: a. A total filtration area of 1 m² or greater; b. Capable of in-situ sterilization or disinfection; Technical Note: In 2B352.d.1.b, “sterilization” means killing all viable microorganisms in equipment through physical means (steam) or chemical agents; “Disinfection” means destroying the potential infectivity of microorganisms in the equipment using germicidal chemicals. “Disinfection” and “sterilization” differ from “sanitization,” a cleaning process that reduces microbial content in equipment without necessarily eliminating all microbial infectivity or viability.

text.zh: 模/数转换器
text.en: Analog-to-digital converters

text.zh:
具有以下任一特性的模 / 数转换器：
a．在-54～125℃的温度范围内连续工作；
b．专门设计以符合加固设备的军用技术规范；
c．专门设计或改进成军用，或设计成抗辐射的，并具有以下任一特性：
1．在额定“精度”下转换速率大于每秒200000 次完整的转换；
2．在规定的工作温度范围内 “ 精度 ” 超过满量程的 1/10000以上；
3．品质因数为 1×10⁸以上（每秒转换次数除以“精度”）；
4．内含具有以下两种特性的模数转换器微型电路：
a．达到最大分辨率时的最长转换时间小于 20 μs；
b．在规定的工作温度范围内，额定的非线性度高于满量程的 0.025%。
text.en: Analog-to-digital converters having any of the following characteristics: a. Continuous operation over the temperature range of -54 to 125 °C; b. Specially designed to meet military specifications for ruggedized equipment; c. text.zh:
具有以下两种特性的高速脉冲发生器及其“脉冲头”：
a．在小于 55 Ω电阻负载上的输出电压大于 6 V；
b．“脉冲转换时间”小于 500 ps。
技术说明：
1．在 3A230.b 项中，“脉冲转换时间”是指电压幅度从 10%增至 90%时的时间间隔。
2．“脉冲头”是指为接受电压阶跃函数并使之形成可包括矩形脉冲、三角形脉冲、阶跃脉冲、冲击脉冲、指数脉冲或单周期脉冲等各类脉冲形式而设计的脉冲形成网络。“脉冲头”可以是脉冲发生器的一个整体组成部分或该装置的一个插件模块，也可以是一个外部连接装置。
text.en: High-speed pulse generators and their “pulse heads,” having both of the following characteristics: a. An output voltage greater than 6 V into a resistive load below 55 Ω; b. A "pulse transition time" of less than 500 ps. Technical Notes: 1. In 3A230.b, “pulse transition time” means the interval during which the voltage amplitude rises from 10% to 90%. 2. “Pulse heads” means pulse-forming networks designed to accept a voltage step function and shape it into various pulse forms, including rectangular, triangular, step, impulse, exponential, or monocycle pulses. A “pulse head” may be an integral component of a pulse generator, a plug-in module, or an externally connected device.

text.zh:
雷管和多点起爆系统：
说明：3A232 项不管制仅使用起爆药（例如：叠氮化铅）的雷管。
技术说明：3A232项所管制的雷管均利用一个小导电体（例如：桥、桥丝或箔），当上升时间短的大电流电脉冲通过上述导电体时，使它爆炸而汽化。在非冲击片型雷管里，爆炸的导电体引起相接触的高能炸药如太安（PETN，季戊四醇四硝酸酯）化学爆轰。在冲击片型雷管里，导电体的爆炸蒸汽驱动飞片或冲击片飞过一个间隙，撞击炸药而引起化学爆轰 。 在某些设计中，冲击片是由磁力驱动。术语爆炸箔雷管，可以指爆炸桥雷管，或指冲击片型雷管。起爆器有时也被用来代替雷管。
a．电驱动的炸药雷管：
1．爆炸桥（EB）；
text.en: Detonators and multipoint initiation systems: Note: 3A232 does not control detonators using only primary explosives, such as lead azide. Technical Note: All detonators controlled by 3A232 use a small electrical conductor, such as a bridge, bridgewire or foil, which explosively vaporizes when a high-current electrical pulse with a short rise time passes through it. In nonslapper detonators, the exploding conductor initiates chemical detonation in a high explosive in contact with it, such as PETN (pentaerythritol tetranitrate). In slapper-type detonators, the explosive vaporization of a conductor propels a flyer or slapper across a gap to strike the explosive and initiate chemical detonation. In some designs, the slapper is magnetically driven. The term exploding-foil detonator may refer to an exploding-bridge detonator or a slapper-type detonator. The term initiator is sometimes used instead of detonator. a. Electrically driven explosive detonators: 1. Exploding bridge (EB);

d．具有以下两种特性的电子轰击质谱仪：
1．分子束入口系统，将准直的分析物分子束注入分子被电子束电离的离子源区域；
2．能冷却至-80 ℃或更低的温度，以捕获未被电子束电离的分析物分子的一个或多个“冷阱”；
技术说明：
1．3A233.d 项所管制的是通常用于六氟化铀气体样品同位素分析的质谱仪。
2．3A233.d 项所管制的电子轰击质谱仪也称电子冲击质谱仪或电子电离质谱仪。
3．在 3A233.d.2 项中，“冷阱”是一种通过将气体分子凝结或冻结在冷的表面上来捕集气体分子的装置。就本项而言，闭环气态氦低温真空泵不是“冷阱”。
text.en: Mass spectrometers capable of measuring ions of 230 u or greater, with a resolution better than 2/230, and their ion sources: N.B.: Mass spectrometers specially designed or manufactured for analyzing on-line uranium-hexafluoride samples are controlled under the Nuclear Export Control List of the People's Republic of China. d. Electron-bombardment mass spectrometers having both of the following characteristics: 1. A molecular-beam inlet system that injects a collimated beam of analyte molecules into the ion-source region where an electron beam ionizes the molecules; 2. One or more “cold traps” capable of cooling to -80 °C or lower to trap analyte molecules not ionized by the electron beam; Technical Notes: 1. 3A233.d controls mass spectrometers typically used for isotope analysis of uranium-hexafluoride gas samples. 2. Electron-bombardment mass spectrometers controlled under 3A233.d are also called electron-impact or electron-ionization mass spectrometers. 3. In 3A233.d.2, a “cold trap” is a device that captures gas molecules by condensing or freezing them on a cold surface. For this item, a closed-loop gaseous-helium cryogenic vacuum pump is not a “cold trap.”

高性能“数字计算机”、电子组件及相关设备：
技术说明：调整后的峰值性能（APP）是指“数字计算机”在进行 64 位或更多位的浮点加法和乘法运算的调整后的峰值速度。本技术说明涉及的缩写：n “数字计算机”中的处理器数量I 处理器编号（1，……，n）t 处理器时i钟周期（t =1/F ）i i F 处理器频率i R 峰值浮点运i算速度W 体系结构i调整因子APP 用加权万亿次浮点运算（Weighted TeraFLOPS（WT））表示，单位是 10¹² 调整后的每秒浮点运算。APP 的计算方法如下：
1. 确定“数字计算机”中的每个处理器 i 在每个时钟周期内执行的64 位或更多位的峰值浮点操作次数（FPOi）。
说明：在确定FPO时，仅包括64 位或更多位浮点加法、浮点乘法运算。所有浮点运算必须表示为每个处理器时钟周期所执行的运算次数；需要多个时钟周期完成的运算可以表示为每个时钟周期完成运算的分数值。对于不能进行64
text.en: High-performance “digital computers,” electronic assemblies, and related equipment: Technical Note: Adjusted Peak Performance (APP) means the adjusted peak speed at which a “digital computer” performs floating-point additions and multiplications with operands of 64 bits or more. Abbreviations used in this Technical Note: n, number of processors in the “digital computer”; i, processor number (1, …, n); tᵢ, processor clock-cycle time (tᵢ=1/Fᵢ); Fᵢ, processor frequency; Rᵢ, peak floating-point operation rate; Wᵢ, architecture adjustment factor. APP is expressed in Weighted TeraFLOPS (WT), in units of 10¹² adjusted floating-point operations per second. APP is calculated as follows: 1. Determine FPOᵢ, the peak number of floating-point operations with operands of 64 bits or more performed in each clock cycle by each processor i in the “digital computer.” Note: In determining FPO, include only floating-point additions and multiplications with operands of 64 bits or more. All floating-point operations must be expressed as the number performed per processor clock cycle; operations requiring multiple clock cycles may be expressed as fractions of an operation per clock cycle. For processors incapable of floating-point operations with operands of 64

text.zh:
位或更多位浮点操作数的处理器，其有效浮点运算速度R为0。
2.计算每个处理器的浮点运算速度R，Ri= FPOi/ ti
3.计算APP，APP=W₁×R₁+W₂×R₂+…+ Wn×Rn
4.对于“向量处理器”，Wi=0.9；对于非“向量处理器”，Wi=0.3说明1：对于在一个时钟周期内能够完成复合运算的处理器，例如同时进行加法和乘法运算，所有运算次数都计算在内。说明2：就流水线处理器而言，有效浮点运算速度R 取流水线满时的流水线速度，或非流水线速度中的较高值。说明 3：在计算 APP之前，应先对每个参与运算的处理器，按照其最大可能的理论值来计算其运算速度 R。如果计算机制造商在手册或资料中声称，该计算机能够进行并发、并行、同时操作或运行，则在计算 R 时，应考虑同时操作的因素。说明 4：计算 APP时，不应考虑那些仅负责输出/输入和外部设备功能（例如：磁盘驱动器、通信及视频显示等）的处理器。说明 5：计算 APP的值，
text.en: bits or more, the effective floating-point operation rate R is 0. 2. Calculate each processor’s floating-point operation rate R: Rᵢ=FPOᵢ/tᵢ. 3. Calculate APP: APP=W₁×R₁+W₂×R₂+…+Wn×Rn. 4. For “vector processors,” Wᵢ=0.9; for processors other than “vector processors,” Wᵢ=0.3. Note 1: For processors capable of completing compound operations in one clock cycle, such as simultaneous addition and multiplication, count all operations. Note 2: For pipelined processors, the effective floating-point operating rate R is the higher of the fully loaded pipeline rate and the nonpipelined rate. Note 3: Before calculating APP, calculate each participating processor’s operation rate R at its maximum theoretically possible value. If the computer manufacturer claims in manuals or documentation that the computer supports concurrent, parallel, or simultaneous operations or execution, account for simultaneous operation when calculating R. Note 4: In calculating APP, exclude processors dedicated solely to input/output and peripheral functions (such as disk drives, communications, and video displays). Note 5: In calculating APP,

text.zh:
不考虑通过“局域网”、广域网、I/O 共享连接或共享设备、I/O 控制器以及任何由软件实现通讯互连的处理器组合。说明 6：计算 APP的值，必须包括通过聚合、同时运算和共享内存方式专门设计用于增强系统性能的处理器组合。
技术说明：
1．聚合在同一芯片上的所有同时运行的处理器和加速器；
2．处理器组合共享内存方式，是任一处理器通过高速缓存块或存储字的硬件传输、不用任何的软件机制可以访问系统中的任一内存地址。该方式可以通过4A003.b 所管制的“电子组件”获得。说明 7：“向量处理器”定义为内置向量指令的处理器，这些指令能够同时进行多重浮点向量（64 位或更多位的一维数组）运算，且处理器中至少含有 2 个向量功能部件和至少 8 个向量寄存器，每个向量寄存器至少包含 64 个数据单元。
a．“调整后的峰值性能（APP）”大于 8.0 加权每秒万亿次浮点运算（Weighted TeraFLOPS）的“数字计算机”；
text.en: exclude combinations of processors interconnected through “local area networks,” wide-area networks, I/O-shared connections or devices, I/O controllers, or any communications interconnection implemented through software. Note 6: In calculating APP, include combinations of processors specially designed to enhance system performance through aggregation, simultaneous operation, and shared memory. Technical Notes: 1. Aggregate all simultaneously operating processors and accelerators on the same chip; 2. Shared memory in a processor combination means that any processor can access any memory address in the system through hardware transfer of cache lines or memory words, without a software mechanism. This may be achieved through “electronic assemblies” controlled under 4A003.b. Note 7: A “vector processor” is a processor with built-in vector instructions capable of simultaneously performing multiple floating-point vector operations (on one-dimensional arrays with operands of 64 bits or more), containing at least two vector functional units and at least eight vector registers, each holding at least 64 data elements. a. “Digital computers” with “Adjusted Peak Performance (APP)” greater than 8.0 Weighted TeraFLOPS;

title.en: Application-specific integrated circuit chips (security chips)

summary.zh: 专用集成电路芯片（安全芯片）
summary.en: Application-specific integrated circuit chips (security chips)

text.zh: 专用集成电路芯片（安全芯片）
text.en: Application-specific integrated circuit chips (security chips)

text.zh:
信息安全系统、设备及其部件：
a．具有以下任一特性，部分或全部实现了密码运算、密钥管理、随机数生成等功能的集成电路芯片（安全芯片）：
1．含有专门用于电力、税务、公安、金融等领域的 64 位以上密钥长度的对称密码算法，768 位以上密钥长度的基于整数因子分解的非对称密码算法或 128位以上密钥长度基于椭圆曲线的非对称密码算法；
text.en: Information-security systems, equipment, and components: a. Integrated-circuit chips (security chips) implementing, in whole or in part, cryptographic operations, key management, random-number generation, or similar functions, and having either of the following characteristics: 1. Incorporating symmetric cryptographic algorithms with key lengths of 64 bits or more, asymmetric algorithms based on integer factorization with key lengths of 768 bits or more, or asymmetric algorithms based on elliptic curves with key lengths of 128 bits or more, specifically for sectors such as electricity, taxation, public security, and finance;

2．含有 64 位以上密钥长度的对称密码算法、768 位以上密钥长度的基于整数因子分解的非对称密码算法或 128 位以上密钥长度基于椭圆曲线的非对称密码算法，且对称密码算法加解密速率10 Gbps 以上或非对称密码算法签名速率 50000 tps 以上。
text.en: Information-security systems, equipment, and components: a. Integrated-circuit chips (security chips) implementing, in whole or in part, cryptographic operations, key management, random-number generation, or similar functions, and having either of the following characteristics: 2. Incorporating symmetric cryptographic algorithms with key lengths of 64 bits or more, asymmetric algorithms based on integer factorization with key lengths of 768 bits or more, or asymmetric algorithms based on elliptic curves with key lengths of 128 bits or more, and having symmetric encryption/decryption rates of 10 Gbps or more or asymmetric signature rates of 50000 tps or more.

text.en: Information-security systems, equipment, and components: d. Incorporating symmetric cryptographic algorithms with key lengths of 64 bits or more, asymmetric algorithms based on integer factorization with key lengths of 768 bits or more, or asymmetric algorithms based on elliptic curves with key lengths of 128 bits or more; 2. Supporting 10000 or more managed objects.

text.en: "Unmanned aerial vehicles" or "unmanned airships" with an endurance of at least 30 minutes but less than 1 h

text.zh:
“ 无人驾驶航空器 ”“ 无人驾驶飞艇 ” 以及相关设备和部件：
说明：9A012.a、9A012.b.1 、9A012.d 项不管制模型飞机或模型飞艇。
技术说明：就 9A012 项而言：
1．“红外成像设备”是一种利用物体发射的红外辐射来形成图像的探测设备，广泛应用于夜视、热成像、搜索与救援等领域。
2．“合成孔径雷达”是一种主动式微波遥感系统，它通过合成孔径技术获得高分辨率雷达图像，适用于地形测绘、环境监测等。
3．“目标指示激光器”是一种用于军事领域的激光设备，它能精确地指向目标并对其进行标记，以便于激光制导武器对其进行打击。
4．“瞬时视场角”是指探测器在某一瞬间所能覆盖的视场角度，它决定了探测器的空间分辨率。
5．“条带模式”是合成孔径雷达工作的一种模式，其中雷达波束沿着飞行方向连续扫描地面，形成一条宽的扫描带。
6．“聚束模式”是合成孔径雷达工作的一种模式，其中雷达波束在某一特定区域进行长时间的聚焦，
text.en: “Unmanned aerial vehicles,” “unmanned airships,” and related equipment and components: Note: 9A012.a, 9A012.b.1, and 9A012.d do not control model aircraft or model airships. Technical Notes: For the purposes of 9A012: 1. “Infrared imaging equipment” means detection equipment that forms images using infrared radiation emitted by objects, widely used for night vision, thermal imaging, search and rescue, and similar applications. 2. “Synthetic aperture radar” is an active microwave remote-sensing system that obtains high-resolution radar images using synthetic-aperture techniques, for applications such as terrain mapping and environmental monitoring. 3. A “target-designating laser” is military laser equipment that precisely points to and marks a target so that laser-guided weapons can engage it. 4. “Instantaneous field of view” means the angular field a detector covers at a given instant; it determines the detector's spatial resolution. 5. “Stripmap mode” is a synthetic-aperture radar operating mode in which the radar beam continuously scans the ground along the flight direction, forming a wide swath. 6. “Spotlight mode” is a synthetic-aperture radar operating mode in which the radar beam remains focused on a specific area for an extended period,

text.zh:
以获得更高的空间分辨率。
7．“光束发散角”是指光束在传播过程中发散的程度，通常用来描述激光束或其他类型光束的聚焦性能。
8．“无线电视距”是指在没有任何障碍物的情况下，无线电波在自由空间中传播的最大距离。a ． 在 “ 操作人员”“自然视距”以外能够可控飞行并具有以下任一特性的“无人驾驶航空器 ” 或 “ 无人驾驶飞艇”：
技术说明：
1．“操作人员 ” 是指负责操控“无人驾驶航空器 ” 或“ 无人驾驶飞艇 ” 的专业人员，通过地面控制站对飞行器进行遥控或编程，以确保飞行任务的顺利完成；
2．“续航时间 ” 指换算到国际标准大气环境条件（ ISO2533 ：1975）下海平面零风状态的持续飞行时间；
3．“自然视距 ” 是指在没有任何人为干扰和大气污染的理想条件下，地球表面上观察者能够清晰看到物体的最大距离。视距是指在地球表面上，由于地球曲率的限制，观察者能够清晰看到物体的最大距离。在实际应用中，通常考虑大气条件对视距的影响。
text.en: to obtain higher spatial resolution. 7. “Beam divergence” means the extent to which a beam spreads during propagation, commonly used to describe the focusing performance of laser or other light beams. 8. “Radio line of sight” means the maximum distance radio waves propagate through free space without obstructions. a. “Unmanned aerial vehicles” or “unmanned airships” capable of controlled flight beyond the “operator’s” “natural line of sight,” having either of the following characteristics: Technical Notes: 1. “Operator” means a professional responsible for operating an “unmanned aerial vehicle” or “unmanned airship” through remote control or programming from a ground control station to ensure successful completion of the flight mission; 2. “Endurance” means the duration of sustained flight converted to sea-level, zero-wind conditions in the International Standard Atmosphere (ISO2533:1975); 3. “Natural line of sight” means the maximum distance at which an observer on the Earth’s surface can clearly see an object under ideal conditions without human interference or atmospheric pollution. Line of sight means the maximum distance at which an observer on the Earth's surface can clearly see an object, as limited by the Earth's curvature. In practice, the effect of atmospheric conditions on line of sight is normally considered.

text.zh: 1．最大“续航时间”大于等于 30 分钟小于 1h，以及在大于等于 46.3 km/h（25节）的阵风条件下，具有起飞能力和稳定可控飞行能力；
text.en: 1. Maximum “endurance” of 30 minutes or greater but less than 1 h, and the ability to take off and maintain stable, controlled flight in gusts of 46.3 km/h (25 knots) or greater;

title.zh: 高压水炮
title.en: High-pressure water cannons

summary.zh: 高压水炮
summary.en: High-pressure water cannons

text.zh: 高压水炮
text.en: High-pressure water cannons

text.zh:
具有以下所有特性的“高压水炮”：
a．“最大射程”大于等于 100 m；
b．“额定流量”大于等于 540 m³/h；
c．“额定压力”大于等于 1.2 MPa。
技术说明：
1．“高压水炮”是一种以高压水泵对液体介质做功，形成可在空气中远距离喷射高速流体的设备。
2．“最大射程”是指水炮出口到洒落区域的最远距离。最大射程处伤害力较小，也不存在瞄准的可能。
3．“额定流量”是指在额定工况下的流量。
4．“额定压力”是指在满足设备正常工作需求下的最大压力。
text.en: “High-pressure water cannons” having all of the following characteristics: a. “Maximum range” of 100 m or greater; b. A "rated flow rate" of 540 m³/h or greater; c. A "rated pressure" of 1.2 MPa or greater. Technical Notes: 1. A “high-pressure water cannon” is equipment that uses a high-pressure pump to transfer energy to a liquid medium, producing a high-speed fluid jet that can travel long distances through the air. 2. “Maximum range” means the greatest distance from the water-cannon outlet to the area where the water lands. At maximum range, its injuring force is relatively low and aiming is not possible. 3. “Rated flow rate” means the flow rate under rated operating conditions. 4. “Rated pressure” means the maximum pressure consistent with the equipment's normal operating requirements.

text.en: Nuclear reactors

text.zh:
能够保持受控自持链式裂变反应的可运行核反应堆。
注释：一个“核反应堆”基本上包括反应堆容器内或直接安装在其上的物项、控制堆芯功率水平的设备和通常含有或直接接触或控制反应堆堆芯一次冷却剂的部件。
text.en: Operational nuclear reactors capable of maintaining a controlled self-sustaining fission chain reaction. Explanatory Note: A "nuclear reactor" basically includes the items within or directly attached to the reactor vessel, equipment controlling core power levels, and components that normally contain, come into direct contact with, or control the primary coolant of the reactor core.

text.en: Primary coolant pumps or circulators

text.zh: 专门设计或制造用于循环上述第 6 项定义的核反应堆的一次性冷却剂的泵或循环泵。专门设计和制造的泵或循环泵包括水冷堆泵、气冷堆循环泵以及液态金属冷却堆用电磁泵和机械泵。这种设备包括防止一次冷却剂渗漏的精密密封或多种密封的系统、全密封驱动泵，有惯性质量系统的泵，及鉴定为NC-1 或相当标准的泵。
text.en: Pumps or circulators specially designed or manufactured to circulate primary coolant in a nuclear reactor as defined in item 6 above. Specially designed and manufactured pumps or circulators include pumps for water-cooled reactors, circulators for gas-cooled reactors, and electromagnetic and mechanical pumps for liquid-metal-cooled reactors. This equipment includes pumps with precision-sealed or multisealed systems to prevent primary-coolant leakage, canned-drive pumps, pumps with inertial mass systems, and pumps qualified to NC-1 or equivalent standards.
