text.zh:
专门设计或制造用于上述第 6 项定义的核反应堆的“核反应堆内部构件”，包括堆芯支承柱、燃料通道、排管、热屏蔽层、堆芯缓冲层、堆芯栅格板和扩散板。
注释：“核反应堆内部构件”是反应堆容器内的主要结构，具有一种或多种功能，例如支承堆芯、保持燃料对准、引导一次冷却剂流向、为反应堆容器提供辐射屏蔽层、导向堆芯内仪表。
text.en: "Nuclear reactor internals" specially designed or manufactured for a nuclear reactor as defined in item 6 above, including core support columns, fuel channels, calandria tubes, thermal shields, core baffles, core grid plates and diffuser plates. Explanatory Note: “Nuclear reactor internals” are major structures within a reactor vessel with one or more functions, such as supporting the core, maintaining fuel alignment, directing primary coolant flow, providing radiation shielding for the reactor vessel, or guiding in-core instrumentation.

text.zh: 热交换器
text.en: Heat exchangers

text.zh:
1.专门设计或制造用于上述第 6 项定义的核反应堆的一次冷却剂或中间冷却剂回路的热交换器；
2.专门设计或制造用于上述第 6 项定义的核反应堆的一次冷却剂回路的其他热交换器。
注释：对有一个中间冷却回路的快堆的情况，除蒸汽发生器外，用于将一回路侧的热量输送到中间冷却回路的热交换器理所当然地属于控制范围以内。在气冷堆中，可利用热交换器项驱动燃气轮机的二次气体回路传热。本条款的控制范围不包括反应堆支持系统如应急冷却系统和衰变热冷却系统的热交换器。
text.en: 1. Heat exchangers specially designed or manufactured for the primary or intermediate coolant circuit of a nuclear reactor as defined in item 6 above; 2. Other heat exchangers specially designed or manufactured for the primary coolant circuit of a nuclear reactor as defined in item 6 above. Explanatory Note: For fast reactors with an intermediate cooling circuit, heat exchangers transferring heat from the primary circuit to the intermediate cooling circuit, in addition to steam generators, are understood to fall within the control scope. In gas-cooled reactors, heat exchangers may transfer heat to a secondary gas circuit that drives a gas turbine. This provision does not cover heat exchangers for reactor support systems such as emergency cooling and decay-heat cooling systems.

注释：为了出口控制的目的，政府将确定出口符合上述技术指标的石墨是否用于核反应堆。本条款的控制范围不包括不用于核反应堆的，纯度高于 5ppm（百万分之五）硼当量，密度大于 1.50g/cm³的石墨。硼当量（BE）可以实验测定或以包括硼在内的杂质 BE_{Z} 之总量计算得出（由于碳不被考虑是一种杂质，因此不包括BE_{碳}），其中：BE_{Z}（ppm）= CF×元素 Z 的浓度（ppm为单位）；CF 为转化因子：（σ_{Z}×A_{B}）除以（σ_{B}×A_{Z}）；σ_{B} 和σ_{Z} 分别为自然界形成的硼和元素 Z 的热中子俘获截面（巴为单位）；以及 A_{B} 和 A_{Z} 分别为自然界形成的硼和元素 Z 的原子质量。
text.en: Graphite in quantities exceeding 1 kg, with a purity better than 5 parts per million boron equivalent and a density greater than 1.50 g/cm³. Explanatory Note: For export-control purposes, the government will determine whether graphite meeting the above technical specifications is intended for use in nuclear reactors. This provision does not cover graphite with a purity better than 5 ppm (parts per million) boron equivalent and a density greater than 1.50 g/cm³ that is not intended for use in nuclear reactors. Boron equivalent (BE) may be determined experimentally or calculated as the sum of BE_{Z} contributions from impurities, including boron (excluding BE_{carbon}, since carbon is not considered an impurity), where BE_{Z} (ppm) = CF × concentration of element Z (ppm); CF is the conversion factor: (σ_{Z} × A_{B}) divided by (σ_{B} × A_{Z}); σ_{B} and σ_{Z} are the thermal-neutron capture cross sections, in barns, of naturally occurring boron and element Z, respectively; and A_{B} and A_{Z} are the atomic masses of naturally occurring boron and element Z, respectively.

text.zh: 辐照燃料元件去包壳设备和切割机
text.en: Irradiated fuel element decladding equipment and chopping machines

text.zh:
专门设计或制造供后处理厂用来使辐照燃料组件、燃料棒束或棒的包壳剥开露出燃料芯块的遥控设备。
注释：这种设备能通过切割、剪切等方式切开燃料包壳，使辐照核材料能够被处理。专门设计的金属切割机是最常用的，当然也可能采用先进设备，例如激光器、剥皮机等。去包壳包含将辐照核燃料溶解前除去包壳的过程。
text.en: Remotely operated equipment specially designed or manufactured for use in reprocessing plants to breach the cladding of irradiated fuel assemblies, bundles or rods and expose the fuel pellets. Explanatory Note: This equipment breaches fuel cladding by cutting, shearing or other methods so that irradiated nuclear material can be processed. Specially designed metal chopping machines are most commonly used; advanced equipment, such as lasers or peeling machines, may also be used. Decladding includes the process of removing cladding before dissolving irradiated nuclear fuel.

title.zh: 溶解器
title.en: Dissolvers

summary.zh: 溶解器
summary.en: Dissolvers

text.zh: 溶解器
text.en: Dissolvers

text.zh:
专门设计或制造后处理厂用来溶解辐照核燃料，并能承受热、腐蚀性强的液体以及能远距离装料、操作和维修的溶解器或采用机械装置的溶解器。
注释：溶解器通常接收固体乏燃料。采用锆、不锈钢及其他类似合金材料制成的包壳的核燃料，必须先将包壳去除或切割，再装入溶解器，以使酸能够接触燃料芯块。辐照核燃料通常被溶解在硝酸等强无机酸中，其余未溶解包壳将被去除。虽然某些设计（如小直径、环形或平板式容器）可以用于保证临界安全，但其实它们并不是必需的。一些行政控制手段可以达到替代效果，如小批量尺寸或低裂变材料含量。溶解容器和采用机械装置的溶解器通常由低碳不锈钢、钛、锆等高品质材料制成。溶解器可以包括用于去除包壳或包壳废物的系统，用于控制和处理放射性废气的系统，并且可以远程放置，因为溶解器大多在厚屏蔽体后安放、运行和维护。
text.en: Dissolvers or mechanically operated dissolvers specially designed or manufactured for reprocessing plants to dissolve irradiated nuclear fuel, capable of withstanding hot, highly corrosive liquids and of being remotely loaded, operated and maintained. Explanatory Note: Dissolvers normally receive solid spent fuel. For nuclear fuel clad in zirconium, stainless steel or other similar alloys, the cladding must first be removed or cut before loading into the dissolver so that acid can reach the fuel pellets. Irradiated nuclear fuel is generally dissolved in strong mineral acids such as nitric acid, and the remaining undissolved cladding is removed. Although certain designs, such as small-diameter, annular, or slab vessels, may be used to ensure criticality safety, they are not essential. Administrative controls, such as small batch sizes or low fissile-material content, can provide an alternative. Dissolver vessels and mechanically equipped dissolvers are generally made of high-quality materials such as low-carbon stainless steel, titanium, or zirconium. Dissolvers may include systems for removing cladding or cladding waste and for controlling and treating radioactive off-gases, and may be remotely positioned, because most dissolvers are installed, operated, and maintained behind heavy shielding.

text.zh: 专门设计或制造用于辐照填料后处理厂的溶剂萃取器,例如填料塔或脉冲塔、混合澄清器或离心接触器。溶剂萃取器必须能耐硝酸的腐蚀作用。溶剂萃取器通常由低碳不锈钢、钛、锆或其他优质材料，按极高标准（包括特种焊接和检查以及质量保证和质量控制技术）加工制造而成。溶剂萃取器既接受溶解器中出来的辐照燃料的溶液,又接受分离铀、钚和裂变产物的有机溶液。溶剂萃取设备通常设计得能满足严格的运行参数，例如很长的运行寿命,毋需维修或易于更换、操作和控制简便以及可适应工艺条件的各种变化。
text.en: Solvent extractors specially designed or manufactured for irradiated fuel reprocessing plants, such as packed or pulsed columns, mixer-settlers or centrifugal contactors. [The source uses the word for "packing" in place of "fuel."] Solvent extractors must be resistant to the corrosive effects of nitric acid. Solvent extractors are normally fabricated from low-carbon stainless steel, titanium, zirconium or other high-quality materials to extremely high standards, including special welding, inspection, quality assurance and quality control techniques. Solvent extractors receive both the irradiated-fuel solution from the dissolvers and the organic solution used to separate uranium, plutonium, and fission products. Solvent-extraction equipment is generally designed to meet stringent operating parameters, including long service life, maintenance-free operation or easy replacement, simple operation and control, and adaptability to changes in process conditions.

summary.zh: 化学溶液保存或贮存容器
summary.en: Chemical solution holding or storage vessels

text.zh: 化学溶液保存或贮存容器
text.en: Chemical solution holding or storage vessels

text.zh:
专门设计或制造为辐照燃料后处理厂用的保存或贮存容器。这种保存或贮存容器必须能耐硝酸的腐蚀作用。保存或贮存容器通常用低碳不锈钢、钛或锆或其他优质材料制造。保存或贮存容器可设计成能远距离操作和维修，而且它们可具有下述控制核临界的特点：（1）壁或内部结构至少有2%的硼当量，或（2）对于圆柱状容器来说，最大直径 175mm，或（3）对于平板式或环形容器来说，最大宽度 75mm。
注释：溶剂萃取阶段产生三种主要的工艺液流。所有这三种液流在如下的进一步处理过程中要使用保存或贮存容器：（a）用蒸发法使纯硝酸铀酰溶液浓缩，然后使其进到脱硝过程，并在此过程中转变成氧化铀。这种氧化物再在核燃料循环中利用；（b）通常用蒸发法浓缩强放射性裂变产物溶液，并以浓缩液形式贮存。随后可蒸发这种浓缩液并将其转换成适合于贮存或处置的形式；（c）在将纯硝酸钚溶液转到下几个工艺步骤前先将其浓缩并贮存。尤其是，
text.en: Holding or storage vessels specially designed or manufactured for irradiated fuel reprocessing plants. These holding or storage vessels must be resistant to the corrosive effects of nitric acid. Holding or storage vessels are normally made of low-carbon stainless steel, titanium, zirconium or other high-quality materials. Holding or storage vessels may be designed for remote operation and maintenance and may have the following criticality-control features: (1) at least 2% boron equivalent in their walls or internal structures; (2) a maximum diameter of 175 mm for cylindrical vessels; or (3) a maximum width of 75 mm for slab or annular vessels. Explanatory Note: Three main process streams result from the solvent-extraction stage. All three streams use holding or storage vessels during further processing as follows: (a) Pure uranyl nitrate solution is concentrated by evaporation and then passed to a denitration process, where it is converted into uranium oxide. This oxide is reused in the nuclear fuel cycle; (b) Highly radioactive fission-product solution is generally concentrated by evaporation and stored as concentrate. The concentrate may subsequently be evaporated and converted into a form suitable for storage or disposal; (c) Pure plutonium nitrate solution is concentrated and stored before transfer to subsequent process steps. In particular,

text.zh: 钚溶液的保存或贮存容器要设计得能避免由于这种液流浓度和形状的改变导致的临界问题。
text.en: holding or storage vessels for plutonium solutions must be designed to avoid criticality problems arising from changes in the concentration and geometry of the stream.

title.en: Neutron measurement systems for process control

summary.en: Neutron measurement systems for process control

text.zh: 流程控制用中子测量系统
text.en: Neutron measurement systems for process control

text.zh:
专门设计或制造与辐照燃料元件后处理厂的自动化流程控制系统相结合和共同使用的中子测量系统。
注释：这些系统涉及能动和非能动中子测量和鉴别能力，目的是确定特种可裂变材料的数量和成分。整套系统由中子发生器、中子探头、放大器和信号处理电子元件组成。本条款的范围不包括为核材料衡算和保障或与辐照燃料元件后处理厂自动化流程控制系统的结合和共同使用无关的任何其他应用设计的中子探测和测量仪器。
text.en: Neutron measurement systems specially designed or manufactured for integration and use with automated process-control systems in plants for reprocessing irradiated fuel elements. Explanatory Note: These systems involve active and passive neutron measurement and discrimination capabilities to determine the quantity and composition of special fissionable material. A complete system consists of neutron generators, neutron detectors, amplifiers and signal-processing electronics. This provision does not cover neutron detection and measurement instruments designed for nuclear-material accounting and safeguards, or for any other application unrelated to integration and use with automated process-control systems in irradiated-fuel-element reprocessing plants.

text.zh: 用于制造核反应堆燃料元件的工厂和为其专门设计或制造的设备
text.en: Plants for manufacturing nuclear reactor fuel elements and equipment specially designed or manufactured therefor

text.zh:
核燃料元件是由核出口管制清单第一部分核材料所述的一种或多种源材料或特种可裂变材料制造的。对于氧化物燃料这一种最常用的燃料类型，常用芯块压制、烧结、研磨和分级的设备。直到密封于包壳内，混合氧化物燃料是在手套箱内操作的（或等效的箱体）。在所有情况下，燃料被密封于一个合适的包壳内，这种包壳是设计作为包装燃料的主要包壳，以便在反应堆运行时提供适当的性能和安全。此外，在所有情况下，为保证可预计的和安全的燃料性能，必须按照最高标准精确控制流程、程序和设备。
注释：属于燃料元件制造的和“专门设计或制造的设备”的设备物项包括：（a）通常直接接触或加工或控制核材料生产流程的设备；（b）将核材料封入包壳的设备；（c）检验包壳或密封完整性的设备；（d）检验密封燃料的最终处理的设备；（e）用于装配核燃料元件的设备。这一设备或这些设备系统可能包括：
（1）专门设计或制造用于检验燃料芯块的最终尺寸和表面缺陷的全自动芯块检查台；
text.en: Nuclear fuel elements are manufactured from one or more source materials or special fissionable materials described in Part I, Nuclear Materials, of the Nuclear Export Control List. For oxide fuel, the most common fuel type, equipment for pellet pressing, sintering, grinding and grading is commonly used. Mixed-oxide fuel is handled in glove boxes, or equivalent enclosures, until sealed in its cladding. In all cases, the fuel is sealed in suitable cladding designed as its primary containment to provide appropriate performance and safety during reactor operation. In all cases, processes, procedures, and equipment must also be precisely controlled to the highest standards to ensure predictable and safe fuel performance. Explanatory Note: Equipment items for fuel-element fabrication that are “specially designed or prepared equipment” include: (a) equipment that normally directly contacts or processes nuclear material or controls its production flow; (b) equipment that seals nuclear material inside cladding; (c) equipment that checks cladding or seal integrity; (d) equipment that checks the final treatment of sealed fuel; (e) equipment for assembling nuclear fuel elements. This equipment or these equipment systems may include: (1) Fully automatic pellet inspection stations specially designed or prepared to check final fuel-pellet dimensions and surface defects;

text.zh:
（2）专门设计或制造用于将端塞焊接于燃料细棒（或棒）的自动焊接机；
（3）专门设计或制造用于检验燃料细棒（或棒）成品密封性的自动化测试和检查台；
（4）专门设计或制造用于制造核燃料包壳的系统。第（3）项，代表性设备包括且用于：（a）细棒（或棒）端塞焊缝 X 射线检测；（b）充压细棒（或棒）的氦检漏；（c）细棒（或棒）的γ射线扫描以检验内部燃料芯块的正确装载。
text.en: (2) Automatic welding machines specially designed or prepared to weld end caps onto fuel pins (or rods); (3) Automatic testing and inspection stations specially designed or prepared to check the seal integrity of finished fuel pins (or rods); (4) Systems specially designed or prepared to manufacture nuclear fuel cladding. For item (3), representative equipment includes equipment for: (a) X-ray examination of pin (or rod) end-cap welds; (b) Helium leak testing of pressurized pins or rods; (c) Gamma-ray scanning of pins (or rods) to verify correct loading of the internal fuel pellets.

title.zh: 气体离心机
title.en: Gas centrifuges

summary.zh: 气体离心机
summary.en: Gas centrifuges

text.zh: 气体离心机
text.en: Gas centrifuges

text.zh: 气体离心机通常由直径在75mm 和650mm 之间的薄壁圆筒组成。圆筒处在真空环境中并且以大约300m/s 或更高的线速度旋转，旋转时其中轴线保持垂直。为了达到高的转速,旋转构件的结构材料必须具有高的强度/密度比，而转筒组件及其单个构件必须按高精度公差来制造以便使不平衡减到最小。与其他离心机不同，浓缩铀用的气体离心机的特点是：在转筒室中有一个（或几个）盘状挡板和一个固定的管列用来供应和提取UF₆ 气体，其特点是至少有三个单独的通道，其中两个与从转筒轴向转筒室周边伸出的收集器相连。在真空环境中还有一些不转动的关键物项，它们虽然是专门设计的，但不难制造，也不是用独特材料制造的。不过，一个离心机设施需要大量的这种构件，因此其数量是能够反映最终用途的一个重要指标。
text.en: Gas centrifuges normally consist of thin-walled cylinders with diameters between 75 mm and 650 mm. The cylinder operates in a vacuum and rotates at a peripheral speed of approximately 300 m/s or higher, with its central axis kept vertical during rotation. To attain high rotational speeds, the structural materials of the rotating components must have high strength-to-density ratios, and the rotor assembly and its individual components must be manufactured to close tolerances to minimize imbalance. Unlike other centrifuges, gas centrifuges for uranium enrichment feature one or more disc-shaped baffles within the rotor chamber and a stationary tube assembly for feeding and withdrawing UF₆ gas, characterized by at least three separate channels, two of which connect to scoops extending from the rotor axis toward the chamber’s periphery. Other critical stationary items are located in the vacuum environment; although specially designed, they are neither difficult to manufacture nor made of unique materials. However, a centrifuge facility requires large quantities of these components, so quantity is an important indicator of end use.

Complete assemblies may nevertheless be delivered only partially assembled.

title.zh: 磁悬浮轴承
title.en: Magnetic suspension bearings

summary.zh: 磁悬浮轴承
summary.en: Magnetic suspension bearings

text.zh: 磁悬浮轴承
text.en: Magnetic suspension bearings

text.zh:
专门设计或制造的轴承组合件，由悬浮在充满阻尼介质箱中的一个环形磁铁组成。该箱要用耐UF₆ 的材料（见本节注释）制造。该磁铁与装在42 项所述顶盖上的一个磁极片或另一个磁铁耦合。此磁铁可以是环形的，外径与内径的比小于或等于1.6:1。它的初始磁导率可以是
0.15H/m（120000CGS 制单位）或更高，或剩磁98.5%或更高，或产生的能量高于80kJ/m³（107 高斯-奥斯特）。除了具有通常的材料性质外，先决条件是磁轴对几何轴的偏离应限制在很小的公差范围内（低于0.1mm 或
0.004in）或特别要求磁铁材料有均匀性。
text.en: Specially designed or manufactured bearing assemblies consisting of an annular magnet suspended within a housing containing a damping medium. The housing is made of UF₆-resistant materials; see the explanatory notes to this section. The magnet couples with a pole piece or another magnet fitted to the top cap described in item 42. The magnet may be annular, with an outside-to-inside diameter ratio of 1.6:1 or less. Its initial magnetic permeability may be 0.15 H/m (120000 CGS units) or greater, remanence 98.5% or greater, or energy product greater than 80 kJ/m³ (107 gauss-oersteds [source notation]). In addition to the usual material properties, a prerequisite is that the deviation of the magnetic axis from the geometric axis be held within very small tolerances, below 0.1 mm or 0.004 in, or that the magnet material have particularly high homogeneity.

title.en: Active magnetic bearings

summary.zh: 主动磁轴承
summary.en: Active magnetic bearings

text.zh: 主动磁轴承
text.en: Active magnetic bearings

text.zh:
专门设计或制造供气体离心机使用的主动磁轴承。
注释：这些轴承通常具有下述特点：
1.是为使以 600Hz 或更高速度旋转的转子保持居中而设计的；
2.与可靠的电源和（或）不间断电源单元相连，以便运行 1 小时以上。
text.en: Active magnetic bearings specially designed or manufactured for use in gas centrifuges. Explanatory Note: These bearings generally have the following characteristics: 1. Designed to maintain the centering of rotors spinning at 600 Hz or greater; 2. Connected to a reliable power supply and/or an uninterruptible power supply unit for operation for 1 hour or more.

text.en: Bearings/dampers

text.zh: 专门设计或制造的安装在阻尼器上的具有枢轴/盖的轴承。枢轴通常是一种淬硬钢轴，一端精加工成半球，而另一端能连在 42 项所述底盖上。但是这种轴可附有一个动压轴承。盖是球形的，一面有一个半球形陷穴。这些构件通常是单独为阻尼器提供的。
text.en: Specially designed or manufactured bearings comprising a pivot/cup assembly mounted on a damper. The pivot is normally a hardened steel shaft with one end machined into a hemisphere and the other end capable of attachment to the bottom cap described in item 42. The shaft may, however, have a hydrodynamic bearing attached. The cup is spherical with a hemispherical indentation on one surface. These components are often supplied separately from the damper.

summary.en: Motor stators

text.zh: 电动机定子
text.en: Motor stators

text.zh: 专门设计或制造的环形定子，用于在真空中频率范围为600Hz 或更高、功率范围为 40VA 或更高条件下同步运行的高速多相交流磁滞（或磁阻）式电动机。定子由在典型厚度为 2.0mm 或更薄一些的薄层组成的低损耗叠片铁芯上的多相绕组组成。
text.en: Specially designed or manufactured annular stators for high-speed multiphase AC hysteresis or reluctance motors operating synchronously in a vacuum at frequencies of 600 Hz or greater and at power levels of 40 VA or greater. The stators consist of multiphase windings on a low-loss laminated iron core made of thin layers typically 2.0 mm or less in thickness.

title.en: Centrifuge housings/recipients

summary.zh: 离心机壳/收集器
summary.en: Centrifuge housings/recipients

text.zh: 离心机壳/收集器
text.en: Centrifuge housings/recipients

text.zh: 专门设计或制造用来容纳气体离心机的转筒组件的部件。离心机壳由一个壁厚达 30mm（1.2in）的刚性圆筒组成，它带有经过精密机械加工的两个端面以便固定轴承和一个或多个便于安装的法兰盘。这两个经过机械加工的端面相互平行，并以不大于 0.05 度的误差与圆筒纵轴垂直。离心机壳也可是一种格状结构以容纳几个转筒。
text.en: Components specially designed or manufactured to contain gas-centrifuge rotor assemblies. The centrifuge housing consists of a rigid cylinder with walls up to 30 mm (1.2 in) thick, precision-machined ends for mounting the bearings, and one or more flanges for installation. The two machined ends are parallel to each other and perpendicular to the cylinder's longitudinal axis within 0.05 degrees. Centrifuge housings may also be a cellular structure containing several rotor tubes.

summary.en: Feed systems/product and tails withdrawal systems

text.en: Feed systems/product and tails withdrawal systems

text.zh: 专门设计或制造的工艺系统或设备，由耐UF₆ 腐蚀的材料制造或用这种材料进行保护，包括：供料釜（或供料器）、加热炉或系统，用于将UF₆ 送往离心机级联；凝华器（或冷阱）或泵，用于从级联中取出UF₆，以便随后加热转送；固化站或液化站，用来通过压缩UF₆和将其转化成液态或固态，使UF₆离开浓缩工艺线；“产品”和“尾料”器，用来把UF₆ 收集到容器中。
text.en: Specially designed or manufactured process systems or equipment made of or protected by materials resistant to UF₆ corrosion, including: feed autoclaves or feeders, ovens or systems for introducing UF₆ into centrifuge cascades; Desublimers or cold traps, or pumps, for withdrawing UF₆ from cascades for subsequent transfer upon heating; Solidification or liquefaction stations for removing UF₆ from the enrichment process line by compressing it and converting it to liquid or solid form; “Product” and “tails” stations for collecting UF₆ in containers.

summary.zh: 机械集管管路系统

text.zh: 机械集管管路系统
text.en: Machine header piping systems

text.zh: 专门设计或制造用于在离心机级联中操作UF₆ 的管路系统和集管系统。管路网络通常是“三头”集管系统，每个离心机连接一个集管头。这样，在形式上有大量重复。全都用耐UF₆的材料（见本节注释）制成或用这种材料进行保护，并且按很高的真空和净度标准制造。
text.en: Piping and header systems specially designed or manufactured for handling UF₆ within centrifuge cascades. The piping network is normally a triple-header system, with each centrifuge connected to the headers. Its configuration therefore involves substantial repetition. All are made of or protected by UF₆-resistant materials, as described in the explanatory notes to this section, and manufactured to very high vacuum and cleanliness standards.

text.zh: 特种截流阀和控制阀
text.en: Special shut-off and control valves

text.zh:
(a) 专门设计或制造的作用于单台气体离心机中的供料、产品或尾料UF₆气流的截流阀。(b) 专门设计或制造用于气体离心浓缩厂主系统或辅助系统的手动或自动波纹管密封阀、截流阀或控制阀，用耐UF₆ 腐蚀的材料制成或用这种材料进行保护，内径10-160mm。
注释：专门设计或制造的阀，典型的包括波纹管密封阀、速动封闭阀、速动阀和其他阀。
text.en: (a) Shut-off valves specially designed or manufactured to act on feed, product or tails UF₆ gas streams in individual gas centrifuges. (b) Manually or automatically operated bellows-sealed shut-off or control valves, specially designed or manufactured for main or auxiliary systems in gas-centrifuge enrichment plants, made of or protected by materials resistant to UF₆ corrosion, with inside diameters of 10–160 mm. Explanatory Note: Specially designed or prepared valves typically include bellows-sealed valves, fast-closing shutoff valves, fast-acting valves, and other valves.

title.zh: UF₆ 质谱仪/离子源
title.en: UF₆ mass spectrometers/ion sources

summary.zh: UF₆ 质谱仪/离子源
summary.en: UF₆ mass spectrometers/ion sources

text.zh: UF₆ 质谱仪/离子源
text.en: UF₆ mass spectrometers/ion sources

text.zh:
专门设计或制造的质谱仪，这些质谱仪能从UF₆ 气流中“在线”取得样品，并且具有以下所有特点：
1.能够测量320 或更大原子质量单位的离子，且单位分辨率高于320；
2.离子源用镍、含镍60%或以上（按重量计）的镍铜合金或镍铬合金制成或保护；
3.电子轰击离子源；
4.有一个适合于同位素分析的收集系统。
text.en: Specially designed or prepared mass spectrometers capable of taking “on-line” samples from UF₆ gas streams and having all of the following characteristics: 1. Capable of measuring ions of 320 atomic mass units or greater, with unit resolution better than 320; 2. Ion sources made of or protected by nickel, nickel-copper alloys containing 60% or more nickel by weight, or nickel-chromium alloys; 3. Electron-bombardment ion sources; 4. A collector system suitable for isotopic analysis.

text.zh:
为满足 52 项定义的电动机定子的需要而专门设计或制造的频率变换器（又称变频器或变换器）或这类频率变换器的部件、构件和子配件。它们具有下述所有特点：

text.en: Frequency changers, also known as converters or inverters, specially designed or manufactured to meet the requirements of the motor stators defined in item 52, or parts, components and subassemblies of such frequency changers. They have all of the following characteristics: 1. Multiphase output at 600 Hz or greater; 2. High stability, with frequency control better than 0.2%.

title.zh: 气体扩散膜和扩散膜材料
title.en: Gaseous diffusion barriers and barrier materials

summary.zh: 气体扩散膜和扩散膜材料
summary.en: Gaseous diffusion barriers and barrier materials

text.zh: 气体扩散膜和扩散膜材料
text.en: Gaseous diffusion barriers and barrier materials

text.zh: (a)专门设计或制造的由耐UF₆腐蚀的金属、聚合物或陶瓷材料制成的很薄的多孔过滤膜，孔的大小为100-1000Å,膜厚5mm（或以下），对于管状膜来说，直径为25mm（或以下）；和(b)为制造这种过滤膜而专门制备的化合物或粉末。这类化合物和粉末包括镍或含镍60%（或以上）的合金、氧化铝或纯度99.9%（或以上）的耐UF₆ 的完全氟化的烃聚合物，粒度小于10µm。粒度高度均匀。这些都是专门为制造气体扩散膜制备的。
text.en: (a) Specially designed or manufactured thin, porous filters made of metallic, polymeric or ceramic materials resistant to UF₆ corrosion, with pore sizes of 100–1000 Å, a thickness of 5 mm or less and, for tubular forms, a diameter of 25 mm or less; and (b) Compounds or powders specially prepared for manufacturing such filters. These compounds and powders include nickel, alloys containing 60% or more nickel, aluminum oxide, or fully fluorinated hydrocarbon polymers resistant to UF₆, with a purity of 99.9% or greater and particle sizes below 10 µm. The particle sizes are highly uniform. These are specially prepared for manufacturing gaseous-diffusion barriers.

summary.en: UF₆ mass spectrometers/ion sources

text.zh: UF₆ 质谱仪/离子源
text.en: UF₆ mass spectrometers/ion sources

text.zh:
专门设计或制造的质谱仪，这些质谱仪能从UF₆ 气流中“在线”取得样品，并且具有以下所有特点：
1.能够测量320 或更大原子质量单位的离子，且单位分辨率高于320；
2.离子源用镍、含镍60%以上（按重量计）的镍铜合金或镍铬合金制成或保护；
3.电子轰击离子源；
4.有一个适合于同位素分析的收集系统。
text.en: Specially designed or prepared mass spectrometers capable of taking “on-line” samples from UF₆ gas streams and having all of the following characteristics: 1. Capable of measuring ions of 320 atomic mass units or greater, with unit resolution better than 320; 2. Ion sources made of or protected by nickel, nickel-copper alloys containing 60% or more nickel by weight, or nickel-chromium alloys; 3. Electron-bombardment ion sources; 4. A collector system suitable for isotopic analysis.

text.en: Vortex tubes

text.zh:
专门设计或制造的涡流管及其组件。涡流管呈圆筒形或锥形，用耐UF₆ 腐蚀材料制成或加以保护，并带有1 个或多个切向进口。这些涡流管的一端或两端装有喷嘴型附件。
注释：供料气体在涡流管的一端切向进入涡流管，或通过一些旋流叶片，或从沿涡流管周边分布的若干个切向位置进入涡流管。
text.en: Specially designed or manufactured vortex tubes and assemblies thereof. Vortex tubes are cylindrical or tapered, made of or protected by materials resistant to UF₆ corrosion, and have one or more tangential inlets. These vortex tubes have nozzle-type attachments at one or both ends. Explanatory Note: Feed gas enters the vortex tube tangentially at one end, through swirl vanes, or at several tangential positions distributed around its circumference.

title.zh: UF₆ 质谱仪／离子源
title.en: UF₆ mass spectrometers/ion sources

summary.zh: UF₆ 质谱仪／离子源
summary.en: UF₆ mass spectrometers/ion sources

text.zh: UF₆ 质谱仪／离子源
text.en: UF₆ mass spectrometers/ion sources

text.zh:
专门设计或制造的质谱仪，这些质谱仪能从UF₆ 气流中“在线”取得样品，并且具有所有以下特点：
1．能够测量320 或更大原子质量单位的离子，且单位分辨率高于320；
2.用镍、含镍60%或以上（按重量计）的镍铜合金或镍铬合金制成或保护；
3.电子轰击离子源；
4.适合于同位素分析的收集器系统。
text.en: Specially designed or prepared mass spectrometers capable of taking “on-line” samples from UF₆ gas streams and having all of the following characteristics: 1. Capable of measuring ions of 320 atomic mass units or greater, with unit resolution better than 320; 2. Made of or protected by nickel, nickel-copper alloys containing 60% or more nickel by weight, or nickel-chromium alloys; 3. Electron-bombardment ion sources; 4. A collector system suitable for isotopic analysis.

text.zh: UF₆/载气分离系统
text.en: UF₆/carrier-gas separation systems

text.zh: 这些系统是为将载气中的UF₆ 含量降至1ppm 或更低而设计的，并可装有下述的设备：（a）低温热交换器和低温分离器,能承受-120℃或更低的温度，或（b）低温制冷设备，能承受-120℃或更低的温度，或（c）用于将UF₆ 与载气分离开来的分离喷嘴或涡流管设备，或（d）能冻结分离出UF₆ 的冷阱。
text.en: These systems are designed to reduce the UF₆ content in the carrier gas to 1 ppm or less and may incorporate: (a) Cryogenic heat exchangers and cryogenic separators capable of withstanding temperatures of −120 °C or lower; or (b) cryogenic refrigeration equipment capable of withstanding temperatures of −120 °C or lower; or (c) separation-nozzle or vortex-tube equipment for separating UF₆ from the carrier gas; or (d) cold traps capable of freezing out UF₆.

text.zh: 为使用化学交换过程的铀浓缩工厂专门设计或制造的有机械动力输入的逆流液-液交换柱。为了耐浓盐酸溶液的腐蚀，这些交换柱及其内部构件一般用适宜的塑料（例如氟碳聚合物）或玻璃制作或保护。交换柱的级停留时间一般被设计得很短（30 秒或更短）。
text.en: Countercurrent liquid-liquid exchange columns with mechanical power input, specially designed or manufactured for uranium enrichment plants using the chemical exchange process. To resist corrosion by concentrated hydrochloric acid solutions, these columns and their internals are generally made of or protected by suitable plastics, such as fluorocarbon polymers, or glass. The stage residence time of the columns is generally designed to be short, at 30 seconds or less.

text.zh: 为使用化学交换过程的铀浓缩工厂而专门设计或制造的液－液离心接触器。此类接触器利用转动来达到有机相与水相的分散，然后借助离心力来分离开这两相。为了耐浓盐酸溶液的腐蚀，这些接触器一般用适当的塑料（例如碳氟聚合物）或玻璃来制造或保护。离心接触器的级停留时间被设计得很短（30 秒或更短）。
text.en: Liquid-liquid centrifugal contactors specially designed or manufactured for uranium enrichment plants using the chemical exchange process. These contactors use rotation to disperse the organic and aqueous phases and then use centrifugal force to separate them. To resist corrosion by concentrated hydrochloric acid solutions, these contactors are generally made of or protected by suitable plastics, such as fluorocarbon polymers, or glass. The stage residence time of the centrifugal contactors is designed to be short, at 30 seconds or less.

text.zh: 电化学还原槽
text.en: Electrochemical reduction cells

text.zh: 该设备是为使用化学交换过程的铀浓缩工厂专门设计或制造的，用来将铀从一种价态还原为另一种价态的。与过程溶液接触的这种槽的材料必须能耐浓盐酸溶液腐蚀。这种槽的阴极室必须设计成能防止铀被再氧化到较高的价态。为了把铀保持在阴极室中，这种槽可有一个由特种阳离子交换材料制成的抗渗的隔膜。阴极一般由石墨之类适宜的固态导体组成。
text.en: This equipment is specially designed or manufactured for uranium enrichment plants using the chemical exchange process, to reduce uranium from one valence state to another. Cell materials in contact with process solutions must resist corrosion by concentrated hydrochloric acid solutions. The cathode compartment must be designed to prevent uranium from being reoxidized to a higher valence state. To retain uranium in the cathode compartment, the cell may have an impervious diaphragm made of special cation-exchange material. The cathode generally consists of a suitable solid conductor such as graphite.

text.zh: 装在级联的产品端为将有机相流中的 U⁺⁴ 移出、调节酸浓度和向电化学还原槽供料而专门设计或制造的系统
text.en: Systems installed at the product end of the cascade and specially designed or manufactured to remove U⁺⁴ from the organic stream, adjust acid concentration and feed the electrochemical reduction cells

text.zh: 这些系统由以下设备组成：将有机相流中的 U⁺⁴ 反萃取到水溶液中的溶剂萃取设备，完成溶液 pH 值调节和控制的蒸发设备和（或）其他设备，以及向电化学还原槽供料的泵或其他输送装置。一个重要的设计问题是要避免水相流被某些种类的金属离子沾污。因此，对该系统那些接触这种过程物流的部分，要用适当的材料（例如玻璃、碳氟聚合物、聚苯硫酸酯、聚醚砜和用树脂浸过的石墨）制成或保护的设备来构成。
text.en: These systems consist of solvent extraction equipment for stripping U⁺⁴ from the organic stream into an aqueous solution, evaporation and/or other equipment for adjusting and controlling solution pH, and pumps or other transfer devices for feeding the electrochemical reduction cells. An important design consideration is avoiding contamination of the aqueous stream by certain types of metal ions. Therefore, the parts of the system in contact with these process streams must comprise equipment made of or protected by suitable materials, such as glass, fluorocarbon polymers, polyphenylene sulfate [source wording; likely polyphenylene sulfide], polyether sulfone, or resin-impregnated graphite.

text.zh: 专门设计或制造的用来为化学交换铀同位素分离工厂生产高纯氯化铀供料溶液的系统。这些系统由进行纯化所需的溶解设备、溶剂萃取设备和（或）离子交换设备，以及用来将 U⁺⁶ 或 U⁺⁴ 还原为 U⁺³ 的电解槽组成。这些系统产生只含几个 ppm的铬、铁、钒、钼和其他两价或价态更高的阳离子金属杂质的氯化铀溶液。处理高纯度 U⁺³ 系统的若干部分的建造材料包括玻璃、碳氟聚合物、聚苯硫酸酯或聚醚砜塑料衬里的石墨和用树脂浸过的石墨。
text.en: Systems specially designed or manufactured to produce high-purity uranium chloride feed solutions for chemical-exchange uranium isotope separation plants. These systems consist of dissolution, solvent extraction and/or ion-exchange equipment for purification, and electrolytic cells for reducing U⁺⁶ or U⁺⁴ to U⁺³. These systems produce uranium chloride solutions containing only a few ppm of chromium, iron, vanadium, molybdenum and other metallic impurities that form divalent or higher-valence cations. Construction materials for certain parts of high-purity U⁺³ handling systems include glass, fluorocarbon polymers, graphite lined with polyphenylene sulfate [source wording; likely polyphenylene sulfide] or polyether sulfone plastic, and resin-impregnated graphite.

text.zh: 专门设计或制造用于将 U⁺³ 氧化为 U⁺⁴以便返回化学交换浓缩过程的铀同位素分离级联的系统。这些系统可装有如下设备：（a）使氯气和氧气与来自同位素分离设备的水相流相接触的设备以及将所得U⁺⁴ 萃入由级联的产品端返回的已被反萃取过的有机相的设备；（b）使水与盐酸分离开来，以便水和加浓了的盐酸可在适当位置被重新引入工艺过程的设备。
text.en: Systems specially designed or manufactured to oxidize U⁺³ to U⁺⁴ for return to the uranium isotope separation cascade in the chemical-exchange enrichment process. These systems may incorporate: (a) Equipment for contacting chlorine and oxygen with the aqueous stream from isotope separation equipment, and for extracting the resulting U⁺⁴ into the stripped organic phase returning from the product end of the cascade; (b) Equipment for separating water from hydrochloric acid so that water and concentrated hydrochloric acid can be reintroduced at appropriate points in the process.

summary.zh: 快速反应离子交换树脂/吸附剂（离子交换）

text.en: Fast-reacting ion-exchange resins/adsorbents (ion exchange)

text.zh: 为以离子交换过程进行铀浓缩而专门设计或制造的快速反应离子交换树脂或吸附剂包括：多孔大网络树脂，和（或）薄膜结构（在这些结构中，活性化学交换基团仅限于非活性多孔支持结构表面的一个涂层），以及处于包括颗粒或纤维在内的任何适宜形式的其他复合结构。这些离子交换树脂/吸附剂的直径有 0.2mm 或更小，而且在化学性质上必须能耐浓盐酸溶液腐蚀，在物理性质上必须有足够的强度因而在交换柱中不被降解。这些树脂/吸附剂是专门为实现很快的铀同位素交换动力学过程（低于 10 秒的交换速率减半期）而设计的，并且能在 100-200℃的温度范围内操作。
text.en: Fast-reacting ion-exchange resins or adsorbents specially designed or manufactured for uranium enrichment by the ion-exchange process, including porous macroreticular resins and/or thin-film structures in which the active chemical exchange groups are limited to a coating on the surface of an inactive porous support structure, and other composite structures in any suitable form, including particles or fibers. These ion-exchange resins/adsorbents have diameters of 0.2 mm or less, must chemically resist concentrated hydrochloric acid, and must have sufficient physical strength to avoid degradation in the exchange columns. These resins/adsorbents are specially designed to achieve very rapid uranium-isotope exchange kinetics (an exchange-rate half-time below 10 seconds) and to operate at temperatures of 100–200 °C.

text.zh: （a）专门设计和制造的用于使离子交换铀浓缩级联中所用化学还原剂再生的化学或电化学还原系统。（b）专门设计或制造的用于使离子交换铀浓缩级联中所用化学氧化剂再生的化学或电化学氧化系统。离子交换浓缩过程可使用例如 Ti⁺³ 作为还原阳离子，在这种情况下，所用还原系统将通过还原 Ti⁺⁴ 使 Ti⁺³ 再生。离子交换浓缩过程可使用例如 Fe⁺³ 作为氧化剂，在这种情况下，所用氧化系统将通过氧化 Fe⁺² 来使 Fe⁺³ 再生。
text.en: (a) Chemical or electrochemical reduction systems specially designed and manufactured to regenerate the chemical reducing agents used in ion-exchange uranium enrichment cascades. (b) Chemical or electrochemical oxidation systems specially designed or manufactured to regenerate the chemical oxidizing agents used in ion-exchange uranium enrichment cascades. An ion-exchange enrichment process may use, for example, Ti⁺³ as the reducing cation; in that case, the reduction system regenerates Ti⁺³ by reducing Ti⁺⁴. An ion-exchange enrichment process may use, for example, Fe⁺³ as the oxidizing agent; in that case, the oxidation system regenerates Fe⁺³ by oxidizing Fe⁺².

text.zh: 液态或蒸气铀金属处理系统（AVLIS）和部件
text.en: Liquid or vapor uranium metal handling systems (AVLIS) and components

text.zh:
专门设计或制造用于激光浓缩的熔融铀、熔融铀合金或铀金属蒸气处理系统，或为这些系统专门设计或制造的部件。
注释：液态金属铀处理系统可包括坩埚及其冷却设备。这种系统的坩埚和其他接触熔融铀、熔融铀合金或铀金属蒸气的部分，要用有适当的耐腐蚀和耐高温性能的材料制成或保护。适当的材料包括钽、氧化钇涂敷石墨、用其他稀土氧化物或其混合物涂敷的石墨。
text.en: Systems specially designed or manufactured for handling molten uranium, molten uranium alloys or uranium metal vapor in laser enrichment, or components specially designed or manufactured for those systems. Explanatory Note: Liquid uranium metal handling systems may include crucibles and cooling equipment therefor. Crucibles and other parts of these systems in contact with molten uranium, molten uranium alloys or uranium metal vapor are made of or protected by materials with suitable corrosion resistance and high-temperature resistance. Suitable materials include tantalum, yttria-coated graphite, and graphite coated with other rare-earth oxides or mixtures thereof.

text.zh: 专门设计或制造用于收集液态或固态铀金属的“产品”和“尾料”收集器组件。这些组件的部件由耐铀金属蒸气或液体的高温和腐蚀性的材料（例如氧化钇涂敷石墨或钽）制成或保护。这类部件可包括用于磁、静电或其他分离方法的管、阀、管接头、“出料槽”、进料管、热交换器和收集板。
text.en: "Product" and "tails" collector assemblies specially designed or manufactured for collecting liquid or solid uranium metal. Components of these assemblies are made of or protected by materials resistant to the high temperatures and corrosion caused by uranium metal vapor or liquid, such as yttria-coated graphite or tantalum. These components may include pipes, valves, fittings, gutters, feedthroughs, heat exchangers and collector plates for magnetic, electrostatic or other separation methods.

text.zh: 氟化系统（MLIS）
text.en: Fluorination systems (MLIS)

text.zh: 专门设计或制造的用于将UF₅（固体）氟化为UF₆（气体）的系统。这些系统是为将所收集的UF₅粉末氟化为UF₆而设计的。其UF₆随后将被收集于产品容器中，或作为进料被转送到为进行进一步浓缩而设置的MLIS 单元中。在一种方案中，这种氟化反应可在同位素分离系统内部完成，以便一离开“产品”收集器便反应和回收。在另一种方案中，UF₅粉末将被从“产品”收集器中移出/转送到一个适当的反应容器（例如流化床反应器、螺旋反应器或火焰塔式反应器）中进行氟化。在这两种方案中，都使用氟气（或其他适宜的氟化剂）贮存和转送设备，以及UF₆收集和转送设备。
text.en: Systems specially designed or manufactured for fluorinating UF₅ (solid) to UF₆ (gas). These systems are designed to fluorinate collected UF₅ powder to UF₆. The UF₆ is subsequently collected in product containers or transferred as feed to MLIS units for further enrichment. In one approach, this fluorination reaction may occur within the isotope-separation system, allowing reaction and recovery immediately after leaving the “product” collectors. In another approach, UF₅ powder is removed/transferred from the “product” collectors to a suitable reaction vessel, such as a fluidized-bed, screw, or flame-tower reactor, for fluorination. Both approaches use equipment for storing and transferring fluorine gas or other suitable fluorinating agents, and equipment for collecting and transferring UF₆.

text.zh: UF₆ 质谱仪/离子源（MLIS）
text.en: UF₆ mass spectrometers/ion sources (MLIS)

text.zh:
专门设计或制造的质谱仪，这些质谱仪能从UF₆ 气流中“在线”取得样品，并且具有以下所有特点：
1.能够测量320 或更大原子质量单位的离子，且单位分辨率高于320；
2.离子源镍、含镍60%或以上（按重量计）的镍铜合金或镍铬合金制成或保护；
3.电子轰击离子源；
4.有一个适合于同位素分析的收集器系统。
text.en: Specially designed or prepared mass spectrometers capable of taking “on-line” samples from UF₆ gas streams and having all of the following characteristics: 1. Capable of measuring ions of 320 atomic mass units or greater, with unit resolution better than 320; 2. Ion sources made of or protected by nickel, nickel-copper alloys containing 60% or more nickel by weight, or nickel-chromium alloys; 3. Electron-bombardment ion sources; 4. A collector system suitable for isotopic analysis.

text.zh: 为浓缩厂专门设计或制造的工艺系统或设备，用耐UF₆腐蚀的材料制成或保护，包括：（a）进料釜、加热炉或系统，用于将UF₆ 送入浓缩过程；（b）凝华器（或冷阱），用于从浓缩过程中移出UF₆，供下一步加热转移；（c）固化或液化器，用于通过压缩UF₆并将其转换为液态形式或固态形式，浓缩过程中移出UF₆；（d）“产品”器或“尾料”器，用于把UF₆收集到容器中。
text.en: Process systems or equipment specially designed or manufactured for enrichment plants, made of or protected by materials resistant to UF₆ corrosion, including: (a) Feed autoclaves, ovens or systems for introducing UF₆ into the enrichment process; (b) Desublimers or cold traps for removing UF₆ from the enrichment process for subsequent transfer upon heating; (c) Solidifiers or liquefiers for removing UF₆ from the enrichment process by compressing it and converting it to liquid or solid form; (d) “Product” or “tails” stations for collecting UF₆ in containers.

text.zh: UF₆/载气分离系统（MLIS）
text.en: UF₆/carrier-gas separation systems (MLIS)

text.zh:
为将UF₆ 从载气中分离出来专门设计或制造的工艺系统。载气可为氮、氩或其他气体。
注释：这类系统可装有如下设备：（a）低温热交换器或低温分离器，能承受-120℃或更低的温度；或（b）低温冷冻器，能承受-120℃或更低的温度；或（c）能冻结分离出UF₆ 的冷阱。
text.en: Process systems specially designed or manufactured for separating UF₆ from carrier gas. The carrier gas may be nitrogen, argon or another gas. Explanatory Note: These systems may incorporate: (a) Cryogenic heat exchangers or cryogenic separators capable of withstanding temperatures of −120 °C or lower; or (b) Cryogenic refrigerators capable of withstanding temperatures of −120 °C or lower; or (c) Cold traps capable of freezing out UF₆.

text.zh: 激光系统 （ AVLIS ， MLIS 和CRISLA）
text.en: Laser systems (AVLIS, MLIS and CRISLA)

text.zh: 为铀同位素分离专门设计或制造的激光器或激光系统。在以激光为基础的浓缩过程中有重要意义的激光器和激光部件包括《中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单》中所列的那些激光器和激光部件。激光系统一般包含用于管理激光束（一个或多个）和向同位素分离室发射激光束的光学和电子部件。AVLIS 过程使用的激光系统通常由两个激光器组成：一个铜蒸气激光器或某些固体激光器和一个可调染料激光器。MLIS 使用的激光系统通常由一个 CO2 激光器或受激准分子激光器和一个多程光室（两端有旋转镜）组成。这两种过程使用的激光器或激光系统都需要有一个谱频稳定器以便能够长时间地工作。
text.en: Lasers or laser systems specially designed or manufactured for uranium isotope separation. Lasers and laser components important to laser-based enrichment processes include those listed in the Export Control List of Dual-Use Items of the People's Republic of China. Laser systems generally incorporate optical and electronic components for managing one or more laser beams and directing them into the isotope separation chamber. Laser systems used in the AVLIS process generally consist of two lasers: a copper-vapor laser or certain solid-state lasers, and a tunable dye laser. Laser systems used in MLIS generally consist of a CO₂ laser or excimer laser and a multipass optical cell with rotating mirrors at both ends. Lasers or laser systems used in both processes require a spectrum-frequency stabilizer for extended operation.

title.en: Electromagnetic isotope separators and components

summary.zh: 同位素电磁分离器及部件
summary.en: Electromagnetic isotope separators and components

text.zh: 同位素电磁分离器及部件
text.en: Electromagnetic isotope separators and components

text.zh:
为分离铀同位素专门设计或制造的同位素电磁分离器及其设备和部件包括：（a）离子源专门设计或制造的单个或多个铀离子源由蒸气源、电离器和束流加速器组成，用石墨、不锈钢或铜等适当材料制造，能提供总强度为 50mA 或更高的离子束流；（b）离子收集器收集器板极由专门为收集浓缩和贫化铀离子束而设计或制造的两个或多个槽和容器组成，用石墨或不锈钢一类的适当材料制造；（c）真空外壳为铀电磁分离器专门设计或制造的真空外壳，用不锈钢一类适当的非磁性材料制造，设计在 0.1Pa 或以下的压力下运行；
注释：外壳专门设计成装有离子源、收集器板极和水冷却管路，并有用于扩散泵连接结构和可用来移出和重新安装这些部件的开闭结构。（d）磁极块专门设计或制造的磁极块，直径大于2m，用来在同位素电磁分离器内维持恒定磁场并在毗连分离器之间传输磁场。
text.en: Electromagnetic isotope separators and their equipment and components specially designed or manufactured for separating uranium isotopes, including: (a) Ion sources: Specially designed or manufactured single or multiple uranium ion sources comprising a vapor source, ionizer and beam accelerator, made of suitable materials such as graphite, stainless steel or copper, and capable of providing a total ion-beam current of 50 mA or greater; (b) Ion collectors: collector plates comprising two or more slots and containers specially designed or prepared to collect enriched and depleted uranium ion beams, made of suitable materials such as graphite or stainless steel; (c) Vacuum housings: vacuum housings specially designed or prepared for electromagnetic uranium separators, made of suitable nonmagnetic materials such as stainless steel and designed to operate at pressures of 0.1 Pa or below; Explanatory Note: The housings are specially designed to contain ion sources, collector plates and water-cooling lines, and have diffusion-pump connections and opening and closing provisions for removing and reinstalling these components. (d) Magnet pole pieces: specially designed or prepared magnet pole pieces more than 2 m in diameter, used to maintain a constant magnetic field within electromagnetic isotope separators and transfer the magnetic field between adjacent separators.

text.zh: 专门为利用GS 法生产重水而设计或制造的用于循环硫化氢气体（即含H₂S70%以上的气体）的单级、低压头（即0.2 MPa 或30psi）离心式压缩机。这些压缩机的气体通过能力大于或等于56m³/s（120000 SCFM），能在大于或等于1.8MPa（260psi）的吸入压力下运行，并有对湿H₂S 介质的密封设计。
text.en: Single-stage, low-head (0.2 MPa or 30 psi) centrifugal compressors specially designed or manufactured for circulating hydrogen sulfide gas, meaning gas containing 70% or more H₂S, in heavy-water production using the GS process. These compressors have gas-throughput capacities of 56 m³/s (120000 SCFM) or greater, can operate at suction pressures of 1.8 MPa (260 psi) or greater, and have seal designs suitable for wet H₂S service.

text.en: Ammonia-hydrogen exchange towers specially designed or manufactured for producing heavy water using the ammonia-hydrogen exchange process. The towers are 35 m (114.3 ft) or greater in height, 1.5 m (4.9 ft) to 2.5 m (8.2 ft) in diameter, and capable of operating at pressures greater than 15 MPa (2225 psi). Each column has at least one flanged axial opening of the same diameter as the exchange-column shell, through which internal components can be installed or removed.

text.zh: 注释：从铀矿石浓缩物到UO₃ 的转化可通过以下步骤实现：首先，用硝酸溶解铀矿石浓缩物，用磷酸三丁酯之类溶剂萃取纯化的硝酸铀酰；然后，硝酸铀酰通过浓缩和脱硝转化为UO₃，或用气态氨中和产生重铀酸铵，接着通过过滤、干燥和煅烧转化为UO₃。
text.en: Explanatory Note: Conversion of uranium ore concentrates to UO₃ may involve the following steps: first, dissolving the uranium ore concentrates in nitric acid and extracting purified uranyl nitrate with a solvent such as tributyl phosphate; then converting the uranyl nitrate to UO₃ by concentration and denitration, or neutralizing it with gaseous ammonia to produce ammonium diuranate, followed by filtration, drying and calcination to UO₃.

text.en: Systems specially designed or manufactured for converting UF₆ to UO₂

text.zh: 从UF₆ 到UO₂ 的转化，可用三种方法来实现。在第一种方法中，用氢气和水蒸气将UF₆ 还原并水解为UO₂。在第二种方法中，通过溶解在水中而将UF₆ 水解，然后加入氨沉淀出重铀酸铵，接着可在820℃用氢气将重铀酸铵还原为UO₂。在第三种方法中，将气态UF₆、CO₂ 和NH3 通入水中，结果沉淀出碳酸铀酰铵。在500-600℃，碳酸铀酰铵与水蒸气和氢气发生反应，生成UO₂。从UF₆ 到UO₂ 的转化，通常是燃料制造厂的第一个工序。
text.en: Conversion of UF₆ to UO₂ can be accomplished by three methods. In the first method, UF₆ is reduced and hydrolyzed to UO₂ using hydrogen and steam. In the second method, UF₆ is hydrolyzed by dissolution in water, ammonia is then added to precipitate ammonium diuranate, and the ammonium diuranate can subsequently be reduced to UO₂ with hydrogen at 820 °C. In the third method, gaseous UF₆, CO₂, and NH₃ are passed into water, precipitating ammonium uranyl carbonate. At 500–600 °C, ammonium uranyl carbonate reacts with steam and hydrogen to produce UO₂. Conversion from UF₆ to UO₂ is generally the first operation in a fuel-fabrication plant.

summary.zh: 为将UO₂ 转化为UCl₄ 而专门设计或制造的设备

text.en: Equipment specially designed or manufactured for converting UO₂ to UCl₄

text.zh: 从UO₂到UCl₄转化可通过两个流程之一来实现。在第一个流程中，在大约400℃的温度下，UO₂ 与四氯化碳（CCl₄）发生反应。在第二个流程中，在大约700℃的温度下，以及存在碳黑（CAS1333-86-4）、一氧化碳的条件下，UO₂ 与氯发生反应产生UCl₄。
text.en: Conversion of UO₂ to UCl₄ can be accomplished by either of two processes. In the first process, UO₂ reacts with carbon tetrachloride (CCl₄) at approximately 400 °C. In the second process, UO₂ reacts with chlorine at approximately 700 °C in the presence of carbon black (CAS 1333-86-4) and carbon monoxide to produce UCl₄.

summary.zh: 为将硝酸钚转化到氧化钚而专门设计或制造的设备

text.zh: 该流程包括的主要功能为：流程供料贮存和调料、沉淀和固-液分离，煅烧、产品处理、通风、废物管理，以及流程控制。流程系统经过特别的设计，以避免发生临界和辐射效应，以及使得毒性危险最小。在大多数后处理设施中，这一流程包括将硝酸钚转化到氧化钚。其它流程可能包括草酸钚或过氧化钚的沉淀。
text.en: The main functions of this process are process-feed storage and adjustment, precipitation and solid-liquid separation, calcination, product handling, ventilation, waste management and process control. The process systems are specially designed to avoid criticality and radiation effects and to minimize toxic hazards. In most reprocessing facilities, this process involves conversion of plutonium nitrate to plutonium oxide. Other processes may involve precipitation of plutonium oxalate or plutonium peroxide.

title.en: Equipment specially designed or manufactured for producing plutonium metal

text.zh: 为生产钚金属而专门设计或制造的设备
text.en: Equipment specially designed or manufactured for producing plutonium metal

text.zh: 该流程通常包括氧化钚的氟化，通常以高腐蚀性的氢氟酸来生产氟化钚，而后用高纯钙金属还原生成金属钚和氟化钙残渣。该流程所包括的主要功能是氟化（例如，包括采用贵重金属制造的或作为内衬的设备）、金属还原（例如，使用陶瓷坩埚）、残渣回收、产品处理、通风、废物管理和流程控制。流程系统经过特别的设计，以避免发生临界和辐射效应，以及使得毒性危险最小。其它流程包括草酸钚或过氧化钚的氟化，然后还原成金属。
text.en: The process normally involves fluorination of plutonium oxide, usually with highly corrosive hydrofluoric acid, to produce plutonium fluoride, followed by reduction with high-purity calcium metal to produce plutonium metal and a calcium fluoride residue. The main functions of the process are fluorination, for example using equipment made of or lined with precious metals; metal reduction, for example using ceramic crucibles; residue recovery; product handling; ventilation; waste management; and process control. The process systems are specially designed to avoid criticality and radiation effects and to minimize toxic hazards. Other processes involve fluorination of plutonium oxalate or plutonium peroxide, followed by reduction to metal.

title.zh: 编制背景与用途
title.en: Background and purpose

summary.zh: 编制背景与用途
summary.en: Background and purpose

text.zh: 第一部分2020 年12 月1 日，《中华人民共和国出口管制法》正式施行，明确了出口管制领域实行清单管理制度；2024 年12 月1 日，《中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制条例》正式施行，对两用物项出口管制清单的制定、调整程序和要求作出具体规定。为确保《中华人民共和国出口管制法》和《中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制条例》顺利、有效实施，便利出口经营者合规经营，提高出口管制治理效能，商务部会同有关部门借鉴国际经验和做法，系统整合了原《中华人民共和国核两用品及相关技术出口管制条例》《中华人民共和国导弹及相关物项和技术出口管制条例》《中华人民共和国生物两用品及相关设备和技术出口管制条例》《有关化学品及相关设备和技术出口管制办法》和现行《中华人民共和国监控化学品管理条例》等法规、规章所附出口管制清单，以及商务部会同有关部门发布的10 余个两用物项出口管制公告，形成了统一的《中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单》（以下简称清单），
text.en: Part One. The Export Control Law of the People’s Republic of China took effect on December 1, 2020, establishing a list-based export control system; the Regulations of the People’s Republic of China on Export Control of Dual-Use Items took effect on December 1, 2024, specifying the procedures and requirements for establishing and adjusting the dual-use export control list. To ensure the effective implementation of the Export Control Law of the People’s Republic of China and the Regulations of the People’s Republic of China on Export Control of Dual-Use Items, facilitate exporter compliance, and improve the effectiveness of export control administration, the Ministry of Commerce and relevant departments drew on international experience and practices to systematically integrate the export control lists annexed to the former Regulations of the People’s Republic of China on Export Control of Nuclear Dual-Use Items and Related Technologies, Regulations of the People’s Republic of China on Export Control of Missiles and Related Items and Technologies, Regulations of the People’s Republic of China on Export Control of Biological Dual-Use Items and Related Equipment and Technologies, Measures for Export Control of Related Chemicals and Related Equipment and Technologies, and the current Regulations of the People’s Republic of China on the Administration of Scheduled Chemicals, together with more than ten dual-use export control announcements issued by the Ministry of Commerce and relevant departments, into the unified Export Control List of Dual-Use Items of the People’s Republic of China (the “List”),

text.zh: 与《中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制条例》配套实施，作为出口经营者申请相关物项出口许可，以及商务部等部门实施行政许可和监督执法的重要依据。
text.en: which is implemented alongside the Regulations of the People’s Republic of China on Export Control of Dual-Use Items and serves as an important basis for exporters’ license applications and for administrative licensing, oversight, and enforcement by the Ministry of Commerce and other departments.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: 清单结构和编码规则
title.en: List structure and coding rules

summary.zh: 清单结构和编码规则
summary.en: List structure and coding rules

text.zh: 一、清单结构和编码规则本清单包含两部分：第一部分为清单说明，主要阐述清单的制定背景、依据和目的，明确物项编码规则，厘清必要技术说明和管制要求；第二部分为具体物项，将现行已列管的所有两用物项系统整合为10 大类行业领域，每一大类再细分为5 种物项类型，采用“阿拉伯数字+英文字母”的编码方式进行编排，由“1 个阿拉伯数字+1 个大写英文字母+3个阿拉伯数字”共5 个要素组合而成，如1C351、3A201 等。管制编码的具体含义如下：第1 位代表行业领域，用阿拉伯数字0-9 表示：1 代表“专用材料和相关设备、化学制品、微生物和毒素”；2 代表“材料加工”；3 代表“电子”；4 代表“计算机”；5 代表“电信和信息安全”；6 代表“传感器和激光器”；7 代表“导航和航空电子”；8 代表“船舶”；9 代表“航空航天与推进”；0 代表“其他物项”。第2 位代表物项类型，用大写英文字母A-E 表示：A 代表“系统、设备和部件”；B
text.en: I. List structure and coding rules. The List consists of two parts. Part One contains explanatory notes, primarily describing the background, legal basis, and objectives, specifying item-coding rules, and clarifying necessary technical notes and control requirements; Part Two sets out specific items, systematically consolidating all currently listed dual-use items into ten industry categories, each divided into five item types. Entries use an alphanumeric code comprising five characters: one digit, one uppercase English letter, and three digits, such as 1C351 or 3A201. The control codes mean the following. The first character denotes the industry category, using digits 0–9: 1 denotes “Special Materials and Related Equipment, Chemicals, Microorganisms, and Toxins”; 2 denotes “Materials Processing”; 3 denotes “Electronics”; 4 denotes “Computers”; 5 denotes “Telecommunications and Information Security”; 6 denotes “Sensors and Lasers”; 7 denotes “Navigation and Avionics”; 8 denotes “Marine”; 9 denotes “Aerospace and Propulsion”; 0 denotes “Other Items.” The second character denotes the item type, using uppercase letters A–E: A denotes “Systems, Equipment, and Components”; B

text.zh: 代表“测试、检测和生产设备”；C 代表“材料”；D 代表“软件”；E 代表“技术”。第3 位代表管控原因，用阿拉伯数字0-9 表示：0 代表“与常规武器相关”；1 代表“与大规模杀伤性武器运载工具相关”；2 代表“与核不扩散相关”；3 代表“与化学和生物武器相关”；4 代表“监控化学品”；5 代表“临时管制”；9 代表“与其他国家安全因素相关”。当某个管制物项涉及多个管控原因时，除临时管制外，其他情形以最主要的管控原因为准进行编排。第4 位和第5 位共同用于物项排序，用阿拉伯数字0-9表示。具体如下图所示：每个编码对应一个或多个管制物项，涉及多个管制物项或者多个编码层级的，采用小写英文字母和阿拉伯数字轮替使用的方式编制相应层级的编码，如在编码1C111 项下进一步编制1C111.a.1、1C111.b.1.a 等。
text.en: denotes “Test, Inspection, and Production Equipment”; C denotes “Materials”; D denotes “Software”; E denotes “Technology.” The third character denotes the reason for control, using digits 0–9: 0 denotes “Related to Conventional Arms”; 1 denotes “Related to Delivery Systems for Weapons of Mass Destruction”; 2 denotes “Related to Nuclear Nonproliferation”; 3 denotes “Related to Chemical and Biological Weapons”; 4 denotes “Scheduled Chemicals”; 5 denotes “Temporary Controls”; 9 denotes “Related to Other National Security Factors.” Where an item involves multiple reasons for control, it is organized according to the principal reason, except in the case of temporary controls. The fourth and fifth characters together sequence the items, using digits 0–9. As illustrated in the figure below, each code corresponds to one or more controlled items. Where multiple controlled items or coding levels are involved, lowercase English letters and digits alternate at successive levels, for example 1C111.a.1 and 1C111.b.1.a under 1C111.

text.zh: 五位管制编码结构
text.en: Five-character control code structure
