title.zh: 五位管制编码结构
title.en: Five-character control code structure

title.zh: （一）通用说明。
title.en: (I) General notes.

summary.zh: （一）通用说明。
summary.en: (I) General notes.

text.zh:
（一）通用说明。
1．本清单中物项包括未使用的物项、使用过的物项，以及集成在其他产品中作为其主要成分且可被拆卸、移作他用的物项。本清单第二部分中另有规定的，依照其规定。
2．如果对本清单中物项的描述不含技术规格或限制条件，则该物项包含其全部品种。
3．本清单中与大规模杀伤性武器运载工具相关的物项（即管制编码第3 位为数字1 的物项）是指与能把500 kg 以上有效载荷投掷到300 km 以上的完整弹道导弹、运载火箭、探空火箭、巡航导弹和“无人驾驶航空器”，以及为其专门设计的生产设施相关的物项。
text.en: (I) General notes. 1. Items in this List include unused items, used items, and items incorporated as major components of other products that can be removed and repurposed. Where Part Two of this List provides otherwise, those provisions apply. 2. If an item description in this List contains no technical specifications or restrictions, the item includes all varieties. 3. Items related to delivery systems for weapons of mass destruction in this List, whose third code character is 1, refer to items associated with complete ballistic missiles, space-launch vehicles, sounding rockets, cruise missiles, and “unmanned aerial vehicles” capable of delivering payloads of 500 kg or more to ranges of 300 km or more, and production facilities specially designed therefor.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: （二）关于“技术”的说明。
title.en: (II) Notes on “technology.”

summary.zh: （二）关于“技术”的说明。
summary.en: (II) Notes on “technology.”

text.zh:
（二）关于“技术”的说明。
1．“技术”是指在产品的研发、生产或使用过程中所需的专门信息和知识，包括通过技术资料或技术支持转移或提供的技术。对技术的出口管制不适用于公共领域信息、基础科学研究中的技术或普通专利申请所必需的知识。
2．技术资料包括：蓝图、平面图、图表、模型、公式、工程设计和技术规格、手册与规程，及其被写入或记录在诸如磁盘、磁带、只读存储器等器件或其他载体上。
3．技术支持包括：技术指导、派遣熟练工人、培训、传授知识和技能、咨询服务。
4．本清单所列任一物项的出口许可亦包含对同一最终用户出口该物项的安装、运行、维护和修理所需最低限度的技术的许可。
text.en: (II) Notes on “technology.” 1. “Technology” means the specific information and knowledge needed for the development, production, or use of a product, including technology transferred or provided through technical data or technical assistance. Export controls on technology do not apply to information in the public domain, technology in basic scientific research, or knowledge necessary for ordinary patent applications. 2. Technical data include blueprints, plans, diagrams, models, formulas, engineering designs and specifications, manuals, and procedures, including when written or recorded on devices or other media such as disks, tapes, or read-only memories. 3. Technical assistance includes technical instruction, dispatch of skilled workers, training, transfer of knowledge and skills, and consulting services. 4. An export license for any item in this List also authorizes export to the same end user of the minimum technology necessary for that item’s installation, operation, maintenance, and repair.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: （三）关于“软件”的说明。
title.en: (III) Notes on “software.”

summary.zh: （三）关于“软件”的说明。
summary.en: (III) Notes on “software.”

text.zh:
（三）关于“软件”的说明。“软件”是指载入于有形媒体里的一个或多个“程序”或“微程序”的集合体。对“软件”转让的管制不适用于以下“软件”：
1．通常用以下方式提供给公众的“软件”：
（1）在没有限制的零售点中销售；
（2）专用于用户自身安装而无需供应商进一步具体支持的；
2．公共领域的。
text.en: (III) Notes on “software.” “Software” means a collection of one or more “programs” or “microprograms” stored on a tangible medium. Controls on “software” transfers do not apply to the following “software”: 1. “Software” generally available to the public as follows: (1) Sold at retail outlets without restrictions; (2) Designed for installation by the user without further substantial support from the supplier; 2. In the public domain.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: （四）关于“公共领域”的说明。
title.en: (IV) Notes on the “public domain.”

summary.zh: （四）关于“公共领域”的说明。
summary.en: (IV) Notes on the “public domain.”

text.zh: （四）关于“公共领域”的说明。“公共领域”是指已经公开使用的技术或软件，而对其进一步扩大使用可以不加限制（受版权限制的上述技术或软件被包括在“公共领域”的范围以内）。
text.en: (IV) Notes on the “public domain.” “Public domain” means technology or software that has been made publicly available without restrictions on further dissemination; copyright restrictions do not exclude such technology or software from the “public domain.”

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: （五）关于“基础科学研究”的说明。
title.en: (V) Notes on “basic scientific research.”

summary.zh: （五）关于“基础科学研究”的说明。
summary.en: (V) Notes on “basic scientific research.”

text.zh: （五）关于“基础科学研究”的说明。“基础科学研究”是指为了获得有关现象或可观测事实的基本原理方面的新知识，基本上不具有特定实用目的或目标的实验性或理论性工作。
text.en: (V) Notes on “basic scientific research.” “Basic scientific research” means experimental or theoretical work undertaken principally to acquire new knowledge of the fundamental principles underlying phenomena or observable facts, without a specific practical aim or objective.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: （六）关于“研发”“生产”“使用”的说明。
title.en: (VI) Notes on “development,” “production,” and “use.”

summary.zh: （六）关于“研发”“生产”“使用”的说明。
summary.en: (VI) Notes on “development,” “production,” and “use.”

text.zh:
（六）关于“研发”“生产”“使用”的说明。
1．“研发”是指“生产”前的各个阶段：设计、设计研究、设计分析、设计概念、原型的装配和试验、小规模试生产计划、设计数据、把设计数据转换成产品的过程、外形设计、总体设计、布置。
2．“生产”是指所有的生产阶段：建造、工艺设计、加工制造、装配（安装）、总成、检验、试验、质量保证。
3．“使用”是指操作、安装（包括现场安装）、维护（检查）、维修、检修等活动。
text.en: (VI) Notes on “development,” “production,” and “use.” 1. “Development” means all stages before “production”: design, design research, design analysis, design concepts, prototype assembly and testing, pilot-production schemes, design data, conversion of design data into a product, configuration design, overall design, and layout. 2. “Production” means all production stages: construction, production engineering, manufacturing, assembly (installation), integration, inspection, testing, and quality assurance. 3. “Use” means activities such as operation, installation (including on-site installation), maintenance (inspection), repair, and overhaul.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: （七）关于“可用于”“能够”的说明。
title.en: (VII) Notes on “usable in” and “capable of.”

summary.zh: （七）关于“可用于”“能够”的说明。
summary.en: (VII) Notes on “usable in” and “capable of.”

text.zh: （七）关于“可用于”“能够”的说明。“可用于”“能够”是指系统、设备、部件、组件或软件适合于某一特定用途，而不需要为这种特定用途对这些系统、设备、部件、组件或软件进行配置、改进或调整。
text.en: (VII) Notes on “usable in” and “capable of.” “Usable in” and “capable of” mean that systems, equipment, components, assemblies, or software are suitable for a particular purpose without configuration, modification, or adjustment for that purpose.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: （八）关于“专门设计”的说明。
title.en: (VIII) Notes on “specially designed.”

summary.zh: （八）关于“专门设计”的说明。
summary.en: (VIII) Notes on “specially designed.”

text.zh: （八）关于“专门设计”的说明。“专门设计”是指针对某种特定目的而研发、且有独特性能的系统、设备、部件、组件、材料或软件。例如：一件为用于导弹而设计的设备，如果没有其他的功能或用途，那么就将其视为“专门设计”的设备。再如：一台为制造某种部件而设计的制造设备，如果不能生产其他部件，那么应当将其视为“专门设计”的设备。
text.en: (VIII) Notes on “specially designed.” “Specially designed” means systems, equipment, components, assemblies, materials, or software developed for a particular purpose and having unique properties. For example, equipment designed for use in missiles and having no other function or application is considered “specially designed.” Similarly, manufacturing equipment designed to produce a particular component and incapable of producing other components is considered “specially designed.”

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: （九）关于“设计或改进”的说明。
title.en: (IX) Notes on “designed or modified.”

summary.zh: （九）关于“设计或改进”的说明。
summary.en: (IX) Notes on “designed or modified.”

text.zh: （九）关于“设计或改进”的说明。“设计或改进”是指系统、设备、部件、组件、软件或技术作为研发和改进的对象，使其具有适用于某种特定应用的属性。“设计或改进”的系统、设备、部件、组件、软件或技术可用于其他应用。例如：为导弹设计的钛泵可以使用推进剂之外的腐蚀性液体。
text.en: (IX) Notes on “designed or modified.” “Designed or modified” means that systems, equipment, components, assemblies, software, or technology have been developed or modified to possess properties suitable for a particular application. “Designed or modified” systems, equipment, components, assemblies, software, or technology may be used in other applications. For example, a titanium pump designed for a missile may handle corrosive liquids other than propellants.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: 按重量计
title.en: By weight

summary.zh: 按重量计
summary.en: By weight

text.zh: （一）“按重量计”（第1、2 类）是指合金中某种元素的质量除以合金总质量再乘以100%，表示该元素的含量。
text.en: (I) “By weight” (Categories 1 and 2) means the mass of an element divided by the total mass of an alloy, multiplied by 100%, expressing the element’s content.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: 比模量
title.en: Specific modulus

summary.zh: 比模量
summary.en: Specific modulus

text.zh: （二）“比模量”（第1、9 类）是指在温度为23±2 ℃和相对湿度为50±5%的条件下测量的杨氏模量（单位：N/m²）除以比重（单位：N/m³）。
text.en: (II) “Specific modulus” (Categories 1 and 9) means Young’s modulus, in N/m², divided by specific weight, in N/m³, measured at a temperature of 23±2 °C and relative humidity of 50±5%.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: 比抗拉强度
title.en: Specific tensile strength

summary.zh: 比抗拉强度
summary.en: Specific tensile strength

text.zh: （三）“比抗拉强度”（第1、9 类）是指在温度为23±2 ℃和相对湿度为50±5%的条件下测量的极限抗拉强度（单位：N/m²）除以比重（单位：N/m³）。
text.en: (III) “Specific tensile strength” (Categories 1 and 9) means ultimate tensile strength, in N/m², divided by specific weight, in N/m³, measured at a temperature of 23±2 °C and relative humidity of 50±5%.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: 病原微生物
title.en: Pathogenic microorganisms

summary.zh: 病原微生物
summary.en: Pathogenic microorganisms

text.zh: （四）“病原微生物”（第1 类）是指可使人、动物或植物致死、致病或/和受到损害的，天然的或经过遗传修饰的病原微生物。病原微生物包括细菌、病毒、真菌等。“细菌”是一种单细胞微生物。除少数例外情况，细菌属于不依赖于其他生物体即可完成自我复制的独立活体微生物。“病毒”是一种通常由包裹在蛋白质衣壳内的遗传物质组成的病原微生物。病毒必须感染宿主细胞才能复制、在宿主细胞内发生裂解并传播感染。“真菌”是以有机物为营养来源的一组单细胞和多细胞生物（如霉菌、酵母和蘑菇）。
text.en: (IV) “Pathogenic microorganisms” (Category 1) means naturally occurring or genetically modified pathogenic microorganisms that can cause death, disease, and/or harm in humans, animals, or plants. Pathogenic microorganisms include bacteria, viruses, fungi, etc. “Bacteria” are single-celled microorganisms. With few exceptions, bacteria are independent living microorganisms capable of reproducing without relying on other organisms. “Viruses” are pathogenic microorganisms generally consisting of genetic material enclosed in a protein capsid. Viruses must infect host cells to replicate, undergo lysis in host cells, and spread infection. “Fungi” are a group of unicellular and multicellular organisms, such as molds, yeasts, and mushrooms, that obtain nutrition from organic matter.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: 测量不确定度
title.en: Measurement uncertainty

summary.zh: 测量不确定度
summary.en: Measurement uncertainty

text.zh: （五）“测量不确定度”（第2 类）是指规定可测变量的正确值以95%的置信水平处于输出值附近多大范围内的特性参数。这种特性参数包括未修正的系统偏差、未修正的游隙和随机偏差。
text.en: (V) “Measurement uncertainty” (Category 2) means the characteristic parameter defining the range around an output value within which the true value of the measurand lies at a 95% confidence level. This parameter includes uncorrected systematic bias, uncorrected backlash, and random deviations.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: 衬底
title.en: Substrate

summary.zh: 衬底
summary.en: Substrate

text.zh: （六）“衬底”（第3 类）是指具有或不具有互连模式的基材，其上或其内可放置“分立器件”或集成电路或两者。
text.en: (VI) “Substrate” (Category 3) means a base material, with or without an interconnection pattern, on or within which “discrete devices,” integrated circuits, or both may be placed.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: 程序
title.en: Program

summary.zh: 程序
summary.en: Program

text.zh: （七）“程序”（第1、2 类）是指电子计算机可执行的或可转换成可执行某一过程的指令序列。
text.en: (VII) “Program” (Categories 1 and 2) means a sequence of instructions executable by an electronic computer, or convertible into a form executable by it, to perform a process.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: 成形控制
title.en: Contouring control

summary.zh: 成形控制
summary.en: Contouring control

text.zh: （八）“成形控制”（第2 类）是指根据指令进行两种或多种“数控”动作，该指令规定了下一个所要求的位置和到达该位置所要求的进刀速度。而进刀速度随彼此间的关系变化，以便得到一种所要求的成形（参见ISO2806:1994）。
text.en: (VIII) “Contouring control” (Category 2) means two or more “numerically controlled” motions performed according to instructions specifying the next required position and the feed rate required to reach it. The feed rates vary in relation to each other to produce the desired contour (see ISO2806:1994).

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: 等静压压力机
title.en: Isostatic presses

summary.zh: 等静压压力机
summary.en: Isostatic presses

text.zh: （九）“等静压压力机”（第2 类）是指能够通过各种介质（气体、液体、固体颗粒等）对封闭型腔加压，从而在型腔内各个方向对工件或材料产生相等压力的设备。
text.en: (IX) “Isostatic presses” (Category 2) means equipment capable of pressurizing a closed cavity through various media, such as gases, liquids, or solid particles, to exert equal pressure in all directions on a workpiece or material within the cavity.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: 电子组件
title.en: Electronic assemblies

summary.zh: 电子组件
summary.en: Electronic assemblies

text.zh: （十）“电子组件”（第4 类）是指连接在一起以执行特定功能的多个电子元件（即“电路元件”“分立器件”、集成电路等），可以整体更换，通常可拆卸。
text.en: (X) “Electronic assemblies” (Category 4) means multiple electronic components, such as “circuit elements,” “discrete devices,” or integrated circuits, connected together to perform a specific function, replaceable as a unit, and normally disassemblable.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: 定位精度
title.en: Positioning accuracy

summary.zh: 定位精度
summary.en: Positioning accuracy

text.zh:
（十一）“定位精度”（第2 类），根据第2B201 项，连同以下要求提出和确定“数控”机床的“定位精度”：
1．检验条件（ISO230-2:1988 第3 节或等效国家标准）：
（1）在测量前12 小时和测量期间，机床和精度测量设备要保持在相同的环境温度下。在预测期间，机床的滑座要连续地作与在精度测量期间所作循环同样的循环；
（2）机床将配备随机床一并出口的机械的、电子的或软件的附件；
（3）用于测量的测量设备的精度应至少优于预期机床精度的4 倍；
（4）用于驱动滑座的电源必须是：①线电压变化不得大于标称额定电压的±10%；②频率变化不超出正常频率的±2 Hz；③不允许线路停电或断续供电。
2．检验程序（ISO230-2:1988 第4 节或等效国家标准）：
（1）测量时进给率（滑座速度）必须是快速横向移动的速率；
技术说明：对于产生光学品质表面的机床，进给率必须小于等于每分钟50 mm；
（2）必须以增量方式进行测量，
text.en: (XI) “Positioning accuracy” (Category 2): Under 2B201, the “positioning accuracy” of “numerically controlled” machine tools must be stated and determined subject to the following requirements: 1. Test conditions (ISO230-2:1988, Section 3, or an equivalent national standard): (1) The machine tool and accuracy-measuring equipment must be maintained at the same ambient temperature for 12 hours before and throughout measurement. During the premeasurement period, the machine’s slides must cycle continuously through the same cycles used during accuracy measurement; (2) The machine tool must be equipped with the mechanical, electronic, or software accessories exported with it; (3) The measuring equipment must have an accuracy at least four times better than the machine tool’s expected accuracy; (4) The power supply driving the slides must meet the following: ① line-voltage variation must not exceed ±10% of nominal rated voltage; ② frequency variation must remain within ±2 Hz of normal frequency; ③ power outages or interruptions are not permitted. 2. Test procedure (ISO230-2:1988, Section 4, or an equivalent national standard): (1) The feed rate (slide velocity) during measurement must be the rapid-traverse rate; Technical Note: For machine tools producing optical-quality surfaces, the feed rate must be 50 mm per minute or less; (2) Measurements must be made incrementally,

text.zh:
即从轴向行程的一个端点至另一个端点而不返回到起始位置，每次移动都朝向目标位置；
（3）在检验某一轴线时，其它的轴线必须保持在行程中间位置。
3．检验结果的说明（ISO230-2:1988 第2 节或等效国家标准）：测量结果必须包括：
（1）“定位精度”；
（2）正反向平均误差。
text.en: from one end of the axis travel to the other without returning to the starting position, each movement being toward the target position; (3) When testing one axis, all other axes must remain at mid-travel. 3. Presentation of test results (ISO230-2:1988, Section 2, or an equivalent national standard): Results must include: (1) “Positioning accuracy”; (2) Mean reversal error.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: 毒素
title.en: Toxins

summary.zh: 毒素
summary.en: Toxins

text.zh: （十二）“毒素”（第1、2 类）是指源于任何微生物、动物、植物，可使人、动物或植物致死、致病或/和受到损害的，而无论以何种方式产生的天然的或经过修饰的生物活性物质。
text.en: (XII) “Toxins” (Categories 1 and 2) means naturally occurring or modified biologically active substances derived from any microorganism, animal, or plant, however produced, that can cause death, disease, and/or harm in humans, animals, or plants.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: 对称密码算法
title.en: Symmetric cryptographic algorithm

summary.zh: 对称密码算法
summary.en: Symmetric cryptographic algorithm

text.zh: （十三）“对称密码算法”（第5 类）是指加密和解密变换使用相同密钥的密码算法。
text.en: (XIII) “Symmetric cryptographic algorithm” (Category 5) means a cryptographic algorithm using the same key for encryption and decryption transformations.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: 非对称密码算法
title.en: Asymmetric cryptographic algorithm

summary.zh: 非对称密码算法
summary.en: Asymmetric cryptographic algorithm

text.zh: （十四）“非对称密码算法”（第5 类）是指加密和解密变换使用不同密钥的密码算法，其中一个密钥称为公钥，另外一个密钥称为私钥。
text.en: (XIV) “Asymmetric cryptographic algorithm” (Category 5) means a cryptographic algorithm using different keys for encryption and decryption transformations, one called the public key and the other the private key.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: 分辨率
title.en: Resolution

summary.zh: 分辨率
summary.en: Resolution

text.zh: （十五）“分辨率”（第2、3 类）是指测量装置可分辨的最小增量；在数字测量仪上为最低有效位。
text.en: (XV) “Resolution” (Categories 2 and 3) means the smallest increment a measuring device can distinguish; for a digital measuring instrument, it is the least significant bit.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: 高空
title.en: High altitude

summary.zh: 高空
summary.en: High altitude

text.zh: （十六）“高空”（第9 类）是指航空领域高度在7000~15000 米空域。
text.en: (XVI) “High altitude” (Category 9) means airspace at altitudes of 7000–15000 meters in aviation.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: 高温合金
title.en: Superalloys

summary.zh: 高温合金
summary.en: Superalloys

text.zh: （十七）“高温合金”（第9 类）是指含难熔金属的镍基合金、钴基合金或铁基合金，可在600 ℃及以上的氧化和热腐蚀条件下承受复杂应力，仍具有良好的综合性能，并能长期可靠工作的金属材料，又被称为“超合金”。
text.en: (XVII) “Superalloys” (Category 9) means nickel-, cobalt-, or iron-based alloys containing refractory metals that withstand complex stresses under oxidizing and hot-corrosion conditions at 600 °C or above while retaining good overall properties and reliable long-term operation; also called “high-temperature alloys.”

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: 化学武器
title.en: Chemical weapons

summary.zh: 化学武器
summary.en: Chemical weapons

text.zh:
（十八）“化学武器”（第1 类）是单指或合指：
1．有毒化学品及其前体，但预定用于《禁止化学武器公约》不加禁止的目的者除外，只要种类和数量符合此种目的；
2．经专门设计通过使用后而释放出的本款1 项所指有毒化学品的毒性造成死亡或其他伤害的弹花和装置；
3．经专门设计其用途与本款2 项所指弹花和装置的使用直接有关的任何设备。
text.en: (XVIII) “Chemical weapons” (Category 1) means the following, together or separately: 1. Toxic chemicals and their precursors, except where intended for purposes not prohibited by the Chemical Weapons Convention, provided that the types and quantities are consistent with those purposes; 2. Munition “flowers” [source wording; likely munitions] and devices specially designed to cause death or other harm through the toxic properties of the toxic chemicals in paragraph 1 released as a result of their use; 3. Any equipment specially designed for use directly in connection with the use of the munition “flowers” [source wording; likely munitions] and devices in paragraph 2.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: 化学武器前体
title.en: Chemical weapon precursors

summary.zh: 化学武器前体
summary.en: Chemical weapon precursors

text.zh: （十九）“化学武器前体”（第1 类）是指在生产有毒化学品的任何阶段，参与此生产过程的任何化学反应物，其中包括二元或多元化学系统的任何关键组分。
text.en: (XIX) “Chemical weapon precursors” (Category 1) means any chemical reactant participating at any stage in the production of a toxic chemical, including any key component of a binary or multicomponent chemical system.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: 激光
title.en: Laser

summary.zh: 激光
summary.en: Laser

text.zh: （二十）“激光”（第2、3、6、7、9 类）是一种通过受激辐射的放大而产生空间和时间相干光的物项。
text.en: (XX) “Laser” (Categories 2, 3, 6, 7, and 9) means an item producing spatially and temporally coherent light through amplification by stimulated emission of radiation.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: 加密
title.en: Cryptography

summary.zh: 加密
summary.en: Cryptography

text.zh:
（二十一）“加密”（第3、5、6 类）是指体现数据转换的原则、手段和方法以隐藏其信息内容、防止其未被发现的修改或防止其未经授权使用的学科。“加密”仅限于使用一个或多个“秘密参数”（例如：加密变量）或相关密钥管理的信息转换。
说明：
1．“加密”不包括“固定”数据压缩或编码技术；
2．“加密”包括解密。
技术说明：
1．“加密参数”：不为他人所知或仅在组内共享的常数或密钥；
2．“固定”：编码或压缩算法不能接受外部提供的参数（例如：密码或密钥变量）并且不能由用户修改。
text.en: (XXI) “Cryptography” (Categories 3, 5, and 6) means the discipline embodying the principles, means, and methods of transforming data to conceal its information content, prevent undetected modification, or prevent unauthorized use. “Cryptography” is limited to transformations using one or more “secret parameters,” such as cryptographic variables, or associated key management. Notes: 1. “Cryptography” does not include “fixed” data-compression or coding techniques; 2. “Cryptography” includes decryption. Technical Notes: 1. “Cryptographic parameter”: a constant or key unknown to others or shared only within a group; 2. “Fixed”: a coding or compression algorithm that cannot accept externally supplied parameters, such as cryptographic or key variables, and cannot be modified by the user.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: 角位偏差
title.en: Angular position deviation

summary.zh: 角位偏差
summary.en: Angular position deviation

text.zh: （二十二）“角位偏差”（第2 类）是指在工作台上的工件已移出其初始位置后，精确测量的实际角位与理论角位之间的最大差值。
text.en: (XXII) “Angular position deviation” (Category 2) means the maximum difference between precisely measured actual angular position and theoretical angular position after a workpiece on a table moves from its initial position.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: 介电常数
title.en: Dielectric constant

summary.zh: 介电常数
summary.en: Dielectric constant

text.zh: （二十三）“介电常数”（第1 类）是反映压电材料电介质在静电场作用下介电性质或极化性质的主要参数。
text.en: (XXIII) “Dielectric constant” (Category 1) is a principal parameter describing the dielectric or polarization properties of a piezoelectric material’s dielectric under an electrostatic field.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: 精度
title.en: Accuracy

summary.zh: 精度
summary.en: Accuracy

text.zh: （二十四）“精度”（第2、3、7 类）通常以误差来衡量精度，即某一指示值同标准值或真值之间的最大正负偏差。
text.en: (XXIV) “Accuracy” (Categories 2, 3, and 7) is generally measured by error, meaning the maximum positive or negative deviation of an indicated value from a reference or true value.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: 绝压
title.en: Absolute pressure

summary.zh: 绝压
summary.en: Absolute pressure

text.zh: （二十五）“绝压”（第9 类）即绝对压力，是指介质所处空间的所有压力。
text.en: (XXV) “Absolute pressure” (Category 9) means the total pressure in the space occupied by a medium.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: 抗辐射加固
title.en: Radiation hardening

summary.zh: 抗辐射加固
summary.en: Radiation hardening

text.zh: （二十六）“抗辐射加固”（第4、6、9 类）是指设计用于抵抗辐射的某种组件或设备，其抗辐射水平达到甚至可以超过5×10⁵ 拉德（Si）的辐射总剂量。
text.en: (XXVI) “Radiation hardening” (Categories 4, 6, and 9) means components or equipment designed to resist radiation at total doses of 5×10⁵ rad (Si) or even higher.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: 拉伸断裂应变
title.en: Tensile strain to failure

summary.zh: 拉伸断裂应变
summary.en: Tensile strain to failure

text.zh: （二十七）“拉伸断裂应变”（第1 类）是指材料在受到拉伸力作用下发生的形变。
text.en: (XXVII) “Tensile strain to failure” (Category 1) means the deformation of a material under tensile force.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: 漂移率
title.en: Drift rate

summary.zh: 漂移率
summary.en: Drift rate

text.zh: （二十八）“漂移率”（第7 类）是指在外干扰力矩作用下陀螺仪自转轴在单位时间内相对惯性空间的偏差角，其单位是度/小时，是衡量陀螺仪“精度”的主要性能指标，漂移率越小，陀螺仪“精度”越高。
text.en: (XXVIII) “Drift rate” (Category 7) means the angular deviation per unit time of a gyroscope’s spin axis relative to inertial space under external disturbing torque. Expressed in degrees per hour, it is a principal measure of gyroscope “accuracy”: the lower the drift rate, the higher the “accuracy.”

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: 平均输出功率
title.en: Average output power

summary.zh: 平均输出功率
summary.en: Average output power

text.zh: （二十九）“平均输出功率”（第6 类）是指总“激光”输出能量，以焦耳为单位，除以发射一系列连续脉冲的周期，单位为秒。对于一系列均匀间隔的脉冲，它等于单个脉冲中的总“激光”输出能量（以焦耳为单位）乘以“激光”的脉冲频率（以赫兹为单位）。
text.en: (XXIX) “Average output power” (Category 6) means total “laser” output energy in joules divided by the period in seconds over which a series of consecutive pulses is emitted. For equally spaced pulses, it equals the total “laser” output energy in a single pulse, in joules, multiplied by the “laser” pulse frequency, in hertz.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: 腔室内径
title.en: Inside chamber diameter

summary.zh: 腔室内径
summary.en: Inside chamber diameter

text.zh: （三十）“腔室内径”（第2 类）是指同时达到工作温度和工作压力的腔室尺寸，但不包括夹具。该尺寸是压力室内径或绝缘炉室内径的较小者，具体取决于两室中哪个腔室在另个腔室内。
text.en: (XXX) “Inside chamber diameter” (Category 2) means the dimensions of the chamber in which both operating temperature and operating pressure are achieved, excluding fixtures. It is the smaller of the inside diameter of the pressure chamber and the insulated furnace chamber, depending on which chamber is inside the other.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: 热膨胀系数
title.en: Coefficient of thermal expansion

summary.zh: 热膨胀系数
summary.en: Coefficient of thermal expansion

text.zh: （三十一）“热膨胀系数”（第1 类）是指物体由于温度改变而有胀缩现象。其变化能力以等压下，单位温度变化所导致的长度量值的变化表示。
text.en: (XXXI) “Coefficient of thermal expansion” (Category 1) refers to the expansion or contraction of an object caused by a temperature change. The extent of that change is expressed as the change in length per unit temperature change at constant pressure.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: 射/航程
title.en: Range

summary.zh: 射/航程
summary.en: Range

text.zh:
（三十二）“射/航程”（第9 类）是指定的火箭系统或“无人驾驶航空器”系统在稳定飞行模式下能够飞行的最大距离，由其轨迹在地球表面的投影来测量。
技术说明：
1．在确定射/航程时，考虑的是满载燃料或推进剂时基于系统设计特性的最大能力；
2．在确定火箭系统或“无人驾驶航空器”系统的射/航程时，应排除所有外部因素，如操作、遥测、数据链及其他外部约束和限制因素；
3．对于火箭系统，射程是在假定国际民航组织标准大气且无风情况下，以最大射程轨迹确定的飞行距离；
4．对于“无人驾驶航空器”，航程是在假定国际民航组织标准大气且无风情况下，以最高燃烧效率飞行状态或电池最高放电效率确定的单程距离。
text.en: (XXXII) “Range” (Category 9) means the maximum distance a specified rocket system or “unmanned aerial vehicle” system can travel in a stable flight mode, measured by the projection of its trajectory on the Earth’s surface. Technical Notes: 1. Range determination considers the maximum capability based on the system’s design characteristics when fully loaded with fuel or propellant; 2. In determining the range of a rocket or “unmanned aerial vehicle” system, exclude all external factors, such as operational, telemetry, data-link, and other external constraints or limitations; 3. For rocket systems, range is the flight distance determined using the maximum-range trajectory under an assumed ICAO standard atmosphere with zero wind; 4. For “unmanned aerial vehicles,” range is the one-way distance determined at the flight condition of highest fuel efficiency or highest battery-discharge efficiency under an assumed ICAO standard atmosphere with zero wind.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: 数控
title.en: Numerical control

summary.zh: 数控
summary.en: Numerical control

text.zh: （三十三）“数控”（第1、2 类）是指通过一种装置来执行某一过程的自动控制，该装置通常在操作中引入数字数据（参见ISO2382:2015）。
text.en: (XXXIII) “Numerical control” (Categories 1 and 2) means automated control of a process by a device that normally introduces numerical data during operation (see ISO2382:2015).

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: 数字计算机
title.en: Digital computers

summary.zh: 数字计算机
summary.en: Digital computers

text.zh:
（三十四）“数字计算机”（第4 类）是指能够以一个或多个离散变量的形式执行以下所有操作的设备：
1．接收数据；
2．将数据或指令存储在固定或可更改（可写）的存储设备中；
3．通过存储的可修改指令序列处理数据；
4．提供数据输出。
技术说明：对存储的指令序列的修改包括更换固定存储设备，但不包括物理更改接线或互连。
text.en: (XXXIV) “Digital computer” (Category 4) means equipment capable of performing all of the following operations in the form of one or more discrete variables: 1. Receiving data; 2. Storing data or instructions in fixed or alterable (writable) storage devices; 3. Processing data through a stored sequence of modifiable instructions; 4. Providing data output. Technical Note: Modification of a stored instruction sequence includes replacement of fixed storage devices, but excludes physical alteration of wiring or interconnections.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: 微程序
title.en: Microprogram

summary.zh: 微程序
summary.en: Microprogram

text.zh: （三十五）“微程序”（关于“软件”的说明）是指保持在一个特殊的存储器里的基本指令序列，通过把其参考指令引入指令寄存器开始执行该基本指令序列。
text.en: (XXXV) “Microprogram” (Notes on “Software”) means a sequence of elementary instructions held in a special memory, execution of which is initiated by loading its reference instruction into an instruction register.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: 无人驾驶飞艇
title.en: Unmanned airship

summary.zh: 无人驾驶飞艇
summary.en: Unmanned airship

text.zh: （三十六）“无人驾驶飞艇”（第9 类）是指轻于空气的由动力驱动的“无人驾驶航空器”，主要靠空气净浮力升空。
text.en: (XXXVI) “Unmanned airship” (Category 9) means a powered, lighter-than-air “unmanned aerial vehicle” that rises primarily through net buoyancy in air.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: 无人驾驶航空器
title.en: Unmanned aerial vehicle

summary.zh: 无人驾驶航空器
summary.en: Unmanned aerial vehicle

text.zh: （三十七）“无人驾驶航空器”（第9 类）是指由遥控设备或自备程序控制装置操控，机上无人驾驶的航空器。
text.en: (XXXVII) “Unmanned aerial vehicle” (Category 9) means an aircraft with no pilot on board, operated by remote-control equipment or an onboard programmed control device.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: 纤维或纤丝材料
title.en: Fibrous or filamentary materials

summary.zh: 纤维或纤丝材料
summary.en: Fibrous or filamentary materials

text.zh:
（三十八）“纤维或纤丝材料”（第1 类）是指连续的单纤丝、细线、粗纱、纱或带。其中：
1．纤丝或单纤丝是指纤维的最小增量，直径通常为几微米。
2．粗纱是指一股大致平行的细纱束（典型情况为12~120根细纱）。
3．细纱是指大致平行排列的一股纤维束（典型情况为200 多根纤维）。
4．带是指一种由通常预先浸渍过树脂并交织在一起或单向排列的纤维、细纱、粗纱、纱或细线等构成的材料。
5．纱是指一股通常大致平行的纤维束。
6．细线是指一股绞在一起的细纱束。
text.en: (XXXVIII) “Fibrous or filamentary materials” (Category 1) means continuous monofilaments, tows, rovings, yarns, or tapes. For these purposes: 1. Filaments or monofilaments are the smallest fiber elements, generally a few micrometers in diameter. 2. Rovings are bundles of approximately parallel strands, typically 12–120 strands. 3. Strands are bundles of approximately parallel fibers, typically more than 200 fibers. 4. Tape is material composed of fibers, strands, rovings, yarns, tows, etc., generally preimpregnated with resin and interwoven or arranged unidirectionally. 5. Yarn is a bundle of fibers generally arranged approximately in parallel. 6. Tow is a bundle of twisted strands.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: 线性度
title.en: Linearity

summary.zh: 线性度
summary.en: Linearity

text.zh: （三十九）“线性度”（第2、3 类）（通常以非线性度衡量）是实际特性值相对一直线的最大正负值偏差（高端和低端读数的平均值），正值或负值，该直线的位置应使最大偏差均衡设置并减至最小。
text.en: (XXXIX) “Linearity” (Categories 2 and 3), generally measured as nonlinearity, means the maximum positive or negative deviation of the actual characteristic from a straight line (the average of upper and lower readings), with the line positioned to equalize and minimize the maximum deviations.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: 疫苗
title.en: Vaccines

summary.zh: 疫苗
summary.en: Vaccines

text.zh: （四十）“疫苗”（第1 类）是指经国家主管部门批准进行临床试验、生产或上市销售的，可激发人或动物产生保护性免疫反应，以预防由该种微生物或毒素所致疾病或中毒的生物制剂。
text.en: (XL) “Vaccines” (Category 1) means biological preparations approved by the competent national authority for clinical trials, production, or marketing, capable of inducing protective immune responses in humans or animals to prevent disease or poisoning caused by the microorganism or toxin concerned.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: 炸药
title.en: Explosives

summary.zh: 炸药
summary.en: Explosives

text.zh: （四十一）“炸药”（第1、2、3 类）是指固体、液体或气体物质或物质混合物，在弹头、爆破和其他应用中作为首要装药、助推器或主要装药时，需要引爆。
text.en: (XLI) “Explosives” (Categories 1, 2, and 3) means solid, liquid, or gaseous substances or mixtures requiring detonation when used as primary charges, boosters, or main charges in warheads, demolition, or other applications.

source.title: 中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单

title.zh: 载荷
title.en: Payload

summary.zh: 载荷
summary.en: Payload

text.zh: （四十二）“载荷”（第9 类）是指航空器所能携带的有效负荷，包括任务设备、燃料、乘客等。有效载荷可由特定火箭系统或“无人驾驶航空器”系统携带或投送的总质量，不用于维持飞行。有效载荷是否包含特定设备、分系统或部件取决于相关飞行器的类型和配置。
text.en: (XLII) “Payload” (Category 9) means the useful load an aircraft can carry, including mission equipment, fuel, passengers, etc. Payload is the total mass that a particular rocket or “unmanned aerial vehicle” system can carry or deliver that is not used to maintain flight. Whether particular equipment, subsystems, or components are included in payload depends on the type and configuration of the vehicle concerned.

text.zh:
两用物项和技术进出口许可证管理目录
说明：一、本目录分为《两用物项和技术进口许可证管理目录》与《两用物项和技术出口许可证管理目录》。二、本目录所列物项和技术是指依据《中华人民共和国出口管制法》《中华人民共和国密码法》等相关法律、行政法规和规章实施管制或管理的物项和技术。三、进出口本目录的物项和技术，不论该物项和技术是否在本目录中列明海关商品编号，均应依法办理两用物项和技术进出口许可证。四、本目录所列物项和技术及其商品名称和描述与相关法律、行政法规、规章、《中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单》及相关公告不一致时，以相关法律、行政法规、规章、《中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单》及相关公告为准。
text.en: Catalog for the Administration of Import and Export Licenses for Dual-Use Items and Technologies Notes: I. This Catalog consists of the Catalog for the Administration of Import Licenses for Dual-Use Items and Technologies and the Catalog for the Administration of Export Licenses for Dual-Use Items and Technologies. II. The items and technologies listed in this Catalog are those subject to control or administration under relevant laws, administrative regulations, and rules, including the Export Control Law of the People’s Republic of China and the Cryptography Law of the People’s Republic of China. III. Imports or exports of items and technologies in this Catalog require the applicable dual-use items and technologies import or export license in accordance with law, whether or not a customs commodity code is listed in the Catalog. IV. Where the items, technologies, commodity names, or descriptions in this Catalog are inconsistent with relevant laws, administrative regulations, rules, the Export Control List of Dual-Use Items of the People’s Republic of China, or relevant announcements, those laws, administrative regulations, rules, the control list, and announcements prevail.

Fibrous materials suitable for composite structures, with a specific modulus of 3.18×10⁶ m or greater and a specific ultimate tensile strength of 7.62×10⁴ m or greater (“specific modulus” is Young’s modulus in N/m² divided by specific weight in N/m³; “specific ultimate tensile strength” is ultimate tensile strength in N/m² divided by specific weight in N/m³).

text.en: List of Items Controlled

text.zh: 相关管制：(1) 全自动枪支及某些相关零件、部件、配件和附属装置（包括容量超过50发的弹匣），见USML第I类。(2) 半自动步枪见ECCN 0A506。(3) 半自动手枪见ECCN 0A507。(4) 半自动霰弹枪见ECCN 0A508；不受0A509.a或.c管制的半自动霰弹枪某些“零件”和“部件”见ECCN 0A502。(5) ECCN 0A506、0A507和0A508所用、列举或以其他方式描述的“零件”“部件”、装置、“配件”和“附属装置”，见ECCN 0A509。(6) 为0A506、0A507或0A508“专门设计”的其他“零件”“部件”“配件”和“附属装置”，见本条目.d、.x和.y。(7) 受EAR管辖的非自动霰弹枪及其“零件”和“部件”，以及不受0A509.a或.c管制的半自动霰弹枪某些“零件”和“部件”，见ECCN 0A502。(8) 光学瞄准装置的管制见ECCN 0A504和USML第XII类。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) See USML Category I for firearms that are fully automatic, and certain related parts, components, accessories, and attachments (including magazines with a capacity of greater than 50 rounds). (2) See ECCN 0A506 for semi-automatic rifles. (3) See ECCN 0A507 for semi-automatic pistols. (4) See ECCN 0A508 for semi-automatic shotguns and ECCN 0A502 for certain “parts” and “components” for semi-automatic shotguns that are not controlled by 0A509.a or .c. (5) See ECCN 0A509 for enumerated or otherwise described “parts,” “components,” devices, “accessories,” and “attachments” for ECCNs 0A506, 0A507, and 0A508. (6) See .d, .x, and .y of this entry for other “parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” “specially designed” for 0A506 and 0A507, or 0A508. (7) See ECCN 0A502 for non-automatic shotguns and their “parts” and “components” that are subject to the EAR and for certain “parts” and “components” for semi-automatic shotguns that are not controlled by 0A509.a or .c. (8) See ECCN 0A504 and USML Category XII for controls on optical sighting devices.

text.zh: 相关定义：不适用。
text.en: Related Definitions: N/A.

text.zh: 物项：
text.en: Items:

text.zh: a. 口径等于或小于0.50英寸（12.7毫米）的非自动且非半自动枪支。
text.en: a. Non-automatic and non-semi-automatic firearms equal to .50 caliber (12.7 mm) or less.
Note 1 to paragraph 0A501.a:

text.zh: ‘组合式手枪’受ECCN 0A501.a管制。‘组合式手枪’（亦称组合枪）至少具有一根膛线枪管和一根滑膛枪管（通常为霰弹枪式枪管）。
text.en: 'Combination pistols' are controlled under ECCN 0A501.a. A 'combination pistol' (a.k.a., a combination gun) has at least one rifled barrel and at least one smoothbore barrel (generally a shotgun style barrel).
Note 2 to paragraph 0A501.a:

text.zh: 口径等于或小于0.50英寸（12.7毫米）的半自动枪支受ECCN 0A506和0A507管制。
text.en: Semi-automatic firearms equal to .50 caliber (12.7 mm) or less are controlled under ECCNs 0A506 and 0A507.

text.zh: 0A501.a技术注：
text.en: Technical Note to 0A501.a:

text.zh: 0A501.a所述枪支包括膛室适配0.50 BMG枪弹的枪支。
text.en: Firearms described in 0A501.a include those chambered for the .50 BMG cartridge.

text.zh: b. 口径大于0.50英寸（12.7毫米）但小于或等于0.72英寸（18.0毫米）的非自动且非半自动步枪、卡宾枪、左轮手枪或手枪。
text.en: b. Non-automatic and non-semi-automatic rifles, carbines, revolvers or pistols with a caliber greater than .50 inches (12.7 mm) but less than or equal to .72 inches (18.0 mm).

text.zh: c. 为本条目.a或.b款、ECCN 0A506或0A507或USML第I类管制商品“专门设计”的下列类型“零件”和“部件”（USML另有列举或规定，或受ECCN 0A509管制的除外）：枪管、弹巢、枪管延伸件、安装座（耳轴座）、枪机、枪机框、操作杆、导气活塞、扳机座、扳机、击锤/击针、阻铁、断发器，含有射击控制“零件”或“部件”（如扳机、击锤/击针、阻铁、断发器）的手枪握把，以及含有射击控制“零件”或“部件”的枪托。
text.en: c. The following types of “parts” and “components” if “specially designed” for a commodity controlled by paragraph .a or .b of this entry or ECCNs 0A506 or 0A507, or USML Category I (unless otherwise enumerated or elsewhere specified on the USML or controlled under ECCN 0A509): Barrels, cylinders, barrel extensions, mounting blocks (trunnions), bolts, bolt carriers, operating rods, gas pistons, trigger housings, triggers, hammers/striker, sears, disconnectors, pistol grips that contain fire control “parts” or “components” (e.g., triggers, hammers/striker, sears, disconnectors) and buttstocks that contain fire control “parts” or “components.”

text.zh: 0A501.c技术注：
text.en: Technical Note to 0A501.c:

text.zh: 制造进度已达到加工出弹膛或膛线阶段的枪管毛坯，受0A501.c管制。
text.en: Barrel blanks that have reached a stage in manufacturing in which they are either chambered or rifled are controlled by 0A501.c.

text.zh: d. 为本条目.a或.b款或ECCN 0A506或0A507管制商品“专门设计”、容量为17至50发的可拆卸弹匣。
text.en: d. Detachable magazines with a capacity of 17 to 50 rounds “specially designed” for a commodity controlled by paragraph .a or .b of this entry or controlled by ECCNs 0A506 or 0A507.

text.zh: 0A501.d款注3
text.en: Note 3 to paragraph 0A501.d

text.zh: 容量为16发或以下的弹匣受0A501.x管制；容量超过50发的弹匣见USML第I类。仅容纳0A505.d管制空包弹的弹匣，视其容量受0A501.d或0A501.x管制。
text.en: Magazines with a capacity of 16 rounds or less are controlled under 0A501.x; for magazines with a capacity greater than 50 rounds, see USML Category I. Magazines that hold only blank ammunition controlled under 0A505.d are controlled under 0A501.d or 0A501.x, depending on the magazine's capacity.

text.zh: e. 为本条目.a或.b款管制商品“专门设计”的机匣（机框）及“完整闭锁机构”，包括其铸件、锻件、冲压件或机加工件。
text.en: e. Receivers (frames) and “complete breech mechanisms,” including castings, forgings, stampings, or machined items thereof, “specially designed” for a commodity controlled by paragraph .a or .b of this entry.
Note 4 to 0A501.e:

text.zh: 0A501.e所指机框（机匣），是指枪支上依法须标记序列号时具有或通常标有序列号的任何“零件”或“部件”。0A501.e款所指物项，与酒精、烟草、火器和爆炸物管理局作为枪支管理的“零件”或“部件”同义（见《美国法典》第18编第921(a)(3)条；《联邦法规》第27编第447、478和479部分）。
text.en: Frames (receivers) under 0A501.e refers to any “part” or “component” of the firearm that has or is customarily marked with a serial number when required by law. This paragraph 0A501.e is synonymous with a “part” or “component” that is regulated by the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives (see 18 U.S.C. 921(a)(3); 27 CFR parts 447, 478, and 479,) as a firearm.
Note 5 to 0A501.e:

text.zh: 为半自动枪支“专门设计”的机框（机匣）受ECCN 0A509.b或.c管制。
text.en: Frames (receivers) “specially designed” for semi-automatic firearms are controlled under ECCN 0A509.b or .c.

text.zh: f.至w. [保留]
text.en: f. through w. [Reserved]

text.zh: x. 为本条目.a至.c款、ECCN 0A506或0A507或USML项下分类商品“专门设计”，且USML或CCL未在其他处规定、亦不受ECCN 0A509管制的“零件”和“部件”。
text.en: x. “Parts” and “components” that are “specially designed” for a commodity classified under paragraphs .a through .c of this entry, a commodity classified under ECCNs 0A506 or 0A507, or the USML and not elsewhere specified on the USML or CCL or controlled under ECCN 0A509.

text.zh: y. 为本ECCN、ECCN 0A506或0A507管制商品“专门设计”，或与USML第I类防务物品通用，且USML或CCL未在其他处规定的下列特定“零件”“部件”“配件”和“附属装置”，以及为其“专门设计”的“零件”“部件”“配件”和“附属装置”。
text.en: y. Specific “parts,” “components,” “accessories” and “attachments” “specially designed” for a commodity subject to control in this ECCN, ECCNs 0A506, 0A507, or common to a defense article in USML Category I and not elsewhere specified in the USML or CCL as follows, and “parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” “specially designed” therefor.

text.zh: y.1. 不含任何射击控制“零件”或“部件”（如扳机、击锤/击针、阻铁、断发器）的枪托（包括可调式、折叠式、刀片式枪托和支撑托）、握把、护木或前托；
text.en: y.1. Stocks (including adjustable, collapsible, blades and braces), grips, handguards, or forends, that do not contain any fire control “parts” or “components” (e.g., triggers, hammers/striker, sears, disconnectors);

text.zh: y.2至y.5. [保留]
text.en: y.2 through y.5. [Reserved]

text.zh: y.6. 刺刀；以及
text.en: y.6. Bayonets; and

text.zh: y.7. 1890年至1898年制造的枪支及其仿制品。
text.en: y.7. Firearms manufactured from 1890 to 1898 and reproductions thereof.

text.zh: 0A501技术注1：
text.en: Technical Note 1 to 0A501:

text.zh: ECCN 0A501包括不“受ITAR管辖”的“零件”和“部件”，即使它们可通用于ECCN 0A501所述枪支及“受ITAR管辖”的枪支。
text.en: ECCN 0A501 includes “parts” and “components” that are not “subject to the ITAR” even though they are common to firearms described in ECCN 0A501 and to those firearms “subject to the ITAR.”

text.zh: 0A501技术注2：
text.en: Technical Note 2 to 0A501:

text.zh: 带有任何其他受管制“零件”或“部件”（如枪管（0A501.c）、扳机护圈（0A501.x）或枪托（0A501.y.1））的机匣，仍受0A501.e管制。
text.en: A receiver with any other controlled “part” or “component” ( e.g., a barrel (0A501.c), or trigger guard (0A501.x), or stock (0A501.y.1)) is still controlled under 0A501.e.

text.zh: 0A501技术注3：
text.en: Technical Note 3 to 0A501:

text.zh: 空包弹射击适配器归为EAR99。该适配器是半自动和自动枪支的附属装置，为安全和正常工作而与空包弹配合使用，用于警察、军队、体育射击人员的枪械训练，也用于电影行业。
text.en: Blank firing adapters, which are attachments to semi-automatic and automatic firearms used in conjunction with blank cartridges for safety and functional reasons and used for firearm training purposes by police, military, sporting shooters, as well as in the movie industry, are designated as EAR99.
Note 6 to 0A501:

text.zh: 古董枪支（即1890年以前制造的枪支）及其仿制品、前装枪和黑火药枪（基于1937年后设计的中心发火武器设计者除外）、BB枪、铅弹气步枪、彩弹枪及所有其他气步枪，均为EAR99商品。
text.en: Antique firearms (i.e., those manufactured before 1890) and reproductions thereof, muzzle loading and black powder firearms except those designs based on centerfire weapons of a post 1937 design, BB guns, pellet rifles, paint ball, and all other air rifles are EAR99 commodities.
Note 7 to 0A501:

text.zh: 1937年后制造、口径小于20毫米、用于狩猎或体育用途、非为军事用途“专门设计”、未在USML中描述且不作为霰弹枪受ECCN 0A502管制的前装枪和黑火药枪，属于EAR99商品。
text.en: Muzzle loading and black powder firearms with a caliber less than 20 mm that were manufactured post 1937 that are used for hunting or sporting purposes that were not “specially designed” for military use and are not described on the USML nor controlled as shotguns under ECCN 0A502 are EAR99 commodities.
Note 8 to 0A501:

text.zh: 受EAR管辖的瞄准镜座或附件导轨、机械瞄具、背带环和枪托底板或后坐垫，归为EAR99。已确定这些商品不再应按ECCN 0A501视为“专门设计”。
text.en: Scope mounts or accessory rails, iron sights, sling swivels, and butt plates or recoil pads that are subject to the EAR are designated as EAR99. These commodities have been determined to no longer warrant being “specially designed” for purposes of ECCN 0A501.
Note 9 to 0A501:

text.zh: 通常成套销售和出口的枪支“零件”或“部件”套件，包括更换或维修套件，按其中管制最严格的“零件”或“部件”分类。例如，含有0A501.y和.x“零件”的套件按0A501.x套件管制，因为.x“零件”是该套件中管制最严格的“零件”。以拆解套件形式提供的完整0A501枪支，按0A501.a、.b或.y.7项下枪支管制。
text.en: A kit, including a replacement or repair kit, of firearms “parts” or “components” customarily sold and exported together takes on the classification of the most restrictive “part” or “component” that is included in the kit. For example, a kit containing 0A501.y and .x “parts,” is controlled as a 0A501.x kit because the .x “part” is the most restrictive “part” included in the kit. A complete 0A501 firearm disassembled in a kit form is controlled as a firearm under 0A501.a, .b, or .y.7.

text.zh: 相关管制：(1) USML所述霰弹枪见USML第I类。(2) 半自动霰弹枪见ECCN 0A508。(3) ECCN 0A508所用、列举或以其他方式描述的“零件”“部件”、装置、“配件”和“附属装置”，见ECCN 0A509。(4) 为0A508“专门设计”的其他“零件”“部件”“配件”和“附属装置”，见0A501.d、.x和.y。(5) 非半自动枪支见ECCN 0A501，半自动步枪见0A506，半自动手枪见0A507。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) See USML Category I for shotguns described therein. (2) See ECCN 0A508 for semi-automatic shotguns. (3) See ECCN 0A509 for enumerated or otherwise described “parts,” “components,” devices, “accessories,” and “attachments” for ECCN 0A508. (4) See 0A501.d, .x, and .y for other “parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” “specially designed” for 0A508. (5) See ECCNs 0A501 for non-semi-automatic firearms, 0A506 for semi-automatic rifles, and 0A507 for semi-automatic pistols.

text.zh: a. 非自动且非半自动的中心发火（非边缘发火）霰弹枪。
text.en: a. Non-automatic and non-semi automatic centerfire (non-rimfire) shotguns.

text.zh: b. 非自动且非半自动的边缘发火霰弹枪。
text.en: b. Non-automatic and non-semi automatic rimfire shotguns.

text.zh: c. 用于本条目.a或.b款、ECCN 0A508或USML第I类管制商品的完整扳机机构（USML另有列举或规定的除外）。
text.en: c. Complete trigger mechanisms for a commodity controlled by paragraph .a or .b of this entry, ECCN 0A508, or USML Category I (unless otherwise enumerated or elsewhere specified on the USML).

text.zh: d. 用于本条目.a或.b款或ECCN 0A508管制商品的弹匣和弹匣延长管。
text.en: d. Magazines and magazine extension tubes for a commodity controlled by paragraph .a or .b of this entry or controlled by ECCN 0A508.

text.zh: e. 用于本条目.a或.b款管制商品的“完整闭锁机构”。
text.en: e. “Complete breech mechanisms” for a commodity controlled by paragraph .a or .b of this entry.
Note 1 to paragraph 0A502.e:

text.zh: 为半自动霰弹枪“专门设计”的机框（机匣）受ECCN 0A509.d管制。
text.en: Frames (receivers) “specially designed” for semi-automatic shotguns are controlled under ECCN 0A509.d.
Note 2 to 0A502:

text.zh: ECCN 0A502不管制用于屠宰家畜或专用于治疗动物、使动物镇静的设备；也不管制专为发射信号、照明弹或鸣礼用途设计的武器。
text.en: ECCN 0A502 does not control equipment used to slaughter domestic animals or used exclusively to treat or tranquilize animals; or arms designed solely for signal, flare, or saluting use.
Note 3 to 0A502:

text.zh: 1898年或以前制造的霰弹枪视为古董霰弹枪，归为EAR99。
text.en: Shotguns made in or before 1898 are considered antique shotguns and designated as EAR99.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 非自动且非半自动的霰弹手枪，或去掉肩托并加装手枪握把的霰弹枪，受ECCN 0A502管制。非自动且非半自动的独头弹枪同样受ECCN 0A502管制。
text.en: Non-automatic and non-semi-automatic shot pistols or shotguns that have had the shoulder stock removed and a pistol grip attached are controlled by ECCN 0A502. Non-automatic and non-semi-automatic slug guns are also controlled under ECCN 0A502.

text.zh: 相关管制：(1) 使用光灵敏度大于350 µA/lm的第二代像增强管，或使用第三代及更高代像增强管且“受ITAR管辖”的瞄准装置，见USML第XII(c)类。(2) “受ITAR管辖”的激光瞄准或激光照明系统，见USML第XII(b)类。(3) 根据EAR §744.9，0A504所述某些商品如出口、再出口或境内转移供军事最终用户使用，或用于装入ECCN 0A919管制物项，须取得许可证。

text.en: f. Laser aiming devices or laser illuminators “specially designed” for use on firearms, and having an operational wavelength exceeding 400 nm but not exceeding 710 nm.

text.en: 0A504.f does not control laser boresighting devices that must be placed in the bore or chamber to provide a reference for aligning the firearms sights.

text.en: i. Riflescopes that were not “subject to the EAR” as of March 8, 2020 and are “specially designed” for use in firearms that are “subject to the ITAR.”

text.zh: i款注2：

text.zh: 就0A504.i管制步枪瞄准镜适用“专门设计”而言，应依据EAR §772.1“专门设计”定义的(a)(1)款，确定该步枪瞄准镜是否属于“专门设计”。
text.en: For purpose of the application of “specially designed” for the riflescopes controlled under 0A504.i, paragraph (a)(1) of the definition of “specially designed” in § 772.1 of the EAR is what is used to determine whether the riflescope is “specially designed.”

text.zh: 相关管制：(1) 榴弹炮、火炮、大炮、迫击炮和无后坐力炮等现代重型武器的弹药，以及固有军事用途弹药（如预先装入弹链或弹带的弹药、无壳弹、曳光弹、带有贫铀弹丸或硬化弹尖/弹芯的弹药及带爆炸弹丸的弹药），见USML第III类。(2) 用于前装枪支的击发帽、铅丸和弹头属于EAR99物项。(3) 箭形、燃烧、曳光或爆炸性霰弹枪弹丸，见USML第III类。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) See USML Category III for ammunition for modern heavy weapons such as howitzers, artillery, cannon, mortars and recoilless rifles as well as inherently military ammunition types such as ammunition preassembled into links or belts, caseless ammunition, tracer ammunition, ammunition with a depleted uranium projectile or a projectile with a hardened tip or core and ammunition with an explosive projectile. (2) Percussion caps, and lead balls and bullets, for use with muzzle-loading firearms are EAR99 items. (3) See USML Category III for shotgun projectiles that are flechettes, incendiary, tracer, or explosive.

text.zh: 相关定义：‘标记弹’为非致命弹药，通常用于训练，其胶囊内装有不属于化学刺激剂的染料或涂料。
text.en: Related Definitions: 'Marking rounds' are non-lethal, typically used for training purposes, and contain a dye or paint in a capsule that is not a chemical irritant.

text.zh: 物项：
text.en: Items:

text.zh: a. 用于ECCN 0A501、0A506或0A507或USML第I类管制枪支，且未在本条目.b、.c或.d款列举或USML第III类描述的弹药。
text.en: a. Ammunition for firearms controlled by ECCNs 0A501, 0A506, or 0A507 or USML Category I and not enumerated in paragraph .b, .c, or .d of this entry or described in USML Category III.

text.zh: b. 鹿弹霰弹枪弹（4号、直径0.24英寸及以上，任何材料），以及仅装鹿弹或用于散布化学刺激剂的霰弹枪弹。
text.en: b. Buckshot (No. 4 .24” diameter and larger, any material) shotgun shells and shotgun shells that contain only buckshot, or are for the dispersion of chemical irritants.

text.zh: c. 不含鹿弹的霰弹枪弹（包括较低致命性弹药）；以及霰弹枪弹的“专门设计”的“零件”和“部件”。
text.en: c. Shotgun shells (including less than lethal rounds) that do not contain buckshot; and “specially designed” “parts” and “components” of shotgun shells.

text.zh: d. 用于ECCN 0A501、0A502、0A506、0A507或0A508管制枪支，且未在USML第III类描述的空包弹。
text.en: d. Blank ammunition for firearms controlled by ECCNs 0A501, 0A502, 0A506, 0A507, or 0A508 and not described in USML Category III.

text.zh: 0A505.d技术注：
text.en: Technical Note to 0A505.d:

text.zh: 包括以涂料/染料为弹丸的‘标记弹’。
text.en: Includes 'marking rounds' that have paint/dye as the projectile.

text.zh: e.至w. [保留]
text.en: e. through w. [Reserved]

text.zh: x. 为本ECCN管制商品或USML第III类防务物品“专门设计”，且USML或CCL未在其他处规定的“零件”和“部件”。
text.en: x. “Parts” and “components” that are “specially designed” for a commodity subject to control in this ECCN or a defense article in USML Category III and not elsewhere specified on the USML or the CCL.
Note 1 to 0A505.x:

text.zh: 本条目对“零件”和“部件”的管制包括伯丹式和博克瑟式底火、金属弹壳以及标准金属弹丸，例如全金属被甲弹、铅芯弹、铜弹丸和易碎弹丸。
text.en: The controls on “parts” and “components” in this entry include Berdan and boxer primers, metallic cartridge cases, and standard metallic projectiles such as full metal jacket, lead core, copper projectiles, and frangible projectiles.
Note 2 to 0A505:

text.zh: 小于4号鹿弹的金属弹丸、未装填且未装底火的霰弹枪弹壳、霰弹枪弹托、无烟火药、‘假弹’和‘训练弹’（已连接成弹链或弹带者除外），如不含致命或非致命弹丸，归为EAR99。‘假弹’或‘训练弹’是完全惰性的弹药（即不含底火、发射药或爆炸装药），通常用于检查武器功能及人员训练。
text.en: Metal shot smaller than No. 4 Buckshot, empty and unprimed shotgun shells, shotgun wads, smokeless gunpowder, 'dummy rounds' and 'drill rounds' (unless linked or belted), not incorporating a lethal or non-lethal projectile(s) are designated EAR99. A 'dummy round' or 'drill round' is a round that is completely inert, (i.e., contains no primer, propellant, or explosive charge). It is typically used to check weapon function and for crew training.
Note 3 to 0A505:

text.zh: 含有两颗或以上、尺寸大于0.24英寸的球形弹丸/霰弹的霰弹枪弹，受0A505.b管制。
text.en: Shotgun shells that contain two or more balls/shot larger than .24-inch are controlled under 0A505.b.

text.zh: 相关管制：(1) 全自动枪支及容量超过50发的弹匣，见USML第I类。(2) 半自动手枪见ECCN 0A507，但使用例如AR式或AK式机匣（机框）构成的手枪除外，此类手枪受ECCN 0A506管制。(3) 半自动霰弹枪见ECCN 0A508；不受0A509.a或.c管制的半自动霰弹枪某些“零件”和“部件”，见ECCN 0A502。(4) ECCN 0A506、0A507和0A508所用、列举或以其他方式描述的“零件”“部件”、装置、“配件”和“附属装置”，见ECCN 0A509。(5) 为0A506、0A507或0A508“专门设计”的其他“零件”“部件”“配件”和“附属装置”，见0A501.c、.d、.x和.y。(6) 受EAR管辖的非半自动枪支（0A502霰弹枪除外）及相关商品，见ECCN 0A501。(7) 受EAR管辖的非自动霰弹枪及其“零件”和“部件”，以及不受0A509.a或.c管制的半自动霰弹枪某些“零件”和“部件”，见ECCN 0A502。(8) 光学瞄准装置的管制见ECCN 0A504和USML第XII类。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) See USML Category I for firearms that are fully automatic, and magazines with a capacity of greater than 50 rounds. (2) See ECCN 0A507 for semi-automatic pistols, excluding pistols built with, e.g., AR- or AK-style receivers (frames), which are controlled under ECCN 0A506. (3) See ECCN 0A508 for semi-automatic shotguns and ECCN 0A502 for certain “parts” and “components” for semi-automatic shotguns that are not controlled by 0A509.a or .c. (4) See ECCN 0A509 for enumerated or otherwise described “parts,” “components,” devices, “accessories,” and “attachments” for ECCNs 0A506, 0A507, and 0A508. (5) See 0A501.c, .d, .x, and .y for other “parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” “specially designed” for 0A506 and 0A507, or 0A508. (6) See ECCN 0A501 for non-semi-automatic firearms (except 0A502 shotguns) and related commodities that are subject to the EAR. (7) See ECCN 0A502 for non-automatic shotguns and their “parts” and “components” that are subject to the EAR and certain “parts” and “components” for semi-automatic shotguns that are not controlled by 0A509.a or .c. (8) See ECCN 0A504 and USML Category XII for controls on optical sighting devices.

text.en: a. Semi-automatic centerfire (non-rimfire) rifles equal to .50 caliber (12.7 mm) or less.

text.en: b. Semi-automatic rimfire rifles equal to .50 caliber (12.7 mm) or less.

text.en: “Parts” and “components” that are “specially designed” for a commodity classified under .a or .b of this entry, except those controlled under ECCN 0A509, are controlled under ECCN 0A501.c, .d, .x, or .y.

text.en: Firearms described in 0A506 include those chambered for the .50 BMG cartridge.

text.en: Firearms described in 0A506 include pistols built with, e.g., AR- or AK-style receivers (frames).

text.zh: 相关管制：(1) 全自动枪支及容量超过50发的弹匣，见USML第I类。(2) 半自动步枪见ECCN 0A506。(3) 半自动手枪见ECCN 0A507。(4) 半自动霰弹枪见ECCN 0A508；不受本条目.a或.c款管制的半自动霰弹枪某些“零件”和“部件”，见ECCN 0A502。(5) 为0A506、0A507或0A508“专门设计”的其他“零件”“部件”“配件”和“附属装置”，见ECCN 0A501.c、.d、.x和.y。(6) 受EAR管辖的非半自动枪支（0A502霰弹枪除外）及相关商品，见ECCN 0A501。(7) 受EAR管辖的非自动霰弹枪及其“零件”和“部件”，以及不受本条目.a或.d款管制的半自动霰弹枪某些“零件”和“部件”，见ECCN 0A502。(8) 光学瞄准装置的管制见ECCN 0A504和USML第XII类。(9) 类似物项见USML第I类。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) See USML Category I for firearms that are fully automatic, and magazines with a capacity of greater than 50 rounds. (2) See ECCN 0A506 for semi-automatic rifles. (3) See ECCN 0A507 for semi-automatic pistols. (4) See ECCN 0A508 for semi-automatic shotguns and ECCN 0A502 for certain “parts” and “components” for semi-automatic shotguns that are not controlled by .a or .c of this entry. (5) See ECCN 0A501.c, .d, .x, and .y for other “parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” “specially designed” for 0A506 and 0A507, or 0A508. (6) See ECCN 0A501 for non-semi-automatic firearms (except 0A502 shotguns) and related commodities that are subject to the EAR. (7) See ECCN 0A502 for non-automatic shotguns and their “parts” and “components” that are subject to the EAR and certain “parts” and “components” for semi-automatic shotguns that are not controlled by .a or .d of this entry. (8) See ECCN 0A504 and USML Category XII for controls on optical sighting devices. (9) See USML Category I for similar items.

text.en: Related Definitions: N/A

text.zh: 物项：
text.en: Items:

text.zh: a. USML未在其他处规定，且设计用于或具备以下功能的任何“零件”“部件”、装置、“附属装置”或“配件”：将0A501或0A502管制的非半自动枪支转换为半自动枪支，或提高0A506、0A507或0A508管制半自动枪支的射速。
text.en: a. Any “part,” “component,” device, “attachment,” or “accessory” not elsewhere specified on the USML that is designed or functions to convert a non-semi-automatic firearm controlled by 0A501 or 0A502 to semi-automatic or to accelerate the rate of fire of a semi-automatic firearm controlled by 0A506, 0A507, or 0A508.

text.zh: b. 为ECCN 0A506管制物项“专门设计”的机匣（机框），包括其铸件、锻件、冲压件或机加工件。
text.en: b. Receivers (frames), including castings, forgings, stampings, or machined items thereof, “specially designed” for an item controlled by ECCN 0A506.

text.zh: c. 为ECCN 0A507管制物项“专门设计”的机匣（机框），包括其铸件、锻件、冲压件或机加工件。
text.en: c. Receivers (frames), including castings, forgings, stampings, or machined items thereof, “specially designed” for an item controlled by ECCN 0A507.

text.zh: d. 用于ECCN 0A508管制商品的机匣（机框）及“专门设计”的“完整闭锁机构”。
text.en: d. Receivers (frames) and “specially designed” “complete breech mechanisms” for a commodity controlled by ECCN 0A508.
Note 1 to 0A509.b and .c:

text.zh: 0A509.b和.c所指机匣（机框），是指枪支上依法须标记序列号时具有或通常标有序列号的任何“零件”或“部件”。0A509.b和.c款所指物项，与酒精、烟草、火器和爆炸物管理局作为枪支管理的“零件”或“部件”同义（见《美国法典》第18编第921(a)(3)条；《联邦法规》第27编第447、478和479部分）。就0A509.c而言，机匣（机框）包括法律上作为枪支的底架“部件”（即在现代手枪中，底架本身即为标记序列号的枪支）。
text.en: Receivers (frames) under 0A509.b and .c refers to any “part” or “component” of the firearm that has or is customarily marked with a serial number when required by law. Paragraph 0A509.b and .c are synonymous with a “part” or “component” that is regulated by the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives (see 18 U.S.C. 921(a)(3); 27 CFR parts 447, 478, and 479,) as a firearm. For 0A509.c, receivers (frames) includes chassis “components” that serve as the legal firearm ( i.e., with modern pistols, the chassis itself is the serialized firearm).

text.en: Engines that are “specially designed” for a self-propelled gun or howitzer subject to control under paragraph .a of this ECCN or a defense article in USML Category VII are controlled under ECCN 0A606.x.

text.zh: 相关管制：(1) 鱼雷、炸弹和地雷“受ITAR管辖”（见《联邦法规》第22编§121.1，USML第IV类）。(2) 兼有军事和商业用途的烟幕弹、非刺激性发烟信号弹、发烟罐、手榴弹、装药和其他烟火制品，受ECCN 1A984管制。(3) 某些爆炸雷管起爆装置、电驱动爆炸雷管，以及雷管和多点起爆系统，受ECCN 1A007或ECCN 3A232管制。(4) 含有超过最低比例门槛的美国原产“600系列”受管制内容的外国制造“军事商品”，见ECCN 0A919。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) Torpedoes, bombs, and mines are “subject to the ITAR” (see 22 CFR § 121.1, USML Category IV). (2) Smoke bombs, non-irritant smoke flares, canisters, grenades and charges, and other pyrotechnical articles having both military and commercial applications are controlled by ECCN 1A984. (3) Certain explosive detonator firing sets, electrically driven explosive detonators, and detonators and multipoint initiation systems are controlled by ECCN 1A007 or ECCN 3A232. (4) See ECCN 0A919 for foreign-made “military commodities” that incorporate more than a de minimis amount of U.S.-origin “600 series” controlled content.

text.zh: 受管制物项清单
text.en: List of Items Controlled

text.zh: 相关管制：(1) 《联邦法规》第22编第121部分第VII类所述地面车辆、其他物品、技术数据（包括软件）和服务，受《国际武器贸易条例》管辖。(2) 含有超过最低比例门槛的美国原产“600系列”受管制内容的外国制造“军事商品”，见ECCN 0A919。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) The ground vehicles, other articles, technical data (including software) and services described in 22 CFR part 121, Category VII are subject to the jurisdiction of the International Traffic in Arms Regulations. (2) See ECCN 0A919 for foreign-made “military commodities” that incorporate more than a de minimis amount of U.S.-origin “600 series” controlled content.

text.zh: 相关定义：不适用
text.en: Related Definitions: N/A

text.zh: 物项：
text.en: Items:

text.zh: a. 为军事用途“专门设计”，且未在USML第VII类列举或以其他方式描述的地面车辆，无论有人驾驶还是无人驾驶。
text.en: a. Ground vehicles, whether manned or unmanned, “specially designed” for a military use and not enumerated or otherwise described in USML Category VII.

text.zh: a款注1：
text.en: Note 1 to paragraph a:

text.zh: 就a款而言，“地面车辆”包括：(i) 1956年之前制造、1955年以后未改装，且不含可正常使用武器或经维修即可恢复使用武器的坦克和装甲车辆；(ii) 军用铁路列车，但已武装或为发射导弹“专门设计”者除外；(iii) 非装甲军用抢救车辆和其他支援车辆；(iv) 非装甲、无武装、带有0.50口径或以下枪支安装座或挂点的车辆；以及(v) 为配合USML第VII类或ECCN 0A606.a列举的其他地面车辆使用而“专门设计”，且未在USML第VII类单独列举或以其他方式描述的拖车。就本注而言，“改装”不包括加装法律要求的安全设施、外观变更（如改换涂漆或调整螺栓孔位置），或加装1956年以前已有的“零件”或“部件”。
text.en: For purposes of paragraph a, “ground vehicles” include (i) tanks and armored vehicles manufactured prior to 1956 that have not been modified since 1955 and that do not contain a functional weapon or a weapon capable of becoming functional through repair; (ii) military railway trains except those that are armed or are “specially designed” to launch missiles; (iii) unarmored military recovery and other support vehicles; (iv) unarmored, unarmed vehicles with mounts or hard points for firearms of .50 caliber or less; and (v) trailers “specially designed” for use with other ground vehicles enumerated in USML Category VII or ECCN 0A606.a, and not separately enumerated or otherwise described in USML Category VII. For purposes of this note, the term “modified” does not include incorporation of safety features required by law, cosmetic changes (e.g., different paint or repositioning of bolt holes) or addition of “parts” or “components” available prior to 1956.

text.zh: a款注2：
text.en: Note 2 to paragraph a:

text.zh: 为确定.a款管制，地面车辆为军事用途“专门设计”，是指其结构、电气或机械特征涉及一个或多个为军事用途“专门设计”的“部件”。这些“部件”包括：
text.en: A ground vehicle's being “specially designed” for military use for purposes of determining controls under paragraph .a. entails a structural, electrical or mechanical feature involving one or more “components” that are “specially designed” for military use. Such “components” include:

text.zh: a. “专门设计”为防弹型的充气轮胎外胎；
text.en: a. Pneumatic tire casings of a kind “specially designed” to be bullet-proof;

text.zh: b. 对重要“零件”（如油箱或驾驶室）的装甲防护；
text.en: b. Armored protection of vital “parts” (e.g., fuel tanks or vehicle cabs);

text.zh: c. 武器专用加固结构或安装座；
text.en: c. Special reinforcements or mountings for weapons;

text.zh: d. 灯火管制照明装置。
text.en: d. Black-out lighting.

text.zh: b. 下列其他地面车辆、“零件”和“部件”：
text.en: b. Other ground vehicles, “parts” and “components,” as follows:

text.zh: b.1. 由民用车辆衍生并具有以下所有特征的无武装车辆：
text.en: b.1. Unarmed vehicles that are derived from civilian vehicles and that have all of the following:

text.zh: b.1.a. 使用或加装反应式或电磁装甲以外的材料或“部件”，以提供等于或优于III级（美国国家司法研究所标准0108.01，1985年9月）或“同等标准”的弹道防护；
text.en: b.1.a. Manufactured or fitted with materials or “components” other than reactive or electromagnetic armor to provide ballistic protection equal to or better than level III (National Institute of Justice standard 0108.01, September 1985) or “equivalent standards”;

text.zh: b.1.b. 配有同时驱动前后轮的传动系统，包括为承载而增设车轮的车辆，无论该附加车轮是否驱动；
text.en: b.1.b. A transmission to provide drive to both front and rear wheels simultaneously, including those for vehicles having additional wheels for load bearing purposes whether driven or not;

text.zh: b.1.c. 车辆额定总质量（GVWR）大于4,500千克；以及
text.en: b.1.c. Gross vehicle weight rating (GVWR) greater than 4,500 kg; and

text.zh: b.1.d. 为越野使用而设计或改装。
text.en: b.1.d. Designed or modified for off-road use.

text.zh: b.2. 具有以下所有特征的“零件”和“部件”：
text.en: b.2. “Parts” and “components” having all of the following:

text.zh: b.2.a. 为本条目.b.1款规定的车辆“专门设计”；以及
text.en: b.2.a. “Specially designed” for vehicles specified in paragraph .b.1 of this entry; and

text.zh: b.2.b. 提供等于或优于III级（美国国家司法研究所标准0108.01，1985年9月）或“同等标准”的弹道防护。
text.en: b.2.b. Providing ballistic protection equal to or better than level III (National Institute of Justice standard 0108.01, September 1985) or “equivalent standards”.

text.zh: b款注1：
text.en: Note 1 to paragraph b:

text.zh: 原本受0A606.b.1管制、但含有反应式或电磁装甲的地面车辆，受USML第VII类管制。
text.en: Ground vehicles otherwise controlled by 0A606.b.1 that contain reactive or electromagnetic armor are subject to the controls of USML Category VII.

text.zh: b款注2：
text.en: Note 2 to paragraph b:

text.zh: ECCN 0A606.b.1不管制为运输现金或贵重物品“专门设计”的民用车辆。
text.en: ECCN 0A606.b.1 does not control civilian vehicles “specially designed” for transporting money or valuables.

text.zh: b款注3：
text.en: Note 3 to paragraph b:

text.zh: “无武装”是指未安装武器、武器安装座或为武器安装座设置的专用加固结构。
text.en: “Unarmed” means not having installed weapons, installed mountings for weapons, or special reinforcements for mounts for weapons.

text.zh: c. 用于重量超过40吨装甲车辆的风冷柴油发动机及发动机缸体。
text.en: c. Air-cooled diesel engines and engine blocks for armored vehicles that weigh more than 40 tons.

text.zh: d. 用于履带式战斗车辆的全自动无级变速器。
text.en: d. Fully automatic continuously variable transmissions for tracked combat vehicles.

text.zh: e. 为ECCN 0A606.a或USML第VII类管制地面车辆“专门设计”的深水涉渡套件。
text.en: e. Deep water fording kits “specially designed” for ground vehicles controlled by ECCN 0A606.a or USML Category VII.

text.zh: f. 未在USML第VII(g)类列举，为由USML第VII类或本ECCN列举地面车辆部署而“专门设计”的自行架设桥梁“部件”。
text.en: f. Self-launching bridge “components” not enumerated in USML Category VII(g) “specially designed” for deployment by ground vehicles enumerated in USML Category VII or this ECCN.

text.zh: g.至w. [保留]
text.en: g. through w. [Reserved]

text.zh: x. 为ECCN 0A606（0A606.b或0A606.y除外）列举或以其他方式描述的商品，或USML第VII类列举的防务物品“专门设计”，且USML其他处或0A606.y未规定的“零件”“部件”“配件”和“附属装置”。
text.en: x. “Parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” that are “specially designed” for a commodity enumerated or otherwise described in ECCN 0A606 (other than 0A606.b or 0A606.y) or a defense article enumerated in USML Category VII and not elsewhere specified on the USML or in 0A606.y.
Note 1:

text.zh: 锻件、铸件及其他未完成制品（如挤压件和机加工坯体），如制造进度已达到可根据机械性能、材料组成、几何形状或功能明确识别为ECCN 0A606.x管制商品的阶段，受ECCN 0A606.x管制。
text.en: Forgings, castings, and other unfinished products, such as extrusions and machined bodies, that have reached a stage in manufacture where they are clearly identifiable by mechanical properties, material composition, geometry, or function as commodities controlled by ECCN 0A606.x are controlled by ECCN 0A606.x.
Note 2:

text.zh: USML第VII(g)款列举的“零件”“部件”“配件”和“附属装置”，受该款管制。ECCN 0A606.y所述“零件”“部件”“配件”和“附属装置”，受该款管制。
text.en: “Parts,” “components,” “accessories” and “attachments” enumerated in USML paragraph VII(g) are subject to the controls of that paragraph. “Parts,” “components,” “accessories” and “attachments” described in ECCN 0A606.y are subject to the controls of that paragraph.

text.zh: y. 为本ECCN（ECCN 0A606.b除外）列举或以其他方式描述的商品，或USML第VII类防务物品“专门设计”，且USML或CCL未在其他处规定的下列特定“零件”“部件”“配件”和“附属装置”，以及为其“专门设计”的“零件”“部件”“配件”和“附属装置”：
text.en: y. Specific “parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” “specially designed” for a commodity enumerated or otherwise described in this ECCN (other than ECCN 0A606.b) or for a defense article in USML Category VII and not elsewhere specified on the USML or the CCL, as follows, and “parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” “specially designed” therefor:

text.zh: y.1. 制动盘、转子、制动鼓、制动钳、制动缸、制动片、制动蹄、管路、软管、真空助力器及其零件；
text.en: y.1. Brake discs, rotors, drums, calipers, cylinders, pads, shoes, lines, hoses, vacuum boosters, and parts therefor;

text.zh: y.2. 交流发电机和发电机；
text.en: y.2. Alternators and generators;

text.zh: y.3. 车轴；
text.en: y.3. Axles;

text.zh: y.4. 蓄电池；
text.en: y.4. Batteries;

text.zh: y.5. 轴承（如球轴承、滚子轴承、轮毂轴承）；
text.en: y.5. Bearings (e.g., ball, roller, wheel);

text.zh: y.6. 电缆、电缆组件和连接器；
text.en: y.6. Cables, cable assembles, and connectors;

text.zh: y.7. 冷却系统软管；
text.en: y.7. Cooling system hoses;

text.zh: y.8. 不受ECCN 1A004管制的液压、燃油、机油和空气滤清器；
text.en: y.8. Hydraulic, fuel, oil, and air filters, not controlled by ECCN 1A004;

text.zh: y.9. 垫片和O形密封圈；
text.en: y.9. Gaskets and o-rings;

text.zh: y.10. 液压系统软管、管件、联接件、适配器和阀门；
text.en: y.10. Hydraulic system hoses, fittings, couplings, adapters, and valves;

text.zh: y.11. 锁扣和铰链；
text.en: y.11. Latches and hinges;

text.zh: y.12. 照明系统、熔断器和“部件”；

text.zh: 相关管制：(1) USML第XIII类管制的防务物品（如依据保密信息制成的材料）及其直接相关技术数据（包括软件），受ITAR管辖。(2) 含有超过最低比例门槛的美国原产“600系列”受管制内容的外国制造“军事商品”，见ECCN 0A919。(3) 自携式潜水和水下游泳装置及相关商品的管制，见ECCN 8A620.f。(4) 机器人、机器人控制器和机器人末端执行器的管制，见USML第VII类及ECCN 0A606和2B007。(5) 为军事用途而与USML或“600系列”ECCN管制设备配合使用所“专门设计”的“数据库”（即参数化技术数据库），受适用于相应物项的技术数据和技术管制。(6) 为军事用途“专门设计”的核发电设备或推进设备（包括“核反应堆”）及为其“专门设计”的“零件”和“部件”的管制，见USML第VI、XIII、XV和XX类。(7) 为军用“核反应堆”“专门设计”的模拟器，受USML第IX(b)类管制。(8) 为军事用途“专门设计”的“激光”防护设备（如眼睛和传感器防护），见USML第X、XI和XII类。(9) 为USML中的防务物品或“600系列”ECCN管制商品“专门设计”的“燃料电池”，按相应最终产品所属的“600系列”ECCN管制。(10) 为卫星或航天器“专门设计”的燃料电池管制，见USML第XV类。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) Defense articles, such as materials made from classified information, that are controlled by USML Category XIII, and technical data (including software) directly related thereto, are subject to the ITAR. (2) See ECCN 0A919 for foreign-made “military commodities” that incorporate more than a de minimis amount of U.S.-origin “600 series” controlled content. (3) For controls on self-contained diving and underwater swimming apparatus and related commodities, see ECCN 8A620.f. (4) For controls on robots, robot controllers, and robot end-effectors, see USML Category VII and ECCNs 0A606 and 2B007. (5) “Libraries,” i.e., parametric technical databases, “specially designed” for military use with equipment controlled by the USML or a “600 series” ECCN are controlled by the technical data and technology controls pertaining to such items. (6) For controls on nuclear power generating equipment or propulsion equipment, including “nuclear reactors,” “specially designed” for military use, and “parts” and “components” “specially designed” therefor, see USML Categories VI, XIII, XV, and XX. (7) Simulators “specially designed” for military “nuclear reactors” are controlled by USML Category IX(b). (8) See USML Categories X, XI and XII for “laser” protection equipment (e.g., eye and sensor protection) “specially designed” for military use. (9) “Fuel cells” “specially designed” for a defense article on the USML or a commodity controlled by a “600 series” ECCN are controlled according to the corresponding “600 series” ECCN for such end items. (10) See USML Category XV for controls on fuel cells “specially designed” for satellite or spacecraft.

text.en: b. Concealment and deception equipment “specially designed” for military application, including special paints, decoys, smoke or obscuration equipment and simulators, and “parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” “specially designed” therefor, not controlled by USML Category XIII.

text.zh: c. 为军事用途“专门设计”的渡船、ECCN 0A606或USML第VII类未描述的桥梁及浮桥舟。
text.en: c. Ferries, bridges not described in ECCN 0A606 or USML Category VII, and pontoons, “specially designed” for military use.

text.zh: d. 为“开发”USML第IV、VI、VII和VIII类管制防务物品而“专门设计”的试验模型。
text.en: d. Test models “specially designed” for the “development” of defense articles controlled by USML Categories IV, VI, VII and VIII.

text.en: f. “Metal embrittlement agents.”

text.zh: y. 下列其他商品，以及为其“专门设计”的“零件”“部件”“配件”和“附属装置”：
text.en: y. Other commodities as follows, and “parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” “specially designed” therefore:

text.zh: y.1. 为军事用途“专门设计”的施工设备，包括为由USML VIII(a)或ECCN 9A610.a管制航空器运输而“专门设计”的此类设备。
text.en: y.1. Construction equipment “specially designed” for military use, including such equipment “specially designed” for transport in aircraft controlled by USML VIII(a) or ECCN 9A610.a.

text.zh: y.2. 为本条目.y.1款商品“专门设计”的“零件”“部件”“配件”和“附属装置”，包括用作防护驾驶室的乘员防护套件。
text.en: y.2. “Parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” “specially designed” for commodities in paragraph .y.1 of this entry, including crew protection kits used as protective cabs.

text.zh: y.3. 为运输或包装防务物品或“600系列”ECCN管制物项而“专门设计”或‘改装’、未在其他处规定的ISO联运集装箱或可拆卸车辆箱体（即交换箱体）。
text.en: y.3. ISO intermodal containers or demountable vehicle bodies (i.e., swap bodies), n.e.s., “specially designed” or 'modified' for shipping or packing defense articles or items controlled by a “600 series” ECCN.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就0A617.y.3而言，‘改装’是指任何结构、电气、机械或其他变化，使非军事物项具备相当于为军事用途“专门设计”物项的军事能力。
text.en: For the purpose of 0A617.y.3, 'modified' means any structural, electrical, mechanical, or other change that provides a non-military item with military capabilities equivalent to an item which is “specially designed” for military use.

text.zh: y.4. 为军事用途“专门设计”的野战发电机。
text.en: y.4. Field generators “specially designed” for military use.

text.zh: y.5. 为军事用途“专门设计”的动力控制探照灯及其控制单元，以及安装此类单元的“设备”。
text.en: y.5. Power controlled searchlights and control units therefor, “specially designed” for military use, and “equipment” mounting such units.

text.zh: 相关管制：(1) “军事商品”如含有受《国际武器贸易条例》（ITAR，《联邦法规》第22编第120—130部分）管辖的物项，即受国务院出口许可管辖。(2) 本款所述“军事商品”如列于《美国军品清单》（《联邦法规》第22编第121部分）并位于美国境内，即受国务院出口许可管辖。(3) 无论在美国境内或境外，就受ITAR管辖防务物品的设计、开发、工程、制造、生产、组装、测试、修理、维护、改装、操作、非军事化、销毁、加工或使用向外国人提供协助（包括培训），或向外国人提供受《联邦法规》第22编§121.1管制的任何技术数据，均属国务院许可管辖。(4) 对受ITAR管辖“军事商品”开展的经纪活动（定义见《联邦法规》第22编第129部分），属国务院许可管辖。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) “Military commodities” are subject to the export licensing jurisdiction of the Department of State if they incorporate items that are subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) (22 CFR parts 120-130). (2) “Military commodities” described in this paragraph are subject to the export licensing jurisdiction of the Department of State if such commodities are described on the U.S. Munitions List (22 CFR part 121) and are in the United States. (3) The furnishing of assistance (including training) to foreign persons, whether in the United States or abroad, in the design, development, engineering, manufacture, production, assembly, testing, repair, maintenance, modification, operation, demilitarization, destruction, processing, or use of defense articles that are subject to the ITAR; or the furnishing to foreign persons of any technical data controlled under 22 CFR 121.1 whether in the United States or abroad are under the licensing jurisdiction of the Department of State. (4) Brokering activities (as defined in 22 CFR 129) of “military commodities” that are subject to the ITAR are under the licensing jurisdiction of the Department of State.

text.zh: 相关定义：“军事商品”是指《美国军品清单》（《联邦法规》第22编第121部分）或《常规武器和两用物品及技术出口管制瓦森纳安排》公布的军品清单（即瓦森纳安排军品清单，WAML）所述物品、材料或物资，但不包括软件、技术、列于末三位数字为018的任何ECCN中的物项，或任何“600系列”物项。
text.en: Related Definitions: “Military commodity” or “military commodities” means an article, material or supply that is described on the U.S. Munitions List (22 CFR part 121) or on the Munitions List that is published by the Wassenaar Arrangement on Export Controls for Conventional Arms and Dual-Use Goods and Technologies (i.e., the Wassenaar Arrangement Munitions List (WAML)), but does not include software, technology, any item listed in any ECCN for which the last three numerals are 018, or any item in the “600 series.”

text.zh: 物项：
text.en: Items:

text.zh: a. 在美国境外生产并位于美国境外、不受《国际武器贸易条例》（《联邦法规》第22编第120—130部分）管辖，且具有以下任一特征的“军事商品”：
text.en: a. “Military commodities” produced and located outside the United States that are not subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (22 CFR parts 120-130) and having any of the following characteristics:

text.zh: a.1. 含有超过最低比例门槛的美国原产受管制内容，该内容分类于ECCN 6A002、6A003或6A993.a（最大帧频等于或小于9 Hz，因而符合6A003.b.4注3.a的标准）；
text.en: a.1. Incorporate more than a de minimis amount of U.S.-origin controlled content classified under ECCNs 6A002, 6A003, or 6A993.a (having a maximum frame rate equal to or less than 9 Hz and thus meeting the criterion of Note 3.a to 6A003.b.4);

text.zh: a.2. 含有超过最低比例门槛的美国原产“600系列”受管制内容（见EAR §734.4）；或

text.zh: b.2. 水力压裂‘支撑剂’、‘压裂液’及其化学添加剂。
text.en: b.2. Hydraulic fracturing 'proppant,' 'fracking fluid,' and chemical additives therefor.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: ‘支撑剂’是一种固体材料，通常为经处理的砂或人造陶瓷材料，设计用于在压裂处理期间或之后保持诱导产生的水力裂缝开启。其加入‘压裂液’中；压裂液的组成可随压裂类型变化，可以凝胶、泡沫或滑溜水为基础。
text.en: A 'proppant' is a solid material, typically treated sand or man-made ceramic materials, designed to keep an induced hydraulic fracture open, during or following a fracturing treatment. It is added to a 'fracking fluid' which may vary in composition depending on the type of fracturing used, and can be gel, foam or slickwater-based.

text.zh: b.3. 高压泵。
text.en: b.3. High pressure pumps.

title.zh: 受EAR管辖且未在CCL其他处列明，但因至少能够使美国获得重大军事或情报优势，或因外交政策原因而实施出口管制的任何技术。
title.en: Any technology subject to the EAR that is not listed elsewhere in the CCL, but which is controlled for export because it provides at least a significant military or intelligence advantage to the United States or for foreign policy reasons.

text.zh: 0E521 受EAR管辖且未在CCL其他处列明，但因至少能够使美国获得重大军事或情报优势，或因外交政策原因而实施出口管制的任何技术。
text.en: 0E521 Any technology subject to the EAR that is not listed elsewhere in the CCL, but which is controlled for export because it provides at least a significant military or intelligence advantage to the United States or for foreign policy reasons.

text.zh: 0E521技术受RS1管制，除EAR §740.11(b)(2)(ii)针对美国政府人员和机构的GOV许可证例外，或第774部分补充文件第5号针对ECCN 0E521所涵盖特定物项列明的物项专属许可证例外外，不具备其他许可证例外资格。确定归入ECCN 0E521管制的技术清单公布于第774部分补充文件第5号。ECCN 0E521相关许可要求和许可政策见EAR §742.6(a)(8)。
text.en: 0E521 technology is subject to RS1 controls with no license exception eligibility other than License Exception GOV for U.S. Government personnel and agencies under § 740.11(b)(2)(ii) of the EAR, or an item-specific license exception identified in Supplement No. 5 to part 774 particular to an item covered under ECCN 0E521. The list of technologies determined to be classified under ECCN 0E521 controls is published in Supplement No. 5 to part 774. The license requirements and licensing policy relating to ECCN 0E521 are set forth in § 742.6(a)(8) of the EAR.

text.zh: 相关管制：(1) 本条目管制物项的技术见ECCN 1E001（“开发”和“生产”）及1E201（“使用”）。(2) 另见ECCN 1A202、1C010、1C210、9A010和9A110。(3) 为导弹应用“专门设计”的“复合材料”结构（包括“专门设计”的子系统、“零件”和“部件”），受ECCN 9A110管制。(4) 为分离铀同位素而“专门设计”或制备的“复合材料”结构或层压制品，受核管理委员会出口许可权限管辖（见《联邦法规》第10编第110部分）。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) See ECCNs 1E001 (“development” and “production”) and 1E201 (“use”) for technology for items controlled by this entry. (2) Also see ECCNs 1A202, 1C010, 1C210, 9A010, and 9A110. (3) “Composite” structures “specially designed” for missile applications (including “specially designed” subsystems, “parts,” and “components”) are controlled by ECCN 9A110. (4) “Composite” structures or laminates “specially designed” or prepared for use in separating uranium isotopes are subject to the export licensing authority of the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (see 10 CFR part 110).

text.zh: 相关定义：不适用
text.en: Related Definitions: N/A

text.zh: 物项：
text.en: Items:

text.zh: a. 由以下任一种材料制成：
text.en: a. Made from any of the following:

text.zh: a.1. 有机“基体”及1C010.c或1C010.d规定的“纤维或丝状材料”；或
text.en: a.1. An organic “matrix” and “fibrous or filamentary materials” specified by 1C010.c or 1C010.d; or

text.zh: a.2. 1C010.e规定的预浸料或预成型件；
text.en: a.2. Prepregs or preforms specified by 1C010.e;

text.zh: b. 由金属或碳“基体”及以下任一种材料制成：
text.en: b. Made from a metal or carbon “matrix”, and any of the following:

text.zh: b.1. 具有以下所有特征的碳“纤维或丝状材料”：
text.en: b.1. Carbon “fibrous or filamentary materials” having all of the following:
b.1.a. A “specific modulus” exceeding 10.15 x 10^{6} m; and
b.1.b. A “specific tensile strength” exceeding 17.7 x 10^{4} m; or

text.zh: b.2. 1C010.c管制的材料。
text.en: b.2. Materials controlled by 1C010.c.
