text.zh: 3A001.b未列明的参量信号放大器或量子极限放大器（QLA）见ECCN 3A901.b。
text.en: For parametric signal amplifiers or Quantum-limited amplifiers (QLAs) not specified by 3A001.b, see ECCN 3A901.b.

text.zh: b.1. 如下“真空电子器件”和阴极：
text.en: b.1. “Vacuum electronic devices” and cathodes, as follows:
Note 1:

text.zh: 3A001.b.1不管制设计或额定在具有以下全部特性的任何频段工作的“真空电子器件”：
text.en: 3A001.b.1 does not control “vacuum electronic devices” designed or rated for operation in any frequency band and having all of the following:

text.zh: a. 不超过31.8 GHz；且
text.en: a. Does not exceed 31.8 GHz; and

text.zh: b. “由ITU分配”用于无线电通信业务，但不用于无线电测定。
text.en: b. Is “allocated by the ITU” for radio-communications services, but not for radio-determination.
Note 2:

text.zh: 3A001.b.1不管制具有以下全部特性的非“空间合格”“真空电子器件”：
text.en: 3A001.b.1 does not control non-“space-qualified” “vacuum electronic devices” having all the following:

text.zh: a. 平均输出功率等于或小于50 W；且
text.en: a. An average output power equal to or less than 50 W; and

text.zh: b. 设计或额定在具有以下全部特性的任何频段工作：
text.en: b. Designed or rated for operation in any frequency band and having all of the following:

text.zh: 1. 超过31.8 GHz但不超过43.5 GHz；且
text.en: 1. Exceeds 31.8 GHz but does not exceed 43.5 GHz; and

text.zh: 2. “由ITU分配”用于无线电通信业务，但不用于无线电测定。
text.en: 2. Is “allocated by the ITU” for radio-communications services, but not for radio-determination.

text.zh: b.1.a. 如下脉冲或连续波行波“真空电子器件”：
text.en: b.1.a. Traveling-wave “vacuum electronic devices,” pulsed or continuous wave, as follows:

text.zh: b.1.a.1. 工作频率超过31.8 GHz的器件；
text.en: b.1.a.1. Devices operating at frequencies exceeding 31.8 GHz;

text.zh: b.1.a.2. 阴极加热器从开启至达到额定射频功率的时间小于3秒的器件；
text.en: b.1.a.2. Devices having a cathode heater with a turn on time to rated RF power of less than 3 seconds;

text.zh: b.1.a.3. “相对带宽”大于7%或峰值功率超过2.5 kW的耦合腔器件或其衍生器件；
text.en: b.1.a.3. Coupled cavity devices, or derivatives thereof, with a “fractional bandwidth” of more than 7% or a peak power exceeding 2.5 kW;

text.zh: b.1.a.4. 基于螺旋线、折叠波导或蛇形波导电路，或其衍生电路，且具有以下任一特性的器件：
text.en: b.1.a.4. Devices based on helix, folded waveguide, or serpentine waveguide circuits, or derivatives thereof, having any of the following:

text.zh: b.1.a.4.a. “瞬时带宽”大于一个倍频程，且平均功率（kW）与频率（GHz）的乘积大于0.5；
text.en: b.1.a.4.a. An “instantaneous bandwidth” of more than one octave, and average power (expressed in kW) times frequency (expressed in GHz) of more than 0.5;

text.zh: b.1.a.4.b. “瞬时带宽”为一个倍频程或以下，且平均功率（kW）与频率（GHz）的乘积大于1；
text.en: b.1.a.4.b. An “instantaneous bandwidth” of one octave or less, and average power (expressed in kW) times frequency (expressed in GHz) of more than 1;

text.zh: b.1.a.4.c. 具有“空间合格”资格；或
text.en: b.1.a.4.c. Being “space-qualified”; or

text.zh: b.1.a.4.d. 具有栅控电子枪；
text.en: b.1.a.4.d. Having a gridded electron gun;

text.zh: b.1.a.5. “相对带宽”大于或等于10%，且具有以下任一特性的器件：
text.en: b.1.a.5. Devices with a “fractional bandwidth” greater than or equal to 10%, with any of the following:

text.zh: b.1.a.5.a. 环形电子束；
text.en: b.1.a.5.a. An annular electron beam;

text.zh: b.1.a.5.b. 非轴对称电子束；或
text.en: b.1.a.5.b. A non-axisymmetric electron beam; or

text.zh: b.1.a.5.c. 多电子束；
text.en: b.1.a.5.c. Multiple electron beams;

text.zh: b.1.b. 增益大于17 dB的正交场放大器“真空电子器件”；
text.en: b.1.b. Crossed-field amplifier “vacuum electronic devices” with a gain of more than 17 dB;

text.zh: b.1.c. 为“真空电子器件”设计，在额定工作条件下发射电流密度超过5 A/cm^{2}，或脉冲（非连续）电流密度超过10 A/cm^{2}的热阴极；
text.en: b.1.c. Thermionic cathodes, designed for “vacuum electronic devices,” producing an emission current density at rated operating conditions exceeding 5 A/cm^{2} or a pulsed (non-continuous) current density at rated operating conditions exceeding 10 A/cm^{2};

text.zh: b.1.d. 能以“双模式”工作的“真空电子器件”。
text.en: b.1.d. “Vacuum electronic devices” with the capability to operate in a 'dual mode.'

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就3A001.b.1.d而言，“双模式”指利用栅极，可有意将“真空电子器件”的束流在连续波与脉冲工作模式之间切换，且产生的峰值脉冲输出功率大于连续波输出功率。
text.en: For the purposes of 3A001.b.1.d, 'dual mode' means the “vacuum electronic device” beam current can be intentionally changed between continuous-wave and pulsed mode operation by use of a grid and produces a peak pulse output power greater than the continuous-wave output power.

text.zh: b.2. 具有以下任一特性的“单片微波集成电路”（“MMIC”）放大器：
text.en: b.2. “Monolithic Microwave Integrated Circuit” (“MMIC”) amplifiers that any of the following:

text.zh: 注意：
text.en: N.B.:

text.zh: 集成有移相器的“MMIC”放大器见3A001.b.12。
text.en: For “MMIC” amplifiers that have an integrated phase shifter see 3A001.b.12.

text.zh: b.2.a. 额定工作频率大于2.7 GHz且不超过6.8 GHz，“相对带宽”大于15%，且具有以下任一特性：
text.en: b.2.a. Rated for operation at frequencies exceeding 2.7 GHz up to and including 6.8 GHz with a “fractional bandwidth” greater than 15%, and having any of the following:

text.zh: b.2.a.1. 在大于2.7 GHz且不超过2.9 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于75 W（48.75 dBm）；
text.en: b.2.a.1. A peak saturated power output greater than 75 W (48.75 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 2.7 GHz up to and including 2.9 GHz;

text.zh: b.2.a.2. 在大于2.9 GHz且不超过3.2 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于55 W（47.4 dBm）；
text.en: b.2.a.2. A peak saturated power output greater than 55 W (47.4 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 2.9 GHz up to and including 3.2 GHz;

text.zh: b.2.a.3. 在大于3.2 GHz且不超过3.7 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于40 W（46 dBm）；或
text.en: b.2.a.3. A peak saturated power output greater than 40 W (46 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 3.2 GHz up to and including 3.7 GHz; or

text.zh: b.2.a.4. 在大于3.7 GHz且不超过6.8 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于20 W（43 dBm）；
text.en: b.2.a.4. A peak saturated power output greater than 20 W (43 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 3.7 GHz up to and including 6.8 GHz;

text.zh: b.2.b. 额定工作频率大于6.8 GHz且不超过16 GHz，“相对带宽”大于10%，且具有以下任一特性：
text.en: b.2.b. Rated for operation at frequencies exceeding 6.8 GHz up to and including 16 GHz with a “fractional bandwidth” greater than 10%, and having any of the following:

text.zh: b.2.b.1. 在大于6.8 GHz且不超过8.5 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于10 W（40 dBm）；或
text.en: b.2.b.1. A peak saturated power output greater than 10 W (40 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 6.8 GHz up to and including 8.5 GHz; or

text.zh: b.2.b.2. 在大于8.5 GHz且不超过16 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于5 W（37 dBm）；
text.en: b.2.b.2. A peak saturated power output greater than 5 W (37 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 8.5 GHz up to and including 16 GHz;

text.zh: b.2.c. 额定在大于16 GHz且不超过31.8 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于3 W（34.77 dBm），且“相对带宽”大于10%；
text.en: b.2.c. Rated for operation with a peak saturated power output greater than 3 W (34.77 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 16 GHz up to and including 31.8 GHz, and with a “fractional bandwidth” of greater than 10%;

text.zh: b.2.d. 额定在大于31.8 GHz且不超过37 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于0.1 nW（−70 dBm）；
text.en: b.2.d. Rated for operation with a peak saturated power output greater than 0.1 nW (−70 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 31.8 GHz up to and including 37 GHz;

text.zh: b.2.e. 额定在大于37 GHz且不超过43.5 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于1 W（30 dBm），且“相对带宽”大于10%；
text.en: b.2.e. Rated for operation with a peak saturated power output greater than 1 W (30 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 37 GHz up to and including 43.5 GHz, and with a “fractional bandwidth” of greater than 10%;

text.zh: b.2.f. 额定在大于43.5 GHz且不超过75 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于31.62 mW（15 dBm），且“相对带宽”大于10%；
text.en: b.2.f. Rated for operation with a peak saturated power output greater than 31.62 mW (15 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 43.5 GHz up to and including 75 GHz, and with a “fractional bandwidth” of greater than 10%;

text.zh: b.2.g. 额定在大于75 GHz且不超过90 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于10 mW（10 dBm），且“相对带宽”大于5%；或
text.en: b.2.g. Rated for operation with a peak saturated power output greater than 10 mW (10 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 75 GHz up to and including 90 GHz, and with a “fractional bandwidth” of greater than 5%; or

text.zh: b.2.h. 额定在大于90 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于0.1 nW（−70 dBm）；
text.en: b.2.h. Rated for operation with a peak saturated power output greater than 0.1 nW (−70 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 90 GHz;
Note 1:

text.zh: [保留]
text.en: [Reserved]
Note 2:

text.zh: 如“MMIC”的额定工作频率跨越3A001.b.2.a至3A001.b.2.h所定义的多个频率范围，其管制状态按最低峰值饱和输出功率管制阈值确定。
text.en: The control status of the “MMIC” whose rated operating frequency includes frequencies listed in more than one frequency range, as defined by 3A001.b.2.a through 3A001.b.2.h, is determined by the lowest peak saturated power output control threshold.
Note 3:

text.zh: 第3类产品组A“系统、设备和部件”标题后注1和注2的含义是：如“MMIC”为其他用途（例如电信、雷达、汽车）“专门设计”，3A001.b.2不对其实施管制。
text.en: Notes 1 and 2 following the Category 3 heading for product group A. Systems, Equipment, and Components mean that 3A001.b.2 does not control “MMICs” if they are “specially designed” for other applications, e.g., telecommunications, radar, automobiles.

text.zh: b.3. 具有以下任一特性的分立微波晶体管：
text.en: b.3. Discrete microwave transistors that are any of the following:

text.zh: b.3.a. 额定工作频率大于2.7 GHz且不超过6.8 GHz，且具有以下任一特性：
text.en: b.3.a. Rated for operation at frequencies exceeding 2.7 GHz up to and including 6.8 GHz and having any of the following:

text.zh: b.3.a.1. 在大于2.7 GHz且不超过2.9 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于400 W（56 dBm）；
text.en: b.3.a.1. A peak saturated power output greater than 400 W (56 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 2.7 GHz up to and including 2.9 GHz;

text.zh: b.3.a.2. 在大于2.9 GHz且不超过3.2 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于205 W（53.12 dBm）；
text.en: b.3.a.2. A peak saturated power output greater than 205 W (53.12 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 2.9 GHz up to and including 3.2 GHz;

text.zh: b.3.a.3. 在大于3.2 GHz且不超过3.7 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于115 W（50.61 dBm）；或
text.en: b.3.a.3. A peak saturated power output greater than 115 W (50.61 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 3.2 GHz up to and including 3.7 GHz; or

text.zh: b.3.a.4. 在大于3.7 GHz且不超过6.8 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于60 W（47.78 dBm）；
text.en: b.3.a.4. A peak saturated power output greater than 60 W (47.78 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 3.7 GHz up to and including 6.8 GHz;

text.zh: b.3.b. 额定工作频率大于6.8 GHz且不超过31.8 GHz，且具有以下任一特性：
text.en: b.3.b. Rated for operation at frequencies exceeding 6.8 GHz up to and including 31.8 GHz and having any of the following:

text.zh: b.3.b.1. 在大于6.8 GHz且不超过8.5 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于50 W（47 dBm）；
text.en: b.3.b.1. A peak saturated power output greater than 50 W (47 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 6.8 GHz up to and including 8.5 GHz;

text.zh: b.3.b.2. 在大于8.5 GHz且不超过12 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于15 W（41.76 dBm）；
text.en: b.3.b.2. A peak saturated power output greater than 15 W (41.76 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 8.5 GHz up to and including 12 GHz;

text.zh: b.3.b.3. 在大于12 GHz且不超过16 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于40 W（46 dBm）；或
text.en: b.3.b.3. A peak saturated power output greater than 40 W (46 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 12 GHz up to and including 16 GHz; or

text.zh: b.3.b.4. 在大于16 GHz且不超过31.8 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于7 W（38.45 dBm）；
text.en: b.3.b.4. A peak saturated power output greater than 7 W (38.45 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 16 GHz up to and including 31.8 GHz;

text.zh: b.3.c. 额定在大于31.8 GHz且不超过37 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于0.5 W（27 dBm）；
text.en: b.3.c. Rated for operation with a peak saturated power output greater than 0.5 W (27 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 31.8 GHz up to and including 37 GHz;

text.zh: b.3.d. 额定在大于37 GHz且不超过43.5 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于1 W（30 dBm）；
text.en: b.3.d. Rated for operation with a peak saturated power output greater than 1 W (30 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 37 GHz up to and including 43.5 GHz;

text.zh: b.3.e. 额定在大于43.5 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于0.1 nW（−70 dBm）；或
text.en: b.3.e. Rated for operation with a peak saturated power output greater than 0.1 nW (−70 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 43.5 GHz; or

text.zh: b.3.f. 3A001.b.3.a至3A001.b.3.e未列明，额定在大于8.5 GHz且不超过31.8 GHz的所有频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于5 W（37.0 dBm）；
text.en: b.3.f. Other than those specified by 3A001.b.3.a to 3A001.b.3.e and rated for operation with a peak saturated power output greater than 5 W (37.0 dBm) at all frequencies exceeding 8.5 GHz up to and including 31.8 GHz;
Note 1:

text.zh: 3A001.b.3.a至3A001.b.3.e中的晶体管，如其额定工作频率跨越这些条款所定义的多个频率范围，其管制状态按最低峰值饱和输出功率管制阈值确定。
text.en: The control status of a transistor in 3A001.b.3.a through 3A001.b.3.e, whose rated operating frequency includes frequencies listed in more than one frequency range, as defined by 3A001.b.3.a through 3A001.b.3.e, is determined by the lowest peak saturated power output control threshold.
Note 2:

text.zh: 3A001.b.3包括裸芯片、安装于载体上的芯片或封装芯片。某些分立晶体管也可能被称为功率放大器，但其管制状态由3A001.b.3确定。
text.en: 3A001.b.3 includes bare dice, dice mounted on carriers, or dice mounted in packages. Some discrete transistors may also be referred to as power amplifiers, but the status of these discrete transistors is determined by 3A001.b.3.

text.zh: b.4. 具有以下任一特性的微波固态放大器，以及含微波固态放大器的微波组件/模块：
text.en: b.4. Microwave solid state amplifiers and microwave assemblies/modules containing microwave solid state amplifiers, that are any of the following:

text.zh: b.4.a. 额定工作频率大于2.7 GHz且不超过6.8 GHz，“相对带宽”大于15%，且具有以下任一特性：
text.en: b.4.a. Rated for operation at frequencies exceeding 2.7 GHz up to and including 6.8 GHz with a “fractional bandwidth” greater than 15%, and having any of the following:

text.zh: b.4.a.1. 在大于2.7 GHz且不超过2.9 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于500 W（57 dBm）；
text.en: b.4.a.1. A peak saturated power output greater than 500 W (57 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 2.7 GHz up to and including 2.9 GHz;

text.zh: b.4.a.2. 在大于2.9 GHz且不超过3.2 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于270 W（54.3 dBm）；
text.en: b.4.a.2. A peak saturated power output greater than 270 W (54.3 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 2.9 GHz up to and including 3.2 GHz;

text.zh: b.4.a.3. 在大于3.2 GHz且不超过3.7 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于200 W（53 dBm）；或
text.en: b.4.a.3. A peak saturated power output greater than 200 W (53 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 3.2 GHz up to and including 3.7 GHz; or

text.zh: b.4.a.4. 在大于3.7 GHz且不超过6.8 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于90 W（49.54 dBm）；
text.en: b.4.a.4. A peak saturated power output greater than 90 W (49.54 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 3.7 GHz up to and including 6.8 GHz;

text.zh: b.4.b. 额定工作频率大于6.8 GHz且不超过31.8 GHz，“相对带宽”大于10%，且具有以下任一特性：
text.en: b.4.b. Rated for operation at frequencies exceeding 6.8 GHz up to and including 31.8 GHz with a “fractional bandwidth” greater than 10%, and having any of the following:

text.zh: b.4.b.1. 在大于6.8 GHz且不超过8.5 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于70 W（48.45 dBm）；
text.en: b.4.b.1. A peak saturated power output greater than 70 W (48.45 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 6.8 GHz up to and including 8.5 GHz;

text.zh: b.4.b.2. 在大于8.5 GHz且不超过12 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于50 W（47 dBm）；
text.en: b.4.b.2. A peak saturated power output greater than 50 W (47 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 8.5 GHz up to and including 12 GHz;

text.zh: b.4.b.3. 在大于12 GHz且不超过16 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于30 W（44.77 dBm）；或
text.en: b.4.b.3. A peak saturated power output greater than 30 W (44.77 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 12 GHz up to and including 16 GHz; or

text.zh: b.4.b.4. 在大于16 GHz且不超过31.8 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于20 W（43 dBm）；
text.en: b.4.b.4. A peak saturated power output greater than 20 W (43 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 16 GHz up to and including 31.8 GHz;

text.zh: b.4.c. 额定在大于31.8 GHz且不超过37 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于0.5 W（27 dBm）；
text.en: b.4.c. Rated for operation with a peak saturated power output greater than 0.5 W (27 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 31.8 GHz up to and including 37 GHz;

text.zh: b.4.d. 额定在大于37 GHz且不超过43.5 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于2 W（33 dBm），且“相对带宽”大于10%；
text.en: b.4.d. Rated for operation with a peak saturated power output greater than 2 W (33 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 37 GHz up to and including 43.5 GHz, and with a “fractional bandwidth” of greater than 10%;

text.zh: b.4.e. 额定工作频率超过43.5 GHz，且具有以下任一特性：
text.en: b.4.e. Rated for operation at frequencies exceeding 43.5 GHz and having any of the following:

text.zh: b.4.e.1. 在大于43.5 GHz且不超过75 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于0.2 W（23 dBm），且“相对带宽”大于10%；
text.en: b.4.e.1. A peak saturated power output greater than 0.2 W (23 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 43.5 GHz up to and including 75 GHz, and with a “fractional bandwidth” of greater than 10%;

text.zh: b.4.e.2. 在大于75 GHz且不超过90 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于20 mW（13 dBm），且“相对带宽”大于5%；或
text.en: b.4.e.2. A peak saturated power output greater than 20 mW (13 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 75 GHz up to and including 90 GHz, and with a “fractional bandwidth” of greater than 5%; or

text.zh: b.4.e.3. 在大于90 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于0.1 nW（−70 dBm）；或
text.en: b.4.e.3. A peak saturated power output greater than 0.1 nW (−70 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 90 GHz; or

text.zh: b.4.f. [保留]
text.en: b.4.f. [Reserved]

text.zh: 注意：
text.en: N.B.:

text.zh: 1. “MMIC”放大器见3A001.b.2。
text.en: 1. For “MMIC” amplifiers see 3A001.b.2.

text.zh: 2. “发射/接收模块”和“发射模块”见3A001.b.12。
text.en: 2. For 'transmit/receive modules' and 'transmit modules' see 3A001.b.12.

text.zh: 3. 设计用于扩展信号分析仪、信号发生器、网络分析仪或微波测试接收机的工作范围或频率范围的变频器和谐波混频器，见3A001.b.7。
text.en: 3. For converters and harmonic mixers, designed to extend the operating or frequency range of signal analyzers, signal generators, network analyzers or microwave test receivers, see 3A001.b.7.
Note 1:

text.zh: [保留]
text.en: [Reserved]
Note 2:

text.zh: 如物项额定工作频率跨越3A001.b.4.a至3A001.b.4.e所定义的多个频率范围，其管制状态按最低峰值饱和输出功率管制阈值确定。
text.en: The control status of an item whose rated operating frequency includes frequencies listed in more than one frequency range, as defined by 3A001.b.4.a through 3A001.b.4.e, is determined by the lowest peak saturated power output control threshold.

text.zh: b.5. 采用电子或磁调谐的带通或带阻滤波器，具有5个以上可调谐谐振器，能在小于10 ms内跨越1.5:1频带（f_{max}/f_{min}）调谐，且具有以下任一特性：
text.en: b.5. Electronically or magnetically tunable band-pass or band-stop filters, having more than 5 tunable resonators capable of tuning across a 1.5:1 frequency band (f_{max}/f_{min}) in less than 10 ms and having any of the following:

text.zh: b.5.a. 带通带宽大于中心频率的0.5%；或
text.en: b.5.a. A band-pass bandwidth of more than 0.5% of center frequency; or

text.zh: b.5.b. 带阻带宽小于中心频率的0.5%；
text.en: b.5.b. A band-stop bandwidth of less than 0.5% of center frequency;
b.6. [Reserved]

text.zh: b.7. 具有以下任一特性的变频器和谐波混频器：
text.en: b.7. Converters and harmonic mixers, that are any of the following:

text.zh: b.7.a. 设计用于将“信号分析仪”的频率范围扩展至90 GHz以上；
text.en: b.7.a. Designed to extend the frequency range of “signal analyzers” beyond 90 GHz;

text.zh: b.7.b. 设计用于将信号发生器的工作范围扩展至以下范围：
text.en: b.7.b. Designed to extend the operating range of signal generators as follows:

text.zh: b.7.b.1. 90 GHz以上；
text.en: b.7.b.1. Beyond 90 GHz;

text.zh: b.7.b.2. 在大于43.5 GHz但不超过90 GHz的频率范围内任一点，输出功率大于100 mW（20 dBm）；
text.en: b.7.b.2. To an output power greater than 100 mW (20 dBm) anywhere within the frequency range exceeding 43.5 GHz but not exceeding 90 GHz;

text.zh: b.7.c. 设计用于将网络分析仪的工作范围扩展至以下范围：
text.en: b.7.c. Designed to extend the operating range of network analyzers as follows:

text.zh: b.7.c.1. 110 GHz以上；
text.en: b.7.c.1. Beyond 110 GHz;

text.zh: b.7.c.2. 在大于43.5 GHz但不超过90 GHz的频率范围内任一点，输出功率大于31.62 mW（15 dBm）；
text.en: b.7.c.2. To an output power greater than 31.62 mW (15 dBm) anywhere within the frequency range exceeding 43.5 GHz but not exceeding 90 GHz;

text.zh: b.7.c.3. 在大于90 GHz但不超过110 GHz的频率范围内任一点，输出功率大于1 mW（0 dBm）；或
text.en: b.7.c.3. To an output power greater than 1 mW (0 dBm) anywhere within the frequency range exceeding 90 GHz but not exceeding 110 GHz; or

text.zh: b.7.d. 设计用于将微波测试接收机的频率范围扩展至110 GHz以上；
text.en: b.7.d. Designed to extend the frequency range of microwave test receivers beyond 110 GHz;

text.zh: b.8. 含有3A001.b.1管制的“真空电子器件”，且具有以下全部特性的微波功率放大器：
text.en: b.8. Microwave power amplifiers containing “vacuum electronic devices” controlled by 3A001.b.1 and having all of the following:

text.zh: b.8.a. 工作频率高于3 GHz；
text.en: b.8.a. Operating frequencies above 3 GHz;

text.zh: b.8.b. 平均输出功率与质量之比超过80 W/kg；且
text.en: b.8.b. An average output power to mass ratio exceeding 80 W/kg; and

text.zh: b.8.c. 体积小于400 cm^{3}；
text.en: b.8.c. A volume of less than 400 cm^{3};

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 3A001.b.8不管制设计或额定在“由ITU分配”用于无线电通信业务而非无线电测定的任何频段工作的设备。
text.en: 3A001.b.8 does not control equipment designed or rated for operation in any frequency band which is “allocated by the ITU” for radio-communications services, but not for radio-determination.

text.zh: b.9. 至少由行波“真空电子器件”、“单片微波集成电路”（“MMIC”）及集成电子电源调节器构成，且具有以下全部特性的微波功率模块（MPM）：
text.en: b.9. Microwave Power Modules (MPM) consisting of, at least, a traveling-wave “vacuum electronic device,” a “Monolithic Microwave Integrated Circuit” (“MMIC”) and an integrated electronic power conditioner and having all of the following:

text.zh: b.9.a. 从关闭至完全运行的“开启时间”小于10秒；
text.en: b.9.a. A 'turn-on time' from off to fully operational in less than 10 seconds;

text.zh: b.9.b. 体积小于以瓦计的最大额定功率乘以10 cm^{3}/W；且
text.en: b.9.b. A volume less than the maximum rated power in Watts multiplied by 10 cm^{3}/W; and

text.zh: b.9.c. “瞬时带宽”大于1个倍频程（f_{max} > 2f_{min}），且具有以下任一特性：
text.en: b.9.c. An “instantaneous bandwidth” greater than 1 octave (f_{max} > 2f_{min}) and having any of the following:

text.zh: b.9.c.1. 对于等于或低于18 GHz的频率，射频输出功率大于100 W；或
text.en: b.9.c.1. For frequencies equal to or less than 18 GHz, an RF output power greater than 100 W; or

text.zh: b.9.c.2. 频率大于18 GHz；
text.en: b.9.c.2. A frequency greater than 18 GHz;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:
For the purposes of 3A001.b.9:

text.zh: 1. 3A001.b.9.b中的体积计算示例如下：最大额定功率为20 W时，体积为20 W × 10 cm^{3}/W = 200 cm^{3}。
text.en: 1. To calculate the volume in 3A001.b.9.b, the following example is provided: for a maximum rated power of 20 W, the volume would be: 20 W × 10 cm^{3}/W = 200 cm^{3}.

text.zh: 2. 3A001.b.9.a中的“开启时间”指从完全关闭至完全运行的时间，即包括MPM的预热时间。
text.en: 2. The 'turn-on time' in 3A001.b.9.a refers to the time from fully-off to fully operational, i.e., it includes the warm-up time of the MPM.

text.zh: b.10. 规定在10 Hz ≤ F ≤ 10 kHz范围内任一点，单边带（SSB）相位噪声（dBc/Hz）小于（优于）−（126 + 20log_{10}F − 20log_{10}f）的振荡器或振荡器组件；
text.en: b.10. Oscillators or oscillator assemblies, specified to operate with a single sideband (SSB) phase noise, in dBc/Hz, less (better) than − (126 + 20log_{10}F − 20log_{10}f) anywhere within the range of 10 Hz ≤ F ≤ 10 kHz;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就3A001.b.10而言，F为相对工作频率的偏移量（Hz），f为工作频率（MHz）。
text.en: For the purposes of 3A001.b.10, F is the offset from the operating frequency in Hz and f is the operating frequency in MHz.

text.zh: b.11. “频率切换时间”符合以下任一条件的“频率合成器”“电子组件”：
text.en: b.11. 'Frequency synthesizer' “electronic assemblies” having a “frequency switching time” as specified by any of the following:

text.zh: b.11.a. 小于143 ps；
text.en: b.11.a. Less than 143 ps;

text.zh: b.11.b. 在大于4.8 GHz但不超过31.8 GHz的合成频率范围内，对超过2.2 GHz的任意频率变化，切换时间小于100 µs；
text.en: b.11.b. Less than 100 µs for any frequency change exceeding 2.2 GHz within the synthesized frequency range exceeding 4.8 GHz but not exceeding 31.8 GHz;
b.11.c. [Reserved]

text.zh: b.11.d. 在大于31.8 GHz但不超过37 GHz的合成频率范围内，对超过550 MHz的任意频率变化，切换时间小于500 µs；
text.en: b.11.d. Less than 500 µs for any frequency change exceeding 550 MHz within the synthesized frequency range exceeding 31.8 GHz but not exceeding 37 GHz;

text.zh: b.11.e. 在大于37 GHz但不超过75 GHz的合成频率范围内，对超过2.2 GHz的任意频率变化，切换时间小于100 µs；
text.en: b.11.e. Less than 100 µs for any frequency change exceeding 2.2 GHz within the synthesized frequency range exceeding 37 GHz but not exceeding 75 GHz;

text.zh: b.11.f. 在大于75 GHz但不超过90 GHz的合成频率范围内，对超过5.0 GHz的任意频率变化，切换时间小于100 µs；或
text.en: b.11.f. Less than 100 µs for any frequency change exceeding 5.0 GHz within the synthesized frequency range exceeding 75 GHz but not exceeding 90 GHz; or

text.zh: b.11.g. 在超过90 GHz的合成频率范围内，切换时间小于1 ms；
text.en: b.11.g. Less than 1 ms within the synthesized frequency range exceeding 90 GHz;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就3A001.b.11而言，“频率合成器”指任何类型的频率源，无论实际采用何种技术，能够从一个或多个输出端提供多个同时或择一输出的频率，这些频率由数量较少的标准（或主）频率控制、派生或校准。
text.en: For the purposes of 3A001.b.11, a 'frequency synthesizer' is any kind of frequency source, regardless of the actual technique used, providing a multiplicity of simultaneous or alternative output frequencies, from one or more outputs, controlled by, derived from or disciplined by a lesser number of standard (or master) frequencies.

text.zh: 注意：
text.en: N.B.:

text.zh: 通用“信号分析仪”、信号发生器、网络分析仪及微波测试接收机，分别见3A002.c、3A002.d、3A002.e和3A002.f。
text.en: For general purpose “signal analyzers”, signal generators, network analyzers and microwave test receivers, see 3A002.c, 3A002.d, 3A002.e and 3A002.f, respectively.

text.zh: b.12. 额定工作频率高于2.7 GHz，且具有以下全部特性的“发射/接收模块”、“发射/接收MMIC”、“发射模块”和“发射MMIC”：
text.en: b.12. 'Transmit/receive modules, 'transmit/receive MMICs, 'transmit modules,' and 'transmit MMICs,' rated for operation at frequencies above 2.7 GHz and having all of the following:

text.zh: b.12.a. 任一通道的峰值饱和输出功率P_{sat}（瓦）大于505.62除以最大工作频率（GHz）的平方[P_{sat}>505.62 W*GHz^{2}/f_{GHz}^{2}]；
text.en: b.12.a. A peak saturated power output (in watts), P_{sat}, greater than 505.62 divided by the maximum operating frequency (in GHz) squared [P_{sat}>505.62 W*GHz^{2}/f_{GHz}^{2}] for any channel;

text.zh: b.12.b. 任一通道的“相对带宽”为5%或以上；
text.en: b.12.b. A “fractional bandwidth” of 5% or greater for any channel;

text.zh: b.12.c. 任一平面边长d（cm）等于或小于15除以最低工作频率（GHz）[d ≤ 15cm*GHz*N/f_{GHz}]，其中N为发射或发射/接收通道数；且
text.en: b.12.c. Any planar side with length d (in cm) equal to or less than 15 divided by the lowest operating frequency in GHz [d ≤ 15cm*GHz*N/f_{GHz}] where N is the number of transmit or transmit/receive channels; and

text.zh: b.12.d. 每个通道均有电子可变移相器；
text.en: b.12.d. An electronically variable phase shifter per channel;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:
For the purposes of 3A001.b.12:

text.zh: 1. “发射/接收模块”是为信号发射和接收提供双向幅度及相位控制的多功能“电子组件”。
text.en: 1. A 'transmit/receive module' is a multifunction “electronic assembly” that provides bi-directional amplitude and phase control for transmission and reception of signals.

text.zh: 2. “发射模块”是为信号发射提供幅度及相位控制的“电子组件”。
text.en: 2. A 'transmit module' is an “electronic assembly” that provides amplitude and phase control for transmission of signals.

text.zh: 3. “发射/接收MMIC”是为信号发射和接收提供双向幅度及相位控制的多功能“MMIC”。
text.en: 3. A 'transmit/receive MMIC' is a multifunction “MMIC” that provides bi-directional amplitude and phase control for transmission and reception of signals.

text.zh: 4. “发射MMIC”是为信号发射提供幅度及相位控制的“MMIC”。
text.en: 4. A 'transmit MMIC' is a “MMIC” that provides amplitude and phase control for transmission of signals.

text.zh: 5. 对于额定工作范围向下延伸至2.7 GHz或以下的发射/接收模块或发射模块，3A001.b.12.c公式中的最低工作频率（f_{GHz}）应采用2.7 GHz[d≤15cm*GHz*N/2.7 GHz]。
text.en: 5. 2.7 GHz should be used as the lowest operating frequency (f_{GHz}) in the formula in 3A001.b.12.c for transmit/receive or transmit modules that have a rated operation range extending downward to 2.7 GHz and below [d≤15cm*GHz*N/2.7 GHz].

text.zh: 6. 3A001.b.12适用于带或不带散热器的“发射/接收模块”或“发射模块”。3A001.b.12.c中d的数值不包括这些模块中发挥散热器功能的任何部分。
text.en: 6. 3A001.b.12 applies to 'transmit/receive modules' or 'transmit modules' with or without a heat sink. The value of d in 3A001.b.12.c does not include any portion of the 'transmit/receive module' or 'transmit module' that functions as a heat sink.

text.zh: 7. “发射/接收模块”或“发射模块”、“发射/接收MMIC”或“发射MMIC”可以具有或不具有N个集成辐射天线单元，其中N为发射或发射/接收通道数。
text.en: 7. 'Transmit/receive modules' or 'transmit modules,' 'transmit/receive MMICs' or 'transmit MMICs' may or may not have N integrated radiating antenna elements where N is the number of transmit or transmit/receive channels.

text.zh: c. 如下声波器件及为其“专门设计”的“部件”：
text.en: c. Acoustic wave devices as follows and “specially designed” “components” therefor:

text.zh: c.1. 具有以下任一特性的表面声波及掠表面（浅体）声波器件：
text.en: c.1. Surface acoustic wave and surface skimming (shallow bulk) acoustic wave devices, having any of the following:

text.zh: c.1.a. 载波频率超过6 GHz；
text.en: c.1.a. A carrier frequency exceeding 6 GHz;

text.zh: c.1.b. 载波频率超过1 GHz但不超过6 GHz，且具有以下任一特性：
text.en: c.1.b. A carrier frequency exceeding 1 GHz, but not exceeding 6 GHz and having any of the following:

text.zh: c.1.b.1. “频率旁瓣抑制”超过65 dB；
text.en: c.1.b.1. A 'frequency side-lobe rejection' exceeding 65 dB;

text.zh: c.1.b.2. 最大延迟时间与带宽的乘积大于100（时间以µs计，带宽以MHz计）；
text.en: c.1.b.2. A product of the maximum delay time and the bandwidth (time in µs and bandwidth in MHz) of more than 100;

text.zh: c.1.b.3. 带宽大于250 MHz；或
text.en: c.1.b.3. A bandwidth greater than 250 MHz; or

text.zh: c.1.b.4. 色散延迟大于10 µs；或
text.en: c.1.b.4. A dispersive delay of more than 10 µs; or

text.zh: c.1.c. 载波频率为1 GHz或以下，且具有以下任一特性：
text.en: c.1.c. A carrier frequency of 1 GHz or less and having any of the following:

text.zh: c.1.c.1. 最大延迟时间与带宽的乘积大于100（时间以µs计，带宽以MHz计）；
text.en: c.1.c.1. A product of the maximum delay time and the bandwidth (time in µs and bandwidth in MHz) of more than 100;

text.zh: c.1.c.2. 色散延迟大于10 µs；或
text.en: c.1.c.2. A dispersive delay of more than 10 µs; or

text.zh: c.1.c.3. “频率旁瓣抑制”超过65 dB，且带宽大于100 MHz；
text.en: c.1.c.3. A 'frequency side-lobe rejection' exceeding 65 dB and a bandwidth greater than 100 MHz;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就3A001.c.1而言，“频率旁瓣抑制”指数据表规定的最大抑制值。
text.en: For the purposes of 3A001.c.1, 'frequency side-lobe rejection' is the maximum rejection value specified in data sheet.

text.zh: c.2. 能直接处理频率超过6 GHz信号的体声波器件；
text.en: c.2. Bulk (volume) acoustic wave devices that permit the direct processing of signals at frequencies exceeding 6 GHz;

text.zh: c.3. 利用声波（体波或表面波）与光波相互作用，能够直接处理信号或图像，包括频谱分析、相关或卷积的声光“信号处理”器件；
text.en: c.3. Acoustic-optic “signal processing” devices employing interaction between acoustic waves (bulk wave or surface wave) and light waves that permit the direct processing of signals or images, including spectral analysis, correlation or convolution;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 3A001.c不管制仅具有单一带通、低通、高通或陷波滤波功能，或谐振功能的声波器件。
text.en: 3A001.c does not control acoustic wave devices that are limited to a single band pass, low pass, high pass or notch filtering, or resonating function.

text.zh: d. 含有由“超导”材料制造的“部件”，为在低于至少一种“超导”组分的“临界温度”下工作而“专门设计”，且具有以下任一特性的电子器件和电路：
text.en: d. Electronic devices and circuits containing “components,” manufactured from “superconductive” materials, “specially designed” for operation at temperatures below the “critical temperature” of at least one of the “superconductive” constituents and having any of the following:

text.zh: d.1. 采用“超导”门对数字电路进行电流切换，每个门的延迟时间（秒）与功耗（瓦）的乘积小于10^{−14} J；或
text.en: d.1. Current switching for digital circuits using “superconductive” gates with a product of delay time per gate (in seconds) and power dissipation per gate (in watts) of less than 10^{−14} J; or

text.zh: d.2. 采用Q值超过10,000的谐振电路，在所有频率下进行频率选择；
text.en: d.2. Frequency selection at all frequencies using resonant circuits with Q-values exceeding 10,000;

text.zh: e. 如下高能器件：
text.en: e. High energy devices as follows:

text.zh: e.1. 如下“电池单体”：
text.en: e.1. 'Cells' as follows:

text.zh: e.1.a. 在20 °C时具有以下任一特性的“原电池单体”：
text.en: e.1.a 'Primary cells' having any of the following at 20 °C:

text.zh: e.1.a.1. “能量密度”超过550 Wh/kg，且“连续功率密度”超过50 W/kg；或
text.en: e.1.a.1. 'Energy density' exceeding 550 Wh/kg and a 'continuous power density' exceeding 50 W/kg; or

text.zh: e.1.a.2. “能量密度”超过50 Wh/kg，且“连续功率密度”超过350 W/kg；
text.en: e.1.a.2. 'Energy density' exceeding 50 Wh/kg and a 'continuous power density' exceeding 350 W/kg;

text.zh: e.1.b. 在20 °C时“能量密度”超过350 Wh/kg的“二次电池单体”；
text.en: e.1.b. 'Secondary cells' having an 'energy density' exceeding 350 Wh/kg at 20 °C;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 1. 就3A001.e.1而言，“能量密度”（Wh/kg）按标称电压乘以标称容量（Ah），再除以质量（kg）计算。如未标明标称容量，则以标称电压的平方乘以放电持续时间（小时），再除以放电负载（欧姆）及质量（kg）计算。
text.en: 1. For the purposes of 3A001.e.1, 'energy density' (Wh/kg) is calculated from the nominal voltage multiplied by the nominal capacity in ampere-hours (Ah) divided by the mass in kilograms. If the nominal capacity is not stated, energy density is calculated from the nominal voltage squared then multiplied by the discharge duration in hours divided by the discharge load in Ohms and the mass in kilograms.

text.zh: 2. 就3A001.e.1而言，“电池单体”定义为具有正负电极和电解质、提供电能的电化学装置，是构成电池的基本单元。
text.en: 2. For the purposes of 3A001.e.1, a 'cell' is defined as an electrochemical device, which has positive and negative electrodes, an electrolyte, and is a source of electrical energy. It is the basic building block of a battery.

text.zh: 3. 就3A001.e.1.a而言，“原电池单体”是未设计为可由任何其他能源充电的“电池单体”。
text.en: 3. For the purposes of 3A001.e.1.a, a 'primary cell' is a 'cell' that is not designed to be charged by any other source.

text.zh: 4. 就3A001.e.1.b而言，“二次电池单体”是设计为可由外部电源充电的“电池单体”。
text.en: 4. For the purposes of 3A001.e.1.b, a 'secondary cell' is a 'cell' that is designed to be charged by an external electrical source.

text.zh: 5. 就3A001.e.1.a而言，“连续功率密度”（W/kg）按标称电压乘以规定的最大连续放电电流（A），再除以质量（kg）计算。“连续功率密度”也称比功率。
text.en: 5. For the purposes of 3A001.e.1.a, 'continuous power density' (W/kg) is calculated from the nominal voltage multiplied by the specified maximum continuous discharge current in ampere (A) divided by the mass in kilograms. 'Continuous power density' is also referred to as specific power.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 3A001.e不管制电池，包括单电芯电池。
text.en: 3A001.e does not control batteries, including single-cell batteries.

text.zh: e.2. 如下高储能电容器：
text.en: e.2. High energy storage capacitors as follows:

text.zh: e.2.a. 重复频率小于10 Hz（单次放电电容器），且具有以下全部特性的电容器：
text.en: e.2.a. Capacitors with a repetition rate of less than 10 Hz (single shot capacitors) and having all of the following:

text.zh: e.2.a.1. 额定电压等于或大于5 kV；
text.en: e.2.a.1. A voltage rating equal to or more than 5 kV;

text.zh: e.2.a.2. 能量密度等于或大于250 J/kg；且
text.en: e.2.a.2. An energy density equal to or more than 250 J/kg; and

text.zh: e.2.a.3. 总能量等于或大于25 kJ；
text.en: e.2.a.3. A total energy equal to or more than 25 kJ;

text.zh: e.2.b. 重复频率为10 Hz或以上（额定重复放电电容器），且具有以下全部特性的电容器：
text.en: e.2.b. Capacitors with a repetition rate of 10 Hz or more (repetition rated capacitors) and having all of the following:

text.zh: e.2.b.1. 额定电压等于或大于5 kV；
text.en: e.2.b.1. A voltage rating equal to or more than 5 kV;

text.zh: e.2.b.2. 能量密度等于或大于50 J/kg；
text.en: e.2.b.2. An energy density equal to or more than 50 J/kg;

text.zh: e.2.b.3. 总能量等于或大于100 J；且
text.en: e.2.b.3. A total energy equal to or more than 100 J; and

text.zh: e.2.b.4. 充放电循环寿命等于或大于10,000次；
text.en: e.2.b.4. A charge/discharge cycle life equal to or more than 10,000;

text.zh: e.3. 为在不到一秒内完全充电或放电而“专门设计”，且具有以下全部特性的“超导”电磁体和螺线管：
text.en: e.3. “Superconductive” electromagnets and solenoids, “specially designed” to be fully charged or discharged in less than one second and having all of the following:

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 3A001.e.3不管制为磁共振成像（MRI）医疗设备“专门设计”的“超导”电磁体或螺线管。
text.en: 3A001.e.3 does not control “superconductive” electromagnets or solenoids “specially designed” for Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) medical equipment.

text.zh: e.3.a. 放电第一秒内释放的能量超过10 kJ；
text.en: e.3.a. Energy delivered during the discharge exceeding 10 kJ in the first second;

text.zh: e.3.b. 载流绕组内径大于250 mm；且
text.en: e.3.b. Inner diameter of the current carrying windings of more than 250 mm; and

text.zh: e.3.c. 额定磁感应强度大于8 T，或绕组中的“总电流密度”大于300 A/mm^{2}；
text.en: e.3.c. Rated for a magnetic induction of more than 8 T or “overall current density” in the winding of more than 300 A/mm^{2};

text.zh: e.4. 具有“空间合格”资格的太阳能电池单体、电池-互连-盖片玻璃（CIC）组件、太阳能电池板及太阳能电池阵列，在301 K（28 °C）工作温度、辐照度为1,367 W/m^{2}的模拟“AM0”光照下，最低平均效率超过20%；
text.en: e.4. Solar cells, cell-interconnect-coverglass (CIC) assemblies, solar panels, and solar arrays, which are “space-qualified,” having a minimum average efficiency exceeding 20% at an operating temperature of 301 K (28 °C) under simulated 'AM0' illumination with an irradiance of 1,367 Watts per square meter (W/m^{2});

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就3A001.e.4而言，“AM0”或“零大气质量”指日地距离为一个天文单位（AU）时，地球外层大气处太阳光的光谱辐照度。
text.en: For the purposes of 3A001.e.4, 'AM0', or 'Air Mass Zero', refers to the spectral irradiance of sun light in the earth's outer atmosphere when the distance between the earth and sun is one astronomical unit (AU).

text.zh: f. “精度”等于或小于（优于）1.0角秒的旋转输入式绝对位置编码器，以及为其“专门设计”的编码环、盘或标尺；
text.en: f. Rotary input type absolute position encoders having an “accuracy” equal to or less (better) than 1.0 second of arc and “specially designed” encoder rings, discs or scales therefor;

text.zh: g. 采用电、光或电子辐射控制开关方式，且具有以下任一特性的固态脉冲功率开关晶闸管器件和“晶闸管模块”：
text.en: g. Solid-state pulsed power switching thyristor devices and 'thyristor modules', using either electrically, optically, or electron radiation controlled switch methods and having any of the following:

text.zh: g.1. 最大导通电流上升率（di/dt）大于30,000 A/µs，且关断态电压大于1,100 V；或
text.en: g.1. A maximum turn-on current rate of rise (di/dt) greater than 30,000 A/µs and off-state voltage greater than 1,100 V; or

text.zh: g.2. 最大导通电流上升率（di/dt）大于2,000 A/µs，且具有以下全部特性：
text.en: g.2. A maximum turn-on current rate of rise (di/dt) greater than 2,000 A/µs and having all of the following:

text.zh: g.2.a. 关断态峰值电压等于或大于3,000 V；且
text.en: g.2.a. An off-state peak voltage equal to or greater than 3,000 V; and

text.zh: g.2.b. 峰值（浪涌）电流等于或大于3,000 A；
text.en: g.2.b. A peak (surge) current equal to or greater than 3,000 A;
Note 1:

text.zh: 3A001.g包括：
text.en: 3A001.g. includes:

text.zh: —可控硅整流器（SCR）
text.en: —Silicon Controlled Rectifiers (SCRs)

text.zh: —电触发晶闸管（ETT）
text.en: —Electrical Triggering Thyristors (ETTs)

text.zh: —光触发晶闸管（LTT）
text.en: —Light Triggering Thyristors (LTTs)

text.zh: —集成门极换流晶闸管（IGCT）
text.en: —Integrated Gate Commutated Thyristors (IGCTs)

text.zh: —门极可关断晶闸管（GTO）
text.en: —Gate Turn-off Thyristors (GTOs)

text.zh: —MOS控制晶闸管（MCT）
text.en: —MOS Controlled Thyristors (MCTs)

text.zh: —Solidtron固态开关器件
text.en: —Solidtrons
Note 2:

text.zh: 3A001.g不管制集成于为民用铁路或“民用航空器”用途设计的设备中的晶闸管器件和“晶闸管模块”。
text.en: 3A001.g does not control thyristor devices and 'thyristor modules' incorporated into equipment designed for civil railway or “civil aircraft” applications.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就3A001.g而言，“晶闸管模块”含一个或多个晶闸管器件。
text.en: For the purposes of 3A001.g, a 'thyristor module' contains one or more thyristor devices.

text.zh: h. 具有以下全部特性的固态功率半导体开关、二极管或“模块”：
text.en: h. Solid-state power semiconductor switches, diodes, or 'modules', having all of the following:

text.zh: h.1. 额定最高工作结温大于488 K（215 °C）；
text.en: h.1. Rated for a maximum operating junction temperature greater than 488 K (215 °C);

text.zh: h.2. 重复峰值关断态电压（阻断电压）超过300 V；且
text.en: h.2. Repetitive peak off-state voltage (blocking voltage) exceeding 300 V; and

text.zh: h.3. 连续电流大于1 A。
text.en: h.3. Continuous current greater than 1 A.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就3A001.h而言，“模块”含一个或多个固态功率半导体开关或二极管。
text.en: For the purposes of 3A001.h, 'modules' contain one or more solid-state power semiconductor switches or diodes.
Note 1:

text.zh: 3A001.h中的重复峰值关断态电压包括漏源电压、集电极-发射极电压、重复峰值反向电压和重复峰值关断态阻断电压。
text.en: Repetitive peak off-state voltage in 3A001.h includes drain to source voltage, collector to emitter voltage, repetitive peak reverse voltage and peak repetitive off-state blocking voltage.
Note 2:

text.zh: 3A001.h包括：
text.en: 3A001.h includes:

text.zh: —结型场效应晶体管（JFET）
text.en: —Junction Field Effect Transistors (JFETs)

text.zh: —垂直结型场效应晶体管（VJFET）
text.en: —Vertical Junction Field Effect Transistors (VJFETs)

text.zh: —金属氧化物半导体场效应晶体管（MOSFET）
text.en: —Metal Oxide Semiconductor Field Effect Transistors (MOSFETs)

text.zh: —双扩散金属氧化物半导体场效应晶体管（DMOSFET）
text.en: —Double Diffused Metal Oxide Semiconductor Field Effect Transistor (DMOSFET)

text.zh: —绝缘栅双极晶体管（IGBT）
text.en: —Insulated Gate Bipolar Transistor (IGBT)

text.zh: —高电子迁移率晶体管（HEMT）
text.en: —High Electron Mobility Transistors (HEMTs)

text.zh: —双极结型晶体管（BJT）
text.en: —Bipolar Junction Transistors (BJTs)

text.zh: —晶闸管和可控硅整流器（SCR）
text.en: —Thyristors and Silicon Controlled Rectifiers (SCRs)

text.zh: —门极可关断晶闸管（GTO）
text.en: —Gate Turn-Off Thyristors (GTOs)

text.zh: —发射极可关断晶闸管（ETO）
text.en: —Emitter Turn-Off Thyristors (ETOs)

text.zh: —PiN二极管
text.en: —PiN Diodes

text.zh: —肖特基二极管
text.en: —Schottky Diodes
Note 3:

text.zh: 3A001.h不适用于集成于为民用汽车、民用铁路或“民用航空器”用途设计的设备中的开关、二极管或“模块”。
text.en: 3A001.h does not apply to switches, diodes, or 'modules', incorporated into equipment designed for civil automobile, civil railway, or “civil aircraft” applications.

text.zh: i. 为模拟信号设计且具有以下任一特性的强度、幅度或相位电光调制器：
text.en: i. Intensity, amplitude, or phase electro-optic modulators, designed for analog signals and having any of the following:

text.zh: i.1. 最大工作频率大于10 GHz但小于20 GHz，光插入损耗等于或小于3 dB，且具有以下任一特性：
text.en: i.1. A maximum operating frequency of more than 10 GHz but less than 20 GHz, an optical insertion loss equal to or less than 3 dB and having any of the following:

text.zh: i.1.a. 在1 GHz或以下频率测量时，“半波电压”（“Vπ”）小于2.7 V；或
text.en: i.1.a. A 'half-wave voltage' ('Vπ') less than 2.7 V when measured at a frequency of 1 GHz or below; or

text.zh: i.1.b. 在大于1 GHz的频率测量时，“Vπ”小于4 V；或
text.en: i.1.b. A 'Vπ' of less than 4 V when measured at a frequency of more than 1 GHz; or

text.zh: i.2. 最大工作频率等于或大于20 GHz，光插入损耗等于或小于3 dB，且具有以下任一特性：
text.en: i.2. A maximum operating frequency equal to or greater than 20 GHz, an optical insertion loss equal to or less than 3 dB and having any of the following:

text.zh: i.2.a. 在1 GHz或以下频率测量时，“Vπ”小于3.3 V；或
text.en: i.2.a. A 'Vπ' less than 3.3 V when measured at a frequency of 1 GHz or below; or

text.zh: i.2.b. 在大于1 GHz的频率测量时，“Vπ”小于5 V。
text.en: i.2.b. A 'Vπ' less than 5 V when measured at a frequency of more than 1 GHz.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 3A001.i包括具有光输入及输出连接器（例如光纤尾纤）的电光调制器。
text.en: 3A001.i includes electro-optic modulators having optical input and output connectors (e.g., fiber-optic pigtails).

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就3A001.i而言，“半波电压”（“Vπ”）指使在光调制器中传播的光产生180度相位变化所需施加的电压。
text.en: For the purposes of 3A001.i, a 'half-wave voltage' ('Vπ') is the applied voltage necessary to make a phase change of 180 degrees in the wavelength of light propagating through the optical modulator.

text.zh: j.至y. [保留]
text.en: j. through y. [Reserved]

text.zh: z. 3A001所述、达到或超过3A090性能参数的任何商品，如下：
text.en: z. Any commodity described in 3A001 that meets or exceeds the performance parameters in 3A090, as follows:

text.zh: z.1.a. 3A001.b.2所述“单片微波集成电路”（“MMIC”）放大器及3A001.b.3中的分立微波晶体管，同时达到或超过ECCN 3A090.a性能参数，但为民用电信用途出口或再出口的3A001.b.2和b.3物项除外；
text.en: z.1.a “Monolithic Microwave Integrated Circuit” (“MMIC”) amplifiers described in 3A001.b.2 and discrete microwave transistors in 3A001.b.3 that also meet or exceed the performance parameters in ECCN 3A090.a, except those 3A001.b.2 and b.3 items being exported or reexported for use in civil telecommunications applications;

text.zh: z.1.b. 3A001.b.2所述“单片微波集成电路”（“MMIC”）放大器及3A001.b.3中的分立微波晶体管，同时达到或超过ECCN 3A090.b性能参数，但为民用电信用途出口或再出口的3A001.b.2和b.3物项除外；
text.en: z.1.b “Monolithic Microwave Integrated Circuit” (“MMIC”) amplifiers described in 3A001.b.2 and discrete microwave transistors in 3A001.b.3 that also meet or exceed the performance parameters in ECCN 3A090.b, except those 3A001.b.2 and b.3 items being exported or reexported for use in civil telecommunications applications;

text.zh: z.2.a. 3A001.a.1.a所述、可用于“导弹”且同时达到或超过ECCN 3A090.a性能参数的商品；以及3A001.a.5.a所述、为军事用途“设计或改装”、气密封装、额定工作温度范围从低于−54 °C至高于+125 °C，且同时达到或超过ECCN 3A090.a性能参数的商品；
text.en: z.2.a Commodities that are described in 3A001.a.1.a when usable in “missiles” that also meet or exceed the performance parameters in ECCN 3A090.a; and to 3A001.a.5.a when “designed or modified” for military use, hermetically sealed and rated for operation in the temperature range from below −54 °C to above +125 °C and that also meet or exceed the performance parameters in ECCN 3A090.a;

text.zh: z.2.b. 3A001.a.1.a所述、可用于“导弹”且同时达到或超过ECCN 3A090.b性能参数的商品；以及3A001.a.5.a所述、为军事用途“设计或改装”、气密封装、额定工作温度范围从低于−54 °C至高于+125 °C，且同时达到或超过ECCN 3A090.b性能参数的商品；
text.en: z.2.b Commodities that are described in 3A001.a.1.a when usable in “missiles” that also meet or exceed the performance parameters in ECCN 3A090.b; and to 3A001.a.5.a when “designed or modified” for military use, hermetically sealed and rated for operation in the temperature range from below −54 °C to above +125 °C and that also meet or exceed the performance parameters in ECCN 3A090.b;

text.zh: z.3.a. 3A001.e.2所述脉冲放电电容器及3A001.e.3中的超导螺线管电磁体，分别达到或超过3A201.a和3A201.b技术参数，且同时达到或超过ECCN 3A090.a性能参数；
text.en: z.3.a. Pulse discharge capacitors described in 3A001.e.2 and superconducting solenoidal electromagnets in 3A001.e.3 that meet or exceed the technical parameters in 3A201.a and 3A201.b, respectively and that also meet or exceed the performance parameters in ECCN 3A090.a;

text.zh: z.3.b. 3A001.e.2所述脉冲放电电容器及3A001.e.3中的超导螺线管电磁体，分别达到或超过3A201.a和3A201.b技术参数，且同时达到或超过ECCN 3A090.b性能参数；
text.en: z.3.b Pulse discharge capacitors described in 3A001.e.2 and superconducting solenoidal electromagnets in 3A001.e.3 that meet or exceed the technical parameters in 3A201.a and 3A201.b, respectively and that also meet or exceed the performance parameters in ECCN 3A090.b;

text.zh: z.4.a. 本ECCN所列达到或超过ECCN 3A090.a性能参数的所有其他商品；或
text.en: z.4.a. All other commodities specified in this ECCN that meet or exceed the performance parameters of ECCN 3A090.a; or

text.zh: z.4.b. 本ECCN所列达到或超过ECCN 3A090.b性能参数的所有其他商品。
text.en: z.4.b All other commodities specified in this ECCN that meet or exceed the performance parameters of ECCN 3A090.b.

text.en: N.B.:

text.zh: 波形数字化仪和瞬态记录仪见3A002.h。
text.en: For waveform digitizers and transient recorders, see 3A002.h.

text.zh: a.6. 具有以下全部特性的数字数据记录仪：
text.en: a.6. Digital data recorders having all of the following:

text.zh: a.6.a. 向磁盘或固态驱动器存储器持续写入的“连续吞吐量”大于6.4 Gbit/s；且
text.en: a.6.a. A sustained 'continuous throughput' of more than 6.4 Gbit/s to disk or solid-state drive memory; and

text.zh: a.6.b. 在记录射频信号数据的同时对其进行“信号处理”；
text.en: a.6.b. “Signal processing” of the radio frequency signal data while it is being recorded;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:
For the purposes of 3A002.a.6:

text.zh: 1. 对采用并行总线架构的记录仪，“连续吞吐量”速率为最高字速率乘以每字位数。
text.en: 1. For recorders with a parallel bus architecture, the 'continuous throughput' rate is the highest word rate multiplied by the number of bits in a word.

text.zh: 2. “连续吞吐量”指仪器在维持输入数字数据率或数字化仪转换速率的同时，不丢失任何信息地将数据记录至磁盘或固态驱动器存储器的最快数据率。
text.en: 2. 'Continuous throughput' is the fastest data rate the instrument can record to disk or solid-state drive memory without the loss of any information while sustaining the input digital data rate or digitizer conversion rate.

text.zh: a.7. 对每通道任一60 GHz或以上输入3 dB带宽，在产生最低噪声值的垂直刻度设置下，垂直均方根（rms）噪声电压小于满量程2%的实时示波器；
text.en: a.7. Real-time oscilloscopes having a vertical root-mean-square (rms) noise voltage of less than 2% of full-scale at the vertical scale setting that provides the lowest noise value for any input 3dB bandwidth of 60 GHz or greater per channel;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 3A002.a.7不适用于等效时间采样示波器。
text.en: 3A002.a.7 does not apply to equivalent-time sampling oscilloscopes.

text.zh: b. [保留]
text.en: b. [Reserved]

text.zh: c. 如下“信号分析仪”：
text.en: c. “Signal analyzers” as follows:

text.zh: c.1. 在大于31.8 GHz但不超过37 GHz的频率范围内任一点，3 dB分辨率带宽（RBW）超过40 MHz的“信号分析仪”；
text.en: c.1. “Signal analyzers” having a 3 dB resolution bandwidth (RBW) exceeding 40 MHz anywhere within the frequency range exceeding 31.8 GHz but not exceeding 37 GHz;

text.zh: c.2. 在大于43.5 GHz但不超过90 GHz的频率范围内任一点，显示平均噪声电平（DANL）小于（优于）−150 dBm/Hz的“信号分析仪”；
text.en: c.2. “Signal analyzers” having a Displayed Average Noise Level (DANL) less (better) than −150 dBm/Hz anywhere within the frequency range exceeding 43.5 GHz but not exceeding 90 GHz;

text.zh: c.3. 频率超过90 GHz的“信号分析仪”；
text.en: c.3. “Signal analyzers” having a frequency exceeding 90 GHz;

text.zh: c.4. 具有以下全部特性的“信号分析仪”：
text.en: c.4. “Signal analyzers” having all of the following:

text.zh: c.4.a. “实时带宽”超过170 MHz；且
text.en: c.4.a. 'Real-time bandwidth' exceeding 170 MHz; and

text.zh: c.4.b. 具有以下任一特性：
text.en: c.4.b. Having any of the following:

text.zh: c.4.b.1. 对持续时间为15 µs或以下的信号，发现概率为100%，且因间隙或加窗效应造成的幅度损失小于相对于完整幅度的3 dB；或
text.en: c.4.b.1. 100% probability of discovery, with less than a 3 dB reduction from full amplitude due to gaps or windowing effects, of signals having a duration of 15 µs or less; or

text.zh: c.4.b.2. 具有“频率模板触发”功能，对持续时间为15 µs或以下的信号，触发（捕获）概率为100%；
text.en: c.4.b.2. A 'frequency mask trigger' function, with 100% probability of trigger (capture) for signals having a duration of 15 µs or less;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 1. 就3A002.c.4.a而言，“实时带宽”指分析仪在输出或显示转换后数据的同时，采用处理每个输入时间点的傅里叶或其他离散时间变换，将时域数据连续完整地转换为频域结果，且因间隙或加窗效应造成的测量幅度降低不超过相对实际信号幅度3 dB时的最宽频率范围。
text.en: 1. For the purposes of 3A002.c.4.a, 'real-time bandwidth' is the widest frequency range for which the analyzer can continuously transform time-domain data entirely into frequency-domain results, using a Fourier or other discrete time transform that processes every incoming time point, without a reduction of measured amplitude of more than 3 dB below the actual signal amplitude caused by gaps or windowing effects, while outputting or displaying the transformed data.

text.zh: 2. 就3A002.c.4.b.1而言，发现概率也称截获概率或捕获概率。
text.en: 2. For the purposes of 3A002.c.4.b.1., probability of discovery is also referred to as probability of intercept or probability of capture.

text.zh: 3. 就3A002.c.4.b.1而言，100%发现概率所对应的持续时间，等于达到规定电平测量不确定度所需的最短信号持续时间。
text.en: 3. For the purposes of 3A002.c.4.b.1, the duration for 100% probability of discovery is equivalent to the minimum signal duration necessary for the specified level measurement uncertainty.

text.zh: 4. 就3A002.c.4.b.2而言，“频率模板触发”是一种触发功能可选择采集带宽的某个频率子范围作为触发范围，而忽略同一采集带宽内可能存在的其他信号的机制。“频率模板触发”可包含多组独立限值。
text.en: 4. For the purposes of 3A002.c.4.b.2, a 'frequency mask trigger' is a mechanism where the trigger function is able to select a frequency range to be triggered on as a subset of the acquisition bandwidth while ignoring other signals that may also be present within the same acquisition bandwidth. A 'frequency mask trigger' may contain more than one independent set of limits.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 3A002.c.4不适用于仅使用恒定百分比带宽滤波器（亦称倍频程或分数倍频程滤波器）的“信号分析仪”。
text.en: 3A002.c.4 does not apply to those “signal analyzers” using only constant percentage bandwidth filters (also known as octave or fractional octave filters).
c.5. [Reserved]

text.zh: d. 具有以下任一特性的信号发生器：
text.en: d. Signal generators having any of the following:

text.zh: d.1. 规定能在大于31.8 GHz但不超过37 GHz的频率范围内任一点，生成具有以下全部特性的脉冲调制信号：
text.en: d.1. Specified to generate pulse-modulated signals having all of the following, anywhere within the frequency range exceeding 31.8 GHz but not exceeding 37 GHz:

text.zh: d.1.a. “脉冲持续时间”小于25 ns；且
text.en: d.1.a. 'Pulse duration' of less than 25 ns; and

text.zh: d.1.b. 通断比等于或超过65 dB；
text.en: d.1.b. On/off ratio equal to or exceeding 65 dB;

text.zh: d.2. 在大于43.5 GHz但不超过90 GHz的频率范围内任一点，输出功率超过100 mW（20 dBm）；
text.en: d.2. An output power exceeding 100 mW (20 dBm) anywhere within the frequency range exceeding 43.5 GHz but not exceeding 90 GHz;

text.zh: d.3. “频率切换时间”符合以下任一条件：
text.en: d.3. A “frequency switching time” as specified by any of the following:

text.zh: d.3.a. [保留]
text.en: d.3.a. [Reserved]

text.zh: d.3.b. 在大于4.8 GHz但不超过31.8 GHz的频率范围内，对超过2.2 GHz的任意频率变化，切换时间小于100 µs；
text.en: d.3.b. Less than 100 µs for any frequency change exceeding 2.2 GHz within the frequency range exceeding 4.8 GHz but not exceeding 31.8 GHz;

text.zh: d.3.c. [保留]
text.en: d.3.c. [Reserved]

text.zh: d.3.d. 在大于31.8 GHz但不超过37 GHz的频率范围内，对超过550 MHz的任意频率变化，切换时间小于500 µs；
text.en: d.3.d. Less than 500 µs for any frequency change exceeding 550 MHz within the frequency range exceeding 31.8 GHz but not exceeding 37 GHz;

text.zh: d.3.e. 在大于37 GHz但不超过75 GHz的频率范围内，对超过2.2 GHz的任意频率变化，切换时间小于100 µs；或
text.en: d.3.e. Less than 100 µs for any frequency change exceeding 2.2 GHz within the frequency range exceeding 37 GHz but not exceeding 75 GHz; or

text.zh: d.3.f. [保留]
text.en: d.3.f. [Reserved]

text.zh: d.3.g. 在大于75 GHz但不超过90 GHz的频率范围内，对超过5.0 GHz的任意频率变化，切换时间小于100 µs。
text.en: d.3.g. Less than 100 µs for any frequency change exceeding 5.0 GHz within the frequency range exceeding 75 GHz but not exceeding 90 GHz.

text.zh: d.4. 单边带（SSB）相位噪声（dBc/Hz）规定符合以下任一条件：
text.en: d.4. A single sideband (SSB) phase noise, in dBc/Hz, specified as being any of the following:

text.zh: d.4.a. 在大于3.2 GHz但不超过90 GHz的频率范围内任一点，且在10 Hz ≤ F ≤ 10 kHz范围内任一点，小于（优于）−（126 + 20 log_{10} F−20log_{10}f）；或
text.en: d.4.a. Less (better) than −(126 + 20 log_{10} F−20log_{10}f) for anywhere within the range of 10 Hz ≤ F ≤ 10 kHz anywhere within the frequency range exceeding 3.2 GHz but not exceeding 90 GHz; or

text.zh: d.4.b. 在大于3.2 GHz但不超过90 GHz的频率范围内任一点，且在10 kHz < F ≤ 100 kHz范围内任一点，小于（优于）−（206−20log_{10}f）；
text.en: d.4.b. Less (better) than −(206−20log_{10}f) for anywhere within the range of 10 kHz < F ≤ 100 kHz anywhere within the frequency range exceeding 3.2 GHz but not exceeding 90 GHz;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就3A002.d.4而言，F为相对工作频率的偏移量（Hz），f为工作频率（MHz）。
text.en: For the purposes of 3A002.d.4, F is the offset from the operating frequency in Hz and f is the operating frequency in MHz.

text.zh: d.5. 数字基带信号的“射频调制带宽”符合以下任一条件：
text.en: d.5. An 'RF modulation bandwidth' of digital baseband signals as specified by any of the following:

text.zh: d.5.a. 在大于4.8 GHz但不超过31.8 GHz的频率范围内，超过2.2 GHz；
text.en: d.5.a. Exceeding 2.2 GHz within the frequency range exceeding 4.8 GHz but not exceeding 31.8 GHz;

text.zh: d.5.b. 在大于31.8 GHz但不超过37 GHz的频率范围内，超过550 MHz；
text.en: d.5.b. Exceeding 550 MHz within the frequency range exceeding 31.8 GHz but not exceeding 37 GHz;

text.zh: d.5.c. 在大于37 GHz但不超过75 GHz的频率范围内，超过2.2 GHz；
text.en: d.5.c. Exceeding 2.2 GHz within the frequency range exceeding 37 GHz but not exceeding 75 GHz;

text.zh: d.5.d. 在大于75 GHz但不超过90 GHz的频率范围内，超过5.0 GHz；或
text.en: d.5.d. Exceeding 5.0 GHz within the frequency range exceeding 75 GHz but not exceeding 90 GHz; or

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就3A002.d.5而言，“射频调制带宽”指数字编码基带信号调制到射频信号上所占用的射频（RF）带宽，也称信息带宽或矢量调制带宽。I/Q数字调制是产生矢量调制射频输出信号的技术方法，该输出信号通常以“射频调制带宽”表征。
text.en: For the purposes of 3A002.d.5, 'RF modulation bandwidth' is the Radio Frequency (RF) bandwidth occupied by a digitally encoded baseband signal modulated onto an RF signal. It is also referred to as information bandwidth or vector modulation bandwidth. I/Q digital modulation is the technical method for producing a vector-modulated RF output signal, and that output signal is typically specified as having an 'RF modulation bandwidth'.

text.zh: d.6. 最大频率超过90 GHz；
text.en: d.6. A maximum frequency exceeding 90 GHz;
Note 1:

text.zh: 就3A002.d而言，信号发生器包括任意波形发生器和函数发生器。
text.en: For the purposes of 3A002.d, signal generators include arbitrary waveform and function generators.
Note 2:

text.zh: 3A002.d不管制输出频率通过两个或以上晶体振荡器频率相加或相减，或相加或相减后再对结果倍频而产生的设备。
text.en: 3A002.d does not control equipment in which the output frequency is either produced by the addition or subtraction of two or more crystal oscillator frequencies, or by an addition or subtraction followed by a multiplication of the result.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 1. 就3A002.d而言，任意波形发生器或函数发生器的最大频率，按采样率（样本/秒）除以2.5计算。
text.en: 1. For the purposes of 3A002.d, the maximum frequency of an arbitrary waveform or function generator is calculated by dividing the sample rate, in samples/second, by a factor of 2.5.

text.zh: 2. 就3A002.d.1.a而言，“脉冲持续时间”定义为从前沿达到脉冲幅度50%的点，到后沿达到脉冲幅度50%的点之间的时间间隔。
text.en: 2. For the purposes of 3A002.d.1.a, 'pulse duration' is defined as the time interval from the point on the leading edge that is 50% of the pulse amplitude to the point on the trailing edge that is 50% of the pulse amplitude.

text.zh: e. 具有以下任一特性的网络分析仪：
text.en: e. Network analyzers having any of the following:

text.zh: e.1. 在大于43.5 GHz但不超过90 GHz的工作频率范围内任一点，输出功率超过31.62 mW（15 dBm）；
text.en: e.1. An output power exceeding 31.62 mW (15 dBm) anywhere within the operating frequency range exceeding 43.5 GHz but not exceeding 90 GHz;

text.zh: e.2. 在大于90 GHz但不超过110 GHz的工作频率范围内任一点，输出功率超过1 mW（0 dBm）；
text.en: e.2. An output power exceeding 1 mW (0 dBm) anywhere within the operating frequency range exceeding 90 GHz but not exceeding 110 GHz;

text.zh: e.3. 在大于50 GHz但不超过110 GHz的频率下具有“非线性矢量测量功能”；或
text.en: e.3. 'Nonlinear vector measurement functionality' at frequencies exceeding 50 GHz but not exceeding 110 GHz; or

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就3A002.e.3而言，“非线性矢量测量功能”指仪器分析被驱动至大信号区或非线性失真区的器件测试结果的能力。
text.en: For the purposes of 3A002.e.3, 'nonlinear vector measurement functionality' is an instrument's ability to analyze the test results of devices driven into the large-signal domain or the non-linear distortion range.

text.zh: e.4. 最大工作频率超过110 GHz；
text.en: e.4. A maximum operating frequency exceeding 110 GHz;

text.zh: f. 具有以下全部特性的微波测试接收机：
text.en: f. Microwave test receivers having all of the following:

text.zh: f.1. 最大工作频率超过110 GHz；且
text.en: f.1. Maximum operating frequency exceeding 110 GHz; and

text.zh: f.2. 能同时测量幅度和相位；
text.en: f.2. Being capable of measuring amplitude and phase simultaneously;

text.zh: g. 具有以下任一特性的原子频率标准：
text.en: g. Atomic frequency standards being any of the following:

text.zh: g.1. 具有“空间合格”资格；
text.en: g.1. “Space-qualified”;

text.zh: g.2. 非铷型，且长期稳定性小于（优于）1 × 10^{−11}/月；或
text.en: g.2. Non-rubidium and having a long-term stability less (better) than 1 × 10^{−11}/month; or

text.zh: g.3. 非“空间合格”，且具有以下全部特性：
text.en: g.3. Non-“space-qualified” and having all of the following:

text.zh: g.3.a. 为铷频标；
text.en: g.3.a. Being a rubidium standard;

text.zh: g.3.b. 长期稳定性小于（优于）1 × 10^{−11}/月；且
text.en: g.3.b. Long-term stability less (better) than 1 × 10^{−11}/month; and

text.zh: g.3.c. 总功耗小于1瓦。
text.en: g.3.c. Total power consumption of less than 1 Watt.

text.zh: h. 规定执行以下全部功能的“电子组件”、模块或设备：
text.en: h. “Electronic assemblies,” modules or equipment, specified to perform all of the following:

text.zh: h.1. 满足以下任一条件的模数转换：
text.en: h.1. Analog-to-digital conversions meeting any of the following:

text.zh: h.1.a. 分辨率为8 bit或以上但小于10 bit，“采样率”大于1.3吉样本/秒（GSPS）；
text.en: h.1.a. A resolution of 8 bit or more, but less than 10 bit, with a “sample rate” greater than 1.3 Giga Samples Per Second (GSPS);

text.zh: h.1.b. 分辨率为10 bit或以上但小于12 bit，“采样率”大于1.0 GSPS；
text.en: h.1.b. A resolution of 10 bit or more, but less than 12 bit, with a “sample rate” greater than 1.0 GSPS;

text.zh: h.1.c. 分辨率为12 bit或以上但小于14 bit，“采样率”大于1.0 GSPS；
text.en: h.1.c. A resolution of 12 bit or more, but less than 14 bit, with a “sample rate” greater than 1.0 GSPS;

text.zh: h.1.d. 分辨率为14 bit或以上但小于16 bit，“采样率”大于400兆样本/秒（MSPS）；或
text.en: h.1.d. A resolution of 14 bit or more but less than 16 bit, with a “sample rate” greater than 400 Mega Samples Per Second (MSPS); or

text.zh: h.1.e. 分辨率为16 bit或以上，“采样率”大于180 MSPS；且
text.en: h.1.e. A resolution of 16 bit or more with a “sample rate” greater than 180 MSPS; and

text.zh: h.2. 以下任一功能：
text.en: h.2. Any of the following:

text.zh: h.2.a. 输出数字化数据；
text.en: h.2.a. Output of digitized data;

text.zh: h.2.b. 存储数字化数据；或
text.en: h.2.b. Storage of digitized data; or

text.zh: h.2.c. 处理数字化数据；
text.en: h.2.c. Processing of digitized data;

text.zh: 注意：
text.en: N.B.:

text.zh: 数字数据记录仪、示波器、“信号分析仪”、信号发生器、网络分析仪及微波测试接收机，分别由3A002.a.6、3A002.a.7、3A002.c、3A002.d、3A002.e和3A002.f列明。
text.en: Digital data recorders, oscilloscopes, “signal analyzers,” signal generators, network analyzers and microwave test receivers, are specified by 3A002.a.6, 3A002.a.7, 3A002.c, 3A002.d, 3A002.e and 3A002.f, respectively.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 就3A002.h而言：
text.en: For the purposes of 3A002.h:

text.zh: 1. n bit分辨率对应2^{n}个量化等级。
text.en: 1. A resolution of n bit corresponds to a quantization of 2^{n} levels.

text.zh: 2. ADC的分辨率是其数字输出中表示被测模拟输入字的位数。有效位数（ENOB）不用于确定ADC分辨率。
text.en: 2. The resolution of the ADC is the number of bits of the digital output of the ADC that represents the measured analog input word. Effective Number of Bits (ENOB) is not used to determine the resolution of the ADC.

text.zh: 3. 对于非交织多通道“电子组件”、模块或设备，“采样率”不累加，以任一单通道的最大速率为“采样率”。
text.en: 3. For non-interleaved multiple-channel “electronic assemblies”, modules, or equipment, the “sample rate” is not aggregated and the “sample rate” is the maximum rate of any single channel.

text.zh: 4. 对于多通道“电子组件”、模块或设备中的交织通道，各“采样率”累加，以所有交织通道合计的最大总速率为“采样率”。
text.en: 4. For interleaved channels on multiple-channel “electronic assemblies”, modules, or equipment, the “sample rates” are aggregated and the “sample rate” is the maximum combined total rate of all the interleaved channels.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 3A002.h包括ADC卡、波形数字化仪、数据采集卡、信号采集板及瞬态记录仪。
text.en: 3A002.h includes ADC cards, waveform digitizers, data acquisition cards, signal acquisition boards and transient recorders.

source.title: 15 CFR Part 774 — The Commerce Control List

title.zh: 喷雾冷却热管理系统，在密封外壳内采用闭环流体处理及再生设备，利用“专门设计”的喷嘴将介电流体喷到电子“部件”上，以使电子“部件”保持在其工作温度范围内；以及为其“专门设计”的“部件”。
title.en: Spray cooling thermal management systems employing closed loop fluid handling and reconditioning equipment in a sealed enclosure where a dielectric fluid is sprayed onto electronic “components” using “specially designed” spray nozzles that are designed to maintain electronic “components” within their operating temperature range, and “specially designed” “components” therefore.

summary.zh: 喷雾冷却热管理系统，在密封外壳内采用闭环流体处理及再生设备，利用“专门设计”的喷嘴将介电流体喷到电子“部件”上，以使电子“部件”保持在其工作温度范围内；以及为其“专门设计”的“部件”。

text.zh: a. 具有一个或多个数字处理单元且符合以下任一条件的集成电路：
text.en: a. Integrated circuits having one or more digital processing units having either of the following:

text.zh: a.1. “总处理性能”为4800或以上；或
text.en: a.1. A 'total processing performance' of 4800 or more; or

text.zh: a.2. “总处理性能”为1600或以上且“性能密度”为5.92或以上。
text.en: a.2. A 'total processing performance' of 1600 or more and a 'performance density' of 5.92 or more.
Note 1 to 3A090.a:

text.zh: 当“前端制造商”或“OSAT”公司拟出口、再出口或境内转移“适用的先进逻辑集成电路”时，推定该物项属于3A090.a并且为数据中心设计或销售。如果“前端制造商”或“OSAT”公司无法推翻该推定，则必须遵守适用于3A090.a所列物项的所有许可要求。但该推定不适用于“前端制造商”或“OSAT”公司之外的任何实体。“前端制造商”或“OSAT”公司可通过本注1第a至c段所列三种方式中的任一种推翻该推定。
text.en: When a “front-end fabricator” or “OSAT” company is seeking to export, reexport, or transfer (in-country) an “applicable advanced logic integrated circuit,” there is a presumption that the item is 3A090.a and designed or marketed for datacenters. If the “front-end fabricator” or “OSAT” company cannot overcome this presumption, then it must comply with all license requirements applicable to items specified in 3A090.a. However, this presumption does not apply to any entity other than the “front-end fabricator” or “OSAT” company. A “front-end fabricator” or “OSAT” company can overcome this presumption in any of the following three ways outlined in paragraphs a. through c. of this Note 1.

text.zh: a. 如果“适用的先进逻辑集成电路”的设计商是经批准或获授权的集成电路设计商，则由该经批准或获授权的集成电路设计商提供、注明“总处理性能”和“性能密度”且表明该IC不属于3A090.a的数据表或其他证明，即可推翻对“前端制造商”或“OSAT”公司适用的该IC属于ECCN 3A090.a的推定。
text.en: a. If the designer of the “applicable advanced logic integrated circuit” is an approved or authorized integrated circuit designer, then a datasheet or other attestation of the 'total processing performance' and the 'performance density' from the approved or authorized integrated circuit designer indicating that the IC is not specified in 3A090.a will overcome the presumption for the “front-end fabricator” or “OSAT” company that the IC is specified in ECCN 3A090.a.

text.zh: (1) 经批准的集成电路设计商列于EAR本部分附录6；
text.en: (1) Approved integrated circuit designers are listed in supplement no. 6 to this part of the EAR;

text.zh: (2) 2026年12月31日之前，获授权的集成电路设计商包括符合以下条件的所有集成电路设计商：
text.en: (2) Prior to December 31, 2026, authorized integrated circuit designers include all integrated circuit designers:

text.zh: (i) 总部设在台湾或A:1或A:5国家组所列目的地，且其自身不位于澳门或EAR第740部分附录1中D:5国家组所列目的地，其最终母公司总部也不设于这些地方；以及
text.en: (i) Headquartered in Taiwan or a destination specified in Country Group A:1 or A:5, that are neither located in nor have an ultimate parent headquartered in Macau or a destination specified in Country Group D:5 of supplement no. 1 to part 740 of the EAR; and

text.zh: (ii) 已同意向“前端制造商”提交第743.9(b)条所述适用信息，随后“前端制造商”必须向BIS报告该信息。
text.en: (ii) That have agreed to submit applicable information described in § 743.9(b) to the “front-end fabricator,” which the “front-end fabricator” must then report to BIS.

text.zh: (3) 2026年12月31日之后，获授权的集成电路设计商包括同时满足第(2)项标准并已提交成为经批准的集成电路设计商申请的任何集成电路设计商。但是，在2026年12月31日之后被视为获授权IC设计商的任何公司，将在其提交成为经批准IC设计商的申请180天后不再属于获授权IC设计商。
text.en: (3) After December 31, 2026, authorized integrated circuit designers include any integrated circuit designer that both meets the criteria specified in subparagraph (2) and has submitted an application to become an approved integrated circuit designer. However, any company deemed an authorized IC designer after December 31, 2026, will cease to be an authorized IC designer 180 days after the submission of its application to become an approved IC designer.

text.zh: b. 如果集成电路裸片由“前端制造商”在澳门及第740部分附录1中D:5国家组所列目的地以外的地点进行封装，则该“前端制造商”出具的以下证明可推翻对“前端制造商”或“OSAT”公司适用的该IC属于ECCN 3A090.a的推定：(a) 最终封装IC的“合计估算晶体管数量”低于300亿个；或(b) 最终封装IC不含高带宽存储器，且其“合计估算晶体管数量”低于(i) 对2027年完成的任何出口、再出口或境内转移而言为350亿个；或(ii) 对2029年或以后完成的任何出口、再出口或境内转移而言为400亿个。
text.en: b. If the integrated circuit die is packaged by the “front-end fabricator” at a location outside of Macau or a destination specified in Country Group D:5 in supplement no. 1 to part 740, then the attestation of the “front-end fabricator” that (a) the “aggregated approximated transistor count” of the final packaged IC is below 30 billion transistors, or (b) the final packaged IC does not contain high-bandwidth memory and that the “aggregated approximated transistor count” of the final packaged IC is below (i) 35 billion transistors for any exports, reexports, or transfers (in-country) completed in 2027; or (ii) 40 billion transistors for any exports, reexports, or transfers (in-country) completed in 2029 or thereafter, then this overcomes the presumption by the “front-end fabricator” or “OSAT” company that the IC is specified in ECCN 3A090.a.

text.zh: c. 如果集成电路由EAR第740部分附录7所列经批准的“OSAT”公司封装，则该经批准的“OSAT”公司出具的以下证明可推翻对“前端制造商”或“OSAT”公司适用的该IC属于ECCN 3A090.a的推定：(a) 最终封装IC的“合计估算晶体管数量”低于300亿个；或(b) 最终封装IC不含高带宽存储器，且其“合计估算晶体管数量”低于(i) 对2027年完成的任何出口、再出口或境内转移而言为350亿个；或(ii) 对2029年或以后完成的任何出口、再出口或境内转移而言为400亿个。
text.en: c. If the integrated circuit is packaged by an approved “OSAT” company listed in supplement no. 7 to part 740 of the EAR, then the attestation of the approved “OSAT” company that (a) the “aggregated approximated transistor count” of the final packaged IC is below 30 billion transistors, or (b) the final packaged IC does not contain high-bandwidth memory and that the “aggregated approximated transistor count” of the final packaged IC is below (i) 35 billion transistors for any exports, reexports, or transfers (in-country) completed in 2027; or (ii) 40 billion transistors for any exports, reexports, or transfers (in-country) completed in 2029 or thereafter, then this overcomes the presumption by the “front-end fabricator” or “OSAT” company that the IC is specified in ECCN 3A090.a.

text.zh: d. 除本注第a至c段所列三种方式之一外，“前端制造商”或“OSAT”公司仅依赖最终用户或交易其他方的证明来确认ECCN并不足够。在没有EAR第740部分附录6所列经批准的集成电路设计商就“总处理性能”和“性能密度”作出证明的情况下，“前端制造商”或“OSAT”公司必须推定以下任何逻辑集成电路属于ECCN 3A090.a并为数据中心设计或销售：采用“16/14纳米节点”或以下节点制造，或采用非平面晶体管架构制造，并拟用于符合以下条件的商品：(a) 最终封装IC的“合计估算晶体管数量”低于300亿个；或(b) 最终封装IC不含高带宽存储器，且其“合计估算晶体管数量”低于(i) 对2027年完成的任何出口、再出口或境内转移而言为350亿个；或(ii) 对2029年或以后完成的任何出口、再出口或境内转移而言为400亿个；或者最终封装集成电路的“合计估算晶体管数量”无法由“前端制造商”或EAR第740部分附录7所列经批准的“OSAT”公司确认。
text.en: d. It is not sufficient for the “front-end fabricator” or “OSAT” company to confirm the ECCN by relying on the attestation of the end user or other party to the transaction, except under one of the three ways enumerated in paragraphs a. through c. of this note. In the absence of an attestation of the 'total processing performance' and the 'performance density' by an approved integrated circuit designer listed in supplement no. 6 to part 740 of the EAR, the “front-end fabricator” or “OSAT” company must presume that any logic integrated circuit produced using the “16/14 nanometer node” or below, or using a non-planar transistor architecture and destined for a commodity with an (a) “aggregated approximated transistor count” of the final packaged IC is below 30 billion transistors, or (b) the final packaged IC does not contain high-bandwidth memory and that the “aggregated approximated transistor count” of the final packaged IC is below (i) 35 billion transistors for any exports, reexports, or transfers (in-country) completed in 2027; or (ii) 40 billion transistors for any exports, reexports, or transfers (in-country) completed in 2029 or thereafter, or where the “aggregated approximated transistor count,” of the final, packaged integrated circuit cannot be confirmed by the “front-end fabricator,” or an approved “OSAT” company listed in supplement no. 7 to part 740 of the EAR, is specified in ECCN 3A090.a and designed or marketed for a datacenter.

text.zh: 3A090.a技术说明1：
text.en: Technical Note 1 to 3A090.a:

text.zh: 裸片的“估算晶体管数量”为该裸片的“晶体管密度”乘以以平方毫米计量的裸片面积。裸片的“晶体管密度”是指采用制造该裸片的工艺节点时每平方毫米可制造的晶体管数。计算裸片的“估算晶体管数量”时，“前端制造商”或“OSAT”公司有两种选择。第一，“前端制造商”或“OSAT”公司可将制造裸片所用工艺节点的晶体管密度乘以裸片面积。该数值可能明显高于真实晶体管数量，但如果结果低于相关晶体管阈值，则“前端制造商”或“OSAT”公司可确信该裸片不会超过该阈值。第二，对于临界情况，“前端制造商”或“OSAT”公司可利用标准设计验证工具，依据GDS文件估算裸片上有源和无源晶体管的数量。
text.en: The 'approximated transistor count' of a die is the 'transistor density' of the die multiplied by the area of the die measured in square millimeters. The 'transistor density' of the die is the number of transistors that can be fabricated per square millimeter for the process node used to manufacture the die. To calculate the number of 'approximated transistor count' of a die, a “front end fabricator” or “OSAT” company has two options. First, the “front end fabricator” or “OSAT” company may take the transistor density of the process node used to manufacture the die and multiply this density by the area of the die. This number may be significantly higher than the true transistor count, but if the result is below the relevant transistor threshold, then the “front end fabricator” or “OSAT” company can be confident that the die in question will not exceed that threshold. Second, to adjudicate edge cases, the “front end fabricator” or “OSAT” company may use standard design verification tools to estimate the number of (both active and passive) transistors on the die using the GDS file.

text.zh: b. 具有一个或多个数字处理单元且符合以下任一条件的集成电路：
text.en: b. Integrated circuits having one or more digital processing units having either of the following:

text.zh: b.1. “总处理性能”为2400或以上且低于4800，并且“性能密度”为1.6或以上且低于5.92；或
text.en: b.1. A 'total processing performance' of 2400 or more and less than 4800 and a 'performance density' of 1.6 or more and less than 5.92, or

text.zh: b.2. “总处理性能”为1600或以上，并且“性能密度”为3.2或以上且低于5.92。
text.en: b.2. A 'total processing performance' of 1600 or more and a 'performance density' of 3.2 or more and less than 5.92.
Note 2 to 3A090.a and 3A090.b:

text.zh: 3A090.a及3A090.b不适用于并非为数据中心用途设计或销售且“总处理性能”未达到4800的物项。对于并非为数据中心用途设计或销售且“总处理性能”为4800或以上的3A090.a及3A090.b物项，见许可证例外NAC和ACA。
text.en: 3A090.a and 3A090.b do not apply to items that are not designed or marketed for use in datacenters and do not have a 'total processing performance' of 4800 or more. For 3A090.a and 3A090.b items that are not designed or marketed for use in datacenters and that have a 'total processing performance' of 4800 or more, see license exceptions NAC and ACA.
Note 3 to 3A090.a and 3A090.b:

text.zh: 3A090所列集成电路包括图形处理单元（GPU）、张量处理单元（TPU）、神经处理器、存内处理器、视觉处理器、文本处理器、协处理器/加速器、自适应处理器、现场可编程逻辑器件（FPLD）和专用集成电路（ASIC）。集成电路示例见3A001.a的注。
text.en: Integrated circuits specified by 3A090 include graphical processing units (GPUs), tensor processing units (TPUs), neural processors, in-memory processors, vision processors, text processors, co-processors/accelerators, adaptive processors, field-programmable logic devices (FPLDs), and application-specific integrated circuits (ASICs). Examples of integrated circuits are in the Note to 3A001.a.
Note 4 to 3A090.a and 3A090.b:

text.zh: 对于根据3A090注2或注3排除在ECCN 3A090之外的集成电路，也不适用ECCN 3A001.z、4A003.z、4A004.z、4A005.z、4A090、5A002.z、5A004.z、5A992.z、5D002.z或5D992.z项下的分类，因为这些其他CCL分类以含有满足ECCN 3A090管制参数的集成电路，或以其他方式达到或超过ECCN 3A090或4A090的管制参数为依据。ECCN 3A090.c中的性能参数不用于判定物项是否归入某个.z ECCN。见ECCN 3A001.z、4A003.z、4A004.z、4A005.z、4A090、5A002.z、5A004.z、5A992.z、5D002.z或5D992.z的相关管制段落。
text.en: For integrated circuits that are excluded from ECCN 3A090 under Note 2 or 3 to 3A090, those ICs are also not applicable for classifications made under ECCNs 3A001.z, 4A003.z, 4A004.z, 4A005.z, 4A090, 5A002.z, 5A004.z, 5A992.z, 5D002.z, or 5D992.z because those other CCL classifications are based on the incorporation of an integrated circuit that meets the control parameters under ECCN 3A090 or otherwise meets or exceeds the control parameters or ECCNs 3A090 or 4A090. The performance parameters under ECCN 3A090.c are not used for determining whether an item is classified in a .z ECCN. See the Related Controls paragraphs of ECCNs 3A001.z, 4A003.z, 4A004.z, 4A005.z, 4A090, 5A002.z, 5A004.z, 5A992.z, 5D002.z, or 5D992.z.

text.zh: 3A090.a及3A090.b技术说明2：
text.en: Technical Note 2 to 3A090.a and 3A090.b:

text.zh: 1. “总处理性能”（“TPP”）为2 × “MacTOPS” × “运算位长”，并对集成电路上的所有处理单元求和。
text.en: 1. 'Total processing performance' ('TPP') is 2 × 'MacTOPS' × 'bit length of the operation', aggregated over all processing units on the integrated circuit.

text.zh: a. 在3A090中，“MacTOPS”是乘累加运算（D = A × B + C）每秒万亿（10^{12}）次运算的理论峰值。
text.en: a. For purposes of 3A090, 'MacTOPS' is the theoretical peak number of Tera (10^{12}) operations per second for multiply-accumulate computation (D = A × B + C).

text.zh: b. “TPP”公式中的2基于行业惯例：在数据表中，将一次乘累加运算D = A × B + C计为2次运算。因此，2 × MacTOPS可对应于数据表报告的TOPS或FLOPS。
text.en: b. The 2 in the 'TPP' formula is based on industry convention of counting one multiply-accumulate computation, D = A × B + C, as 2 operations for purpose of datasheets. Therefore, 2 × MacTOPS may correspond to the reported TOPS or FLOPS on a datasheet.

text.zh: c. 在3A090中，乘累加运算的“运算位长”为乘法运算输入值中的最大位长。
text.en: c. For purposes of 3A090, 'bit length of the operation' for a multiply-accumulate computation is the largest bit-length of the inputs to the multiply operation.

text.zh: d. 将集成电路上各处理单元的TPP相加得到总值。“TPP” = TPP1 + TPP2 + . . . . + TPPn（其中n为集成电路上的处理单元数量）。
text.en: d. Aggregate the TPPs for each processing unit on the integrated circuit to arrive at a total. 'TPP' = TPP1 + TPP2 + . . . . + TPPn (where n is the number or processing units on the integrated circuit).

text.zh: 2. “MacTOPS”速率应按理论上可能达到的最大值计算。“MacTOPS”速率假定为制造商在该集成电路年报或宣传册中声称的最高值。例如，8位下每秒600万亿次整数运算（或2 × 300 “MacTOPS”）或16位下每秒300万亿次浮点运算（或2 × 150 “MacTOPS”）均可达到4800的“TPP”阈值。如果集成电路设计用于多种位长的MAC运算，并可获得不同“TPP”值，则应以最高“TPP”值对照3A090的参数评估。
text.en: 2. The rate of 'MacTOPS' is to be calculated at its maximum value theoretically possible. The rate of 'MacTOPS' is assumed to be the highest value the manufacturer claims in annual or brochure for the integrated circuit. For example, the 'TPP' threshold of 4800 can be met with 600 tera integer operations (or 2 × 300 'MacTOPS') at 8 bits or 300 tera FLOPS (or 2 × 150 'MacTOPS') at 16 bits. If the integrated circuit is designed for MAC computation with multiple bit lengths that achieve different 'TPP' values, the highest 'TPP' value should be evaluated against parameters in 3A090.

text.zh: 3. 对于同时支持稀疏矩阵和稠密矩阵处理的3A090所列集成电路，“TPP”值为处理稠密矩阵时的数值（即不使用稀疏性）。
text.en: 3. For integrated circuits specified by 3A090 that provide processing of both sparse and dense matrices, the 'TPP' values are the values for processing of dense matrices (e.g., without sparsity).

text.zh: 4. “性能密度”为“TPP”除以“适用裸片面积”。在3A090中，“适用裸片面积”以平方毫米计量，包括采用非平面晶体管架构工艺节点制造的所有逻辑裸片的全部面积。
text.en: 4. 'Performance density' is 'TPP' divided by 'applicable die area'. For purposes of 3A090, 'applicable die area' is measured in millimeters squared and includes all die area of logic dies manufactured with a process node that uses a non-planar transistor architecture.

text.zh: c. “存储器带宽密度”大于每平方毫米每秒2吉字节的高带宽存储器（HBM）。
text.en: c. High bandwidth memory (HBM) having a 'memory bandwidth density' greater than 2 gigabytes per second per square millimeter.

text.zh: 3A090.c技术说明1：
text.en: Technical Note 1 to 3A090.c:

text.zh: “存储器带宽密度”为以吉字节每秒计量的存储器带宽，除以以平方毫米计量的封装或堆叠面积。如果堆叠包含在一个封装内，则使用封装器件的存储器带宽和封装面积。高带宽存储器（HBM）包括动态随机存取存储器集成电路，无论其是否符合JEDEC高带宽存储器（HBM）标准，只要其“存储器带宽密度”大于每平方毫米每秒2吉字节。本管制不涵盖同时包含HBM和逻辑集成电路、且主导功能为处理的共封装集成电路。本管制包括永久附着在逻辑集成电路上的HBM，该逻辑集成电路设计用作控制接口并具有物理层（PHY）功能。
text.en: 'Memory bandwidth density' is the memory bandwidth measured in gigabytes per second divided by the area of the package or stack measured in square millimeters. In the case where a stack is contained in a package, use the memory bandwidth of the packaged device and the area of the package. High bandwidth memory (HBM) includes dynamic random access memory integrated circuits, regardless of whether they conform to the JEDEC standards for high bandwidth memory (HBM), provided they have a 'memory bandwidth density' greater than 2 gigabytes per second per square millimeter. This control does not cover co-packaged integrated circuits with both HBM and logic integrated circuit where the dominant function of the co-packaged integrated circuit is processing. It does include HBM permanently affixed to a logic integrated circuit designed as a control interface and incorporating a physical layer (PHY) function.

text.zh: 3A201.b不管制为医用核磁共振（NMR）成像系统“专门设计”并“作为其零件”出口的磁体。“作为其零件”不一定是指同一批货物中的实体零件；允许由不同来源分批装运，但相关出口文件须明确表明各批货物“作为”该成像系统的“一部分”发运。
