text.zh: 相关管制：(1) 为光刻“设备”“专门设计”的光学反射镜或“非球面光学元件”，见ECCN 3B001。(2) “受ITAR管辖”的万向架，见USML第XII(e)类。(3) 另见6A994。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) For optical mirrors or 'aspheric optical elements' “specially designed” for lithography “equipment,” see ECCN 3B001. (2) See USML Category XII(e) for gimbals “subject to the ITAR.” (3) See also 6A994.

text.zh: 相关定义：“非球面光学元件”是指光学系统中使用的任何元件，其一个或多个成像表面设计为偏离理想球面的形状。
text.en: Related Definitions: An 'aspheric optical element' is any element used in an optical system whose imaging surface or surfaces are designed to depart from the shape of an ideal sphere.

text.zh: 物项：
text.en: Items:

text.zh: a. 下列光学反射镜：
text.en: a. Optical mirrors (reflectors) as follows:

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6A004.a而言，激光诱导损伤阈值（LIDT）按ISO 21254-1:2011测量。
text.en: For the purposes of 6A004.a, Laser Induced Damage Threshold (LIDT) is measured according to ISO 21254-1:2011.

text.zh: a.1. 有效光学口径大于10 mm且具有下列任一特性的“可变形反射镜”，以及为其“专门设计”的部件：
text.en: a.1. 'Deformable mirrors' having an active optical aperture greater than 10 mm and having any of the following, and “specially designed” components therefor:

text.zh: a.1.a. 同时具有以下全部特性：
text.en: a.1.a. Having all the following:

text.zh: a.1.a.1. 机械谐振频率为750 Hz或以上；以及
text.en: a.1.a.1. A mechanical resonant frequency of 750 Hz or more; and

text.zh: a.1.a.2. 超过200个致动器；或
text.en: a.1.a.2. More than 200 actuators; or

text.zh: a.1.b. 激光诱导损伤阈值（LIDT）符合下列任一条件：
text.en: a.1.b. A Laser Induced Damage Threshold (LIDT) being any of the following:

text.zh: a.1.b.1. 使用“连续波激光器”时大于1 kW/cm^{2}；或
text.en: a.1.b.1. Greater than 1 kW/cm^{2} using a “CW laser”; or

text.zh: a.1.b.2. 使用重复频率20 Hz的20 ns“激光”脉冲时大于2 J/cm^{2}；
text.en: a.1.b.2. Greater than 2 J/cm^{2} using 20 ns “laser” pulses at 20 Hz repetition rate;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:
For the purposes of 6A004.a.1:

text.zh: 1. “可变形反射镜”是具有下列任一特性的反射镜：
text.en: 1. 'Deformable mirrors' are mirrors having any of the following:

text.zh: a. 单一连续光学反射面，通过施加独立扭矩或力使其动态变形，以补偿入射至该镜面的光学波形畸变；或
text.en: a. A single continuous optical reflecting surface which is dynamically deformed by the application of individual torques or forces to compensate for distortions in the optical waveform incident upon the mirror; or

text.zh: b. 多个光学反射元件，可通过施加扭矩或力独立动态调整位置，以补偿入射至该镜面的光学波形畸变。
text.en: b. Multiple optical reflecting elements that can be individually and dynamically repositioned by the application of torques or forces to compensate for distortions in the optical waveform incident upon the mirror.

text.zh: 2. “可变形反射镜”也称自适应光学反射镜。
text.en: 2. 'Deformable mirrors' are also known as adaptive optic mirrors.

text.zh: a.2. 平均“等效密度”小于30 kg/m^{2}且总质量超过10 kg的轻量化整体反射镜；
text.en: a.2. Lightweight monolithic mirrors having an average “equivalent density” of less than 30 kg/m^{2} and a total mass exceeding 10 kg;

text.zh: a.3. 平均“等效密度”小于30 kg/m^{2}且总质量超过2 kg的轻量化“复合材料”或泡沫反射镜结构；
text.en: a.3. Lightweight “composite” or foam mirror structures having an average “equivalent density” of less than 30 kg/m^{2} and a total mass exceeding 2 kg;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 6A004.a.2和6A004.a.3不适用于为地面定日镜装置引导太阳辐射而“专门设计”的反射镜。
text.en: 6A004.a.2 and 6A004.a.3 do not apply to mirrors “specially designed” to direct solar radiation for terrestrial heliostat installations.

text.zh: a.4. 为6A004.d.2.a所列光束操纵反射镜台“专门设计”，平面度为λ/10或更优（λ等于633 nm），且具有下列任一特性的反射镜：
text.en: a.4. Mirrors “specially designed” for beam steering mirror stages specified in 6A004.d.2.a with a flatness of λ/10 or better (λ is equal to 633 nm) and having any of the following:

text.zh: a.4.a. 直径或长轴长度大于或等于100 mm；或
text.en: a.4.a. Diameter or major axis length greater than or equal to 100 mm; or

text.zh: a.4.b. 同时具有以下全部特性：
text.en: a.4.b. Having all of the following:

text.zh: a.4.b.1. 直径或长轴长度大于50 mm但小于100 mm；以及
text.en: a.4.b.1. Diameter or major axis length greater than 50 mm but less than 100 mm; and

text.zh: a.4.b.2. 激光诱导损伤阈值（LIDT）符合下列任一条件：
text.en: a.4.b.2. A Laser Induced Damage Threshold (LIDT) being any of the following:

text.zh: a.4.b.2.a. 使用“连续波激光器”时大于10 kW/cm2；或
text.en: a.4.b.2.a. Greater than 10 kW/cm2 using a “CW laser”; or

text.zh: a.4.b.2.b. 使用重复频率20 Hz的20 ns“激光”脉冲时大于20 J/cm2；
text.en: a.4.b.2.b. Greater than 20 J/cm2 using 20 ns “laser” pulses at 20 Hz repetition rate;

text.zh: 特别提示
text.en: N.B.

text.zh: 为光刻设备“专门设计”的光学反射镜，见3B001。
text.en: For optical mirrors “specially designed” for lithography equipment, see 3B001.

text.zh: b. 由硒化锌（ZnSe）或硫化锌（ZnS）制成，在大于3,000 nm但不超过25,000 nm的波长范围透射，且具有下列任一特性的光学“部件”：
text.en: b. Optical “components” made from zinc selenide (ZnSe) or zinc sulfide (ZnS) with transmission in the wavelength range exceeding 3,000 nm but not exceeding 25,000 nm and having any of the following:

text.zh: b.1. 体积超过100 cm^{3}；或
text.en: b.1. Exceeding 100 cm^{3} in volume; or

text.zh: b.2. 直径或长轴长度超过80 mm，且厚度（深度）超过20 mm；
text.en: b.2. Exceeding 80 mm in diameter or length of major axis and 20 mm in thickness (depth);

text.zh: c. 下列光学系统用“航天级”“部件”：
text.en: c. “Space-qualified” “components” for optical systems, as follows:

text.zh: c.1. 经轻量化，与相同口径和厚度的实心坯料相比，“等效密度”低于20%的“部件”；
text.en: c.1. “Components” lightweighted to less than 20% “equivalent density” compared with a solid blank of the same aperture and thickness;

text.zh: c.2. 未加工衬底、具有表面涂层（单层或多层、金属或介质、导电、半导电或绝缘）或保护膜的加工后衬底；
text.en: c.2. Raw substrates, processed substrates having surface coatings (single-layer or multi-layer, metallic or dielectric, conducting, semiconducting or insulating) or having protective films;

text.zh: c.3. 设计为在太空组装成光学系统的反射镜分段或组件，该光学系统的集光口径等于或大于直径1 m的单一光学元件；
text.en: c.3. Segments or assemblies of mirrors designed to be assembled in space into an optical system with a collecting aperture equivalent to or larger than a single optic 1 m in diameter;

text.zh: c.4. 由“复合材料”制造、在任一坐标方向的线性热膨胀系数小于或等于5 × 10^{−6}/K的“部件”；
text.en: c.4. “Components” manufactured from “composite” materials having a coefficient of linear thermal expansion, in any coordinate direction, equal to or less than 5 × 10^{−6}/K;

text.zh: d. 下列光学控制设备：
text.en: d. Optical control equipment as follows:

text.zh: d.1. 为保持6A004.c.1或6A004.c.3管制“航天级”“部件”的面形或方向而“专门设计”的设备；
text.en: d.1. Equipment “specially designed” to maintain the surface figure or orientation of the “space-qualified” “components” controlled by 6A004.c.1 or 6A004.c.3;

text.zh: d.2. 下列操纵、跟踪、稳定和谐振腔对准设备：
text.en: d.2. Steering, tracking, stabilisation and resonator alignment equipment as follows:

text.zh: d.2.a. 设计为承载直径或长轴长度大于50 mm的反射镜，且同时具有以下全部特性的光束操纵反射镜台，以及为其“专门设计”的电子控制设备：
text.en: d.2.a. Beam steering mirror stages designed to carry mirrors having diameter or major axis length greater than 50 mm and having all of the following, and “specially designed” electronic control equipment therefor:

text.zh: d.2.a.1. 最大角行程为±26 mrad或以上；
text.en: d.2.a.1. A maximum angular travel of ±26 mrad or more;

text.zh: d.2.a.2. 机械谐振频率为500 Hz或以上；以及
text.en: d.2.a.2. A mechanical resonant frequency of 500 Hz or more; and

text.zh: d.2.a.3. 角“准确度”为10 µrad（微弧度）或以下（更优）；
text.en: d.2.a.3. An angular “accuracy” of 10 µrad (microradians) or less (better);

text.zh: d.2.b. 带宽大于或等于100 Hz、且“准确度”为10 µrad或以下（更优）的谐振腔对准设备；
text.en: d.2.b. Resonator alignment equipment having bandwidths equal to or more than 100 Hz and an “accuracy” of 10 µrad or less (better);

text.zh: d.3. 同时具有以下全部特性的万向架：
text.en: d.3. Gimbals having all of the following:

text.zh: d.3.a. 最大回转角超过5°；
text.en: d.3.a. A maximum slew exceeding 5°;

text.zh: d.3.b. 带宽为100 Hz或以上；
text.en: d.3.b. A bandwidth of 100 Hz or more;

text.zh: d.3.c. 角指向误差为200 µrad（微弧度）或以下；以及
text.en: d.3.c. Angular pointing errors of 200 µrad (microradians) or less; and

text.zh: d.3.d. 具有下列任一特性：
text.en: d.3.d. Having any of the following:

text.zh: d.3.d.1. 直径或长轴长度超过0.15 m但不超过1 m，且角加速度能够超过2 rad（弧度）/s^{2}；或
text.en: d.3.d.1. Exceeding 0.15 m but not exceeding 1 m in diameter or major axis length and capable of angular accelerations exceeding 2 rad (radians)/s^{2}; or

text.zh: d.3.d.2. 直径或长轴长度超过1 m，且角加速度能够超过0.5 rad（弧度）/s^{2}；
text.en: d.3.d.2. Exceeding 1 m in diameter or major axis length and capable of angular accelerations exceeding 0.5 rad (radians)/s^{2};
d.4. [Reserved]

text.zh: e. 同时具有以下全部特性的“非球面光学元件”：
text.en: e. 'Aspheric optical elements' having all of the following:

text.zh: e.1. 光学口径的最大尺寸大于400 mm；
text.en: e.1. Largest dimension of the optical-aperture greater than 400 mm;

text.zh: e.2. 在采样长度大于或等于1 mm时，表面粗糙度小于1 nm（rms）；以及
text.en: e.2. Surface roughness less than 1 nm (rms) for sampling lengths equal to or greater than 1 mm; and

text.zh: e.3. 在25 °C时，线性热膨胀系数绝对值小于3 × 10^{−6}/K；
text.en: e.3. Coefficient of linear thermal expansion's absolute magnitude less than 3 × 10^{−6}/K at 25 °C;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 1. 就6A004.e而言，“非球面光学元件”是指光学系统中使用的任何元件，其一个或多个成像表面设计为偏离理想球面的形状。
text.en: 1. For the purposes of 6A004.e, an 'aspheric optical element' is any element used in an optical system whose imaging surface or surfaces are designed to depart from the shape of an ideal sphere.

text.zh: 2. 就6A004.e.2而言，制造商无需测量表面粗糙度，除非设计或制造该光学元件的意图是达到或超过管制参数。
text.en: 2. For the purposes of 6A004.e.2, manufacturers are not required to measure the surface roughness unless the optical element was designed or manufactured with the intent to meet, or exceed, the control parameter.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 6A004.e不管制具有下列任一特性的“非球面光学元件”：
text.en: 6A004.e does not control 'aspheric optical elements' having any of the following:

text.zh: a. 最大光学口径尺寸小于1 m，且焦距与口径之比大于或等于4.5:1；
text.en: a. Largest optical-aperture dimension less than 1 m and focal length to aperture ratio equal to or greater than 4.5:1;

text.zh: b. 最大光学口径尺寸大于或等于1 m，且焦距与口径之比大于或等于7:1；
text.en: b. Largest optical-aperture dimension equal to or greater than 1 m and focal length to aperture ratio equal to or greater than 7:1;

text.zh: c. 设计为菲涅耳、蝇眼、条纹、棱镜或衍射光学元件；
text.en: c. Designed as Fresnel, flyeye, stripe, prism or diffractive optical elements;

text.zh: d. 由25 °C时线性热膨胀系数大于2.5 × 10^{−6}/K的硼硅酸盐玻璃制造；或
text.en: d. Fabricated from borosilicate glass having a coefficient of linear thermal expansion greater than 2.5 × 10^{−6}/K at 25 °C; or

text.zh: e. 具有内表面反射能力的X射线光学元件（例如管式反射镜）。
text.en: e. An x-ray optical element having inner mirror capabilities (e.g., tube-type mirrors).

text.zh: f. 同时具有以下全部特性的动态波前测量设备：
text.en: f. Dynamic wavefront measuring equipment having all of the following:

text.zh: f.1. “帧率”大于或等于1 kHz；以及
text.en: f.1. 'Frame rates' equal to or more than 1 kHz; and

text.zh: f.2. 在设计波长下，波前准确度为λ/20或以下（更优）。
text.en: f.2. A wavefront accuracy equal to or less (better) than λ/20 at the designed wavelength.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6A004.f而言，“帧率”是“焦平面阵列”中全部“有效像素”进行积分，以记录波前传感器光学系统所投射图像的频率。
text.en: For the purposes of 6A004.f, 'frame rate' is a frequency at which all “active pixels” in the “focal plane array” are integrated for recording images projected by the wavefront sensor optics.

title.en: “Lasers”, “components” and optical equipment, as follows (see List of Items Controlled), excluding items that are subject to the export licensing authority of the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (see 10 CFR part 110).

summary.en: “Lasers”, “components” and optical equipment, as follows (see List of Items Controlled), excluding items that are subject to the export licensing authority of the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (see 10 CFR part 110).

text.zh: 6A005 下列“激光器”、“部件”和光学设备（见管制物项清单），不包括受核管理委员会出口许可权限管辖的物项（见10 CFR第110部分）。
text.en: 6A005 “Lasers”, “components” and optical equipment, as follows (see List of Items Controlled), excluding items that are subject to the export licensing authority of the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (see 10 CFR part 110).

text.zh: 许可要求
text.en: License Requirements

text.zh: 基于清单的许可证例外（所有许可证例外的说明见第740部分）
text.en: List Based License Exceptions (See Part 740 for a Description of All License Exceptions)

text.zh: LVS：不适用于NP物项。
text.en: LVS: N/A for NP items

text.zh: 所有其他物项为3,000美元。
text.en: $3000 for all other items

text.zh: GBS：适用于6A005.b.6.d.2（6A005.b.6.d.2.b除外）管制的掺钕（玻璃除外）“激光器”，其输出波长大于1,000 nm但不超过1,100 nm，平均或连续波输出功率不超过2 kW，且以脉冲激励、非“调Q”多横模，或连续激励多横模运行；6A005.c.1、c.2和c.3管制的染料及液体激光器，但“脉冲持续时间”小于100 ns时，平均输出功率超过1 W且重复频率超过1 kHz的脉冲单纵模振荡器除外；6A005.d.2管制且连续波最大额定单模或多模输出功率不超过10 kW的CO“激光器”；6A005.d.3管制的CO_{2}或CO/CO_{2}“激光器”，其输出波长在9,000至11,000 nm范围内，脉冲输出不超过每脉冲2 J，且最大额定平均单模或多模输出功率不超过5 kW；以及6A005.d.3管制、以连续波多横模运行且连续波输出功率不超过15 kW的CO_{2}“激光器”。
text.en: GBS: Neodymium-doped (other than glass) “lasers” controlled by 6A005.b.6.d.2 (except 6A005.b.6.d.2.b) that have an output wavelength exceeding 1,000 nm, but not exceeding 1,100 nm, and an average or CW output power not exceeding 2 kW, and operate in a pulse-excited, non- “Q-switched” multiple-transverse mode, or in a continuously excited, multiple-transverse mode; Dye and Liquid Lasers controlled by 6A005.c.1, c.2 and c.3, except for a pulsed single longitudinal mode oscillator having an average output power exceeding 1 W and a repetition rate exceeding 1 kHz if the “pulse duration” is less than 100 ns; CO “lasers” controlled by 6A005.d.2 having a CW maximum rated single or multimode output power not exceeding 10 kW; CO_{2} or CO/CO_{2} “lasers” controlled by 6A005.d.3 having an output wavelength in the range from 9,000 to 11,000 nm and having a pulsed output not exceeding 2 J per pulse and a maximum rated average single or multimode output power not exceeding 5 kW; and CO_{2} “lasers” controlled by 6A005.d.3 that operate in CW multiple-transverse mode, and having a CW output power not exceeding 15 kW.

text.zh: 受管制物项清单
text.en: List of Items Controlled

text.zh: 相关管制：(1) 本条目管制物项的“软件”见ECCN 6D001。(2) 本条目管制物项的技术见ECCN 6E001（“开发”）、6E002（“生产”）和6E201（“使用”）。(3) 另见ECCN 6A205和6A995。(4) 为光刻设备“专门设计”的准分子“激光器”，见ECCN 3B001。(5) 为用于同位素分离而“特别设计”或制备的“激光器”，受核管理委员会出口许可权限管辖（见10 CFR第110部分）。(6) 受ITAR管辖的激光系统或激光器，见USML第XII(b)和(e)类。(7) 受ITAR管辖的某些基于激光的定向能武器系统、设备和部件，见USML第XVIII类。
text.en: Related Controls (1) See ECCN 6D001 for “software” for items controlled under this entry. (2) See ECCNs 6E001 (“development”), 6E002 (“production”), and 6E201 (“use”) for technology for items controlled under this entry. (3) Also see ECCNs 6A205 and 6A995. (4) See ECCN 3B001 for excimer “lasers” “specially designed” for lithography equipment. (5) “Lasers” “especially designed” or prepared for use in isotope separation are subject to the export licensing authority of the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (see 10 CFR part 110). (6) See USML Category XII(b) and (e) for laser systems or lasers subject to the ITAR. (7) See USML Category XVIII for certain laser-based directed energy weapon systems, equipment, and components subject to the ITAR.

text.zh: 相关定义：就6A005而言：(1) “电光效率”定义为“激光器”输出功率（或“平均输出功率”）与运行该“激光器”所需总电输入功率之比，包括电源/电力调节及温度调节/热交换器，见6A005.a.6.b.1和6A005.b.6；(2) “非重复脉冲”指产生单个输出脉冲，或脉冲间时间间隔超过一分钟的“激光器”，见6A005注2和6A005.d.6。
text.en: Related Definitions: For the purposes of 6A005: (1) 'Wall-plug efficiency' is defined as the ratio of “laser” output power (or “average output power”) to total electrical input power required to operate the “laser”, including the power supply/conditioning and thermal conditioning/heat exchanger, see 6A005.a.6.b.1 and 6A005.b.6; (2) 'Non-repetitive pulsed' refers to “lasers” that produce either a single output pulse or that have a time interval between pulses exceeding one minute, see Note 2 of 6A005 and 6A005.d.6.

text.zh: 物项：
text.en: Items:

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Notes:

text.zh: 1. 脉冲“激光器”包括以连续波（CW）模式运行并叠加脉冲的激光器。
text.en: 1. Pulsed “lasers” include those that run in a continuous wave (CW) mode with pulses superimposed.

text.zh: 2. 准分子、半导体、化学、CO、CO^{2}以及“非重复脉冲”钕玻璃“激光器”仅由6A005.d列明。
text.en: 2. Excimer, semiconductor, chemical, CO, CO^{2}, and 'non-repetitive pulsed' Nd:glass “lasers” are only specified by 6A005.d.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6A005注2而言，“非重复脉冲”指产生单个输出脉冲，或脉冲间时间间隔超过一分钟的“激光器”。
text.en: For the purposes of 6A005 Note 2, 'non-repetitive pulsed' refers to “lasers” that produce either a single output pulse or that have a time interval between pulses exceeding one minute.

text.zh: 3. 6A005包括光纤“激光器”。
text.en: 3. 6A005 includes fiber “lasers”.

text.zh: 4. 对于通过一台“激光器”泵浦另一台“激光器”以外的手段进行频率转换（即波长改变）的“激光器”，其管制状态通过同时对源“激光器”输出及频率转换后的光学输出应用管制参数来确定。
text.en: 4. The control status of “lasers” incorporating frequency conversion (i.e., wavelength change) by means other than one “laser” pumping another “laser” is determined by applying the control parameters for both the output of the source “laser” and the frequency-converted optical output.

text.zh: 5. 6A005不管制下列“激光器”：
text.en: 5. 6A005 does not control “lasers” as follows:

text.zh: a. 输出能量低于20 J的红宝石激光器；
text.en: a. Ruby with output energy below 20 J;

text.zh: b. 氮激光器；
text.en: b. Nitrogen;

text.zh: c. 氪激光器。
text.en: c. Krypton.

text.zh: 6. 就6A005.a和6A005.b而言，“单横模”指光束轮廓的M^{2}因子小于1.3的“激光器”，“多横模”指光束轮廓的M^{2}因子为1.3或以上的“激光器”。
text.en: 6. For the purposes of 6A005.a and 6A005.b, 'single transverse mode' refers to “lasers” with a beam profile having an M^{2}-factor of less than 1.3, while 'multiple transverse mode' refers to “lasers” with a beam profile having an M^{2}-factor of 1.3 or higher

text.zh: a. 具有下列任一特性的非“可调谐”连续波“（CW）激光器”：

text.en: 6A005.a.6.b does not control 'multiple transverse mode', industrial “lasers” with output power exceeding 2 kW and not exceeding 6 kW with a total mass greater than 1,200 kg. For the purpose of this note, total mass includes all “components” required to operate the “laser,” e.g., “laser,” power supply, heat exchanger, but excludes external optics for beam conditioning or delivery.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6A005.d.1.d而言，“功率密度”指“激光器”总输出功率除以“叠阵”的发射表面积。
text.en: For the purposes of 6A005.d.1.d, 'power density' means the total “laser” output power divided by the emitter surface area of the 'stacked array'.

text.zh: d.1.e. 6A005.d.1.d所列以外、同时具有以下全部特性的半导体“激光器”“叠阵”：
text.en: d.1.e. Semiconductor “laser” 'stacked arrays', other than those specified by 6A005.d.1.d, having all of the following:

text.zh: d.1.e.1. 为与其他“叠阵”组合形成更大“叠阵”而“专门设计”或改装；以及
text.en: d.1.e.1. “Specially designed” or modified to be combined with other 'stacked arrays' to form a larger 'stacked array'; and

text.zh: d.1.e.2. 具有电子和冷却共同使用的集成连接；
text.en: d.1.e.2. Integrated connections, common for both electronics and cooling;
Note 1:

text.zh: 通过组合6A005.d.1.e所列半导体“激光器”“叠阵”而形成、且并非设计为进一步组合或改装的“叠阵”，由6A005.d.1.d列明。
text.en: 'Stacked arrays', formed by combining semiconductor “laser” 'stacked arrays' specified by 6A005.d.1.e, that are not designed to be further combined or modified are specified by 6A005.d.1.d.
Note 2:

text.zh: 通过组合6A005.d.1.e所列半导体“激光器”“叠阵”而形成、且设计为进一步组合或改装的“叠阵”，由6A005.d.1.e列明。
text.en: 'Stacked arrays', formed by combining semiconductor “laser” 'stacked arrays' specified by 6A005.d.1.e, that are designed to be further combined or modified are specified by 6A005.d.1.e.
Note 3:

text.zh: 6A005.d.1.e不适用于由单个“巴条”构成、设计为制造成首尾相连堆叠线性阵列的模块化组件。
text.en: 6A005.d.1.e does not apply to modular assemblies of single 'bars' designed to be fabricated into end to end stacked linear arrays.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 就6A005.d.1.e而言：
text.en: For the purposes of 6A005.d.1.e:

text.zh: 1. 半导体“激光器”通常称为“激光”二极管。
text.en: 1. Semiconductor “lasers” are commonly called “laser” diodes.

text.zh: 2. “巴条”（也称半导体“激光器”“巴条”、“激光”二极管“巴条”或二极管“巴条”）由多个半导体“激光器”组成一维阵列。
text.en: 2. A 'bar' (also called a semiconductor “laser” 'bar', a “laser” diode 'bar' or diode 'bar') consists of multiple semiconductor “lasers” in a one-dimensional array.

text.zh: 3. “叠阵”由多个“巴条”组成，形成半导体“激光器”的二维阵列。
text.en: 3. A 'stacked array' consists of multiple 'bars' forming a two-dimensional array of semiconductor “lasers”.

text.zh: d.4. 具有下列任一特性的准分子“激光器”：
text.en: d.4. Excimer “lasers” having any of the following:

text.zh: d.4.a. 输出波长不超过150 nm，且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: d.4.a. Output wavelength not exceeding 150 nm and any of the following:

text.zh: d.4.a.1. 每脉冲输出能量超过50 mJ；或
text.en: d.4.a.1. Output energy exceeding 50 mJ per pulse; or

text.zh: d.4.a.2. “平均输出功率”超过1 W；
text.en: d.4.a.2. “Average output power” exceeding 1 W;

text.zh: d.4.b. 输出波长大于150 nm但不超过190 nm，且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: d.4.b. Output wavelength exceeding 150 nm but not exceeding 190 nm and any of the following:

text.zh: d.4.b.1. 每脉冲输出能量超过1.5 J；或
text.en: d.4.b.1. Output energy exceeding 1.5 J per pulse; or

text.zh: d.4.b.2. “平均输出功率”超过120 W；
text.en: d.4.b.2. “Average output power” exceeding 120 W;

text.zh: d.4.c. 输出波长大于190 nm但不超过360 nm，且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: d.4.c. Output wavelength exceeding 190 nm but not exceeding 360 nm and any of the following:

text.zh: d.4.c.1. 每脉冲输出能量超过10 J；或
text.en: d.4.c.1. Output energy exceeding 10 J per pulse; or

text.zh: d.4.c.2. “平均输出功率”超过500 W；或
text.en: d.4.c.2. “Average output power” exceeding 500 W; or

text.zh: d.4.d. 输出波长大于360 nm，且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: d.4.d. Output wavelength exceeding 360 nm and any of the following:

text.zh: d.4.d.1. 每脉冲输出能量超过1.5 J；或
text.en: d.4.d.1. Output energy exceeding 1.5 J per pulse; or

text.zh: d.4.d.2. “平均输出功率”超过30 W；
text.en: d.4.d.2. “Average output power” exceeding 30 W;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 为光刻设备“专门设计”的准分子“激光器”，见3B001。
text.en: For excimer “lasers” “specially designed” for lithography equipment, see 3B001.

text.zh: d.5. 下列“化学激光器”：
text.en: d.5. “Chemical lasers” as follows:

text.zh: d.5.a. 氟化氢（HF）“激光器”；
text.en: d.5.a. Hydrogen Fluoride (HF) “lasers';

text.zh: d.5.b. 氟化氘（DF）“激光器”；
text.en: d.5.b. Deuterium Fluoride (DF) “lasers”;

text.zh: d.5.c. 下列“转移激光器”：
text.en: d.5.c. 'Transfer lasers' as follows:
d.5.c.1. Oxygen Iodine (O_{2}-I) “lasers”;

text.zh: d.5.c.2. 氟化氘—二氧化碳（DF-CO_{2}）“激光器”；
text.en: d.5.c.2. Deuterium Fluoride-Carbon dioxide (DF-CO_{2}) “lasers”;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6A005.d.5.c而言，“转移激光器”是指通过非激光跃迁原子或分子与激光跃迁原子或分子碰撞传递能量，激发激光工作物质的“激光器”。
text.en: For the purposes of 6A005.d.5.c, 'transfer lasers' are “lasers” in which the lasing species are excited through the transfer of energy by collision of a non-lasing atom or molecule with a lasing atom or molecule species.

text.zh: d.6. 具有下列任一特性的“非重复脉冲”钕（Nd）玻璃“激光器”：
text.en: d.6. 'Non-repetitive pulsed' Neodymium (Nd) glass “lasers” having any of the following:

text.zh: d.6.a. “脉冲持续时间”不超过1 µs且每脉冲输出能量超过50 J；或
text.en: d.6.a. A “pulse duration” not exceeding 1 µs and output energy exceeding 50 J per pulse; or

text.zh: d.6.b. “脉冲持续时间”超过1 µs且每脉冲输出能量超过100 J；
text.en: d.6.b. A “pulse duration” exceeding 1 µs and output energy exceeding 100 J per pulse;

text.zh: e. 下列“部件”：
text.en: e. “Components” as follows:

text.zh: e.1. 采用“主动冷却”或热管冷却的反射镜；
text.en: e.1. Mirrors cooled either by 'active cooling' or by heat pipe cooling;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6A005.e.1而言，“主动冷却”是一种光学“部件”冷却技术，利用光学部件表层下方（标称距光学表面小于1 mm）流动的流体从光学器件移除热量。
text.en: For the purposes of 6A005.e.1, 'active cooling' is a cooling technique for optical “components” using flowing fluids within the subsurface (nominally less than 1 mm below the optical surface) of the optical component to remove heat from the optic.

text.zh: e.2. 为与受管制“激光器”配合使用而“专门设计”的光学反射镜，或透射或部分透射光学或电光“部件”，但熔融拉锥光纤合束器和多层介质光栅（MLD）除外；
text.en: e.2. Optical mirrors or transmissive or partially transmissive optical or electro-optical-”components,” other than fused tapered fiber combiners and Multi-Layer Dielectric gratings (MLDs), “specially designed” for use with controlled “lasers”;
Note to 6A005.e.2:

text.zh: 光纤合束器和MLD由6A005.e.3列明。
text.en: Fiber combiners and MLDs are specified by 6A005.e.3.

text.zh: e.3. 下列光纤“激光器”“部件”：
text.en: e.3. Fiber “laser” “components” as follows:

text.zh: e.3.a. 同时具有以下全部特性的多模至多模熔融拉锥光纤合束器：
text.en: e.3.a. Multimode to multimode fused tapered fiber combiners having all of the following:

text.zh: e.3.a.1. 在额定总平均或连续波输出功率超过1,000 W时（不包括通过单模纤芯传输的输出功率，如有），维持优于（小于）或等于0.3 dB的插入损耗；以及
text.en: e.3.a.1. An insertion loss better (less) than or equal to 0.3 dB maintained at a rated total average or CW output power (excluding output power transmitted through the single mode core if present) exceeding 1,000 W; and

text.zh: e.3.a.2. 输入光纤数量大于或等于3；
text.en: e.3.a.2. Number of input fibers equal to or greater than 3;

text.zh: e.3.b. 同时具有以下全部特性的单模至多模熔融拉锥光纤合束器：
text.en: e.3.b. Single mode to multimode fused tapered fiber combiners having all of the following:

text.zh: e.3.b.1. 在额定总平均或连续波输出功率超过4,600 W时，维持优于（小于）0.5 dB的插入损耗；
text.en: e.3.b.1. An insertion loss better (less) than 0.5 dB maintained at a rated total average or CW output power exceeding 4,600 W;

text.zh: e.3.b.2. 输入光纤数量大于或等于3；以及
text.en: e.3.b.2. Number of input fibers equal to or greater than 3; and

text.zh: e.3.b.3. 具有下列任一特性：
text.en: e.3.b.3. Having any of the following:

text.zh: e.3.b.3.a. 输入光纤数量小于或等于5时，在输出端测得的光束参数积（BPP）不超过1.5 mm mrad；或
text.en: e.3.b.3.a. A Beam Parameter Product (BPP) measured at the output not exceeding 1.5 mm mrad for a number of input fibers less than or equal to 5; or

text.zh: e.3.b.3.b. 输入光纤数量大于5时，在输出端测得的BPP不超过2.5 mm mrad；
text.en: e.3.b.3.b. A BPP measured at the output not exceeding 2.5 mm mrad for a number of input fibers greater than 5;

text.zh: e.3.c. 同时具有以下全部特性的MLD：
text.en: e.3.c. MLDs having all of the following:

text.zh: e.3.c.1. 设计为对5个或以上光纤“激光器”进行光谱合束或相干合束；以及
text.en: e.3.c.1. Designed for spectral or coherent beam combination of 5 or more fiber “lasers;” and

text.zh: e.3.c.2. 连续波“激光”诱导损伤阈值（LIDT）大于或等于10 kW/cm^{2}；
text.en: e.3.c.2. CW “Laser” Induced Damage Threshold (LIDT) greater than or equal to 10 kW/cm^{2};

text.zh: f. 下列光学设备：
text.en: f. Optical equipment as follows:

text.zh: 注意：
text.en: N.B.:

text.zh: 可用于“超高功率激光器”（“SHPL”）应用的共孔径光学元件，见《美国军品清单》（22 CFR第121部分）。
text.en: For shared aperture optical elements, capable of operating in “Super-High Power Laser” (“SHPL”) applications, see the U.S. Munitions List (22 CFR part 121).
f.1. [Reserved]

text.zh: 注意：
text.en: N.B.:

text.zh: 此前由6A005.f.1列明的物项，见6A004.f。
text.en: For items previously specified by 6A005.f.1, see 6A004.f.

text.zh: f.2. 为动态测量“SHPL”系统光束角操纵误差而“专门设计”，且角“准确度”为10 µrad（微弧度）或以下（更优）的“激光”诊断设备；
text.en: f.2. “Laser” diagnostic equipment “specially designed” for dynamic measurement of “SHPL” system angular beam steering errors and having an angular “accuracy” of 10 µrad (microradians) or less (better);

text.zh: f.3. 为相控阵“SHPL”系统相干合束而“专门设计”，且具有下列任一特性的光学设备和“部件”：
text.en: f.3. Optical equipment and “components”, “specially designed” for coherent beam combination in a phased-array “SHPL” system and having any of the following:

text.zh: f.3.a. 对于大于1 µm的波长，“准确度”为0.1 µm或以下；或
text.en: f.3.a. An “accuracy” of 0.1 µm or less, for wavelengths greater than 1 µm; or

text.zh: f.3.b. 对于小于或等于1 µm的波长，在设计波长下“准确度”为λ/10或以下（更优）；
text.en: f.3.b. An “accuracy” of λ/10 or less (better) at the designed wavelength, for wavelengths equal to or less than 1 µm;

text.zh: f.4. 为与“SHPL”系统配合使用而“专门设计”的投射望远镜；
text.en: f.4. Projection telescopes “specially designed” for use with “SHPL” systems;

text.zh: g. 同时具有以下全部特性的“激光声探测设备”：
text.en: g. 'Laser acoustic detection equipment' having all of the following:

text.zh: g.1. 连续波“激光器”输出功率大于或等于20 mW；
text.en: g.1. CW “laser” output power greater than or equal to 20 mW;

text.zh: g.2. “激光器”频率稳定性等于或优于（小于）10 MHz；
text.en: g.2. “Laser” frequency stability equal to or better (less) than 10 MHz;

text.zh: g.3. “激光器”波长大于或等于1,000 nm但不超过2,000 nm；
text.en: g.3. “Laser” wavelengths equal to or exceeding 1,000 nm but not exceeding 2,000 nm;

text.zh: g.4. 光学系统分辨率优于（小于）1 nm；以及
text.en: g.4. Optical system resolution better (less) than 1 nm; and

text.zh: g.5. 光学信噪比大于或等于10^{3}。
text.en: g.5. Optical Signal to Noise ratio equal to or exceeding 10^{3}.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6A005.g而言，“激光声探测设备”有时称为“激光”麦克风或粒子流探测麦克风。
text.en: For the purposes of 6A005.g, 'laser acoustic detection equipment' is sometimes referred to as a “Laser” Microphone or Particle Flow Detection Microphone.

text.en: 6A006 “Magnetometers”, “magnetic gradiometers”, “intrinsic magnetic gradiometers”, underwater electric field sensors, “compensation systems”, and “specially designed” “components” therefor, as follows (see List of Items Controlled).

text.en: LVS: $1500, N/A for 6A006.a.1; “Magnetometers” and subsystems defined in 6A006.a.2 using optically pumped or nuclear precession (proton/Overhauser) having a 'sensitivity' lower (better) than 2 pT (rms) per square root Hz; and 6A006.d, and 6A006.e.

text.zh: 受管制物项清单
text.en: List of Items Controlled

text.zh: 相关管制：另见6A996。本条目不管制为渔业应用或医疗诊断用生物磁测量而“专门设计”的仪器。
text.en: Related Controls: See also 6A996. This entry does not control instruments “specially designed” for fishery applications or biomagnetic measurements for medical diagnostics.

text.zh: 相关定义：不适用
text.en: Related Definitions: N/A

text.zh: 物项：
text.en: Items:

text.zh: a. 下列“磁力计”和子系统：
text.en: a. “Magnetometers” and subsystems, as follows:

text.zh: a.1. 采用“超导”（SQUID）“技术”且具有下列任一特性的“磁力计”：
text.en: a.1. “Magnetometers” using “superconductive” (SQUID) “technology” and having any of the following:

text.zh: a.1.a. 为静止运行设计、不带为降低运动噪声而“专门设计”的子系统，且在1 Hz频率下“灵敏度”等于或低于（优于）50 fT（rms）/√Hz的SQUID系统；或
text.en: a.1.a. SQUID systems designed for stationary operation, without “specially designed” subsystems designed to reduce in-motion noise, and having a 'sensitivity' equal to or lower (better) than 50 fT (rms) per square root Hz at a frequency of 1 Hz; or

text.zh: a.1.b. 在1 Hz频率下运动中磁力计“灵敏度”低于（优于）20 pT（rms）/√Hz，且为降低运动噪声而“专门设计”的SQUID系统；
text.en: a.1.b. SQUID systems having an in-motion-magnetometer 'sensitivity' lower (better) than 20 pT (rms) per square root Hz at a frequency of 1 Hz and “specially designed” to reduce in-motion noise;

text.zh: a.2. 采用光泵或核旋进（质子/Overhauser）“技术”，且在1 Hz频率下“灵敏度”低于（优于）20 pT（rms）/√Hz的“磁力计”；
text.en: a.2. “Magnetometers” using optically pumped or nuclear precession (proton/Overhauser) “technology” having a 'sensitivity' lower (better) than 20 pT (rms) per square root Hz at a frequency of 1 Hz;

text.zh: a.3. 采用磁通门“技术”，且在1 Hz频率下“灵敏度”等于或低于（优于）10 pT（rms）/√Hz的“磁力计”；
text.en: a.3. “Magnetometers” using fluxgate “technology” having a 'sensitivity' equal to or lower (better) than 10 pT (rms) per square root Hz at a frequency of 1 Hz;

text.zh: a.4. “灵敏度”低于（优于）下列任一值的感应线圈“磁力计”：
text.en: a.4. Induction coil “magnetometers” having a 'sensitivity' lower (better) than any of the following:

text.zh: a.4.a. 频率小于1 Hz时为0.05 nT（rms）/√Hz；
text.en: a.4.a. 0.05 nT (rms)/square root Hz at frequencies of less than 1 Hz;

text.zh: a.4.b. 频率为1 Hz或以上但不超过10 Hz时为1 × 10^{−3} nT（rms）/√Hz；或
text.en: a.4.b. 1 × 10^{−3} nT (rms)/square root Hz at frequencies of 1 Hz or more but not exceeding 10 Hz; or

text.zh: a.4.c. 频率超过10 Hz时为1 × 10^{−4} nT（rms）/√Hz；
text.en: a.4.c. 1 × 10^{−4} nT (rms)/square root Hz at frequencies exceeding 10 Hz;

text.zh: a.5. “灵敏度”低于（优于）1 nT（rms）/√Hz的光纤“磁力计”；
text.en: a.5. Fiber optic “magnetometers” having a 'sensitivity' lower (better) than 1 nT (rms) per square root Hz;

text.zh: b. 在1 Hz下测量时，“灵敏度”低于（优于）8纳伏/米/√Hz的水下电场传感器；
text.en: b. Underwater electric field sensors having a 'sensitivity' lower (better) than 8 nanovolt per meter per square root Hz when measured at 1 Hz;

text.zh: c. 下列“磁梯度计”：
text.en: c. “Magnetic gradiometers” as follows:

text.zh: c.1. 采用多个6A006.a管制“磁力计”的“磁梯度计”；
text.en: c.1. “Magnetic gradiometers” using multiple “magnetometers” controlled by 6A006.a;

text.zh: c.2. 磁场梯度“灵敏度”低于（优于）0.3 nT/m（rms）/√Hz的光纤“本征磁梯度计”；
text.en: c.2. Fiber optic “intrinsic magnetic gradiometers” having a magnetic gradient field 'sensitivity' lower (better) than 0.3 nT/m (rms) per square root Hz;

text.zh: c.3. 采用光纤“技术”以外“技术”，且磁场梯度“灵敏度”低于（优于）0.015 nT/m（rms）/√Hz的“本征磁梯度计”；
text.en: c.3. “Intrinsic magnetic gradiometers”, using “technology” other than fiber-optic “technology”, having a magnetic gradient field 'sensitivity' lower (better) than 0.015 nT/m (rms) per square root Hz;

text.zh: d. 使性能达到或优于6A006.a、6A006.b和6A006.c管制参数的磁场和水下电场传感器“补偿系统”；以及
text.en: d. “Compensation systems” for magnetic and underwater electric field sensors resulting in a performance equal to or better than the control parameters of 6A006.a, 6A006.b, and 6A006.c; and

text.zh: e. 采用6A006.a所列磁场传感器或6A006.b所列水下电场传感器的水下电磁接收机。
text.en: e. Underwater electromagnetic receivers incorporating magnetic field sensors specified by 6A006.a or underwater electric field sensors specified by 6A006.b.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6A006而言，“灵敏度”（噪声水平）是设备自身限制的噪声本底的均方根值，该噪声本底即能够测量的最低信号。
text.en: For the purposes of 6A006, 'sensitivity' (noise level) is the root mean square of the device-limited noise floor which is the lowest signal that can be measured.

text.en: b.1. A static “accuracy” of less (better) than 0.7 mGal; and

text.zh: b.2. 使用中（运行）“准确度”小于（优于）0.7 mGal，在任何随附校正补偿和运动影响组合下，“达到稳态记录的时间”小于2分钟；
text.en: b.2. An in-service (operational) “accuracy” of less (better) than 0.7 mGal having a 'time-to-steady-state registration' of less than 2 minutes under any combination of attendant corrective compensations and motional influences;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6A007.b.2而言，“达到稳态记录的时间”（也称重力仪响应时间）是减小平台引起的加速度（高频噪声）干扰效应所需的时间。
text.en: For the purposes of 6A007.b.2, 'time-to-steady-state registration' (also referred to as the gravimeter's response time) is the time over which the disturbing effects of platform induced accelerations (high frequency noise) are reduced.

text.en: c. Gravity gradiometers.

ECCN 6A998 controls, inter alia, the Light Detection and Ranging (LIDAR) equipment excluded by the note to paragraph j of this ECCN (6A008). (2) See USML Category XII(b) for certain LIDAR, Laser Detection and Ranging (LADAR), or range-gated systems subject to the ITAR.

text.zh: 相关定义：不适用
text.en: Related Definitions: N/A

text.zh: 物项：
text.en: Items:

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 6A008不管制：
text.en: 6A008 does not control:

text.zh: —二次监视雷达（SSR）；
text.en: —Secondary surveillance radar (SSR);

text.zh: —民用汽车雷达；
text.en: —Civil Automotive Radar;

text.zh: —用于空中交通管制（ATC）的显示器或监视器；
text.en: —Displays or monitors used for air traffic control (ATC);

text.zh: —气象（天气）雷达；
text.en: —Meteorological (weather) radar;

text.zh: —符合ICAO标准并采用电子可操纵线性（一维）阵列或机械定位无源天线的精密进近雷达（PAR）设备。
text.en: —Precision Approach Radar (PAR) equipment conforming to ICAO standards and employing electronically steerable linear (1-dimensional) arrays or mechanically positioned passive antennas.

text.zh: a. 工作频率为40 GHz至230 GHz，且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: a. Operating at frequencies from 40 GHz to 230 GHz and having any of the following:

text.zh: a.1. 平均输出功率超过100 mW；或
text.en: a.1. An average output power exceeding 100 mW; or

text.zh: a.2. 距离定位“准确度”为1 m或以下（更优），方位定位“准确度”为0.2度或以下（更优）；
text.en: a.2. Locating “accuracy” of 1 m or less (better) in range and 0.2 degree or less (better) in azimuth;

text.zh: b. 可调谐带宽超过“中心工作频率”的±6.25%；
text.en: b. A tunable bandwidth exceeding ±6.25% of the 'center operating frequency';

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6A008.b而言，“中心工作频率”等于最高与最低规定工作频率之和的一半。
text.en: For the purposes of 6A008.b, the 'center operating frequency' equals one half of the sum of the highest plus the lowest specified operating frequencies.

text.zh: c. 能够同时在两个以上载波频率上工作；
text.en: c. Capable of operating simultaneously on more than two carrier frequencies;

text.zh: d. 能够以合成孔径（SAR）、逆合成孔径（ISAR）雷达模式或机载侧视（SLAR）雷达模式运行；
text.en: d. Capable of operating in synthetic aperture (SAR), inverse synthetic aperture (ISAR) radar mode, or sidelooking airborne (SLAR) radar mode;

text.zh: e. 采用电子扫描阵列天线；
text.en: e. Incorporating electronically scanned array antennae;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6A008.e而言，电子扫描阵列天线也称电子可操纵阵列天线。
text.en: For the purposes of 6A008.e, electronically scanned array antennae are also known as electronically steerable array antennae.

text.zh: f. 能够对非合作目标进行测高；
text.en: f. Capable of heightfinding non-cooperative targets;

text.zh: g. 为机载（气球或机体安装）运行而“专门设计”，且具有用于探测移动目标的多普勒“信号处理”；
text.en: g. “Specially designed” for airborne (balloon or airframe mounted) operation and having Doppler “signal processing” for the detection of moving targets;

text.zh: h. 采用雷达信号处理且使用下列任一技术：
text.en: h. Employing processing of radar signals and using any of the following:

text.zh: h.1. “雷达扩频”技术；或
text.en: h.1. “Radar spread spectrum” techniques; or

text.zh: h.2. “雷达频率捷变”技术；
text.en: h.2. “Radar frequency agility” techniques;

text.zh: i. 可在地面运行，最大“仪器显示距离”超过185 km；
text.en: i. Providing ground-based operation with a maximum 'instrumented range' exceeding 185 km;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 6A008.i不管制：
text.en: 6A008.i does not control:

text.zh: a. 渔场监视雷达；
text.en: a. Fishing ground surveillance radar;

text.zh: b. 为航路空中交通管制“专门设计”，且同时具有以下全部特性的地面雷达设备：
text.en: b. Ground radar equipment “specially designed” for en route air traffic control, and having all of the following:

text.zh: 1. 最大“仪器显示距离”为500 km或以下；
text.en: 1. A maximum 'instrumented range' of 500 km or less;

text.zh: 2. 配置为雷达目标数据仅能从雷达站向一个或多个民用ATC中心单向传输；
text.en: 2. Configured so that radar target data can be transmitted only one way from the radar site to one or more civil ATC centers;

text.zh: 3. 不具备从航路ATC中心远程控制雷达扫描速率的功能；以及
text.en: 3. Contains no provisions for remote control of the radar scan rate from the en route ATC center; and

text.zh: 4. 永久安装；
text.en: 4. Permanently installed;

text.zh: c. 气象气球跟踪雷达。
text.en: c. Weather balloon tracking radars.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6A008.i而言，“仪器显示距离”是雷达规定的无模糊显示距离。
text.en: For the purposes of 6A008.i, 'instrumented range' is the specified unambiguous display range of a radar.

text.zh: j. 属于“激光”雷达或光探测与测距（LIDAR）设备，且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: j. Being “laser” radar or Light Detection and Ranging (LIDAR) equipment and having any of the following:

text.zh: j.1. “航天级”；
text.en: j.1. “Space-qualified”;

text.zh: j.2. 采用相干外差或零差探测技术，且角分辨率小于（优于）20 µrad（微弧度）；或
text.en: j.2. Employing coherent heterodyne or homodyne detection techniques and having an angular resolution of less (better) than 20 µrad (microradians); or

text.zh: j.3. 设计为按国际海道测量组织（IHO）《海道测量标准》1a等标准（第5版，2008年2月）或更高标准执行机载近岸水深测量，并使用一个或多个波长大于400 nm但不超过600 nm的“激光器”；
text.en: j.3. Designed for carrying out airborne bathymetric littoral surveys to International Hydrographic Organization (IHO) Order 1a Standard (5th Edition February 2008) for Hydrographic Surveys or better, and using one or more “lasers” with a wavelength exceeding 400 nm but not exceeding 600 nm;
Note 1:

text.zh: 为测绘“专门设计”的LIDAR设备仅由6A008.j.3列明。
text.en: LIDAR equipment “specially designed” for surveying is only specified by 6A008.j.3.
Note 2:

text.zh: 6A008.j不适用于为气象观测“专门设计”的LIDAR设备。
text.en: 6A008.j does not apply to LIDAR equipment “specially designed” for meteorological observation.
Note 3:

text.zh: IHO 1a等标准（第5版，2008年2月）中的参数概述如下：
text.en: Parameters in the IHO Order 1a Standard 5th Edition February 2008 are summarized as follows:

text.zh: 水平准确度（95%置信水平）= 5 m + 深度的5%。
text.en: Horizontal Accuracy (95% Confidence Level)= 5 m + 5% of depth.

text.zh: 归算水深的深度准确度（95%置信水平）= ±√(a^{2} + (b*d)^{2})，其中：
text.en: Depth Accuracy for Reduced Depths (95% confidence level) = ±√(a^{2} + (b*d)^{2}) where:

text.zh: a = 0.5 m = 恒定深度误差，即全部恒定深度误差之和
text.en: a = 0.5 m = constant depth error, i.e., the sum of all constant depth errors

text.zh: b = 0.013 = 随深度变化误差的系数
text.en: b = 0.013 = factor of depth dependent error

text.zh: b*d = 随深度变化的误差，即全部随深度变化误差之和
text.en: b*d = depth dependent error, i.e., the sum of all depth dependent errors

text.zh: d = 深度
text.en: d = depth

text.zh: 地物探测 = 深度不超过40 m时，大于2 m的立方体地物；深度超过40 m时，为深度的10%。
text.en: Feature Detection = Cubic features > 2 m in depths up to 40 m; 10% of depth beyond 40 m.

text.zh: k. 具有采用“脉冲压缩”的“信号处理”子系统，且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: k. Having “signal processing” sub-systems using “pulse compression” and having any of the following:

text.zh: k.1. “脉冲压缩”比超过150；或
text.en: k.1. A “pulse compression” ratio exceeding 150; or

text.zh: k.2. 压缩后脉冲宽度小于200 ns；或
text.en: k.2. A compressed pulse width of less than 200 ns; or

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 6A008.k.2不适用于同时具有以下全部特性的二维“船用雷达”或“船舶交通服务”雷达：
text.en: 6A008.k.2 does not apply to two dimensional 'marine radar' or 'vessel traffic service' radar, having all of the following:

text.zh: a. “脉冲压缩”比不超过150；
text.en: a. “Pulse compression” ratio not exceeding 150;

text.zh: b. 压缩后脉冲宽度大于30 ns；
text.en: b. Compressed pulse width of greater than 30 ns;

text.zh: c. 单个旋转机械扫描天线；
text.en: c. Single and rotating mechanically scanned antenna;

text.zh: d. 峰值输出功率不超过250 W；以及
text.en: d. Peak output power not exceeding 250 W; and

text.zh: e. 不具备“跳频”能力。
text.en: e. Not capable of “frequency hopping”.

text.zh: l. 具有数据处理子系统，且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: l. Having data processing sub-systems and having any of the following:

text.zh: l.1. “自动目标跟踪”，在天线任一次旋转时提供超过下次天线波束通过时刻的预测目标位置；或
text.en: l.1. 'Automatic target tracking' providing, at any antenna rotation, the predicted target position beyond the time of the next antenna beam passage; or

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 6A008.l.1不管制ATC系统中的冲突告警能力或“船用雷达”。
text.en: 6A008.l.1 does not control conflict alert capability in ATC systems, or 'marine radar'.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6A008.l.1而言，“自动目标跟踪”是一种实时自动确定目标最可能位置的外推值并将其作为输出提供的处理技术。
text.en: For the purposes of 6A008.l.1, 'automatic target tracking' is a processing technique that automatically determines and provides as output an extrapolated value of the most probable position of the target in real time.
l.2. [Reserved]
l.3. [Reserved]

text.zh: l.4. 配置为在六秒内对两个或以上“地理分散”的雷达传感器的目标数据进行叠加和相关或融合，以使总体性能超过6A008.f或6A008.i所列任一单独传感器的性能。
text.en: l.4. Configured to provide superposition and correlation, or fusion, of target data within six seconds from two or more 'geographically dispersed' radar sensors to improve the aggregate performance beyond that of any single sensor specified by 6A008.f, or 6A008.i.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6A008.l.4而言，当每个传感器位置与任何其他位置在任一方向上的距离均超过1,500 m时，视为“地理分散”。移动传感器始终视为“地理分散”。
text.en: For the purposes of 6A008.l.4, sensors are considered 'geographically dispersed' when each location is distant from any other more than 1,500 m in any direction. Mobile sensors are always considered 'geographically dispersed'.

text.zh: 注意：
text.en: N.B.:

text.zh: 另见《美国军品清单》（22 CFR第121部分）。
text.en: See also the U.S. Munitions List (22 CFR part 121).

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 6A008.l不适用于为“船舶交通服务”设计的系统、设备和组件。
text.en: 6A008.l does not apply to systems, equipment and assemblies designed for 'vessel traffic services'.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 1. 就6A008而言，“船用雷达”是为在海上、内陆水道或近岸环境安全航行而设计的雷达。
text.en: 1. For the purposes of 6A008, 'marine radar' is a radar that is designed to navigate safely at sea, inland waterways or near-shore environments.

text.zh: 2. 就6A008而言，“船舶交通服务”是一种类似于“航空器”空中交通管制的船舶交通监测和控制服务。
text.en: 2. For the purposes of 6A008, 'vessel traffic service' is a vessel traffic monitoring and control service similar to air traffic control for “aircraft.”

source.title: 15 CFR Part 774 — The Commerce Control List

text.zh: 相关管制：(1) 本条目不管制符合民用气象雷达国际标准的机载民用气象雷达，但其不得含有下列任一项：(a) 相控阵天线；(b) 频率捷变；(c) 扩频；或(d) 为跟踪运载工具而“专门设计”的信号处理。(2) 6A108.a中为“导弹”或《美国军品清单》物项“专门设计”或改装的物项“受ITAR管辖”（见22 CFR第120至130部分）。
text.en: Related Controls: (1) This entry does not control airborne civil weather radar conforming to international standards for civil weather radars provided that they do not incorporate any of the following: (a) Phased array antennas; (b) Frequency agility; (c) Spread spectrum; or (d) Signal processing “specially designed” for the tracking of vehicles. (2) Items in 6A108.a that are “specially designed” or modified for “missiles” or for items on the U.S. Munitions List are “subject to the ITAR” (see 22 CFR parts 120 through 130).

text.zh: 相关定义：激光雷达系统是采用专门的发射、扫描、接收和信号处理技术，利用激光进行回波测距、测向，以及根据位置、径向速度和目标体反射特征识别目标的系统。
text.en: Related Definitions: Laser radar systems are defined as those that embody specialized transmission, scanning, receiving and signal processing techniques for utilization of lasers for echo ranging, direction finding and discrimination of targets by location, radial speed and body reflection characteristics.

text.zh: 物项：a. 为用于“导弹”而设计或改装的雷达和激光雷达系统；
text.en: Items: a. Radar and laser radar systems designed or modified for use in “missiles”;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 6A108.a包括下列物项：
text.en: 6A108.a includes the following:

text.zh: a. 地形轮廓测绘设备；
text.en: a. Terrain contour mapping equipment;

text.zh: b. 成像传感器设备；
text.en: b. Imaging sensor equipment;

text.zh: c. 景象测绘和相关设备（数字和模拟）；
text.en: c. Scene mapping and correlation (both digital and analog) equipment;

text.zh: d. 多普勒导航雷达设备。
text.en: d. Doppler navigation radar equipment.

text.zh: b. 可用于能够达到大于或等于300 km“航程”的火箭、导弹或无人航空器的下列精密跟踪系统：
text.en: b. Precision tracking systems, usable for rockets, missiles, or unmanned aerial vehicles capable of achieving a “range” equal to or greater than 300 km, as follows:

text.zh: b.1. 采用安装在火箭或无人航空器上的代码转换器，结合地面或机载基准或导航卫星系统，对飞行中的位置和速度提供实时测量的跟踪系统；
text.en: b.1. Tracking systems which use a code translator installed on the rocket or unmanned aerial vehicle in conjunction with either surface or airborne references or navigation satellite systems to provide real-time measurements of in-flight position and velocity;

text.zh: b.2. 同时具备以下全部能力的靶场测量雷达，包括相关光学/红外跟踪器：
text.en: b.2. Range instrumentation radars including associated optical/infrared trackers with all of the following capabilities:

text.zh: b.2.a. 角分辨率优于1.5毫弧度；
text.en: b.2.a. Angular resolution better than 1.5 milliradians;

text.zh: b.2.b. 作用距离为30 km或以上，且距离分辨率优于10 m rms；
text.en: b.2.b. Range of 30 km or greater with a range resolution better than 10 m rms;

text.zh: b.2.c. 速度分辨率优于3 m/s。
text.en: b.2.c. Velocity resolution better than 3 m/s.

(3) The act of incorporating a radiation hardened integrated circuit into a TV camera designated as EAR99 does not, in and of itself, cause the TV camera to meet the parameters of ECCN paragraph 6A203.d.

text.zh: 物项：
text.en: Items:

text.zh: a. 下列条纹照相机及为其“专门设计”的部件：
text.en: a. Streak cameras and “specially designed” components therefor, as follows:

text.zh: a.1. 记录速度大于0.5 mm/µs的条纹照相机；
text.en: a.1. Streak cameras with writing speeds greater than 0.5 mm/µs;

text.zh: a.2. 时间分辨率可达50 ns或以下的电子条纹照相机；
text.en: a.2. Electronic streak cameras capable of 50 ns or less time resolution;

text.zh: a.3. 用于6A203.a.2所述照相机的条纹管；
text.en: a.3. Streak tubes for cameras described in 6A203.a.2;

text.zh: a.4. 为与模块化结构条纹照相机配合使用而“专门设计”，使其达到6A203.a.1或.a.2所述性能特性的插件；
text.en: a.4. Plug-ins, “specially designed” for use with streak cameras having modular structures, that enable the performance characteristics described in 6A203.a.1 or .a.2;

text.zh: a.5. 为6A203.a.1所述照相机“专门设计”的同步电子单元，以及由涡轮、反射镜和轴承组成的转子组件。
text.en: a.5. Synchronizing electronics units, and rotor assemblies consisting of turbines, mirrors and bearings, that are “specially designed” for cameras described in 6A203.a.1.

text.zh: b. 下列分幅照相机及为其“专门设计”的部件：
text.en: b. Framing cameras and “specially designed” components therefor, as follows:

text.zh: b.1. 记录速率大于每秒225,000帧的分幅照相机；
text.en: b.1. Framing cameras with recording rates greater than 225,000 frames per second;

text.zh: b.2. 每帧曝光时间可达50 ns或以下的分幅照相机；
text.en: b.2. Framing cameras capable of 50 ns or less frame exposure time;

text.zh: b.3. 快速图像选通（快门）时间为50 ns或以下，且为6A203.b.1或.b.2所述照相机“专门设计”的分幅管和固态成像器件；
text.en: b.3. Framing tubes, and solid-state imaging devices, that have a fast image gating (shutter) time of 50 ns or less and are “specially designed” for cameras described in 6A203.b.1 or .b.2;

text.zh: b.4. 为与模块化结构分幅照相机配合使用而“专门设计”，使其达到6A203.b.1或.b.2所述性能特性的插件；
text.en: b.4. Plug-ins, “specially designed” for use with framing cameras having modular structures, that enable the performance characteristics described in 6A203.b.1 or .b.2;

text.zh: b.5. 为6A203.b.1或.b.2所述照相机“专门设计”的同步电子单元，以及由涡轮、反射镜和轴承组成的转子组件。
text.en: b.5. Synchronizing electronic units, and rotor assemblies consisting of turbines, mirrors and bearings, that are “specially designed” for cameras described in 6A203.b.1 or .b.2.

text.zh: c. 下列固态或电子管照相机及为其“专门设计”的部件：
text.en: c. Solid-state or electron tube cameras and “specially designed” components therefor, as follows:

text.zh: c.1. 快速图像选通（快门）时间为50 ns或以下的固态照相机或电子管照相机；
text.en: c.1. Solid-state cameras, or electron tube cameras, with a fast image gating (shutter) time of 50 ns or less;

text.zh: c.2. 快速图像选通（快门）时间为50 ns或以下，且为6A203.c.1所述照相机“专门设计”的固态成像器件和像增强管；
text.en: c.2. Solid-state imaging devices, and image intensifiers tubes, that have a fast image gating (shutter) time of 50 ns or less and are “specially designed” for cameras described in 6A203.c.1;

text.zh: c.3. 快速图像选通（快门）时间为50 ns或以下的电光快门器件（克尔或普克尔盒）；
text.en: c.3. Electro-optical shuttering devices (Kerr or Pockels cells) with a fast image gating (shutter) time of 50 ns or less;

text.zh: c.4. 为与模块化结构照相机配合使用而“专门设计”，使其达到6A203.c.1所述性能特性的插件。
text.en: c.4. Plug-ins, “specially designed” for use with cameras having modular structures, that enable the performance characteristics described in 6A203.c.1.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 高速单帧照相机可单独使用，以生成动态事件的一幅图像；也可将多台此类照相机组合为顺序触发系统，以生成某一事件的多幅图像。
text.en: High speed single frame cameras can be used alone to produce a single image of a dynamic event, or several such cameras can be combined in a sequentially-triggered system to produce multiple images of an event.

text.zh: d. 为抗辐射加固而“专门设计”或额定，可承受大于5 × 10^{4} Gy（硅）的总辐射剂量且运行性能不降低的抗辐射加固电视摄像机或其镜头。
text.en: d. Radiation-hardened TV cameras, or lenses therefor, “specially designed” or rated as radiation hardened to withstand a total radiation dose greater than 5 × 10^{4} Gy (silicon) without operational degradation.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: Gy（硅）指未屏蔽硅样品受到电离辐射时，每千克吸收的能量（焦耳）。
text.en: The term Gy (silicon) refers to the energy in Joules per kilogram absorbed by an unshielded silicon sample when exposed to ionizing radiation.

text.zh: 物项：a. 同时具有以下两项特性的铜蒸气激光器：
text.en: Items: a. Copper vapor lasers having both of the following characteristics:

text.zh: a.1. 工作波长在500 nm与600 nm之间；以及
text.en: a.1. Operating at wavelengths between 500 nm and 600 nm; and

text.zh: a.2. 平均输出功率大于或等于30 W；
text.en: a.2. An average output power equal to or greater than 30 W;

text.zh: b. 同时具有以下两项特性的氩离子“激光器”：
text.en: b. Argon ion “lasers” having both of the following characteristics:

text.zh: b.1. 工作波长在400 nm与515 nm之间；以及
text.en: b.1. Operating at wavelengths between 400 nm and 515 nm; and

text.zh: b.2. 平均输出功率大于40 W；
text.en: b.2. An average output power greater than 40 W;

text.zh: c. 输出波长在1000 nm与1100 nm之间，且具有下列任一特性的掺钕（玻璃除外）激光器：
text.en: c. Neodymium-doped (other than glass) lasers with an output wavelength between 1000 nm and 1100 nm having either of the following:

text.zh: c.1. 脉冲激励且调Q，脉冲持续时间大于或等于1 ns，且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: c.1. Pulse-excited and Q-switched with a pulse duration equal to or greater than 1 ns, and having either of the following:

text.zh: c.1.a. 单横模输出且平均输出功率大于40 W；或
text.en: c.1.a. A single-transverse mode output with an average output power greater than 40 W; or

text.zh: c.1.b. 多横模输出且平均输出功率大于50 W；或
text.en: c.1.b. A multiple-transverse mode output with an average output power greater than 50 W; or

text.zh: c.2. 采用倍频使输出波长在500 nm与550 nm之间，且平均输出功率大于40 W。
text.en: c.2. Incorporating frequency doubling to give an output wavelength between 500 nm and 550 nm with an average output power of greater than 40 W.

text.zh: d. 同时具有以下全部特性的可调谐脉冲单模染料激光振荡器：
text.en: d. Tunable pulsed single-mode dye laser oscillators having all of the following characteristics:

text.zh: d.1. 工作波长在300 nm与800 nm之间；
text.en: d.1. Operating at wavelengths between 300 nm and 800 nm;

text.zh: d.2. 平均输出大于1 W；
text.en: d.2. An average output greater than 1 W;

text.zh: d.3. 重复频率大于1 kHz；以及
text.en: d.3. A repetition rate greater than 1 kHz; and

text.zh: d.4. 脉冲宽度小于100 ns；
text.en: d.4. Pulse width less than 100 ns;

text.zh: e. 同时具有以下全部特性的可调谐脉冲染料激光放大器和振荡器：
text.en: e. Tunable pulsed dye laser amplifiers and oscillators having all of the following characteristics:

text.zh: e.1. 工作波长在300 nm与800 nm之间；
text.en: e.1. Operating at wavelengths between 300 nm and 800 nm;

text.zh: e.2. 平均输出大于30 W；
text.en: e.2. An average output greater than 30 W;

text.zh: e.3. 重复频率大于1 kHz；以及
text.en: e.3. A repetition rate greater than 1 kHz; and

text.zh: e.4. 脉冲宽度小于100 ns；
text.en: e.4. Pulse width less than 100 ns;
Note to 6A205.e:

text.zh: 6A205.e不管制单模振荡器。
text.en: 6A205.e does not control single mode oscillators.

text.zh: f. 同时具有以下全部特性的紫翠玉激光器：
text.en: f. Alexandrite lasers having all of the following characteristics:

text.zh: f.1. 工作波长在720 nm与800 nm之间；
text.en: f.1. Operating at wavelengths between 720 nm and 800 nm;

text.zh: f.2. 带宽为0.005 nm或以下；
text.en: f.2. A bandwidth of 0.005 nm or less;

text.zh: f.3. 重复频率大于125 Hz；以及
text.en: f.3. A repetition rate greater than 125 Hz; and

text.zh: f.4. 平均输出功率大于30 W；
text.en: f.4. An average output power greater than 30 W;

text.zh: g. 同时具有以下全部特性的脉冲二氧化碳“激光器”：
text.en: g. Pulsed carbon dioxide “lasers” having all of the following characteristics:

text.zh: g.1. 工作波长在9,000 nm与11,000 nm之间；
text.en: g.1. Operating at wavelengths between 9,000 nm and 11,000 nm;

text.zh: g.2. 重复频率大于250 Hz；
text.en: g.2. A repetition rate greater than 250 Hz;

text.zh: g.3. 平均输出功率大于500 W；以及
text.en: g.3. An average output power greater than 500 W; and

text.zh: g.4. 脉冲宽度小于200 ns；
text.en: g.4. Pulse width of less than 200 ns;
Note to 6A205.g:

text.zh: 6A205.g不管制用于切割和焊接等应用的较高功率（通常为1 kW至5 kW）工业CO_{2}激光器，因为此类激光器为连续波，或为脉冲宽度大于200 ns的脉冲激光器。
text.en: 6A205.g does not control the higher power (typically 1 kW to 5 kW) industrial CO_{2} lasers used in applications such as cutting and welding, as these latter lasers are either continuous wave or are pulsed with a pulse width greater than 200 ns.

text.zh: h. 同时具有以下全部特性的脉冲准分子激光器（XeF、XeCl、KrF）：
text.en: h. Pulsed excimer lasers (XeF, XeCl, KrF) having all of the following characteristics:

text.zh: h.1. 工作波长在240 nm与360 nm之间；
text.en: h.1. Operating at wavelengths between 240 nm and 360 nm;

text.zh: h.2. 重复频率大于250 Hz；以及
text.en: h.2. A repetition rate greater than 250 Hz; and

text.zh: h.3. 平均输出功率大于500 W；
text.en: h.3. An average output power greater than 500 W;

text.zh: i. 设计为输出波长16微米且重复频率大于250 Hz的仲氢拉曼频移器；
text.en: i. Para-hydrogen Raman shifters designed to operate at 16 micrometer output wavelength and at a repetition rate greater than 250 Hz.;

text.zh: j. 同时具有以下全部特性的脉冲一氧化碳激光器：
text.en: j. Pulsed carbon monoxide lasers having all of the following characteristics:

text.zh: j.1. 工作波长在5,000与6,000 nm之间；
text.en: j.1. Operating at wavelengths between 5,000 and 6,000 nm;

text.zh: j.2. 重复频率大于250 Hz；
text.en: j.2. A repetition rate greater than 250 Hz;

text.zh: j.3. 平均输出功率大于200 W；以及
text.en: j.3. An average output power greater than 200 W; and

text.zh: j.4. 脉冲宽度小于200 ns。
text.en: j.4. Pulse width of less than 200 ns.

text.zh: ECCN 6A205.j注：
text.en: Note to ECCN 6A205.j:

text.zh: 6A205.j不管制用于切割和焊接等应用的较高功率（通常为1 kW至5 kW）工业CO激光器，因为此类激光器为连续波，或为脉冲宽度大于200 ns的脉冲激光器。
text.en: 6A205.j does not control the higher power (typically 1 kW to 5 kW) industrial CO lasers used in applications such as cutting and welding, because such lasers are either continuous wave or are pulsed with a pulse width greater than 200 ns.

text.zh: 物项：a. 光学滤光片：
text.en: Items: a. Optical filters:

text.zh: a.1. 用于大于250 nm的波长，由多层光学涂层组成，且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: a.1. For wavelengths longer than 250 nm, comprised of multi-layer optical coatings and having either of the following:

text.zh: a.1.a. 半强度全宽（FWHI）带宽小于或等于1 nm，且峰值透射率为90%或以上；或
text.en: a.1.a. Bandwidths equal to or less than 1 nm Full Width Half Intensity (FWHI) and peak transmission of 90% or more; or

text.zh: a.1.b. FWHI带宽小于或等于0.1 nm，且峰值透射率为50%或以上；
text.en: a.1.b. Bandwidths equal to or less than 0.1 nm FWHI and peak transmission of 50% or more;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 6A994不管制具有固定空气隙的光学滤光片或Lyot型滤光片。
text.en: 6A994 does not control optical filters with fixed air gaps or Lyot-type filters.

text.zh: a.2. 用于大于250 nm的波长，且同时具有以下全部特性：
text.en: a.2. For wavelengths longer than 250 nm, and having all of the following:

text.zh: a.2.a. 可在500 nm或以上的光谱范围内调谐；
text.en: a.2.a. Tunable over a spectral range of 500 nm or more;

text.zh: a.2.b. 瞬时光学通带为1.25 nm或以下；
text.en: a.2.b. Instantaneous optical bandpass of 1.25 nm or less;

text.zh: a.2.c. 在可调谐光谱范围内，波长可在0.1 ms内重新设定，准确度为1 nm或更优；以及
text.en: a.2.c. Wavelength resettable within 0.1 ms to an accuracy of 1 nm or better within the tunable spectral range; and

text.zh: a.2.d. 单一峰值透射率为91%或以上；
text.en: a.2.d. A single peak transmission of 91% or more;

text.zh: a.3. 视场为30°或更宽、且响应时间小于或等于1 ns的光学不透明度开关（滤光片）；
text.en: a.3. Optical opacity switches (filters) with a field of view of 30° or wider and a response time equal to or less than 1 ns;

text.zh: b. 在大于1,000 nm但不超过3,000 nm的波长范围内，衰减小于4 dB/km的“氟化物光纤”光缆或其光纤。
text.en: b. “Fluoride fiber” cable, or optical fibers therefor, having an attenuation of less than 4 dB/km in the wavelength range exceeding 1,000 nm but not exceeding 3,000 nm.

text.zh: 物项：a. 具有下列任一特性的二氧化碳（CO_{2}）“激光器”：
text.en: Items: a. Carbon dioxide (CO_{2}) “lasers” having any of the following:

text.zh: a.1. 连续波输出功率超过10 kW；
text.en: a.1. A CW output power exceeding 10 kW;

text.zh: a.2. 脉冲输出的“脉冲持续时间”超过10微秒；以及
text.en: a.2. A pulsed output with a “pulse duration” exceeding 10 microseconds; and

text.zh: a.2.a. 平均输出功率超过10 kW；或
text.en: a.2.a. An average output power exceeding 10 kW; or

text.zh: a.2.b. 脉冲“峰值功率”超过100 kW；或
text.en: a.2.b. A pulsed “peak power” exceeding 100 kW; or

text.zh: a.3. 脉冲输出的“脉冲持续时间”小于或等于10微秒；以及
text.en: a.3. A pulsed output with a “pulse duration” equal to or less than 10 microseconds; and

text.zh: a.3.a. 每脉冲能量超过5 J且“峰值功率”超过2.5 kW；或
text.en: a.3.a. A pulse energy exceeding 5 J per pulse and “peak power” exceeding 2.5 kW; or

text.zh: a.3.b. 平均输出功率超过2.5 kW；
text.en: a.3.b. An average output power exceeding 2.5 kW;

text.zh: b. 下列半导体激光器：
text.en: b. Semiconductor lasers, as follows:

text.zh: b.1. 具有下列特性的单个单横模半导体“激光器”：
text.en: b.1. Individual, single-transverse mode semiconductor “lasers” having:

text.zh: b.1.a. 平均输出功率超过100 mW；或
text.en: b.1.a. An average output power exceeding 100 mW; or

text.zh: b.1.b. 波长超过1,050 nm；
text.en: b.1.b. A wavelength exceeding 1,050 nm;

text.zh: b.2. 波长超过1,050 nm的单个多横模半导体“激光器”，或单个半导体“激光器”组成的阵列；
text.en: b.2. Individual, multiple-transverse mode semiconductor “lasers”, or arrays of individual semiconductor “lasers”, having a wavelength exceeding 1,050 nm;

text.zh: c. 每脉冲输出能量超过20 J的红宝石“激光器”；
text.en: c. Ruby “lasers” having an output energy exceeding 20 J per pulse;

text.zh: d. 输出波长大于975 nm但不超过1,150 nm，且具有下列任一特性的非“可调谐”“脉冲激光器”：
text.en: d. Non-“tunable” “pulsed lasers” having an output wavelength exceeding 975 nm but not exceeding 1,150 nm and having any of the following:

text.zh: d.1. “脉冲持续时间”大于或等于1 ns但不超过1 µs，且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: d.1. A “pulse duration” equal to or exceeding 1 ns but not exceeding 1 µs, and having any of the following:

text.zh: d.1.a. 单横模输出且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: d.1.a. A single transverse mode output and having any of the following:

text.zh: d.1.a.1. “电光效率”超过12%、“平均输出功率”超过10 W，且能够以大于1 kHz的脉冲重复频率运行；或
text.en: d.1.a.1. A ‘wall-plug efficiency’ exceeding 12% and an “average output power” exceeding 10 W and capable of operating at a pulse repetition frequency greater than 1kHz; or

text.zh: d.1.a.2. “平均输出功率”超过20 W；或
text.en: d.1.a.2. An “average output power” exceeding 20 W; or

text.zh: d.1.b. 多横模输出且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: d.1.b. A multiple transverse mode output and having any of the following:

text.zh: d.1.b.1. “电光效率”超过18%且“平均输出功率”超过30 W；
text.en: d.1.b.1. A ‘wall-plug efficiency’ exceeding 18% and an “average output power” exceeding 30 W;

text.zh: d.1.b.2. “峰值功率”超过200 MW；或
text.en: d.1.b.2. A “peak power” exceeding 200 MW; or

text.zh: d.1.b.3. “平均输出功率”超过50 W；或
text.en: d.1.b.3. An “average output power” exceeding 50 W; or

text.zh: d.2. “脉冲持续时间”超过1 µs，且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: d.2. A “pulse duration” exceeding 1 µs and having any of the following:

text.zh: d.2.a. 单横模输出且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: d.2.a. A single transverse mode output and having any of the following:

text.zh: d.2.a.1. “电光效率”超过12%、“平均输出功率”超过10 W，且能够以大于1 kHz的脉冲重复频率运行；或
text.en: d.2.a.1. A ‘wall-plug efficiency’ exceeding 12% and an “average output power” exceeding 10 W and capable of operating at a pulse repetition frequency greater than 1 kHz; or

text.zh: d.2.a.2. “平均输出功率”超过20 W；或
text.en: d.2.a.2. An “average output power” exceeding 20 W; or

text.zh: d.2.b. 多横模输出且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: d.2.b. A multiple transverse mode output and having any of the following:

text.zh: d.2.b.1. “电光效率”超过18%且“平均输出功率”超过30 W；或
text.en: d.2.b.1. A ‘wall-plug efficiency’ exceeding 18% and an “average output power” exceeding 30 W; or

text.zh: d.2.b.2. “平均输出功率”超过500 W；
text.en: d.2.b.2. An “average output power” exceeding 500 W;

text.zh: e. 输出波长大于975 nm但不超过1,150 nm，且具有下列任一特性的非“可调谐”连续波“（CW）激光器”：
text.en: e. Non-“tunable” continuous wave “(CW) lasers”, having an output wavelength exceeding 975 nm but not exceeding 1,150 nm and having any of the following:

text.zh: e.1. 单横模输出且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: e.1. A single transverse mode output and having any of the following:

text.zh: e.1.a. “电光效率”超过12%、“平均输出功率”超过10 W，且能够以大于1 kHz的脉冲重复频率运行；或
text.en: e.1.a. A ‘wall-plug efficiency’ exceeding 12% and an “average output power” exceeding 10 W and capable of operating at a pulse repetition frequency greater than 1 kHz; or

text.zh: e.1.b. “平均输出功率”超过50 W；或
text.en: e.1.b. An “average output power” exceeding 50 W; or

text.zh: e.2. 多横模输出且具有下列任一特性：
text.en: e.2. A multiple transverse mode output and having any of the following:

text.zh: e.2.a. “电光效率”超过18%且“平均输出功率”超过30 W；或
text.en: e.2.a. A ‘wall-plug efficiency’ exceeding 18% and an “average output power” exceeding 30 W; or

text.zh: e.2.b. “平均输出功率”超过500 W；
text.en: e.2.b. An “average output power” exceeding 500 W;

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 6A995.e.2.b不管制输出功率小于或等于2 kW且总质量大于1,200 kg的多横模工业“激光器”。就本注而言，总质量包括运行“激光器”所需的所有“部件”，例如“激光器”、电源和热交换器，但不包括用于光束调节和/或传输的外部光学器件。
text.en: 6A995.e.2.b does not control multiple transverse mode, industrial “lasers” with output power less than or equal to 2kW with a total mass greater than 1,200kg. For the purpose of this note, total mass includes all “components” required to operate the “laser,” e.g., “laser,” power supply, heat exchanger, but excludes external optics for beam conditioning and/or delivery.

text.zh: f. 波长大于1,400 nm但不超过1555 nm，且具有下列任一特性的非“可调谐”“激光器”：
text.en: f. Non-“tunable” “lasers”, having a wavelength exceeding 1,400 nm, but not exceeding 1555 nm and having any of the following:

text.zh: f.1. 每脉冲输出能量超过100 mJ且脉冲“峰值功率”超过1 W；或
text.en: f.1. An output energy exceeding 100 mJ per pulse and a pulsed “peak power” exceeding 1 W; or

text.zh: f.2. 平均或连续波输出功率超过1 W。
text.en: f.2. An average or CW output power exceeding 1 W.

text.zh: g. 自由电子“激光器”。
text.en: g. Free electron “lasers”.

text.en: a. “Magnetometers”, n.e.s., having a 'sensitivity' lower (better) than 1.0 nT (rms) per square root Hz.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6A996而言，“灵敏度”（噪声水平）是设备自身限制的噪声本底的均方根值，该噪声本底即能够测量的最低信号。
text.en: For the purposes of 6A996, 'sensitivity' (noise level) is the root mean square of the device-limited noise floor which is the lowest signal that can be measured.

text.zh: b. “超导”电磁传感器、由“超导”材料制造且同时具有以下全部特性的“部件”：
text.en: b. “Superconductive” electromagnetic sensors, “components” manufactured from “superconductive” materials and having all the following:

text.zh: b.1. 设计为在低于其至少一种“超导”组成材料的“临界温度”下运行（包括约瑟夫森效应器件或“超导”量子干涉器件〔SQUIDS〕）；
text.en: b.1. Designed for operation at temperatures below the “critical temperature” of at least one of their “superconductive” constituents (including Josephson effect devices or “superconductive” quantum interference devices (SQUIDS));

text.zh: b.2. 设计为感测1 KHz或以下频率的电磁场变化；以及
text.en: b.2. Designed for sensing electromagnetic field variations at frequencies of 1 KHz or less; and

text.zh: b.3. 具有下列任一特性：
text.en: b.3. Having any of the following characteristics:

text.zh: b.3.a. 采用最小特征尺寸小于2 µm的薄膜SQUIDS，并具有相关输入和输出耦合电路；
text.en: b.3.a. Incorporating thin-film SQUIDS with a minimum feature size of less than 2 µm and with associated input and output coupling circuits;

text.zh: b.3.b. 设计为在磁场变化率超过每秒1 × 10^{6}个磁通量子时运行；
text.en: b.3.b. Designed to operate with a magnetic field slew rate exceeding 1 × 10^{6} magnetic flux quanta per second;

text.zh: b.3.c. 设计为在地球环境磁场中无需磁屏蔽即可工作；或
text.en: b.3.c. Designed to function without magnetic shielding in the earth's ambient magnetic field; or

text.zh: b.3.d. 温度系数小于0.1磁通量子/K。
text.en: b.3.d. Having a temperature coefficient less (smaller) than 0.1 magnetic flux quantum/K.

text.zh: b.1. 砷酸钛氧钾（KTA）（CAS 59400-80-5）；
text.en: b.1. Potassium titanyl arsenate (KTA) (CAS 59400-80-5);

text.zh: b.2. 硒镓银（AgGaSe_{2}，也称AGSE）（CAS 12002-67-4）；
text.en: b.2. Silver gallium selenide (AgGaSe_{2}, also known as AGSE) (CAS 12002-67-4);

text.zh: b.3. 硒砷铊（Tl_{3}AsSe_{3}，也称TAS）（CAS 16142-89-5）；
text.en: b.3. Thallium arsenic selenide (Tl_{3}AsSe_{3}, also known as TAS) (CAS 16142-89-5);

text.zh: b.4. 磷锗锌（ZnGeP_{2}，也称ZGP、二磷化锌锗〔zinc germanium biphosphide或zinc germanium diphosphide〕）；或
text.en: b.4. Zinc germanium phosphide (ZnGeP_{2}, also known as ZGP, zinc germanium biphosphide or zinc germanium diphosphide); or
b.5. Gallium selenide (GaSe) (CAS 12024-11-2);

text.zh: c. 6C004.b所列以外、具有下列任一特性的非线性光学材料：
text.en: c. Non-linear optical materials, other than those specified by 6C004.b, having any of the following:

text.zh: c.1. 具有以下全部特性：
text.en: c.1. Having all of the following:

text.zh: c.1.a. 动态（也称非稳态）三阶非线性极化率（χ^{(3)}，chi 3）为10^{−6} m^{2}/V^{2}或以上；以及
text.en: c.1.a. Dynamic (also known as nonstationary) third order nonlinear susceptibility (χ^{(3)}, chi 3) of 10^{−6} m^{2}/V^{2} or more; and

text.zh: c.1.b. 响应时间小于1 ms；或
text.en: c.1.b. Response time of less than 1 ms; or

text.zh: c.2. 二阶非线性极化率（χ^{(2)}，chi 2）为3.3 × 10^{−11} m/V或以上；
text.en: c.2. Second order nonlinear susceptibility (χ^{(2)}, chi 2) of 3.3 × 10^{−11} m/V or more;

text.zh: d. 直径或长轴长度超过300 mm的碳化硅或铍—铍（Be/Be）沉积材料“衬底坯料”；
text.en: d. “Substrate blanks” of silicon carbide or beryllium beryllium (Be/Be) deposited materials, exceeding 300 mm in diameter or major axis length;

text.zh: e. 玻璃，包括熔融石英、磷酸盐玻璃、氟磷酸盐玻璃、氟化锆（ZrF_{4}）（CAS 7783-64-4）和氟化铪（HfF_{4}）（CAS 13709-52-9），且同时具有以下全部特性：
text.en: e. Glass, including fused silica, phosphate glass, fluorophosphate glass, zirconium fluoride (ZrF_{4}) (CAS 7783-64-4) and hafnium fluoride (HfF_{4}) (CAS 13709-52-9) and having all of the following:

text.zh: e.1. 氢氧根离子（OH-）浓度低于5 ppm；
text.en: e.1. A hydroxyl ion (OH-) concentration of less than 5 ppm;

text.zh: e.2. 综合金属纯度水平低于1 ppm；以及
text.en: e.2. Integrated metallic purity levels of less than 1 ppm; and

text.zh: e.3. 高均匀性（折射率变化）小于5 × 10^{−6}；
text.en: e.3. High homogeneity (index of refraction variance) less than 5 × 10^{−6};

text.zh: f. 在大于200 nm但不超过14,000 nm的波长范围内，吸收系数小于10^{−5} cm^{−1}的合成金刚石材料。
text.en: f. Synthetically produced diamond material with an absorption of less than 10^{−5} cm^{−1} for wavelengths exceeding 200 nm but not exceeding 14,000 nm.

text.zh: 相关定义：(1) “摩尔分数”定义为晶体中ZnTe的摩尔数与CdTe和ZnTe摩尔数之和的比值。(2) “拍长”是两个初始同相、正交偏振的信号为达到2 Pi弧度相位差所必须传播的距离。
text.en: Related Definitions: (1) ‘Mole fraction’ is defined as the ratio of moles of ZnTe to the sum of the moles of CdTe and ZnTe present in the crystal. text.zh: 声学
text.en: Acoustics

text.zh: a. 下列“软件”：
text.en: a. “Software” as follows:

text.zh: a.1. 为采用拖曳水听器阵列进行被动接收时，对声学数据进行“实时处理”的声波束形成而“专门设计”的“软件”；
text.en: a.1. “Software” “specially designed” for acoustic beam forming for the “real-time processing” of acoustic data for passive reception using towed hydrophone arrays;

text.zh: a.2. 用于采用拖曳水听器阵列进行被动接收时，对声学数据进行“实时处理”的“源代码”；
text.en: a.2. “Source code” for the “real-time processing” of acoustic data for passive reception using towed hydrophone arrays;

text.zh: a.3. 为采用海底或海湾电缆系统进行被动接收时，对声学数据进行“实时处理”的声波束形成而“专门设计”的“软件”；
text.en: a.3. “Software” “specially designed” for acoustic beam forming for the “real-time processing” of acoustic data for passive reception using bottom or bay cable systems;

text.zh: a.4. 用于采用海底或海湾电缆系统进行被动接收时，对声学数据进行“实时处理”的“源代码”；
text.en: a.4. “Source code” for the “real-time processing” of acoustic data for passive reception using bottom or bay cable systems;

text.zh: a.5. 为以下全部用途而“专门设计”的“软件”或“源代码”：
text.en: a.5. “Software” or “source code”, “specially designed” for all of the following:

text.zh: a.5.a. 对6A001.a.1.e管制声纳系统的声学数据进行“实时处理”；以及
text.en: a.5.a. “Real-time processing” of acoustic data from sonar systems controlled by 6A001.a.1.e; and

text.zh: a.5.b. 自动探测、分类并确定潜水员或游泳者的位置；
text.en: a.5.b. Automatically detecting, classifying and determining the location of divers or swimmers;

text.zh: 注意：
text.en: N.B.:

text.zh: 为军用而“专门设计”或改装的潜水员探测“软件”或“源代码”，见《国际武器贸易条例》（ITAR）（22 CFR第121部分）中的《美国军品清单》。
text.en: For diver detection “software” or “source code”, “specially designed” or modified for military use, see the U.S. Munitions List of the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) (22 CFR part 121).

text.zh: b. 光学传感器。无。
text.en: b. Optical sensors. None.

text.zh: 照相机
text.en: Cameras

text.zh: c. 为采用6A002.a.3.f所列“焦平面阵列”的照相机设计或改装，且为移除帧率限制、使照相机超过6A003.b.4注3.a所列帧率而设计或改装的“软件”；
text.en: c. “Software” designed or modified for cameras incorporating “focal plane arrays” specified by 6A002.a.3.f and designed or modified to remove a frame rate restriction and allow the camera to exceed the frame rate specified in 6A003.b.4 Note 3.a;

text.zh: 光学
text.en: Optics

text.zh: d. 为保持分段反射镜系统的对准和相位关系而“专门设计”的“软件”，该系统由直径或长轴长度大于或等于1 m的反射镜分段组成；
text.en: d. “Software” “specially designed” to maintain the alignment and phasing of segmented mirror systems consisting of mirror segments having a diameter or major axis length equal to or larger than 1 m;

text.zh: e. 激光器。无。
text.en: e. Lasers. None.

text.zh: 磁场和电场传感器
text.en: Magnetic and Electric Field Sensors

text.zh: f. 下列“软件”：
text.en: f. “Software” as follows:

text.zh: f.1. 为设计在移动平台上运行的磁传感器的磁场和电场“补偿系统”而“专门设计”的“软件”；
text.en: f.1. “Software” “specially designed” for magnetic and electric field “compensation systems” for magnetic sensors designed to operate on mobile platforms;

text.zh: f.2. 为移动平台上的磁场和电场异常探测而“专门设计”的“软件”；
text.en: f.2. “Software” “specially designed” for magnetic and electric field anomaly detection on mobile platforms;

text.zh: f.3. 为使用6A006.e所列水下电磁接收机对电磁数据进行“实时处理”而“专门设计”的“软件”；
text.en: f.3. “Software” “specially designed” for “real-time processing” of electromagnetic data using underwater electromagnetic receivers specified by 6A006.e;

text.zh: f.4. 用于使用6A006.e所列水下电磁接收机对电磁数据进行“实时处理”的“源代码”；
text.en: f.4. “Source code” for “real-time processing” of electromagnetic data using underwater electromagnetic receivers specified by 6A006.e;

text.zh: 重力仪
text.en: Gravimeters

text.zh: g. 为校正重力仪或重力梯度仪的运动影响而“专门设计”的“软件”；
text.en: g. “Software” “specially designed” to correct motional influences of gravity meters or gravity gradiometers;

text.zh: 雷达
text.en: Radar

text.zh: h. 下列“软件”：
text.en: h. “Software” as follows:

text.zh: h.1. 设计为运行在空中交通管制中心的通用计算机上，且能够接收四部以上一次雷达的雷达目标数据的空中交通管制（ATC）“软件”；
text.en: h.1. Air Traffic Control (ATC) “software” designed to be hosted on general purpose computers located at Air Traffic Control centers and capable of accepting radar target data from more than four primary radars;

text.zh: h.2. 用于设计或“生产”同时具有以下全部特性的雷达天线罩的“软件”：
text.en: h.2. “Software” for the design or “production” of radomes having all of the following:

text.zh: h.2.a. 为保护6A008.e所列“电子扫描阵列天线”而“专门设计”；以及
text.en: h.2.a. “Specially designed” to protect the “electronically scanned array antennae” specified by 6A008.e; and

text.zh: h.2.b. 使天线方向图的“平均旁瓣电平”低于主波束峰值电平超过40 dB。
text.en: h.2.b. Resulting in an antenna pattern having an 'average side lobe level' more than 40 dB below the peak of the main beam level.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6D003.h.2.b而言，“平均旁瓣电平”在整个阵列范围测量，但不包括主波束及主波束两侧前两个旁瓣的角度范围。
text.en: For the purposes of 6D003.h.2.b 'average side lobe level' is measured over the entire array excluding the angular extent of the main beam and the first two side lobes on either side of the main beam.

text.zh: d. 下列“技术”：
text.en: d. “Technology” as follows:

text.zh: d.1. 对光学表面进行涂覆和处理，使直径或长轴长度为500 mm或以上、总损耗（吸收和散射）小于5 × 10^{−3}的光学涂层达到99.5%或更优“光学厚度”均匀性所“必需”的“技术”；
text.en: d.1. “Technology” “required” for the coating and treatment of optical surfaces to achieve an 'optical thickness' uniformity of 99.5% or better for optical coatings 500 mm or more in diameter or major axis length and with a total loss (absorption and scatter) of less than 5 × 10^{−3};

text.zh: 注意：
text.en: N.B.:

text.zh: 另见2E003.f。
text.en: See also 2E003.f.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6E003.d.1而言，“光学厚度”是涂层折射率与物理厚度的数学乘积。
text.en: For the purposes of 6E003.d.1, 'optical thickness' is the mathematical product of the index of refraction and the physical thickness of the coating.

text.zh: d.2. 采用单点金刚石车削技术制造光学器件，在超过0.5 m^{2}的非平面表面上实现优于10 nm rms表面加工“准确度”的“技术”；
text.en: d.2. “Technology” for the fabrication of optics using single point diamond turning techniques to produce surface finish “accuracies” of better than 10 nm rms on non-planar surfaces exceeding 0.5 m^{2};

text.zh: 物项：a. 在任一单轴上以每年超过10 m^{2}表面积的速率批量生产光学“零件”和“部件”的光学制造技术，且同时具有以下全部特性：
text.en: Items: a. Optical fabrication technologies for serially producing optical “parts” and “components” at a rate exceeding 10 m^{2} of surface area per year on any single spindle and having all of the following:

text.zh: a.1. 面积超过1 m^{2}；以及
text.en: a.1. Area exceeding 1 m^{2}; and

text.zh: a.2. 在设计波长下面形超过λ/10（rms）；
text.en: a.2. Surface figure exceeding λ/10 (rms) at the designed wavelength;

text.zh: b. 带宽小于或等于10 nm、视场（FOV）超过40°且分辨率超过每毫弧度0.75线对的光学滤光片的“技术”；
text.en: b. “Technology” for optical filters with a bandwidth equal to or less than 10 nm, a field of view (FOV) exceeding 40° and a resolution exceeding 0.75 line pairs per milliradian;

text.zh: c. 用于“开发”或“生产”6A993管制照相机的“技术”；
text.en: c. “Technology” for the “development” or “production” of cameras controlled by 6A993;

text.zh: d. “开发”或“生产”具有下列任一特性的非三轴磁通门“磁力计”或非三轴磁通门“磁力计”系统所“必需”的“技术”：
text.en: d. “Technology” “required” for the “development” or “production” of non-triaxial fluxgate “magnetometers” or non-triaxial fluxgate “magnetometer” systems, having any of the following:

text.zh: d.1. 在小于1 Hz的频率下，“灵敏度”低于（优于）0.05 nT（rms）/√Hz；或
text.en: d.1. ‘Sensitivity’ lower (better) than 0.05 nT (rms) per square root Hz at frequencies of less than 1 Hz; or

text.zh: d.2. 在1 Hz或以上的频率下，“灵敏度”低于（优于）1 × 10^{−3} nT（rms）/√Hz。
text.en: d.2. ‘Sensitivity’ lower (better) than 1 × 10^{−3} nT (rms) per square root Hz at frequencies of 1 Hz or more.

text.zh: e. “开发”或“生产”同时具有以下全部特性的红外上转换器件所“必需”的“技术”：
text.en: e. “Technology” “required” for the “development” or “production” of infrared up-conversion devices having all of the following:

text.zh: e.1. 在大于700 nm但不超过1500 nm的波长范围具有响应；以及
text.en: e.1. A response in the wavelength range exceeding 700 nm but not exceeding 1500 nm; and

text.zh: e.2. 由红外光电探测器、发光二极管（OLED）和纳米晶体组合，将红外光转换为可见光。
text.en: e.2. A combination of an infrared photodetector, light emitting diode (OLED), and nanocrystal to convert infrared light into visible light.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就6E993而言，“灵敏度”（或噪声水平）是设备自身限制的噪声本底的均方根值，该噪声本底即能够测量的最低信号。
text.en: For the purposes of 6E993, ‘sensitivity’ (or noise level) is the root mean square of the device-limited noise floor which is the lowest signal that can be measured.
