title.zh: 附件4 CCL审查顺序
title.en: Supplement 4: CCL Order of Review

summary.zh: 附件4 CCL审查顺序
summary.en: Supplement 4: CCL Order of Review

text.zh: 第774部分补充文件4——商业管制清单审查顺序
text.en: Supplement No. 4 to Part 774—Commerce Control List Order of Review

text.zh: (a) 如EAR §734.3所述，EAR仅适用于“受EAR管辖”的物项，例如不属于其他机构专属管辖的物项。因此，某物项如由《国际武器贸易条例》（ITAR，22 CFR第120—130部分）的美国军品清单（USML，22 CFR第121部分）描述，包括由其中的兜底条款描述，该物项即为受ITAR管辖的“国防物品”，无需再审查CCL是否描述该物项。见22 CFR §120.6：“国防物品是指ITAR §121.1指定的任何物项或技术数据。§120.3所述政策适用于新增物项的指定。”若USML未描述某物项，且该物项在其他方面“受EAR管辖”，则应依次完成下列各步骤，确定CCL在哪一条目涵盖该物项；如CCL未涵盖，则将其归为EAR99。
text.en: (a) As described in EAR § 734.3, the EAR govern only items “subject to the EAR,” e.g., items not subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of another agency. Thus, for example, if an item is described in the U.S. Munitions List (USML) (22 CFR Part 121) of the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) (22 CFR Parts 120-130), including one of its catch-all paragraphs, then the item is a “defense article” subject to the ITAR and there is no need to review the CCL with respect to whether it describes the item. See 22 CFR § 120.6 (“Defense article means any item or technical data designated in § 121.1 of the ITAR. The policy described in § 120.3 is applicable to designations of additional items”). If an item is not described on the USML and is otherwise “subject to the EAR,” then work through each of the following steps to determine where the item is covered by the CCL or, if it is not covered by the CCL, and is therefore designated as EAR99.

text.zh: (1) 第1步。将“受EAR管辖”的物项与CCL进行归类比对时，首先审查该物项的一般特征。这通常可帮助确定CCL中适当的类别（0至9）。
text.en: (1) Step 1. To classify an item “subject to the EAR” against the CCL, review the general characteristics of the item. This will usually guide you to the appropriate category (0 through 9) on the CCL.

text.zh: (2) 第2步。确定可能适用的CCL类别后，确定该类别或这些类别中的哪个产品组适用于该物项，即A、B、C、D或E。
text.en: (2) Step 2. Once the potentially applicable CCL categories are identified, determine which product group within the CCL category or categories—i.e., A, B, C, D, or E—is applicable to the item.

text.zh: (3) 第3步。“600系列”描述曾受ITAR管辖的军用物项。9x515 ECCN描述曾依据USML第XV类受ITAR管辖的“航天器”、相关物项及某些抗辐射加固微电子电路。如同ITAR实质上优先于EAR，9x515 ECCN或“600系列”ECCN所描述的物项也优先于CCL中的其他ECCN。因此，对“受EAR管辖”物项进行归类分析的下一步，是确定该物项是否由9x515 ECCN或“600系列”ECCN中非“兜底”款描述；兜底款例如“.x”款，其管制为该ECCN或对应USML款中的物项“专门设计”、但未具体列明的“零件”和“部件”。若是，即使其他ECCN也描述该物项，该物项仍归入该9x515 ECCN或“600系列”ECCN款。
text.en: (3) Step 3. The “600 series” describes military items that were once subject to the ITAR. The 9x515 ECCNs describe “spacecraft,” related items, and some radiation-hardened microelectronic circuits that were once subject to the ITAR under USML Category XV. Just as the ITAR effectively trumps the EAR, items described in a 9x515 ECCN or “600 series” ECCN trump other ECCNs on the CCL. Thus, the next step in conducting a classification analysis of an item “subject to the EAR” is to determine whether it is described in a 9x515 ECCN or “600 series” ECCN paragraph other than a “catch-all” paragraph such as a “.x” paragraph that controls unspecified “parts” and “components” “specially designed” for items in that ECCN or the corresponding USML paragraph. If so, the item is classified under that 9x515 ECCN or “600 series” ECCN paragraph even if it would also be described in another ECCN.

text.zh: (4) 第4步。若物项未由9x515 ECCN或“600系列”ECCN描述，则判断其是否归入9x515 ECCN或“600系列”的兜底款，即管制为该ECCN或对应USML款中的物项“专门设计”、但未具体列明的“零件”“部件”“附件”和“附属装置”的条款。此类物项通常列于ECCN 9A515或某个“600系列”ECCN的“.x”款。
text.en: (4) Step 4. If the item is not described in a 9x515 ECCN or “600 series” ECCN, then determine whether the item is classified under a 9x515 ECCN or “600 series” catch-all paragraph, i.e., one that controls non-specific “parts,” “components,” “accessories,” and “attachments” “specially designed” for items in that ECCN or the corresponding USML paragraph. Such items are generally in the “.x” paragraph of ECCN 9A515 or a “600 series” ECCN.

text.zh: (i) 第4.a步。判断该物项是否符合EAR §772.1“专门设计”定义(a)(1)或(a)(2)款中的任一标准；这些款项通常非正式称为“纳入”款。若均不适用，该物项即不属于以“专门设计”为管制参数的ECCN款的范围，跳至第5步。
text.en: (i) Step 4.a. Determine whether the item would meet the criteria of either paragraphs (a)(1) or (a)(2) of the “specially designed” definition in § 772.1 of the EAR. (These are informally known as the “catch” paragraphs.) If not applicable, then the item is not within the scope of the ECCN paragraph that contains a “specially designed” control parameter. Skip to Step 5.

text.zh: (ii) 第4.b步。若物项符合“专门设计”定义(a)(1)或(a)(2)款中的任一标准，则判断该定义(b)款的任何规定是否适用；这些规定通常非正式称为“排除”规定。若适用，该物项即不属于以“专门设计”为管制参数的ECCN款的范围。
text.en: (ii) Step 4.b. If the item meets the criteria of either paragraph (a)(1) or (a)(2) of the “specially designed” definition, then determine whether any of the provisions of paragraph (b) of the “specially designed” definition would apply. (These are informally known as the “release” provisions.) If so, then the item is not within the scope of the ECCN paragraph that contains a “specially designed” control parameter.

text.zh: (a)(4)款说明：
text.en: Note to paragraph (a)(4):

text.zh: 第4.a步和第4.b步中对“管制”一词的强调具有特定含义。某些ECCN将“专门设计”用作解除管制的参数。若某物项因属于“专门设计”定义(a)(1)或(a)(2)项的范围而不归入某个特定ECCN，则无需分析该定义(b)款的任何要素是否适用于该物项。只有在使用“专门设计”一词的ECCN“管制”款中，“专门设计”定义(a)款适用于该物项时，才需审查该定义(b)款的“排除”规定。
text.en: The emphasis on the word “control” in Steps 4.a and 4.b is deliberate. Some ECCNs use “specially designed” as a de-control parameter. If an item would not be classified under a particular ECCN because it falls within the scope of either subparagraph (a)(1) or (a)(2) of the “specially designed” definition, then there is no need to analyze whether any element of paragraph (b) of the definition would apply to the item. One needs only review the “release” provisions in paragraph (b) of the “specially designed” definition if paragraph (a) of the “specially designed” definition applies to the item in a “control” paragraph of an ECCN that uses the term “specially designed.”

text.zh: (5) 第5步。若某物项未归入“600系列”或9x515 ECCN，则从产品组开头开始逐一分析各ECCN，判断该产品组中是否有其他ECCN描述该物项。若某ECCN使用“专门设计”一词，分别参见上文(a)(4)(i)及(a)(4)(ii)款中的第4.a步和第4.b步。若这些ECCN之一描述该物项，则归入该ECCN。
text.en: (5) Step 5. If an item is not classified by a “600 series” or in a 9x515 ECCN, then starting from the beginning of the product group analyze each ECCN to determine whether any other ECCN in that product group describes the item. If any ECCN uses the term “specially designed,” see Steps 4.a and 4.b above in paragraphs (a)(4)(i) and (a)(4)(ii) respectively. If the item is described in one of these ECCNs, then the item is classified under that ECCN.

text.zh: (6) 第6步。若CCL任何类别的任何ECCN均未描述该物项，则归为EAR99。若EAR99物项拟供给被禁止或受限制的最终用户、最终用途或目的地，仍可能需要许可证。CCL以外的许可要求，见§732.3“十项一般禁止的相关步骤”第(g)至(n)款，或EAR第736部分的一般禁止四至十。
text.en: (6) Step 6. If the item is not described under any ECCN of any category of the CCL, then the item is designated as EAR99. EAR99 items may require a license if destined for a prohibited or restricted end user, end use or destination. See paragraphs (g) through (n) of § 732.3 “Steps Regarding the Ten General Prohibitions,” or General Prohibitions Four through Ten of part 736 of the EAR for license requirements other than those imposed by the CCL.

text.en: (b) [Reserved]

text.zh: 第774部分补充文件6——敏感清单
text.en: Supplement No. 6 to Part 774—Sensitive List

text.zh: 补充文件6说明：
text.en: Note to Supplement No. 6:

text.zh: 本清单物项虽以ECCN而非《瓦森纳安排》编号标识，其物项描述仍直接取自《瓦森纳安排》的敏感清单。若下列ECCN附有文字说明，则敏感清单仅涵盖该ECCN项下的一部分物项，或采用不同参数。
text.en: While the items on this list are identified by ECCN rather than by Wassenaar Arrangement numbering, the item descriptions are drawn directly from the Wassenaar Arrangement's Sensitive List. If text accompanies an ECCN below, then the Sensitive List is limited to a subset of items classified under the specific ECCN or has differing parameters.
(1) Category 1

text.zh: (i) 1A002.a.1——由有机“基体”及1C010.c或1C010.d所列“纤维或纤丝材料”制成的“复合”结构或层压材料。
text.en: (i) 1A002.a.1—“Composite” structures or laminates made from an organic “matrix” and “fibrous or filamentary materials” specified by 1C010.c or 1C010.d.

text.zh: (iv) 1C010.c和.d。
text.en: (iv) 1C010.c and .d.

text.zh: (vi) 1D002——用于“开发”1A002.a.1、1C001、1C007.c、1C010.c、1C010.d或1C012项下所管制有机“基体”、金属“基体”或碳“基体”层压材料或复合材料的“软件”。
text.en: (vi) 1D002—“Software” for the “development” of organic “matrix”, metal “matrix”, or carbon “matrix” laminates or composites controlled under 1A002.a.1, 1C001, 1C007.c, 1C010.c, 1C010.d, or 1C012.

text.zh: (vii) 1E001——根据通用技术说明，用于“开发”或“生产”1A002、1C001、1C007.c、1C010.c、1C010.d或1C012项下所管制设备和材料的“技术”。
text.en: (vii) 1E001—“Technology” according to the General Technology Note for the “development” or “production” of equipment and materials controlled under 1A002, 1C001, 1C007.c, 1C010.c, 1C010.d, or 1C012.

text.zh: (viii) 1E002.e和.f。
text.en: (viii) 1E002.e and .f.
(2) Category 2

text.zh: (i) 2D001——为“开发”或“生产”以下设备而“专门设计”的“软件”，但2D002所管制的软件除外：
text.en: (i) 2D001—“Software”, other than that controlled by 2D002, “specially designed” for the “development” or “production” of equipment as follows:

text.zh: (A) 2B001.a、2B001.b.1或2B001.b.2所列，且沿一个或多个直线轴的“单向定位重复性”等于或小于（优于）0.9 µm的设备；
text.en: (A) Specified by 2B001.a, 2B001.b.1, or 2B001.b.2, and having a “unidirectional positioning repeatability” equal to or less (better) than 0.9 µm along one or more linear axis;
(B) Specified by 2B001.b.3, 2B001.d, 2B001.f or 2B003.

text.zh: (ii) 2E001——根据通用技术说明，用于“开发”以下设备或“软件”的“技术”：
text.en: (ii) 2E001—“Technology” according to the General Technology Note for the “development” of equipment or “software”, as follows:

text.zh: (A) 2B001.a、2B001.b.1或2B001.b.2所列，且沿一个或多个直线轴的“单向定位重复性”等于或小于（优于）0.9 µm的设备；
text.en: (A) Equipment specified by 2B001.a, 2B001.b.1 or 2B001.b.2, and having a “unidirectional positioning repeatability” equal to or less (better) than 0.9 µm along one or more linear axis;
(B) Equipment specified by 2B001.b.3, 2B001.d, 2B001.f or 2B003.

text.zh: (C) 本补充文件2D001所列“软件”；
text.en: (C) “Software” specified by 2D001 of this Supplement;

text.zh: (iii) 2E002——根据通用技术说明，用于“生产”以下设备的“技术”：
text.en: (iii) 2E002—“Technology” according to the General Technology Note for the “production” of equipment as follows:

text.zh: (A) 2B001.a、2B001.b.1或2B001.b.2所列，且沿一个或多个直线轴的“单向定位重复性”等于或小于（优于）0.9 µm的设备；
text.en: (A) Specified by 2B001.a, 2B001.b.1, or 2B001.b.2, and having a “unidirectional positioning repeatability” equal to or less (better) than 0.9 µm along one or more linear axis;
(B) Specified by 2B001.b.3, 2B001.d, 2B001.f or 2B003.
(3) Category 3

text.zh: (i) 3A001.b.2（包括3A001.b.2所述、由3A001.z管制的物项）——符合以下任一情形的“单片微波集成电路”（MMIC）放大器：
text.en: (i) 3A001.b.2 (including those described under 3A001.b.2 that are controlled by 3A001.z)—“Monolithic Microwave Integrated Circuit” (“MMIC”) amplifiers that are any of the following:

text.zh: (A) 额定工作频率大于2.7 GHz且不超过6.8 GHz，“相对带宽”大于15%，并具有以下任一特性：
text.en: (A) Rated for operation at frequencies exceeding 2.7 GHz up to and including 6.8 GHz with a “fractional bandwidth” greater than 15%, and having any of the following:

text.zh: (A.1.) 在大于2.7 GHz且不超过2.9 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于300 W（54.8 dBm）；
text.en: (A.1.) A peak saturated power output greater than 300 W (54.8 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 2.7 GHz up to and including 2.9 GHz;

text.zh: (A.2.) 在大于2.9 GHz且不超过3.2 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于300 W（54.8 dBm）；
text.en: (A.2.) A peak saturated power output greater than 300 W (54.8 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 2.9 GHz up to and including 3.2 GHz;

text.zh: (A.3.) 在大于3.2 GHz且不超过3.7 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于300 W（54.8 dBm）；或
text.en: (A.3.) A peak saturated power output greater than 300 W (54.8 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 3.2 GHz up to and including 3.7 GHz; or

text.zh: (A.4.) 在大于3.7 GHz且不超过6.8 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于120 W（50.8 dBm）；
text.en: (A.4.) A peak saturated power output greater than 120 W (50.8 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 3.7 GHz up to and including 6.8 GHz;

text.zh: (B) 额定工作频率大于6.8 GHz且不超过12 GHz，“相对带宽”大于10%，并具有以下任一特性：
text.en: (B) Rated for operation at frequencies exceeding 6.8 GHz up to and including 12 GHz with a “fractional bandwidth” greater than 10%, and having any of the following:

text.zh: (B.1) 在大于6.8 GHz且不超过8.5 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于25 W（44 dBm）；或
text.en: (B.1) A peak saturated power output greater than 25 W (44 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 6.8 GHz up to and including 8.5 GHz; or

text.zh: (B.2.) 在大于8.5 GHz且不超过12 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于25 W（44 dBm）。
text.en: (B.2.) A peak saturated power output greater than 25 W (44 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 8.5 GHz up to and including 12 GHz.

text.zh: (ii) 3A001.b.3（包括3A001.b.3所述、由3A001.z管制的物项）——符合以下任一情形的分立微波晶体管：
text.en: (ii) 3A001.b.3 (including those described under 3A001.b.3 that are controlled by 3A001.z)—Discrete microwave transistors that are any of the following:

text.zh: (A) 额定工作频率大于2.7 GHz且不超过6.8 GHz，并具有以下任一特性：
text.en: (A) Rated for operation at frequencies exceeding 2.7 GHz up to and including 6.8 GHz and having any of the following:

text.zh: (A.1.) 在大于2.7 GHz且不超过2.9 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于600 W（57.8 dBm）；
text.en: (A.1.) A peak saturated power output greater than 600 W (57.8 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 2.7 GHz up to and including 2.9 GHz;

text.zh: (A.2.) 在大于2.9 GHz且不超过3.2 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于600 W（57.8 dBm）；
text.en: (A.2.) A peak saturated power output greater than 600 W (57.8 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 2.9 GHz up to and including 3.2 GHz;

text.zh: (A.3.) 在大于3.2 GHz且不超过3.7 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于600 W（57.8 dBm）；或
text.en: (A.3.) A peak saturated power output greater than 600 W (57.8 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 3.2 GHz up to and including 3.7 GHz; or

text.zh: (A.4.) 在大于3.7 GHz且不超过6.8 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于130 W（51.2 dBm）；
text.en: (A.4.) A peak saturated power output greater than 130 W (51.2 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 3.7 GHz up to and including 6.8 GHz;

text.zh: (B) 额定工作频率大于6.8 GHz且不超过12 GHz，并具有以下任一特性：
text.en: (B) Rated for operation at frequencies exceeding 6.8 GHz up to and including 12 GHz and having any of the following:

text.zh: (B.1.) 在大于6.8 GHz且不超过8.5 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于130 W（51.2 dBm）；
text.en: (B.1.) A peak saturated power output greater than 130 W (51.2 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 6.8 GHz up to and including 8.5 GHz;

text.zh: (B.2.) 在大于8.5 GHz且不超过12 GHz的任一频率下，峰值饱和输出功率大于60 W（47.8 dBm）。
text.en: (B.2.) A peak saturated power output greater than 60 W (47.8 dBm) at any frequency exceeding 8.5 GHz up to and including 12 GHz.

text.en: (v) 3E001—“Technology” according to the General Technology Note for the “development” or “production” of equipment controlled under 3A001.b.2, 3A001.b.3, equipment described under 3A001.b.2 or 3A001.b.3 that are controlled under 3A001.z, and 3A002.g.1.

text.zh: (i) 6A001.a.1.b——为物体探测或定位而设计，并具有以下任一特性的系统或发射和接收阵列：
text.en: (i) 6A001.a.1.b—Systems or transmitting and receiving arrays, designed for object detection or location, having any of the following:

text.zh: (A) 发射频率低于5 kHz；或者，对于工作频率处于5 kHz至10 kHz频段（含两端）的设备，声压级超过224 dB（在1 m处以1 µPa为基准）；
text.en: (A) A transmitting frequency below 5 kHz or a sound pressure level exceeding 224 dB (reference 1 µPa at 1 m) for equipment with an operating frequency in the band from 5 kHz to 10 kHz inclusive;

text.zh: (B) 对于工作频率处于10 kHz至24 kHz频段（含两端）的设备，声压级超过224 dB（在1 m处以1 µPa为基准）；
text.en: (B) Sound pressure level exceeding 224 dB (reference 1 µPa at 1 m) for equipment with an operating frequency in the band from 10 kHz to 24 kHz inclusive;

text.zh: (C) 对于工作频率处于24 kHz与30 kHz之间频段的设备，声压级超过235 dB（在1 m处以1 µPa为基准）；
text.en: (C) Sound pressure level exceeding 235 dB (reference 1 µPa at 1 m) for equipment with an operating frequency in the band between 24 kHz and 30 kHz;

text.zh: (D) 可在任一轴上形成小于1°的波束，且工作频率低于100 kHz；
text.en: (D) Forming beams of less than 1° on any axis and having an operating frequency of less than 100 kHz;

text.zh: (E) 设计为具有超过5,120 m的无模糊显示距离；或
text.en: (E) Designed to operate with an unambiguous display range exceeding 5,120 m; or

text.zh: (F) 设计为可承受在超过1,000 m深度正常运行时的压力，且其换能器具有以下任一特性：
text.en: (F) Designed to withstand pressure during normal operation at depths exceeding 1,000 m and having transducers with any of the following:

text.zh: (1) 压力动态补偿；或
text.en: (1) Dynamic compensation for pressure; or

text.zh: (2) 使用锆钛酸铅以外的材料作为换能元件；
text.en: (2) Incorporating other than lead zirconate titanate as the transduction element;

text.zh: (v) 6A001.a.2.c——为与拖曳式声学水听器阵列实时配合使用而“专门设计”的处理设备，具有“用户可存取编程能力”和时域或频域处理及相关运算功能，包括采用快速傅里叶变换或其他变换或处理过程进行频谱分析、数字滤波和波束形成。
text.en: (v) 6A001.a.2.c—Processing equipment, “specially designed” for real time application with towed acoustic hydrophone arrays, having “user-accessible programmability” and time or frequency domain processing and correlation, including spectral analysis, digital filtering and beamforming using Fast Fourier or other transforms or processes.

text.zh: (viii) 6A001.a.2.f——为与海底或海湾电缆系统实时配合使用而“专门设计”的处理设备，具有“用户可存取编程能力”和时域或频域处理及相关运算功能，包括采用快速傅里叶变换或其他变换或处理过程进行频谱分析、数字滤波和波束形成。
text.en: (viii) 6A001.a.2.f—Processing equipment, “specially designed” for real time application with bottom or bay cable systems, having “user-accessible programmability” and time or frequency domain processing and correlation, including spectral analysis, digital filtering and beamforming using Fast Fourier or other transforms or processes.

text.zh: (xi) 6A002.a.2.a——具有以下所有特性的图像增强管：
text.en: (xi) 6A002.a.2.a—Image intensifier tubes having all of the following:

text.zh: (A) 峰值响应波长大于400 nm但不超过1,050 nm；
text.en: (A) A peak response in the wavelength range exceeding 400 nm but not exceeding 1,050 nm;

text.zh: (B) 采用以下任一方式实现电子图像放大：
text.en: (B) Electron image amplification using any of the following:

text.zh: (1) 用于电子图像放大的微通道板，孔间距（中心距）为12 µm或更小；或
text.en: (1) A microchannel plate for electron image amplification with a hole pitch (center-to-center spacing) of 12 µm or less; or

text.zh: (2) 为通过微通道板以外方式实现“电荷倍增”而“专门设计”或改进的电子探测器件，其未经像素合并的像素间距为500 µm或更小；并且
text.en: (2) An electron sensing device with a non-binned pixel pitch of 500 µm or less, “specially designed” or modified to achieve ‘ charge multiplication’ other than by a microchannel plate; and

text.zh: (C) 采用以下任一光电阴极：
text.en: (C) Any of the following photocathodes:

text.zh: (1) 光照灵敏度超过700 µA/lm的多碱光电阴极，例如S-20和S-25；
text.en: (1) Multialkali photocathodes (e.g., S-20 and S-25) having a luminous sensitivity exceeding 700 µA/lm;

text.zh: (2) GaAs或GaInAs光电阴极；或
text.en: (2) GaAs or GaInAs photocathodes; or

text.zh: (3) 最大“辐射灵敏度”超过10 mA/W的其他“III-V族化合物”半导体光电阴极。
text.en: (3) Other “III-V compound” semiconductor photocathodes having a maximum “radiant sensitivity” exceeding 10 mA/W.

text.zh: (xiii) 6A002.a.3——受以下附加说明约束：
text.en: (xiii) 6A002.a.3—Subject to the following additional notes:
Note 1:

text.zh: 在本补充文件中，6A002.a.3不适用于以下“焦平面阵列”：
text.en: 6A002.a.3 does not apply to the following “focal plane arrays” in this Supplement:

text.zh: a. 元件数量少于10,000的硅化铂（PtSi）“焦平面阵列”；
text.en: a. Platinum Silicide (PtSi) “focal plane arrays” having less than 10,000 elements;

text.zh: b. 硅化铱（IrSi）“焦平面阵列”。
text.en: b. Iridium Silicide (IrSi) “focal plane arrays”.
Note 2:

text.zh: 在本补充文件中，6A002.a.3不适用于以下“焦平面阵列”：
text.en: 6A002.a.3 does not apply to the following “focal plane arrays” in this Supplement:

text.zh: a. 元件数量少于256的锑化铟（InSb）或硒化铅（PbSe）“焦平面阵列”；
text.en: a. Indium Antimonide (InSb) or Lead Selenide (PbSe) “focal plane arrays” having less than 256 elements;

text.zh: b. 砷化铟（InAs）“焦平面阵列”；
text.en: b. Indium Arsenide (InAs) “focal plane arrays”;

text.zh: c. 硫化铅（PbS）“焦平面阵列”；
text.en: c. Lead Sulphide (PbS) “focal plane arrays”;

text.zh: d. 砷化铟镓（InGaAs）“焦平面阵列”。
text.en: d. Indium Gallium Arsenide (InGaAs) “focal plane arrays”.
Note 3:

text.zh: 在本补充文件中，6A002.a.3不适用于以下碲镉汞（HgCdTe）“焦平面阵列”：
text.en: 6A002.a.3 does not apply to Mercury Cadmium Telluride (HgCdTe) “focal plane arrays” as follows in this Supplement:

text.zh: a. 具有以下任一特性的“扫描阵列”：
text.en: a. 'Scanning Arrays' having any of the following:

text.zh: 1. 元件数量为30或更少；或
text.en: 1. 30 elements or less; or

text.zh: 2. 在元件内部采用时间延迟积分，且元件数量为2或更少；
text.en: 2. Incorporating time delay-and-integration within the element and having 2 elements or less;

text.zh: b. 元件数量少于256的“凝视阵列”。
text.en: b. 'Staring Arrays' having less than 256 elements.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: a. “扫描阵列”定义为设计用于扫描光学系统的“焦平面阵列”；该系统依次对场景成像，从而生成图像；
text.en: a. 'Scanning Arrays' are defined as “focal plane arrays” designed for use with a scanning optical system that images a scene in a sequential manner to produce an image;

text.zh: b. “凝视阵列”定义为设计用于对场景成像的非扫描光学系统的“焦平面阵列”。
text.en: b. 'Staring Arrays' are defined as “focal plane arrays” designed for use with a nonscanning optical system that images a scene.
Note 6:

text.zh: 在本清单中，6A002.a.3不适用于以下“焦平面阵列”：
text.en: 6A002.a.3 does not apply to the following “focal plane arrays” in this List:

text.zh: a. 元件数量少于256的砷化镓（GaAs）或砷化镓铝（GaAlAs）量子阱“焦平面阵列”；
text.en: a. Gallium Arsenide (GaAs) or Gallium Aluminum Arsenide (GaAlAs) quantum well “focal plane arrays” having less than 256 elements;

text.zh: b. 元件数量少于8,000的微测辐射热计“焦平面阵列”。
text.en: b. Microbolometer “focal plane arrays” having less than 8,000 elements.
Note 7:

text.zh: 6A002.a.3.g不适用于以下为实现“电荷倍增”而“专门设计”或改进的“焦平面阵列”：
text.en: 6A002.a.3.g does not apply to “focal plane arrays”, “specially designed” or modified to achieve 'charge multiplication', as follows:

text.zh: a. 元件数量为4,096或更少的线性（1维）阵列。
text.en: a. Linear (1-dimensional) arrays having 4,096 elements or less.

text.zh: b. 具有以下所有特性的非线性（2维）阵列：
text.en: b. Non-linear (2-dimensional) arrays having all of the following;

text.zh: b.1. 元件总数为250,000或更少；并且
text.en: b.1. A total of 250,000 elements or less; and

text.zh: b.2. 每个维度的元件数量最多为4,096。
text.en: b.2. A maximum of 4,096 elements in each dimension.

text.zh: (xv) 6A002.c——集成以下任一物项的“直视”成像设备：
text.en: (xv) 6A002.c—‘ Direct view’ imaging equipment incorporating any of the following:

text.zh: (A) 具有本补充文件对6A002.a.2.a或6A002.a.2.b的描述所列特性的图像增强管；
text.en: (A) Image intensifier tubes having the characteristics listed in this Supplement's description of 6A002.a.2.a or 6A002.a.2.b;

text.zh: (B) 具有本补充文件对6A002.a.3的描述所列特性的“焦平面阵列”；或

text.zh: (C) 具有6A002.a.1所列特性的固态探测器。
text.en: (C) Solid-state detectors having the characteristics listed in 6A002.a.1.

text.zh: (xvi) 6A003.b.3——集成具有本补充文件对6A002.a.2.a或6A002.a.2.b的描述所列特性的图像增强管的成像相机
text.en: (xvi) 6A003.b.3—Imaging cameras incorporating image intensifier tubes having the characteristics listed in this Supplement's description of 6A002.a.2.a or 6A002.a.2.b

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 6A003.b.3不适用于为水下使用而“专门设计”或改进的成像相机。
text.en: 6A003.b.3 does not apply to imaging cameras “specially designed” or modified for underwater use.

text.zh: (xvii) 6A003.b.4——集成“焦平面阵列”、且具有以下任一特性的成像相机：
text.en: (xvii) 6A003.b.4—Imaging cameras incorporating “focal plane arrays” having any of the following:

text.zh: (A) 集成本补充文件对6A002.a.3.a至6A002.a.3.e的描述所列“焦平面阵列”；
text.en: (A) Incorporating “focal plane arrays” specified by this Supplement's description of 6A002.a.3.a to 6A002.a.3.e;

text.zh: (B) 集成本补充文件对6A002.a.3.f的描述所列“焦平面阵列”；或
text.en: (B) Incorporating “focal plane arrays” specified by this Supplement's description of 6A002.a.3.f; or

text.zh: (C) 集成本补充文件对6A002.a.3.g的描述所列“焦平面阵列”。
text.en: (C) Incorporating “focal plane arrays” specified by this Supplement's description of 6A002.a.3.g.
Note 1:

text.zh: 6A003.b.4所述“成像相机”包括“焦平面阵列”与读出集成电路之外的足够“信号处理”电子电路的组合，使其在通电后至少能够输出模拟或数字信号。
text.en: ‘ Imaging cameras’ described in 6A003.b.4 include “focal plane arrays” combined with sufficient “signal processing” electronics, beyond the read out integrated circuit, to enable as a minimum the output of an analog or digital signal once power is supplied.
Note 2:

text.zh: 6A003.b.4.a不管制集成元件数量为12（十二）或更少的线性“焦平面阵列”、未在元件内部采用时间延迟积分，且为以下任一用途设计的成像相机：
text.en: 6A003.b.4.a does not control imaging cameras incorporating linear “focal plane arrays” with twelve 12 elements or fewer, not employing time-delay-and-integration within the element, and designed for any of the following:

text.zh: a. 工业或民用入侵报警、交通或工业运动控制或计数系统；
text.en: a. Industrial or civilian intrusion alarm, traffic or industrial movement control or counting systems;

text.zh: b. 用于检查或监测建筑物、设备或工业过程内热流的工业设备；
text.en: b. Industrial equipment used for inspection or monitoring of heat flows in buildings, equipment or industrial processes;

text.zh: c. 用于检验、分选或分析材料性能的工业设备；
text.en: c. Industrial equipment used for inspection, sorting or analysis of the properties of materials;

text.zh: d. 为实验室使用“专门设计”的设备；或
text.en: d. Equipment “specially designed” for laboratory use; or

text.zh: e. 医疗设备。
text.en: e. Medical equipment.
Note 3:

text.zh: 6A003.b.4.b不管制具有以下任一特性的成像相机：
text.en: 6A003.b.4.b does not control imaging cameras having any of the following characteristics:

text.zh: a. 最大帧率小于或等于9 Hz；
text.en: a. A maximum frame rate equal to or less than 9 Hz;

text.zh: b. 同时具有以下全部特性：
text.en: b. Having all of the following:

text.zh: 1. 最小水平或垂直“瞬时视场”（IFOV）至少为10 mrad/pixel（毫弧度/像素）；
text.en: 1. Having a minimum horizontal or vertical ‘ Instantaneous-Field-of-View (IFOV)’ of at least 10 mrad/pixel (milliradians/pixel);

text.zh: 2. 采用设计为不可拆卸的定焦镜头；
text.en: 2. Incorporating a fixed focal-length lens that is not designed to be removed;

text.zh: 3. 不集成“直视”显示器；并且
text.en: 3. Not incorporating a ‘ direct view’ display; and

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: “直视”是指在红外波段工作，通过集成任何防漏光机制的近眼微型显示器向观察者呈现可视图像的成像相机。
text.en: ‘ Direct view’ refers to an imaging camera operating in the infrared spectrum that presents a visual image to a human observer using a near-to-eye micro display incorporating any light-security mechanism.

text.zh: 4. 具有下列任一特性：
text.en: 4. Having any of the following:

text.zh: a. 不具备获取所探测视场可视图像的功能；或
text.en: a. No facility to obtain a viewable image of the detected field-of-view; or

text.zh: b. 照相机仅为单一类型应用设计，且设计为用户不可修改；或
text.en: b. The camera is designed for a single kind of application and designed not to be user modified; or

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 说明3.b所述“瞬时视场”（IFOV）为“水平FOV”与“垂直FOV”中的较小值。
text.en: ‘ Instantaneous Field of View (IFOV)’ specified in Note 3.b is the lesser figure of the ‘ Horizontal FOV’ or the ‘ Vertical FOV’.

text.zh: “水平IFOV”＝水平视场（FOV）/水平方向探测元件数量
text.en: ‘ Horizontal IFOV’ = horizontal Field of View (FOV)/number of horizontal detector elements

text.zh: “垂直IFOV”＝垂直视场（FOV）/垂直方向探测元件数量。
text.en: ‘ Vertical IFOV’= vertical Field of View (FOV)/number of vertical detector elements.

text.zh: c. 相机为安装于车辆总重小于3公吨（三吨）的民用载客陆地车辆而“专门设计”，并具有以下所有特性：
text.en: c. Where the camera is “specially designed” for installation into a civilian passenger land vehicle of less than 3 tonnes three tons (gross vehicle weight) and having all of the following:

text.zh: 1. 仅在安装于以下任一对象中时才可运行：
text.en: 1. Is operable only when installed in any of the following:

text.zh: a. 为其预定的民用载客陆地车辆；或
text.en: a. The civilian passenger land vehicle for which it was intended; or

text.zh: b. “专门设计”且经授权的维护测试设施；以及
text.en: b. A “specially designed”, authorized maintenance test facility; and

text.zh: 2. 集成主动机制，使相机一旦从其预定车辆上移除即强制停止工作。
text.en: 2. Incorporates an active mechanism that forces the camera not to function when it is removed from the vehicle for which it was intended.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 必要时，应请求向工业与安全局提供物项详细资料，以核实是否符合本6A003.b.4.b注中的注3.b.4和注3.c所述条件。
text.en: When necessary, details of the items will be provided, upon request, to the Bureau of Industry and Security in order to ascertain compliance with the conditions described in Note 3.b.4 and Note 3.c in this Note to 6A003.b.4.b.
Note 4:

text.zh: 6A003.b.4.c不适用于具有以下任一特性的“成像相机”：
text.en: 6A003.b.4.c does not apply to ‘ imaging cameras’ having any of the following characteristics:

text.zh: a. 同时具有以下全部特性：
text.en: a. Having all of the following:

text.zh: 1. 照相机为作为集成部件安装于室内、使用墙壁插座供电的系统或设备而“专门设计”，且设计上仅限于下列单一类型应用：
text.en: 1. Where the camera is “specially designed” for installation as an integrated component into indoor and wall-plug-operated systems or equipment, limited by design for a single kind of application, as follows:

text.zh: a. 工业过程监测、质量控制或材料性能分析；
text.en: a. Industrial process monitoring, quality control, or analysis of the properties of materials;

text.zh: b. 为科学研究“专门设计”的实验室设备；
text.en: b. Laboratory equipment “specially designed” for scientific research;

text.zh: c. 医疗设备；
text.en: c. Medical equipment;

text.zh: d. 金融欺诈检测设备；以及
text.en: d. Financial fraud detection equipment; and

text.zh: 2. 仅在安装于下列任一系统、设备或设施中时可运行：
text.en: 2. Is only operable when installed in any of the following:

text.zh: a. 其预定安装的系统或设备；或
text.en: a. The system(s) or equipment for which it was intended; or

text.zh: b. “专门设计”的获授权维护设施；并且
text.en: b. A “specially designed”, authorized maintenance facility; and

text.zh: 3. 含有主动机制，在照相机从其预定安装的系统或设备中移除时强制使其停止工作；
text.en: 3. Incorporates an active mechanism that forces the camera not to function when it is removed from the system(s) or equipment for which it was intended;

text.zh: b. 相机为安装于车辆总重小于3公吨的民用载客陆地车辆，或总长（LOA）为65 m或更长的客货汽车渡船而“专门设计”，并具有以下所有特性：
text.en: b. Where the camera is “specially designed” for installation into a civilian passenger land vehicle of less than 3 tonnes (gross vehicle weight), or passenger and vehicle ferries having a length overall (LOA) 65 m or greater, and having all of the following:

text.zh: 1. 仅在安装于以下任一对象中时才可运行：
text.en: 1. Is only operable when installed in any of the following:

text.zh: a. 为其预定的民用载客陆地车辆或客货汽车渡船；或
text.en: a. The civilian passenger land vehicle or passenger and vehicle ferry for which it was intended; or

text.zh: b. “专门设计”且经授权的维护测试设施；以及
text.en: b. A “specially designed”, authorized maintenance test facility; and

text.zh: 2. 集成主动机制，使相机一旦从其预定车辆上移除即强制停止工作；
text.en: 2. Incorporates an active mechanism that forces the camera not to function when it is removed from the vehicle for which it was intended;

text.zh: c. 设计上将超过760 nm波长的最大“辐射灵敏度”限制为10 mA/W或以下，且同时具有以下全部特性：
text.en: c. Limited by design to have a maximum “radiant sensitivity” of 10 mA/W or less for wavelengths exceeding 760 nm, having all of the following:

text.zh: 1. 采用设计为不可移除或修改的响应限制机制；以及
text.en: 1. Incorporating a response limiting mechanism designed not to be removed or modified; and

text.zh: 2. 含有主动机制，在响应限制机制被移除时强制使照相机停止工作；以及
text.en: 2. Incorporates an active mechanism that forces the camera not to function when the response limiting mechanism is removed; and

text.zh: 3. 并非为水下使用而“专门设计”或改装；或
text.en: 3. Not “specially designed” or modified for underwater use; or

text.zh: d. 同时具有以下全部特性：
text.en: d. Having all of the following:

text.zh: 1. 不集成“直视”或电子图像显示器；
text.en: 1. Not incorporating a ‘ direct view’ or electronic image display;

text.zh: 2. 不具备输出所探测视场可视图像的功能；
text.en: 2. Has no facility to output a viewable image of the detected field of view;

text.zh: 3. “焦平面阵列”仅在安装于其预定照相机中时可运行；以及
text.en: 3. The “focal plane array” is only operable when installed in the camera for which it was intended; and

text.zh: 4. “焦平面阵列”含有主动机制，在从其预定照相机中移除时强制使其永久无法运行。
text.en: 4. The “focal plane array” incorporates an active mechanism that forces it to be permanently inoperable when removed from the camera for which it was intended.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 必要时，应请求向工业与安全局提供物项详细资料，以核实是否符合上述注4所述条件。
text.en: When necessary, details of the item will be provided, upon request, to the Bureau of Industry and Security in order to ascertain compliance with the conditions described in Note 4 above.
Note 5:

text.zh: 6A003.b.4.c不适用于为水下使用而“专门设计”或改进的成像相机。
text.en: 6A003.b.4.c does not apply to imaging cameras “specially designed” or modified for underwater use.

text.en: (A) Magnetic sensors specified by 6A006.a.2 and using optically pumped or nuclear precession (proton/Overhauser) “technology” that will permit these sensors to realize a ‘ sensitivity’ lower (better) than 2 pT rms per square root Hz.

text.en: (B) Underwater electric field sensors specified by 6A006.b.

text.en: (C) “Magnetic gradiometers” specified by 6A006.c. that will permit these sensors to realize a ‘ sensitivity’ lower (better) than 3 pT/m rms per square root Hz.

text.en: (xxxi) 6E002—“Technology” according to the General Technology Note for the “production” of equipment specified by the 6A or 6B provisions described in this Supplement.

text.en: (ii) 8A002.b—Systems specially designed or modified for the automated control of the motion of submersible vehicles specified by 8A001.b through .c using navigation data having closed loop servo-controls and having any of the following:

text.zh: 补充文件7说明：
text.en: Note to Supplement No. 7:

text.zh: 本清单物项虽以ECCN而非《瓦森纳安排》编号标识，其物项描述仍直接取自《瓦森纳安排》的高度敏感清单；高度敏感清单是《瓦森纳安排》敏感清单的子集。若下列ECCN附有文字说明，则高度敏感清单仅涵盖该ECCN项下的一部分物项，或采用不同参数。
text.en: While the items on this list are identified by ECCN rather than by Wassenaar Arrangement numbering, the item descriptions are drawn directly from the Wassenaar Arrangement's Very Sensitive List, which is a subset of the Wassenaar Arrangement's Sensitive List. If text accompanies an ECCN below, then the Very Sensitive List is limited to a subset of items classified under the specific ECCN or has differing parameters.

summary.zh: 两份文件的核心分工
summary.en: Core functions of the two documents

text.zh: 《清单》用于识别物项的管制范围、技术条件、例外及相关软件/技术；《目录》把许可证管理范围按进出口方向列示，并提供参考商品名称、海关商品编号、计量单位。二者是实体范围与办证/通关索引相互配合的关系。
text.en: The Control List identifies the scope, technical conditions, exclusions, and related software/technology subject to control; the Catalog presents licensing scope by import/export direction and provides reference commodity names, customs commodity codes, and units of measurement. The two complement one another: substantive control scope and a licensing/customs reference index.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 重合范围不是两份文件全部内容
title.en: The overlapping scope does not cover everything in either document

summary.zh: 重合范围不是两份文件全部内容
summary.en: The overlapping scope does not cover everything in either document

text.zh: 《目录》出口部分第一大类与《清单》重合；目录另含进口四类，以及出口核清单、易制毒化学品。清单第一部分的通则、术语和解释应另保留，不能只保留目录的商品行。
text.en: The first major category in the Catalog’s export section overlaps with the Control List; the Catalog also contains four import categories, the nuclear export control list, and drug precursors. The general rules, terms, and explanations in Part One of the Control List must be retained separately; keeping only commodity rows from the Catalog is insufficient.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 冲突处理
title.en: Resolving conflicts

summary.zh: 冲突处理
summary.en: Resolving conflicts

text.zh: 《目录》物项、名称及描述与相关法律、行政法规、规章、《两用物项出口管制清单》及相关公告不一致时，以这些法律文件、清单及公告为准。不得将这个条款简化为“旧清单永远优先于更新公告”。
text.en: Where the Catalog’s items, names, or descriptions differ from relevant laws, administrative regulations, rules, the Dual-Use Items Export Control List, or relevant announcements, those legal instruments, the control list, and announcements prevail. This must not be simplified into “an older control list always takes precedence over a newer announcement.”

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: HS仅供参考
title.en: HS codes are references only

summary.zh: HS仅供参考
summary.en: HS codes are references only

text.zh: 商品范围以商品名称及描述为准，海关商品编号仅供通关申报参考。编号命中不直接证明列管；编号未命中、空白也不排除列管。
text.en: The scope of goods is determined by commodity names and descriptions; customs commodity codes are references for customs declarations only. A code match does not directly establish control; an unmatched or blank code does not exclude control.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 版本核验
title.en: Version verification

summary.zh: 版本核验
summary.en: Version verification

text.zh: 用户《清单》147页，SHA256为b4be9b44fd90d82301290d6c17851bb8c0b33cb563e6287c359dd7a4d162deee，与中国出口管制信息网当前官方附件完全一致；不能标成未经更新的2024年51号原始138页附件。用户《目录》为2026年度168页版。
text.en: The user’s Control List has 147 pages and SHA256 b4be9b44fd90d82301290d6c17851bb8c0b33cb563e6287c359dd7a4d162deee, identical to the current official attachment on China’s export control information website; it must not be labeled as the original, unamended 138-page attachment to Announcement No. 51 of 2024. The user’s Catalog is the 168-page 2026 edition.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 已纳入2025年更新
title.en: 2025 updates already incorporated

summary.zh: 已纳入2025年更新
summary.en: 2025 updates already incorporated

text.zh: 上传清单与目录均包含2025年第10号和第18号更新。二者正文出现的5位管制编码集合均为189个；与旧2024原始PDF比，新增出现16个5位编码、未减少。此为编码集合核验，不是最细物项数量。
text.en: The uploaded Control List and Catalog both incorporate the updates in Announcements No. 10 and No. 18 of 2025. Each document’s main text contains the same set of 189 five-character control codes; compared with the original 2024 PDF, 16 five-character codes have been added and none removed. This verifies the code set; it is not a count of the most granular items.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 进口不能照搬出口判定
title.en: Export determinations cannot simply be applied to imports

summary.zh: 进口不能照搬出口判定
summary.en: Export determinations cannot simply be applied to imports

text.zh: 进口目录分别为监控化学品、易制毒化学品、放射性同位素、商用密码。某物项是否需进口许可，不能仅用出口5位编码判定；进口与出口应分记录，保留各自条件。
text.en: The import catalog separately covers scheduled chemicals, drug precursors, radioactive isotopes, and commercial cryptography. Whether an item requires an import license cannot be determined solely from a five-character export control code; imports and exports require separate records retaining their respective conditions.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 监控化学品的特别规则
title.en: Special rules for scheduled chemicals

summary.zh: 监控化学品的特别规则
summary.en: Special rules for scheduled chemicals

text.zh: 1C450注意事项明确适用《监控化学品管理条例》；该条例未规定的事项，由工业和信息化主管部门依出口管制法、两用物项条例执行。不得把所有条目都标成同一主管机关、同一申请路径。
text.en: The note to 1C450 expressly applies the Regulations on the Administration of Scheduled Chemicals; matters not addressed there are administered by the department responsible for industry and information technology under the Export Control Law and the Dual-Use Items Regulations. Do not assign the same authority or application route to every entry.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 核出口与核两用品必须区分
title.en: Distinguish nuclear exports from nuclear dual-use items

summary.zh: 核出口与核两用品必须区分
summary.en: Distinguish nuclear exports from nuclear dual-use items

text.zh: 《目录》出口第二大类是核出口管制清单所列物项和技术；《清单》编码第3位为2表示与核不扩散相关的管控原因。二者有联系但不是同一个清单，不应把目录核出口条目强配到两用5位编码。
text.en: The Catalog’s second major export category covers items and technologies on the nuclear export control list; a third character of 2 in a Control List code indicates a reason for control related to nuclear nonproliferation. These are related but are not the same list; nuclear export catalog entries must not be forced into five-character dual-use codes.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 易制毒目的地限制不能丢
title.en: Retain destination conditions for drug precursors

summary.zh: 易制毒目的地限制不能丢
summary.en: Retain destination conditions for drug precursors

text.zh: 目录出口易制毒分（一）、（二）、（三）。（二）13项及可能存在的盐类，对美国、墨西哥、加拿大等特定国家（地区）；（三）41项，对缅甸、老挝、阿富汗等特定国家（地区）。表中“等”不是封闭列举，执行时查相应公告完整目的地。
text.en: The Catalog divides drug-precursor exports into subsections (I), (II), and (III). Subsection (II) contains 13 items and any salts in which they may exist, for specified countries or regions including the United States, Mexico, and Canada; subsection (III) contains 41 items, for specified countries or regions including Myanmar, Laos, and Afghanistan. “Including” is not an exhaustive list; consult the relevant announcement for the complete destination scope.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 旧货与集成部件
title.en: Used goods and incorporated components

summary.zh: 旧货与集成部件
summary.en: Used goods and incorporated components

text.zh: 清单通则覆盖新旧物项，也覆盖集成在其他产品中作为主要成分且可拆卸、移作他用的物项；第二部分另有规定时按特别条款。不能因为是整机、旧货或返修件自动排除。
text.en: The Control List’s general rules cover both new and used items, as well as items incorporated as major components of other products that can be removed and repurposed; special provisions in Part Two apply where provided. Complete equipment, used goods, or goods returned for repair are not automatically excluded.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 技术也需单独检索
title.en: Search technology separately

summary.zh: 技术也需单独检索
summary.en: Search technology separately

text.zh: E类技术可包括设计图纸、工艺参数、手册、培训和咨询；通则规定公共领域、基础科学研究、普通专利申请必需知识的边界。货物结论不能直接代替技术结论，企业内部资料不能仅因已在公司内部分享而视为公共领域。
text.en: Category E technology may include design drawings, process parameters, manuals, training, and consulting; the general rules define the limits for the public domain, basic scientific research, and knowledge necessary for ordinary patent applications. A goods determination does not substitute for a technology determination; internal company materials do not enter the public domain merely because they have been shared within the company.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 逻辑与阈值
title.en: Logic and thresholds

summary.zh: 逻辑与阈值
summary.en: Logic and thresholds

text.zh: 必须保留“所有/两种/任一”、≥与>、≤与<、“且/或”、纯度、温度、尺寸、单位、用途及排除条款。“没有限制条件”按通则包含全部品种，而不是不管制。
text.en: Retain “all/both/any,” ≥ versus >, ≤ versus <, AND/OR relationships, purity, temperature, dimensions, units, uses, and exclusions. Under the general rules, “no restrictive conditions” means all varieties are included, not that the item is uncontrolled.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 查不到不是不管制
title.en: No search result does not mean no control

summary.zh: 查不到不是不管制
summary.en: No search result does not mean no control

text.zh: 检索未命中只说明未在本工作簿定位到。仍应核对同义词、部件、材料、软件、技术、临时管制和最新公告，并审查最终用户、最终用途及出口管制法第12条的清单外风险。
text.en: No search result only means that the workbook has not located an entry. Still check synonyms, components, materials, software, technology, temporary controls, and current announcements, and review end users, end uses, and risks involving unlisted items under Article 12 of the Export Control Law.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 许可不等于当然可出口
title.en: A license requirement does not mean export is necessarily permitted

summary.zh: 许可不等于当然可出口
summary.en: A license requirement does not mean export is necessarily permitted

text.zh: 列管一般意味着需要依法申请相应许可，是否准予还取决于目的地、最终用户/用途及禁止性措施。部分交易可能禁止，不应将检索命中统一显示为“办证即可”。
text.en: Control generally requires application for the relevant license in accordance with law; approval also depends on destination, end user/end use, and prohibitions. Some transactions may be prohibited; a search match must not uniformly be presented as “obtain a license and export.”

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 最新公告单独提示
title.en: Flag current announcements separately

summary.zh: 最新公告单独提示
summary.en: Flag current announcements separately

text.zh: 工作簿主数据应忠实于两份附件；附件外的目的地、实体、最终用户/用途及暂停实施措施应独立标注，不悄悄改写附件。2025年第70号暂停范围及截止2026-11-10、2026年第1号和第34号可作时效示例；此示例不是截至2026-10-19的全部专项措施清单。
text.en: Workbook master data must remain faithful to the two attachments; destination, entity, end-user/end-use, and suspension measures outside the attachments must be separately identified, without silently rewriting the attachments. The suspension scope and November 10, 2026 end date in Announcement No. 70 of 2025, and Announcements No. 1 and No. 34 of 2026, may be used as examples of time-sensitive measures; these examples are not an exhaustive list of special measures as of October 19, 2026.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 不得复用已过期过渡期
title.en: Do not reuse an expired transition period

summary.zh: 不得复用已过期过渡期
summary.en: Do not reuse an expired transition period

text.zh: 目录末页关于调整HS的已领证过渡安排只允许在许可证有效期内使用至2026-03-31。这不是目录本身的有效期，也不是所有许可证通用有效期；截至本次整理2026-10-19该过渡期已过。
text.en: The final-page transition arrangement for issued licenses affected by HS-code changes permits use only within the license validity period and no later than March 31, 2026. This is neither the Catalog’s validity period nor a universal validity period for all licenses; as of the compilation date, October 19, 2026, the transition period has expired.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 不能与美欧编码互换
title.en: Codes are not interchangeable with U.S. or EU codes

summary.zh: 不能与美欧编码互换
summary.en: Codes are not interchangeable with U.S. or EU codes

text.zh: 中国5位编码的格式可能与其他国家类似，但本表仅对应中国规则；不能把中国编码当成美国ECCN、欧盟附件I编码或海关HS。跨法域需分别识别。
text.en: China’s five-character codes may resemble other countries’ codes in format, but this table concerns Chinese rules only; do not treat Chinese codes as U.S. ECCNs, EU Annex I codes, or customs HS codes. Classify separately for each jurisdiction.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 从哪里开始查？
title.en: Where should I start?

summary.zh: 从哪里开始查？
summary.en: Where should I start?

text.zh: 先选进口或出口；有管制编码按编码查；只有HS按HS查线索；只有商品名称则用名称、材料、部件或技术关键词查。命中后必须看完整条件。
text.en: First select imports or exports; if you have a control code, search by code; if you only have an HS code, use it as a lead; if you only have a product name, search by name, material, component, or technology keywords. After finding a match, read the full conditions.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 5位管制编码和10位HS有什么区别？
title.en: What is the difference between a five-character control code and a ten-digit HS code?

summary.zh: 5位管制编码和10位HS有什么区别？
summary.en: What is the difference between a five-character control code and a ten-digit HS code?

text.zh: 5位管制编码标识中国出口管制清单条目；HS是通关商品归类信息。两者可能一对多或多对多，不能互换。
text.en: A five-character control code identifies an entry in China’s export control list; HS codes provide commodity classification information for customs purposes. The relationship may be one-to-many or many-to-many; the codes are not interchangeable.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: HS编号查到了，是否一定要许可证？
title.en: Does an HS-code match always mean a license is required?

summary.zh: HS编号查到了，是否一定要许可证？
summary.en: Does an HS-code match always mean a license is required?

text.zh: 不一定。先核对名称、技术指标、用途、说明和排除条件；HS只是参考线索。
text.en: Not necessarily. First check the name, technical parameters, use, notes, and exclusions; HS codes are reference leads only.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: HS空白或找不到，是否就无需许可证？
title.en: If the HS field is blank or no code is found, does that mean no license is required?

summary.zh: HS空白或找不到，是否就无需许可证？
summary.en: If the HS field is blank or no code is found, does that mean no license is required?

text.zh: 不能这样判断。目录明确不论是否列有HS都应依法办理；部分技术本来就没有HS。
text.en: No such conclusion can be drawn. The Catalog expressly requires the applicable license in accordance with law whether or not an HS code is listed; some technologies have no HS code.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 商品名字相同是否就列管？
title.en: Does an identical product name establish control?

summary.zh: 商品名字相同是否就列管？
summary.en: Does an identical product name establish control?

text.zh: 仍需核对完整技术条件。若条目本身没有技术规格或限制条件，按清单通则包含全部品种。
text.en: The full technical conditions still need to be checked. If the entry contains no technical specifications or restrictions, the Control List’s general rules include all varieties.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 搜索没有结果可以直接出口吗？
title.en: Can I export immediately if the search returns no results?

summary.zh: 搜索没有结果可以直接出口吗？
summary.en: Can I export immediately if the search returns no results?

text.zh: 不可以据此下结论。换用同义词、材料/部件/技术名称再查，同时复核最新措施、临时管制及清单外风险。
text.en: That conclusion cannot be based on the search result alone. Search again using synonyms and material/component/technology names, and review current measures, temporary controls, and risks involving unlisted items.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 为什么同一物项有多行？
title.en: Why does the same item appear in multiple rows?

summary.zh: 为什么同一物项有多行？
summary.en: Why does the same item appear in multiple rows?

text.zh: 目录可能按子项、参考商品名称或HS拆行；同一种化学品也可能同时涉及进口和出口或不同管制制度。重复名称不代表重复规则。
text.en: The Catalog may split rows by subitem, reference commodity name, or HS code; the same chemical may also be covered for both imports and exports or under different regulatory regimes. Repeated names do not mean duplicate rules.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 为什么有些行没有5位管制编码？
title.en: Why do some rows have no five-character control code?

summary.zh: 为什么有些行没有5位管制编码？
summary.en: Why do some rows have no five-character control code?

text.zh: 进口目录、核出口清单和易制毒栏目不都采用两用清单5位编码。应使用本栏原序号和所属制度定位，不能自行编造中国管制编码。
text.en: The import catalog, nuclear export control list, and drug-precursor sections do not all use the dual-use list’s five-character codes. Use the original entry number and applicable regime to locate the item; do not invent Chinese control codes.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: “所有特性”和“任一特性”有什么差别？
title.en: What is the difference between “all characteristics” and “any characteristic”?

summary.zh: “所有特性”和“任一特性”有什么差别？
summary.en: What is the difference between “all characteristics” and “any characteristic”?

text.zh: 前者通常要求所列条件同时满足，后者满足任一即可；还要把上级条文、用途、说明和排除条件一起读，不能孤立看某一个指标。
text.en: The former generally requires all listed conditions to be met together; the latter requires any one; also read the parent provision, use, notes, and exclusions rather than isolating a single parameter.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: “大于”和“大于等于”可以等同吗？
title.en: Can “greater than” and “greater than or equal to” be treated as the same?

summary.zh: “大于”和“大于等于”可以等同吗？
summary.en: Can “greater than” and “greater than or equal to” be treated as the same?

text.zh: 不可以。等号会决定临界值是否命中；单位换算、测试条件和精度也应核实。不得为了筛选方便删除符号。
text.en: No. The equality sign determines whether the boundary value is included; verify unit conversions, test conditions, and accuracy as well. Do not remove symbols merely to simplify filtering.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 只卖民用客户是否自动不受管制？
title.en: Does selling only to civilian customers automatically avoid control?

summary.zh: 只卖民用客户是否自动不受管制？
summary.en: Does selling only to civilian customers automatically avoid control?

text.zh: 不自动排除。清单列管物项有民用用途仍可能需要许可；最终用户与最终用途是独立审查维度。
text.en: No automatic exclusion applies. Listed controlled items may still require licenses for civilian uses; end users and end uses are separate review factors.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 旧设备、样品、赠品、返修是否自动豁免？
title.en: Are used equipment, samples, gifts, or repair returns automatically exempt?

summary.zh: 旧设备、样品、赠品、返修是否自动豁免？
summary.en: Are used equipment, samples, gifts, or repair returns automatically exempt?

text.zh: 旧设备已明确纳入通则；非贸易方式也可能构成出口。具体维修、展览等是否能适用便利措施须另查条件，不能一概豁免。
text.en: Used equipment is expressly included in the general rules; noncommercial transfers may also constitute exports. Whether facilitation measures apply to particular repairs, exhibitions, etc., requires a separate conditions check; there is no blanket exemption.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 零部件装进整机后就不管制了吗？
title.en: Do components cease to be controlled once installed in complete equipment?

summary.zh: 零部件装进整机后就不管制了吗？
summary.en: Do components cease to be controlled once installed in complete equipment?

text.zh: 不能一概排除。先核对通则关于主要成分、可拆卸移作他用的条件及该条目特别说明；也不能反过来认为含任何微量列管材料的所有整机必然列管。
text.en: There is no blanket exclusion. First check the general-rule conditions concerning major components, removability, and repurposing, together with entry-specific notes; conversely, do not assume that every complete product containing any trace amount of a listed material is necessarily controlled.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 图纸、源代码、培训资料要查吗？
title.en: Must drawings, source code, and training materials be checked?

summary.zh: 图纸、源代码、培训资料要查吗？
summary.en: Must drawings, source code, and training materials be checked?

text.zh: 需要按软件D类、技术E类和相应通则分别核对。资料对外提供与货物出境可能适用不同条目。
text.en: Check Category D software, Category E technology, and the corresponding general rules separately. Providing information abroad and physically exporting goods may fall under different entries.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 已在网上公开或公司内部共享就属于公共领域吗？
title.en: Does publication online or internal company sharing make information public domain?

summary.zh: 已在网上公开或公司内部共享就属于公共领域吗？
summary.en: Does publication online or internal company sharing make information public domain?

text.zh: 需符合清单定义：已经公开使用，并且可不受限制进一步扩大使用。公司内部共享通常不能仅凭“已分享”满足该定义；公共领域、基础研究等应逐案核实。
text.en: The List’s definition must be satisfied: publicly available and capable of further dissemination without restriction. Internal company sharing generally cannot satisfy the definition merely because the information has been “shared”; public-domain and basic-research status must be verified case by case.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 出口许可证是否自动覆盖全部技术？
title.en: Does an export license automatically cover all technology?

summary.zh: 出口许可证是否自动覆盖全部技术？
summary.en: Does an export license automatically cover all technology?

text.zh: 不覆盖全部技术。通则仅说明同一最终用户、该物项安装/运行/维护/修理所需最低限度技术随物项许可覆盖；研发或生产技术需另核对。
text.en: It does not cover all technology. The general rules only extend an item’s license to the minimum technology necessary for its installation, operation, maintenance, and repair for the same end user; development or production technology requires a separate review.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 进口和出口可以用同一个结论吗？
title.en: Can the same determination be used for imports and exports?

summary.zh: 进口和出口可以用同一个结论吗？
summary.en: Can the same determination be used for imports and exports?

text.zh: 不可以直接套用。先选方向，再查本方向栏目和条件；商用密码进口许可与信息安全出口管制等范围并不相同。
text.en: It cannot simply be carried over. First select the direction, then check that direction’s sections and conditions; the scope of commercial cryptography import licensing, for example, differs from information security export controls.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 普通带加密功能的家电或软件必然列管吗？
title.en: Are ordinary appliances or software with encryption necessarily controlled?

summary.zh: 普通带加密功能的家电或软件必然列管吗？
summary.en: Are ordinary appliances or software with encryption necessarily controlled?

text.zh: 不能仅凭“有加密”判断。核对5A002等条目的主要功能、算法/性能条件、软件条目及相关说明，并与进口密码栏目区分。
text.en: The presence of encryption alone is insufficient to decide. Check the principal functions, algorithm/performance conditions, software entries, and related notes under entries such as 5A002, and distinguish them from the cryptography import section.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 核出口栏目与第3位为2的核不扩散条目是一回事吗？
title.en: Is the nuclear export section the same as nuclear-nonproliferation entries with a third code character of 2?

summary.zh: 核出口栏目与第3位为2的核不扩散条目是一回事吗？
summary.en: Is the nuclear export section the same as nuclear-nonproliferation entries with a third code character of 2?

text.zh: 不是。前者为目录单列的核出口清单；后者是两用管制编码的管控原因。应在各自制度下识别，不强行合并编号。
text.en: No. The former is a separately listed nuclear export control list in the Catalog; the latter is a reason for control encoded in dual-use control codes. Identify items under their respective regimes; do not force the numbering systems together.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 监控化学品可以按一般两用物项流程办理吗？
title.en: Can scheduled chemicals follow the general dual-use application process?

summary.zh: 监控化学品可以按一般两用物项流程办理吗？
summary.en: Can scheduled chemicals follow the general dual-use application process?

text.zh: 应核对专门规则。1C450明确适用监控化学品管理条例及其补充执行安排；主管机关与申请路径不能机械套用一般条目。
text.en: Check the special rules. 1C450 expressly applies the Regulations on the Administration of Scheduled Chemicals and the supplementary implementation arrangements; do not mechanically apply the authority or application route for ordinary entries.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 常见化学品为什么出现在目录，是否所有国家都要办证？
title.en: Why are common chemicals listed, and do exports to every country require licenses?

summary.zh: 常见化学品为什么出现在目录，是否所有国家都要办证？
summary.en: Why are common chemicals listed, and do exports to every country require licenses?

text.zh: 先看易制毒子表。（一）与（二）（三）不同；后两表附特定目的地条件，必须连同脚注阅读。“等”不等于只列出的三个国家。
text.en: First check the drug-precursor subtable. Subsection (I) differs from (II) and (III); the latter two include specific destination conditions and must be read with their footnotes. “Including” does not mean only the three named countries.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 目录与清单说法不一致听哪个？
title.en: Which governs if the Catalog and Control List differ?

summary.zh: 目录与清单说法不一致听哪个？
summary.en: Which governs if the Catalog and Control List differ?

text.zh: 按目录说明第四项，以相关法律、行政法规、规章、两用物项清单及相关公告为准；核对公告生效日期，不按文件名称机械排优先级。
text.en: Under Catalog Explanatory Note IV, relevant laws, administrative regulations, rules, the Dual-Use Items Control List, and relevant announcements prevail; check announcement effective dates rather than assigning priority mechanically by document title.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 确定命中是否就一定可以获批出口？
title.en: Does a confirmed match guarantee export approval?

summary.zh: 确定命中是否就一定可以获批出口？
summary.en: Does a confirmed match guarantee export approval?

text.zh: 不是。还须审核目的地、最终用户/用途、管控名单和禁止性措施；有的交易不能仅靠申请一般许可解决。
text.en: No. Destination, end user/end use, control lists, and prohibitions still require review; some transactions cannot be addressed merely by applying for a standard license.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 技术指标不全，业务同事应交什么材料？
title.en: What should business colleagues provide if technical specifications are incomplete?

summary.zh: 技术指标不全，业务同事应交什么材料？
summary.en: What should business colleagues provide if technical specifications are incomplete?

text.zh: 先补齐产品型号/说明书、关键性能及测试依据、材料组成、主要用途、收货人和最终用户/用途。仍无法判断时，整理疑点向主管部门咨询。
text.en: First obtain the product model/manual, key performance specifications and test basis, material composition, principal uses, consignee, and end-user/end-use information. If the determination remains unclear, organize the questions and consult the competent authority.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 本表是截至今天全部出口管制措施吗？
title.en: Does this table cover every export control measure in force today?

summary.zh: 本表是截至今天全部出口管制措施吗？
summary.en: Does this table cover every export control measure in force today?

text.zh: 不是。本表完整整理两份上传附件，并单列外部时效提醒；目的地、实体名单、临时或专项措施仍须按交易日期核对最新公告。2026-03-31只是目录某项HS过渡截止日。
text.en: No. This table comprehensively organizes the two uploaded attachments and separately flags external time-sensitive measures; destination restrictions, entity lists, and temporary or special measures must still be checked against the latest announcements as of the transaction date. 2026-03-31 is only the deadline for a specific HS-code transition arrangement in the Catalog.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.en: Certain 2025 announcements suspended until 2026-11-10

summary.en: Certain 2025 announcements suspended until 2026-11-10

text.zh: 70号公告暂停55、56、57、58、61、62号；本次整理时仍处其载明暂停期。勿把未生效/暂停项目直接并入当前附件明细；也不能推断所有稀土管制均暂停。
text.en: Announcement No. 70 suspends Announcements No. 55, 56, 57, 58, 61, and 62; the stated suspension period remains ongoing at the time of this compilation. Do not directly incorporate measures that are not yet effective or are suspended into the current attachment entries; nor infer that all rare-earth controls are suspended.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 对日本的最终用户/用途限制
title.en: End-user/end-use restrictions concerning Japan

summary.zh: 对日本的最终用户/用途限制
summary.en: End-user/end-use restrictions concerning Japan

text.zh: 2026年第1号系附件外专项措施，说明产品条目表不能替代目的地和最终用户/用途检查。
text.en: Announcement No. 1 of 2026 is a special measure outside the attachments, illustrating why a product-entry table cannot replace destination and end-user/end-use checks.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 对美无人机相关物项从严审查
title.en: Stricter review of drone-related exports to the United States

summary.zh: 对美无人机相关物项从严审查
summary.en: Stricter review of drone-related exports to the United States

text.zh: 2026年第34号自2026-08-05施行，属于附件外审查要求，未改变本次按用户附件保留的条目原文。
text.en: Announcement No. 34 of 2026 took effect on 2026-08-05 and imposes review requirements outside the attachments; it does not alter the source wording retained from the user’s attachments in this compilation.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 1C102：目录缺“复合”
title.en: 1C102: “composite” omitted from the Catalog

summary.zh: 1C102：目录缺“复合”
summary.en: 1C102: “composite” omitted from the Catalog

text.zh: 清单为“多次浸渍的热解碳-碳复合材料”，目录对应描述为“多次浸渍的热解碳-碳材料”。两个版本分别保留，请按清单、相关公告及目录说明第四项处理。
text.en: The Control List says “multiply impregnated pyrolytic carbon–carbon composite materials,” while the corresponding Catalog description says “multiply impregnated pyrolytic carbon–carbon materials.” Both versions are retained; apply the Control List, relevant announcements, and Catalog Explanatory Note IV.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 9A501：目录没有完整重复清单说明2
title.en: 9A501: Catalog does not fully reproduce Control List Note 2

summary.zh: 9A501：目录没有完整重复清单说明2
summary.en: 9A501: Catalog does not fully reproduce Control List Note 2

text.zh: 清单9A501说明2针对“未列入本清单”的无人机，规定知道或者应当知道将用于大规模杀伤性武器扩散、恐怖主义活动或者军事目的时不得出口。目录9A501行未完整重复；目录第123页另有“未列入出口管制清单或者未实施临时管制”的相关说明。须分别回读原文。
text.en: Control List Note 2 to 9A501 prohibits exports of drones “not included in this List” where the exporter knows or should know that they will be used for proliferation of weapons of mass destruction, terrorist activities, or military purposes. The Catalog’s 9A501 row does not fully reproduce that note; Catalog page 123 separately includes a related note referring to aircraft “not included in an export control list or not subject to temporary controls.” Read each original provision separately.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 目录第167页：邻氯苯甲酰氯
title.en: Catalog page 167: o-chlorobenzoyl chloride

summary.zh: 目录第167页：邻氯苯甲酰氯
summary.en: Catalog page 167: o-chlorobenzoyl chloride

text.zh: 易制毒（三）序25原列同时出现2916399021和2903120000；后者也出现在下一项二氯甲烷。已按原文保留，不能凭编纂者判断擅自修正；申报前复核归类及主管部门口径。
text.en: Drug Precursors (III), entry 25, lists both 2916399021 and 2903120000; the latter also appears in the following entry for dichloromethane. Both are retained as written and must not be corrected solely on the editor’s judgment; verify classification and the competent authority’s position before declaration.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 目录第166页：乙酸重复编号
title.en: Catalog page 166: repeated code for acetic acid

summary.zh: 目录第166页：乙酸重复编号
summary.en: Catalog page 166: repeated code for acetic acid

text.zh: 易制毒（三）序10同一海关商品编号2915219030重复出现。目录原列文字保留重复；反查索引按同一条目去重，不减少原项目。
text.en: Drug Precursors (III), entry 10, repeats customs commodity code 2915219030. The duplicate is retained in the Catalog source text; the reverse-lookup index deduplicates within the same entry without removing any original item.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 清单个别疑似错字
title.en: Apparent typographical errors in the Control List

summary.zh: 清单个别疑似错字
summary.en: Apparent typographical errors in the Control List

text.zh: 原文中的“弹花”“千电子福特”“吸收计量”等措辞已保留。涉及正式解释时回查官方文本；本表不擅改原文件内容。
text.en: Source expressions such as “munition flowers,” “kiloelectron Ford,” and “absorbed measurement” have been retained with source-wording notes. Consult the official text when a formal interpretation is needed; this workbook does not independently amend the source document.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 先选法律模块，再选语言
title.en: Choose the legal module, then the language

summary.zh: 先选法律模块，再选语言
summary.en: Choose the legal module, then the language

text.zh: 中国模块与美国模块各自独立；中文/英文仅切换同一模块的阅读语言。同一个产品可能需要分别完成两套审查。
text.en: The China and U.S. modules are separate legal systems. Chinese/English changes the reading language within a module. A product may require separate reviews under both systems.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 第1分钟：明确要查什么
title.en: Minute 1: define the search

summary.zh: 第1分钟：明确要查什么
summary.en: Minute 1: define the search

text.zh: 准备商品名称、型号、主要材料/成分、性能参数、软件/技术内容、交易方向、目的地及最终用户/用途。有编码先查编码；无编码先查功能或材料。
text.en: Prepare the item name, model, materials/composition, performance specifications, software/technology content, transaction direction, destination, and end user/use. Search a known code first; otherwise start with function or material.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 第2—3分钟：筛选候选条目
title.en: Minutes 2–3: find candidate entries

summary.zh: 第2—3分钟：筛选候选条目
summary.en: Minutes 2–3: find candidate entries

text.zh: 使用表头筛选箭头，按类别、物项类型、编码、名称、关键词筛选。Ctrl+F可改为搜索整个工作簿。命中只是候选结果；翻译名称和关键词不替代正式条文。
text.en: Use column filters for category, item group, code, name, and keywords. Ctrl+F can search the entire workbook. A match is only a candidate; translated names and keywords do not replace the governing text.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 第4—6分钟：核对完整条件
title.en: Minutes 4–6: read the complete criteria

summary.zh: 第4—6分钟：核对完整条件
summary.en: Minutes 4–6: read the complete criteria

text.zh: 打开条文/子项，连同上级条件、技术注释、定义、排除项及交叉引用一起读。核对“全部/任一”“且/或”、>与≥、单位、纯度及测试条件。
text.en: Open the provision/subitem and read its parent conditions, technical notes, definitions, exclusions, and cross-references. Check all/any, and/or, > versus ≥, units, purity, and test conditions.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 第7—10分钟：记录待查事项
title.en: Minutes 7–10: record what remains to be checked

summary.zh: 第7—10分钟：记录待查事项
summary.en: Minutes 7–10: record what remains to be checked

text.zh: 记录候选代码、命中子项、技术证据、未确认参数、目的地和用户/用途；完成各模块的交易审查后才能形成许可结论。找不到时扩大关键词并复核附件外规则。
text.en: Record the candidate code, relevant subparagraph, technical evidence, unknown specifications, destination, and end user/use. Complete the module-specific transaction review before reaching a licensing conclusion. If no match appears, broaden the search and check rules outside the attachments.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 美国第1步：EAR是否适用
title.en: U.S. step 1: establish EAR jurisdiction

summary.zh: 美国第1步：EAR是否适用
summary.en: U.S. step 1: establish EAR jurisdiction

text.zh: 先按Part 734判断物项/活动是否受EAR管辖，不能只看发货国或品牌国籍。美国境外物项可能涉及美国原产内容最低比例规则或外国直接产品规则，须按具体条件判断。
text.en: Determine whether the item/activity is subject to the EAR under Part 734. Shipment origin or brand nationality alone is insufficient. Items outside the United States may fall under de minimis or foreign-direct product rules, subject to their specific conditions.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 美国第2步：确定ECCN或EAR99
title.en: U.S. step 2: determine the ECCN or EAR99

summary.zh: 美国第2步：确定ECCN或EAR99
summary.en: U.S. step 2: determine the ECCN or EAR99

text.zh: 依附件4审查顺序、附件2通则、Part 772定义和具体条目确定ECCN及子项。只有受EAR管辖但不列入CCL的物项才使用EAR99；EAR99不是免证结论。
text.en: Use Supplement 4’s order of review, Supplement 2’s notes, Part 772 definitions, and the specific entry to determine the ECCN and subparagraph. EAR99 applies to items subject to the EAR but not listed on the CCL; it is not a no-license conclusion.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 美国第3步：管制原因与目的地
title.en: U.S. step 3: reasons for control and destination

summary.zh: 美国第3步：管制原因与目的地
summary.en: U.S. step 3: reasons for control and destination

text.zh: 读取适用于该子项的License Requirements，按所列Country Chart列号核对Part 738附件1；同时遵守条目中不依赖国家表的特别要求，并查Part 742。
text.en: Read the License Requirements applicable to the subparagraph and check the specified Country Chart columns in Supplement 1 to Part 738. Also apply entry-specific requirements that operate outside the chart and consult Part 742.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 美国第4步：交易主体和用途
title.en: U.S. step 4: parties and end use

summary.zh: 美国第4步：交易主体和用途
summary.en: U.S. step 4: parties and end use

text.zh: 查Part 744最终用户/用途限制及相关名单、Part 746禁运和专项管制，并结合Part 736一般禁止规定。Country Chart未标X、EAR99或民用用途均不能自动跳过这一步。
text.en: Check Part 744 end-user/end-use restrictions and relevant lists, Part 746 embargoes and special controls, and Part 736 general prohibitions. No Country Chart X, an EAR99 designation, or a civilian use does not eliminate this step.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 美国第5步：许可证例外或申请
title.en: U.S. step 5: license exception or application

summary.zh: 美国第5步：许可证例外或申请
summary.en: U.S. step 5: license exception or application

text.zh: 有许可要求时，再核对Part 740具体许可证例外全文、§740.2限制、目的地/用户条件及通知、报告、记录义务。满足全部适用条件才可使用；否则评估申请许可及审批政策。禁止交易须另行处理。
text.en: Where a license is required, check the full exception in Part 740, §740.2 restrictions, destination/user conditions, and notification, reporting, and recordkeeping duties. Use an exception only if all applicable conditions are met; otherwise assess licensing and review policy. Address prohibited transactions separately.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 语言与法律效力
title.en: Language and legal status

summary.zh: 语言与法律效力
summary.en: Language and legal status

text.zh: 中国中文和美国英文保留来源文本；跨语言译文为辅助阅读译文。最终分类应回到对应法域正式文本，重点复核译文中的逻辑连接词、否定词、专门定义及参数。
text.en: The Chinese source text for China and the English source text for the U.S. are retained. Cross-language translations are reading aids. Final classification should return to the governing jurisdiction’s text, especially logical operators, negatives, defined terms, and specifications.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 新增HTML实际覆盖范围
title.en: Actual scope of the added HTML

summary.zh: 新增HTML实际覆盖范围
summary.en: Actual scope of the added HTML

text.zh: HTML包含15 CFR §§774.1、774.2以及Part 774附件1—7：CCL、通用技术/软件注释、理解声明、审查顺序、0Y521临时列管表、敏感清单和特别敏感清单。
text.en: The HTML contains 15 CFR §§774.1 and 774.2 and Supplements 1–7 to Part 774: the CCL, General Technology/Software Notes, Statements of Understanding, Order of Review, 0Y521 entries, the Sensitive List, and the Very Sensitive List.

source.title: Workbook editorial guidance

title.zh: 不包含完整EAR
title.en: The HTML is not the entire EAR

summary.zh: 不包含完整EAR
summary.en: The HTML is not the entire EAR

text.zh: Part 734管辖规则、Part 738国家表、Part 740许可证例外全文/国家组别、Part 744名单及最终用途、Part 746禁运、Part 772定义等未在附件中完整提供。工作簿提供入口和解释，不声称已收录全部这些规则。
text.en: The attachment does not provide the full Part 734 jurisdiction rules, Part 738 Country Chart, Part 740 exceptions/country groups, Part 744 lists/end-use controls, Part 746 embargoes, or Part 772 definitions. The workbook provides guidance and links, not complete coverage of those rules.

title.zh: 9A005存在明确编辑缺口
title.en: Express editorial gap concerning 9A005

summary.en: Express editorial gap concerning 9A005

text.zh: HTML编辑注明示：88 FR 71936（2023年10月18日）修订9A005，但由于缺失文字未能编入。涉及9A005须回查该公告和后续更正；不得把当前展示文本标成无保留的完整现行规则。
